world.title: Allheaven Star System
world.introText: The cultivation families in the Allheaven Star System has similar classifications as in the Alliance Star System, but they focus more on history. Only long-lasting cultivation cultivation families can become an eternal existence in the Allheaven Star System.
world.history:
In the Allheaven Star System, the most common forces are the cultivation families on the main cultivation planets of the four different domains. There is not much difference in their strength, and three or four cultivation families exist on each planet.

Above these cultivation families were the four great families with inheritances from the Celestial Realm. They were the most powerful force in the Allheaven Star System on the surface. Tracing back to their roots, the ancestors of these four great families were all celestials in the Thunder Celestial Realm before its collapse, so their statuses were not ordinary.

Likewise, there were two more families above these four great families. They usually kept very low profiles, but they were the true powers in the Allheaven Star System.They had even older inheritances than the four families. These families existed in ancient times before the collapse of the Celestial Realm and had survived the collapse of the Celestial Realm. These families had inheritances from the ancient cultivation world, and there were six such families in the Allheaven Star System. The mysterious Ziang family on planet Dong Lin and Li Yuan’s family were among the six. However, after countless years, many of the families with inheritances from the ancient cultivation world had declined. The Li family was one example, and in addition to them, there were three more. Right now only two of these families remained!Just like how the Alliance System had a rank 9 cultivation planet, the Allheaven Star System also had a family that had survived even longer than that. This was a family that had been around since the primordial times.

The Primordial Cultivation Family was the true powerhouse of the Allheaven Star System, and it was extremely mysterious. To exist from the primordial times until today, that kind of power was terrifying. That meant that this family had experienced the evolution of cultivation from ancient times, experienced the collapse of the Celestial Realm, and experienced the creation of the Thunder Celestial Temple. They had experienced all the changes in the Allheaven Star System.
world.trivia:
The name Allheaven would later be used in Er Gen's 3rd novel series I Shall Seal The Heavens as the name of its main villain.
While from a meta standpoint it's not uncommon for authors to re-use/imagine old names and ideas, since all of Er Gen's books exist in a shared universe, a possible in story explanation for this Star System bearing the name could be that someone from the Seven Coloured Sect knew about Allheaven's existence.

The name is quite fitting when one recognises that Allheaven is the ruler of the Vast Expanse and his bloodline is very ancient and powerful "royal" blood and this Star System places strong emphasis on ancient and powerful bloodlines.

world.title: Ancient Celestial Realm
world.introText:
The Inner Realm's half of the Celestial Realm is where the Ancient Celestial Emperor is said to currently reside in closed door Cultivation, the reality however is that it is empty.
This Ancient Celestial Realm is currently closed off and inaccessible. The Lord of the Sealed Realm hails from here and is a servant of the Celestial Emperor.
It is filled with Ancient Clan bodies turned to stone who serve as Messengers of Heaven when needed, with a watery sphere for the Self Retribution at the middle, where the entrance is.
It is from here that Divine Retribution originates from and thus it opens its doors only to inflict Divine Retribution upon a Heaven Defying Cultivator.
This world has Nine Suns, like the Immortal Astral Continent, but each is just an instrument of Divine Retribution .

world.title: Ancient Demon City
world.introText: Ancient Demon City is a vast and historically significant city located in the northern part of the Sky Demon Country within the Demon Spirit Land. It serves as a strategic stronghold filled with dense demonic spiritual energy and ancient power. The city’s immense size and its mysterious, dangerous atmosphere make it one of the most important locations in the realm, deeply tied to both ancient demon spirits and the rise of powerful tribes such as the Soul Refining Tribe.
world.appearance:
Ancient Demon City is a vast and historically significant city located in the northern part of the Sky Demon Country within the Demon Spirit Land. It serves as a strategic stronghold filled with dense demonic spiritual energy and ancient power. The city’s immense size and its mysterious, dangerous atmosphere make it one of the most important locations in the realm, deeply tied to both ancient demon spirits and the rise of powerful tribes such as the Soul Refining Tribe.

It is immense in scale, so vast that one cannot see its end with a single glance. The city is filled with dense demonic spiritual energy and is heavily guarded by elite demon soldiers and spiritual formations.The city is governed by a demon general, a figure of great authority responsible for managing positions and internal affairs within the city. The northern gate serves as a major point of entry, bustling with guards, travelers, and traders from various tribes.At the city’s heart stands a magnificent palace that pierces the sky, crowned by a colossal statue of a powerful armored figure radiating an overwhelming demonic aura.
world.history:
Ancient Demon City is one of several great cities within the Sky Demon Country, a nation in the Demon Spirit Land a mysterious and perilous world imbued with demonic energy and ancient entities.The Demon Spirit Land itself is divided into nine countries, each guarded and influenced by a powerful ancient demon spirit that acts as both protector and symbol of its respective region. Ancient Demon City belongs to the Sky Demon Country, which houses one of these ancient demon spirits.

Each of the nine countries possesses its own ancient demon spirit, beings that evolve roughly every 100,000 years. These spirits are vital to maintaining the stability and strength of their lands. Ancient Demon City once served as the seat of the Demon General of the Left Wing, housing numerous powerful cultivators who practiced ancient demonic arts and specialized in manipulating demonic spiritual energy. The teachings of the ancient demon spirits shaped the tribes and magical systems throughout the Demon Spirit Land, influencing both its people and their cultivation paths.

Throughout history, Ancient Demon City and the surrounding regions have been key battlegrounds in the wars between the nine demon countries.Fierce conflicts between the Sky Demon Country and the Fire Demon Country devastated vast territories, repeatedly destroying and reshaping the city. During these wars, the powerful ancient demon known as Ancient Demon Bei Lou devoured other ancient demon spirits to strengthen himself, dramatically altering the balance of power within the land. Ancient Demon City was destroyed and rebuilt multiple times as a result of these catastrophic conflicts.

Over the ages, the Soul Refining Tribe rose to prominence, expanding its influence across the Demon Spirit Land. Through wars and alliances, it gained control over regions including Ancient Demon City and the territories bordering the Fire Demon Country.

world.title: Blue Pine Peaks
world.introText: It is a location in Heng Yue peaks, where contest with Xuan Dao Sect is held; 2 dan formation experts spend all their time here

world.title: Boundary Compass
world.introText: The Boundary Compass is the supreme treasure of the Reverse Dust Realm, controlling the four great laws of spacetime, realms, life and death, and karma. Its spirit is All-Seer, and it is the cornerstone of Wang Lin's revival of Li Muwan.

world.title: Brilliant Void Star System
world.introText: Brilliant Void Star System was the original name but later changed to "Alliance Star System" after the Cultivation Alliance rose to power.
world.history:
Brilliant Void Star System was the original name but later changed to "Alliance Star System" after the Cultivation Alliance rose to power.

The Rain Celestial Realm existed above it in the past.

world.title: Celestial Domain
world.introText: The Celestial Domain was created to combat the Inner Realm Sealing Formations ability to prevent the existence of Joss Flames. Its purpose was to provide Cultivators with an alternate route so they could eventually reach the 3rd Step.

world.title: Central Continent
world.introText: Due to the presence of two of the strongest Grand Empyreans in the Celestial Clan and the Dao Sect within its borders, even Grand Empyreans from the Ancient Clan would not dare to invade it.
world.appearance:
The Central Continent is the primary continent of the Celestial Clan and as such contains vast Celestial Energy that permeates throughout its borders. At the center of the continent is the Imperial City, whose majesty surpasses that of any of the Royal Capitals in the Ancient Clan.

The Imperial City is controlled directly by the Celestial Royal Family, specifically, the Celestial Emperor and by extension the Imperial Teacher. Despite this, powerful Celestials such as Jiu Di have a degree of autonomy and authority within it.

The Imperial City spans a large amount of territory, comparable to the size of a continent. It is divided into five quadrants, North, East, South, West, and Central. Each quadrant is ruled by a Mansion Family, with the exception of the central which houses the Imperial Palace and the Royal Family. There are also no mortals in the Imperial City as the Celestial Energy is so thick that it is impossible for them to live.

North - Li Mansion (Li Guang's Clan)

East - Meng Mansion

South - Luo Mansion

West - Shan Mansion

Central - Royal Family

Between the East and West quadrants is Mount Emperor, which is home to Grand Empyrean Jiu Di. Due to his presence, it is revered and respected by the Celestial Clan just as much as the Imperial Family.

world.title: Chaotic Broken Stars
world.introText: There was a mysterious force holding these shattered rocks in place. This 1000 foot wide area was what gave this place the name “Chaotic Broken Stars.”

world.title: Chu Country
world.introText: It is a Country where the Cloud Sky Sect is situated and which borders the Sea of Devils.

world.title: Cloud Sea Star System
world.introText: Unlike how Allheaven and the Alliance, which were divided into east, south, west, and north, the Cloud Sea wasn’t divided like that. The Cloud Sea made it difficult for cultivators to know the exact direction.
world.trivia:
The terms, Ghost, God and Demon would later be reused in Er Gen's third novel series I Shall Seal The Heavens as three of the Five Entities, missing only Devil and Immortal.
While from a meta standpoint, it's not uncommon for authors to reuse old concepts and names, since all of Er Gen's works share a universe, a possible explanation for these terms existing here is that someone from the Seven Coloured Sect knew about the legend of the Five Entities, indeed at this point in time the Ghost and Devil should both have existed and the eventual birth of The Immortal is a long spoken of prophesy the Ghost was well aware of.

Another possible explanation is that given Wang Lin himself is The God and is confirmed to have met and befriended The Devil, Su Ming, later on, he's the one who started using these terms of address to refer to them and was at least partly inspired to do so because of the existence of these three sects.

world.title: Core of The Cave World
world.introText: After the entrance lay a Furnace, and those who enter said Furnace will have their faces appear on it. This is the defense mechanism of the Cave World. Within the Furnace are a series of giant flowers, each serving a unique purpose, this is called the Five Flowers Eight Doors Formation.

world.title: Country of Zhao
world.introText: For a rank 3 cultivation country to become a rank 4 cultivation country, they need a Soul Formation cultivator that was born in that country. Rank 4 cultivation countries have a technique to verify this. This technique comes from Suzaku, so unless someone’s cultivation level is higher than the cultivators of Suzaku, it is very hard to fake.

world.title: East Demon Spirit Sea
world.introText: East Demon Spirit Sea (东海 妖灵之地 - Dōng hǎi yāo líng zhī dì) is the former cultivation cave of Celestial Emperor Qing Lin. In the past, it was known as the Celestial Spirit Heaven Realm. Now, it also called the Land of Demonic Spirits or Demon Spirit Land by its inhabitants due to the influence of the Ancient Demon inhabiting the land.

world.title: Empyrean Exalt Trial
world.introText: It is divided into 19 stages, the first 9 assess Empyrean Exalts while the 10th assesses whether or not one is worthy of being called an Ascendant Empyrean. As such, every trial up to ten has the practicing Celestial face a Starsystem that will hurl a number of planets at them. They must destroy these planets simultaneously, meaning they must prove they can combine enough spells to destroy those planets at once. At a certain level, golden planets, as tough as several, begin to appear. Finally, the tenth trial itself has 99 planets, which demands combining at least 99 spells to destroy. Because of this, it is commonly said only an Ascendant Empyrean can combine 100 or more spells.  Anyone who can pass the tenth stage is then bestowed the title of Ascendant Empyrean personally by the Celestial Ancestor's shadow, and their name is recorded on the Ascendant Empyrean List. The 11th to 19th Trials then are specifically for Ascendant Empyreans and pit them against the 72 entities that the Ancestor sealed to make the 72 Celestial Continents.

world.title: Fallen Land
world.introText: The area is known as a forbidden zone to the members if the union and they will often let criminals escape into it rather than pursue them.

world.title: Fire Demon Country
world.introText: The Fire Demon Country is one of the nine major countries within the Demon Spirit Land, a realm consumed by demonic power and ancient conflict. It has been embroiled in an extended and devastating war against its neighboring state, the Sky Demon Country, a conflict that has raged for nearly a century. The endless battles have left the land scarred—cities reduced to ruins, fields soaked in blood, and the air thick with death aura and demonic miasma, turning the entire country into a bleak and desolate battlefield.
world.appearance:
The Fire Demon Country is one of the nine major countries within the Demon Spirit Land, a realm consumed by demonic power and ancient conflict. It has been embroiled in an extended and devastating war against its neighboring state, the Sky Demon Country, a conflict that has raged for nearly a century. The endless battles have left the land scarred—cities reduced to ruins, fields soaked in blood, and the air thick with death aura and demonic miasma, turning the entire country into a bleak and desolate battlefield.

The capital city of the Fire Demon Country now lies mostly deserted. Even the Demon Emperor has personally entered the frontlines, leaving behind a silent capital enveloped in dense demonic energy and death fog. The ancient demon of the Fire Demon Country, much like its counterpart in the Sky Demon Country, has sealed the capital with a powerful formation, restricting access except to the Demon Valley, the sacred and mysterious region at the city’s heart.

Amid the chaos, the Soul Refining Tribe—a ruthless and power-hungry faction—rose to prominence. Exploiting the weakened state of the Fire Demon Country, the tribe expanded rapidly through warfare and soul absorption, using soul fragments and forbidden refining arts to strengthen themselves. After centuries of bloodshed, they became a dominant force, even surrounding the Fire Demon capital itself. Their leaders possess formidable spiritual might, and their rise has dramatically shifted the balance of power across the Demon Spirit Land.

world.title: Foreign Battleground
world.introText: The Foreign Battleground was originally a fragment of a door that led from the cave world to the Immortal Astral Continent, it was however destroyed and one of its fragments became its own world.
world.history:
The Foreign Battleground was originally a fragment of a door that led from the cave world to the Immortal Astral Continent, it was however destroyed and one of its fragments became its own world.

Planet Suzaku itself wouldn't exist without these Battleground.

As time passed Cultivators started using the dimension to fight and gather resources.

The battleground is split into three known layers:

The First Layer is shown to be a place where Cultivators compete and kill each othe for resources, it was regularly maintained by many sects.

The Second Layer is shown to be filled with corpses and Soul Devourers, the latter of whom are known to divide up their territory.

The Third Layer is infinity larger than the second, which itself is much larger than the First Layer. It is shown to be filled with the corpses of Celestial Clan members.

world.title: Forest Ruins
world.introText: the forest surrounding the city is home to a powerful fog. There are many dangers hidden within this fog, most noteably is the immature growth of "Blue Line Vines" located therein. These vines are particularly deadly as noted by Situ Nan, a mature one is known to have the power to intimidate Soul Formation level Cultivators and at least one Rank 2 country was utterly annihilated by one in the past. Should they sense blood or Qi, they will attack to envelop their target and devour it alive. They also utilise a potent acid that even the Teng Fanily's Golden Armour can be dissolved by.

world.title: Ghost Eye City
world.introText: Three Chen Brothers took the security job of securing the Ghost Eye City during the period when its auction took place.
world.history:
Three Chen Brothers took the security job of securing the Ghost Eye City during the period when its auction took place.

It was most likely destroyed due to the battle between Wang Lin and All-Seer and grey-robed All-Seer and Ling Tianhou that took place here.

world.title: Green Devil Continent
world.introText: The continent was allegedly created when the Celestial Ancestor sealed the Green Devil Scorpion that practiced Water based cultivation and used his imprisoned origin soul to birth celestial energy into the continent to allow cultivators to thrive on the continent.

world.title: Heavenly Bull Continent
world.introText: The continent was allegedly created when the Celestial Ancestor sealed the Heavenly Bull that practiced Ice based cultivation and used his imprisoned origin soul to birth celestial energy into the continent to allow cultivators to thrive on the continent.

world.title: Heng Yue Sect
world.introText: Heng Yue Sect is the first sect Wang Lin joins at the start of the novel. In the end, the land of the Zheng Yue Sect was taken over by Xuan Dao Sect. Some disciples chose to join Xuan Dao Sect, while some chose to not to join and left.

world.title: Hou Fen
world.introText: The rank 3 cultivation country, Hou Fen, was at the southern part of planet Suzaku and was to the south of the Sea of Devils.
world.history: Because Wang Lin's Heaven Defying Bead absorbed the Main body of the fire spiritual beast, all of the beast's "children" caused massive chaos in Hou Fen, resulting in the area no longer having viable spiritual energy. The Nascent Soul realm experts of the four main sects tried to use a country sealing array to seal the beast in the volcanic range, but they failed which resulted in the cultivators of Hou Fen waging war with the country of Xuan Wu.

world.title: Immortal Astral Continent
world.introText: The Immortal Astral Continent is stated to be one of the countless continents inhabiting The World of Renegade Immortal. In terms of size, its proportions are indescribably massive. In fact, it is said to be so large that the Cave World created by the Seven-Colored Celestial Sovereign wouldn't even be equal to 1/10,000th the size even if the Inner Realm and Outer Realm were considered together.

world.title: Lightning Celestial Realm
world.introText: The Lightning Celestial Realm is one of the four ancient Celestial Realms, alongside the Wind, Rain, and Thunder Celestial Realms. It originated from the Ancient Celestial Realm, which was shattered in a catastrophic event long ago. Unlike some of the other realms, the Lightning Celestial Realm remains relatively intact and serves a unique protective role for the newly reformed Celestial Realm created by Wang Lin. The realm is associated with the Summoned River star system.
world.appearance:
The Lightning Celestial Realm is one of the four ancient Celestial Realms, alongside the Wind, Rain, and Thunder Celestial Realms. It originated from the Ancient Celestial Realm, which was shattered in a catastrophic event long ago. Unlike some of the other realms, the Lightning Celestial Realm remains relatively intact and serves a unique protective role for the newly reformed Celestial Realm created by Wang Lin. The realm is associated with the Summoned River star system.

The realm is visually represented as a vast, luminous silver river flowing through space. This “silver river” consists of countless small fragments of light, forming an eternal, flowing reflection that distinguishes it from other celestial realms. Its brilliance and beauty make it a striking and iconic part of the celestial map. The realm also serves as a protective boundary, enclosing and safeguarding the continent of the new Celestial Realm.

world.title: Meng Earth Continent
world.introText: The continent was allegedly created when the Celestial Ancestor sealed a foreign Cultivator named Meng, who practiced Earth based Cultivation.
world.history: The continent was allegedly created when the Celestial Ancestor sealed a foreign Cultivator named Meng, who practiced Earth based Cultivation.

world.title: Northern Continent
world.introText: Not much is known about the Northern Continent, other than the fact that it is under the control and rule of Grand Empyrean Wu Feng.

world.title: Outer Realm
world.introText: The Ancient Primordial Star System, also called the Outer Realm, is the immense star system that contrasts the much smaller Inner Realm of Wang Lin's Cave World.
world.appearance:
The star system is incomparably massive compared to the four inner realm star systems.

There are seven major clans inhabiting the system as its top authorities. There are countless clans in the Ancient Star System and each one has a symbol on their forehead related to their power. This mark is what they cultivate in place of the Inner Realm's Domains and Celestial Realm's method, it is their inheritance, therefore a power given by a source or ancestor, such as the Scatter Thunder Clan's Eternal Thunder.

The leading organisation is the Sovereign Union, which is led by the Sovereign.

Many clans, such as the Moon Devourer Clan, claim to be from something called the Immemorial Celestial Clan.

The realm is connected to the Inner Realm via several Seven Coloured Realms which were constructed by The Lord of The Sealed Realm yet usurped later by the Sovereign to serve his goals. These Realms contain a seven coloured light and they realm seem to have a mysterious connection to the All Seer.

They sealed the Inner Realm using The Sealed Realm Formation long ago and mockingly regard those within as though they are the heavens. The main purpose of this formation is to prevent Joss Flames from forming, thus preventing Third Step Cultivators from emerging. For this reason third step cultivators are only a handful in number within the Inner Realm, but they are numerous here. The Inner Realm's four Celestial Realms were constructed to combat this effect.

This realm is also part of the Cave World, just the outer circumference of it.

Each of the 7 major clans excluding the Scatter Thunder Clan are implied to have 3rd step Cultivators.

There is a largely criminal region reigned over by the Great Emperor called the Fallen Land. This region nominates 5 elders whose positions periodically change and it deals in the exchange of dark items such as puppets refined from Cultivators. The Sovereign Union is scared enough of this region to let criminals get away and even one of the Five Masters was said to have been forced to retreat from here in the past.
world.trivia:
The way they are made up of clans over sects and have a large scale organisation unifying them makes them similar to the Allheaven and Alliance Star Systems if the two were one in the same.

Ancient God Tu Si was born here.

While most powerful Third Step Cultivators note Joss Flames are necessary to reach said step, The Silver Corpse implies otherwise, in fact calling Joss Flames "a great heavenly scam."

world.title: Peng Lai
world.introText: The size of Peng Lai is at least a dozen times larger than Mo Luo. It is more appropriate to call it a half a cultivation planet.

world.title: Planet Da Lou
world.introText: Planet Dao Lou was refined as a sword by Master Void Spirit of the Brilliant Void Cultivation Sect. Due to an incident, the illusionary planet collapsed, and planet Da Lou is a fragment from the collapsed planet.

world.title: Planet Dong Lin
world.introText: The Xiang family was the secret ruler of planet Dong Ling, but they rarely showed their faces. Even the cultivators of Allheaven didn’t know this, they only knew that there were three big families on planet Dong Ling!

world.title: Planet Five Elements
world.introText: Planet Five Elements is a planet in the Alliance Star System.

world.title: Planet Qing Ling
world.introText: It is filled with vitality, so it mean that there are a lot of mortals living there. The reason Wang Lin choses this place was because it was very similar to planet Suzaku.

world.title: Planet Ran Yun
world.introText: This was the first planet he visited in this new star system after saving Ran Yue, Sun Xueshan and a few other people from a horde of insects that were pursuing them.
world.appearance: A blue planet appeared before Wang Lin. It seemed like oceans occupied most of the planet. From far away, planet Ran Yun was very beautiful. It gave off dense spiritual energy that nourished everything.

world.title: Planet Suzaku
world.introText: Planet Zhuque or Vermillion Bird Planet is the name of the planet where Wang Lin was born. There were only four Ascendant cultivators on Zhuque. Two of them were at the early stage, one was at the mid stage, and the last one, the one who inherited the name Zhuque, was at the late stage.
world.history:
Many years after the war, under the rule of Zhu Quezi, Planet Zhuque had become stagnant due to the country of Zhuque suppressing any Rank 5 country that even came close to attaining Rank 6. This inner conflict resulted in a cold war between Mount Zhuque and the other Rank 5 countries.

This finally resulted in war as Mount Zhuque waged war against the Soul Refining Sect and Giant Demon Clan and the three Rank 5 countries. In the midst of the war, the survivors of the Forsaken Immortal Clan led by Yun Quezi who had been biding his time for centuries also launched a war against Mount Zhuque.

Mount Zhuque, Holy Land of Zhuque, Title of Zhuque.

It originally belongs to the faction of the Four Divine Sect as its status is like a distant branch of the Four Divine Sect. The first generation Zhuque was rumored to have come from the Four Divine Planet.

Planet Zhuque is one of the Four Ancestral Planet of the Four Divine Sect, the Vermillion Bird Sect. It's said to have one Ancestral Planet for each Four Sect and Star System. The Four Ancestral Planet are the Gate to the Outer Realm and Inner Realm.

world.title: Planet Thousand Illusion
world.introText: Planet Thousand Illusion is a significant location with a complex background and powerful families. It is part of the Allheaven Star System’s northern domain and is protected by three major cultivation families: Qian, Huan, and Xu. Among these, the Qian family is the largest and most powerful, controlling the northern and eastern regions with three Second Step cultivators. The Huan family is second in both size and strength, with two Second Step cultivators—one being the current ancestor and the other having died thousands of years ago. The Huan family lineage traces back to a Celestial from the Thunder Celestial Realm, and they possess an inherited celestial treasure as well as a family-protection jade containing a celestial spell. The Xu family is mysterious and feared by the other two families, possibly linked to a famous family on Planet Dong Lin.
world.appearance:
Planet Thousand Illusion is a significant location with a complex background and powerful families. It is part of the Allheaven Star System’s northern domain and is protected by three major cultivation families: Qian, Huan, and Xu. Among these, the Qian family is the largest and most powerful, controlling the northern and eastern regions with three Second Step cultivators. The Huan family is second in both size and strength, with two Second Step cultivators—one being the current ancestor and the other having died thousands of years ago. The Huan family lineage traces back to a Celestial from the Thunder Celestial Realm, and they possess an inherited celestial treasure as well as a family-protection jade containing a celestial spell. The Xu family is mysterious and feared by the other two families, possibly linked to a famous family on Planet Dong Lin.

The planet itself contains a powerful spiritual energy system. Wang Lin used a method to transform all the spiritual energy on the planet into celestial spiritual energy, causing a temporary depletion of ordinary spiritual energy. He then extracts the planet’s soul—a profound and ancient aura formed over countless years. This extraction causes the planet to tremble, spirit veins to collapse, and shockwaves to spread, resulting in severe damage.

world.title: Planet Tian Yun
world.introText: This planet was far too large; it was tens of times the size of planet Suzaku, and with a planet this big, it would naturally have more mortals.

world.title: Planet Yun Xia
world.introText: There were no cultivators on the planet because it contained poison that could kill any cultivator.

world.title: Rain Celestial Realm
world.introText: The Rain Celestial Realm is one of the four ancient Celestial Realms, alongside the Wind, Thunder, and Lightning Celestial Realms. Originating from the Ancient Celestial Realm, it was fractured and damaged by the catastrophic collapse of that original domain. Despite its fragmented and unstable condition, the Rain Celestial Realm remains a crucial site for cultivation, celestial activities, and the study of elemental laws associated with rain and storms.
world.appearance:
The Rain Celestial Realm is one of the four ancient Celestial Realms, alongside the Wind, Thunder, and Lightning Celestial Realms. Originating from the Ancient Celestial Realm, it was fractured and damaged by the catastrophic collapse of that original domain. Despite its fragmented and unstable condition, the Rain Celestial Realm remains a crucial site for cultivation, celestial activities, and the study of elemental laws associated with rain and storms.

This realm is linked to one of the legendary Celestial Doors, ancient gateways to the Ancient Celestial Realm whose origins remain mysterious. The Rain Celestial Realm contains celestial spiritual energy purer than ordinary spiritual energy but weaker than true cultivation energy, which is used to open the Celestial Gate and support specialized cultivation techniques. The realm resides within the Brilliant Void star system, later referred to as the “Alliance,” and continues to serve as a hub for powerful cultivators seeking lost treasures and ancient spells.

The realm is highly fragmented, with numerous floating landmasses and platforms that remain from its former unified territory. Its environment is dominated by perpetual rain, clouds, and storms, which shape rivers, mud, and local flora and fauna. The realm also contains ancient formations and structures such as celestial temples, altars, and relics of its former grandeur. Spatial cracks and tremors persist, signaling ongoing instability and making exploration perilous but rewarding due to the potent energy present in these zones.
world.personality: The Rain Celestial Realm is one of the Four Great Celestial Realms, each associated with different star systems: Wind (Cloud Sea), Rain (Brilliant Void/Alliance), Thunder (Allheaven), and Lightning (Summoned River). These realms occasionally interact, particularly when ancient celestial gateways open, drawing cultivators from across star systems to compete for resources and power.

world.title: Rank 5 Region
world.introText: The average cultivation level of a high-level member of a rank 5 sect is usually at the early-stage of Nirvana Shatterer with the strongest member at most reaching the mid-stage of Nirvana Shatterer.

world.title: Rank 8 Region
world.introText: Every 1,000 years all rank 8 sects hold a competition where all their rank 5 branch sects compete for supremacy. If any sect comes last place two times in a row then that sect is disbanded and its members scattered to other rank 5 branch sects. Afterwards, the rank 8 main sect decides on a few people to form a new rank 5 branch sect. This ensures that the rank 8 sects would continue to rise in strength, until one day, all their branch sects would grow to be very powerful and they were granted the status of a rank 9 sect by the God Sect.
world.history: 18,000 years ago in the Cloud Sea, every single rank 8 sect allied against the Heaven Breaking Sect after they heard news regarding the treasures Sima Mo and his companions found from the Seven-Colored Realm.

world.title: Rank 9 Region
world.introText: All sects in the rank 9 region reside on cultivation planets which are a rarity across the entire Cloud Sea.
world.history:
There are a total of four sects in the rank 9 region, namely the God Sect, the Ghost Sect, the Demon Sect, and the Heaven Breaking Sect. The Heaven Breaking Sect is the weakest, while the God Sect is the strongest. The Ghost Sect is the most mysterious. The Demon Sect is the most deadly.

A long time ago, there was only one sect in the rank 9 region of the Cloud Sea. It was the God Sect.

After the God Sect had ruled the Cloud Sea for countless years, the first outbreak of fierce beasts occurred. Among them, there were three fierce beasts with human form that were said to have come from another star system.

Without the God Sect, this outbreak of fierce beasts would have spread across the entire Cloud Sea. In the end, it was stopped by the God Sect, so it didn’t spread. That war was said to have brought heavy casualties. After suppressing the fierce beasts, the God Sect sent out a group of people to be stationed in the depths of the rank 9 region. There is crack in space there that links to a mysterious star system. Some extremely powerful beasts came from there. In order to stop the fierce beasts from spreading, battles broke out there for tens of thousands of years. Even now, the fight continues.

A part of the God Sect gave up their freedom and remained deep within the rank 9 region, acting as the first line of defense. However, as time passed, these God Sect disciples became independent and started calling themselves the Demon Sect. They stopped taking orders from the God Sect, but they still defended that position from waves of fierce beast attacks.

The God Sect dreaded the Demon Sect and the invading fierce beasts so they first helped promote the Ghost Sect, who are good at using soul capture spells, into a rank 9 sect. Then they raised the Heaven Breaking Sect into rank 9 as well. All of this was to prepare for the second outbreak that could happen at any time.

world.title: Sea of Devils
world.introText: The Sea of Devils was like a piece of ice, It was full of Yin Energy. Has 999 cities in total, and the outer rim of the Sea alone is 1 million kilometer in radius. The Sea of Devils was the size of several thousand Hou Fens.
world.appearance:
The entire Sea of Devils was filled with fog, so it’s more accurate to say that it’s a fog sea. The creatures living in the Sea of Devils have adapted to survive in this fog too. At the same time, because of the the special fog of the Sea of Devils, the fog becomes seawater for one month out of the year.  Due to the harsh landscape, resources are very lacking, there are very few spirit veins, and killing people is very common. All of this caused the Sea of Devils to become a gathering point for Demonic Cultivators. Even criminals from high ranking cultivation countries being hunted by their countries escape to the Sea of Devils. The name Sea of Devils comes from this. As for its real name, no one remembers it. The Sea of Devils is a very messy and chaotic place. Very few non-demonic cultivators are willing to enter that place.

The Sea of Devils was very large, and it was basically a big hole. It wouldn’t be wrong to call the Sea of Devils a giant basin, only this basin had many mountain ranges within it. There weren’t any trees, but there were many strange plants. If one were to check their ancestry, they would find that these plants would trace all the way back to ancient sea plant life.

The Sea of Devils is composed of the Inner Sea area and the Outer Sea area, separated by a Red Fog and stop cultivator to pass safely. Even Nascent Soul cultivator have trouble to cross it, the only way is to wait until the Sea of Devils' fog become water to cross it.
world.history: The Sea of Devils is not a real sea. Back in ancient times, the sea was evaporated by a very powerful cultivator to kill his enemy.

world.title: Sealed Realm
world.introText: By the time of the 100 year war with the Outer Realm, the Sealed Realm had around 500,000 Cultivators ready for battle from all four star systems, 97 years later, near the end of the war, they had just 50,000 and only 19 Cultivation Planets.

world.title: Seven-Colored Realm
world.introText: It is home to the Lost Ones and the Enlightened Ones.

world.title: Seven-Colored Sect's Cave World
world.introText: The Cave World is the overall setting of the majority of Renegade Immortal. It spans and encompasses all five Star Systems which make up the Sealed and Outer Realms as well as the former's false Celestial Domain and the true Ancient Celestial Realm.
world.history: It became Wang Lin's Cave World after he defeated everyone here and left for the Immortal Astral Continent and later became a Heaven-Trampling cultivator.

world.title: Sky Demon City
world.introText: Sky Demon City is the capital of the Sky Demon Country, located in the northern part of the Demon Spirit Land. It is surrounded by countless intersecting mountains that, when viewed from above, resemble nine dragons coiling protectively around the city. Each dragon head points toward Dragon Lake, a secluded and heavily guarded body of water that houses the Ancient Demon Temple, the holy symbol of the Sky Demon Country. The city itself lies directly in front of this sacred lake, reinforcing its spiritual and strategic importance.
world.appearance:
Sky Demon City is the capital of the Sky Demon Country, located in the northern part of the Demon Spirit Land. It is surrounded by countless intersecting mountains that, when viewed from above, resemble nine dragons coiling protectively around the city. Each dragon head points toward Dragon Lake, a secluded and heavily guarded body of water that houses the Ancient Demon Temple, the holy symbol of the Sky Demon Country. The city itself lies directly in front of this sacred lake, reinforcing its spiritual and strategic importance.

More precisely, Sky Demon City is composed of nine cities of similar size to Ancient Demon City, arranged in the shape of an eight divinatory trigram with the royal palace at the center. The palace is encircled by a river and linked to the surrounding cities by eight bridges. Within the palace, the Demon Emperor resides among exquisite pavilions, while each of the eight outer cities displays its own distinct architectural style.

The city is often shrouded in a faint green mist known as dragon energy, emanating from the surrounding mountain ranges. Cultivators believe this energy enhances cultivation, and from a distance, the city appears like a colossal beast awakening as the mist disperses with the dawn of daily life.

Sky Demon City is also a hub of transportation and military logistics. Outside its walls stand 18 transfer arrays, guarded year-round by demon soldiers. Eight are designated for civilians such as merchants, while ten are reserved for individuals of high status. The 14th transfer array is exclusively for demon generals, whose activation summons these powerful figures—commanders of vast armies and wielders of formidable spells.

Politically and militarily, the city is unmatched. It houses eight commander-in-chiefs and eight vice commander-in-chiefs, deployed during wartime under the direct leadership of the Demon Emperor himself. The imperial square near the Sky Demon Gate serves as the venue for major events such as the demon general competition. This ten-thousand-foot square is protected by powerful formations to prevent destruction, with seating arranged hierarchically: the Demon Emperor at the top, multi-tiered sections for commanders, and expansive areas for officials and spectators. The atmosphere during these competitions is tense, filled with speculation and anticipation as cultivators and generals vie for supremacy.

A defining feature of the imperial city is the Sky Demon Drum, a colossal war drum used only for sacred purposes—worshiping ancestors, opening Dragon Lake, or marking significant events. Its thunderous strikes reverberate across the city, awakening its inhabitants and signaling moments of great importance. The drum has played pivotal roles in extraordinary events, such as when Wang Lin activated it to unleash immense power and defy the heavens, engulfing the city in celestial and demonic energies.

Sky Demon City has endured catastrophic trials. The Emperor’s sword once acted autonomously, soaring through the skies to attack parts of the city, forcing demon generals to intervene. Divine punishments have also struck, including the descent of the heavens’ might, which crushed the city into a deep basin. Though devastated, the city was rebuilt over time, restoring its grandeur and reinforcing its resilience. In recent history, it has been the center of large-scale conflicts, particularly the war between the Sky Demon Country and the Fire Demon Country. Despite heavy losses, the city remains a symbol of strength, with the Demon Emperor and his generals actively leading its defense.

Today, Sky Demon City stands as a vast, fortified metropolis—an epicenter of political authority, military might, and spiritual reverence. It is alive with the presence of demon generals, commanders, cultivators, and officials, its history marked by divine trials, legendary artifacts, and the unyielding will of its people. More than a capital, it is the beating heart of the Sky Demon Country, embodying its glory, resilience, and power

world.title: Sky Demon Country
world.introText: "In the Sky Demon Country, there is the Demon King Kun Xu. Below him are the eight great Demon Generals, 10 million demon soldiers, and more than 100 cities. That is the power of one country!"
world.appearance:
The Sky Demon Country is one of the nine great countries of the Demon Spirit Land, standing out as one of the most militarized, disciplined, and fearsome powers in the region. Unlike ordinary cultivation lands where individuals pursue strength independently, the Sky Demon Country operates almost entirely under a military-based system, where personal cultivation, political status, and survival are inseparably tied to military rank and command. Cultivators who enter the Demon Spirit Land must affiliate themselves with one of the nine countries, and without commanding troops or holding military status, even powerful individuals find it nearly impossible to survive long-term. This structure emphasizes collective strength, formations, and large-scale warfare over lone heroics.

At the heart of the Sky Demon Country lies its capital, Sky Demon City, a massive and awe-inspiring metropolis designed with both strategic and mystical intent. The capital is composed of nine interconnected cities arranged in the pattern of an eight divinatory trigram, with the royal palace positioned at the exact center. A river encircles the palace, crossed by eight bridges that connect it to the surrounding cities, symbolizing both control and balance. The entire city is permeated by a faint green mist known as dragon energy, a natural phenomenon that subtly enhances cultivation and reinforces the city’s status as a sacred and strategic stronghold.

Sky Demon City is protected by an extraordinary defensive system. Eighteen transfer arrays are positioned around the capital, each heavily guarded by demon soldiers and strictly regulated according to rank. Only ten of these arrays are accessible to high-status figures such as demon generals, vice commander-in-chiefs, and commander-in-chiefs, while ordinary cultivators are restricted to lower-tier arrays. This rigid separation of access reinforces the strict class hierarchy of the Sky Demon Country and ensures that authority is visibly and spatially enforced at all times.

The military structure of the Sky Demon Country is its defining feature. At the base are countless demon soldiers, forming massive armies capable of executing large-scale formations that overwhelm even powerful lone cultivators. Above them are hundreds of demon generals, each commanding significant forces and wielding formidable cultivation and combat techniques. Demon generals are not merely officers but battlefield elites whose strength can influence the outcome of regional conflicts. However, even they are bound by strict military law—open life-and-death battles between demon generals are forbidden, and conflicts are instead resolved through political maneuvering, competitions, or sanctioned engagements.

Above the demon generals stand the eight vice commander-in-chiefs, elite figures considered the immediate successors to the commander-in-chiefs. Their authority is immense, and only vice commander-in-chiefs are permitted to challenge commander-in-chiefs for their positions. Every three hundred years, the Sky Demon Country holds a grand demon general competition, where demon generals fight for promotion into vice commander-in-chief positions. These competitions are not merely tests of strength but intense political events, involving alliances, secret assassinations of helpers, and strategic manipulation, reflecting the brutal yet regulated nature of the demon military system.

At the highest military level are the eight commander-in-chiefs, who each oversee vast portions of the army and directly answer to the supreme ruler. Above them stands the Demon Emperor, who personally commands the Sky Demon Country during major wars. Unlike symbolic rulers, the Demon Emperor takes to the battlefield himself, embodying the Sky Demon Country’s belief that authority must be backed by overwhelming personal power. During large-scale conflicts, such as the war against the Fire Demon Country, the Sky Demon Country has mobilized armies numbering thirty million demon soldiers, launching multi-directional invasions that devastate entire regions over decades of sustained warfare.

The Sky Demon Country enforces strict military law, which governs not only soldiers but all cultivators within its territory. A lone cultivator who kills too many demon soldiers will inevitably draw the attention of demon generals and eventually commander-in-chiefs, making survival nearly impossible. Formations, numbers, and coordinated tactics dominate warfare, ensuring that individual strength alone rarely determines outcomes. This system discourages reckless slaughter and reinforces obedience to the country’s authority.

In addition to its military might, the Sky Demon Country possesses ancient sacred locations and artifacts that further solidify its dominance. Dragon Lake, located near the capital, houses the Ancient Demon Temple, a sacred site tied to the origins and faith of the demon race. The imperial palace also contains relics of immense power, such as the Emperor’s sword, whose movements alone can cause panic among high-ranking officials. These ancient elements reflect the deep historical roots of the Sky Demon Country and its connection to primordial demonic forces.

The country’s recent history has been marked by prolonged warfare, internal tension, and divine retribution events tied to the Dao of the heavens. Despite suffering losses and upheaval, the Sky Demon Country has maintained its military dominance and structural integrity. Specialized forces and tribes, such as the Soul Refining Tribe, further enhance its power through unique cultivation methods involving soul fragments and large-scale soul formations, making them feared by both allies and enemies alike.

world.title: Southern Continent
world.introText: It is also the location of the Dao Yi Sect, which had many of its high-ranking members killed in an attempt to stop the Celestial Ancestor's curse from killing their leader Grand Empyrean Dao Yi.

world.title: Summoned River Star System
world.introText: Summoned River is the Star System that resides beneath the Lightning Celestial Realm.

world.title: The Valley
world.introText: A village with a strong formation protecting it. After Wang Lin broke the array, he helped the inhabitants by giving them the Soul Refining Sect Techniques such as Soul Refining, Soul Extracting and the method to create soul flags. But he did let a flaw in the way of making the flags so that he could just take them back if there is any problem and that without even needing to refine them. To say it all, this village is the starting point for the New Soul Refining Sect Wang Lin promises to Du Tian.

world.title: Thunder Celestial Realm
world.introText: The Thunder Celestial Realm is one of the four major celestial realms, alongside the Wind, Rain, and Lightning Celestial Realms. Located within the Allheaven Star System, it is significantly larger and better preserved than the Rain Celestial Realm, though it has suffered considerable collapse and fragmentation over time. Once the core of celestial might, the realm housed ancient celestial palaces and immense spiritual energy, but now only remnants and ruins remain due to catastrophic battles and natural collapses. The realm remains unstable, with spatial cracks threatening further destruction at any moment.
world.appearance:
The Thunder Celestial Realm is one of the four major celestial realms, alongside the Wind, Rain, and Lightning Celestial Realms. Located within the Allheaven Star System, it is significantly larger and better preserved than the Rain Celestial Realm, though it has suffered considerable collapse and fragmentation over time. Once the core of celestial might, the realm housed ancient celestial palaces and immense spiritual energy, but now only remnants and ruins remain due to catastrophic battles and natural collapses. The realm remains unstable, with spatial cracks threatening further destruction at any moment.

The realm’s structure is highly fragmented, with at least 49 major pieces of land floating in the void, connected by “thunder chains”—strands of thunder that maintain cohesion among the fragments. Central to the realm is the “Imperial Capital,” once the core and closest to the Ancient Celestial Realm before the collapse. Other notable locations include thunder lakes, thunder mountains, and areas dense with origin energy, which have become hotspots for cultivation and battles. The Celestial Spirit Heaven Realm and structures such as the Thunder Celestial Temple remain, featuring vast halls and powerful restrictions to protect the realm’s secrets.

Filled with dense thunder and origin energy, the Thunder Celestial Realm is ideal for cultivating thunder origin spells. The ambient thunder is far more potent than that within most cultivators’ bodies, requiring special methods or constitutions to absorb safely. The realm contains numerous treasures, including celestial jades, origin tools, pills, spells, and at least eight intact celestial corpses, all highly coveted for their cultivation benefits.

Entry to the realm requires a thunder furnace, a rare artifact usually distributed by the Thunder Celestial Temple according to strict quotas. These furnaces are nearly indestructible, though Wang Lin is recorded as the first person to crack one, permanently reducing the number of available entry spots. When the realm opens, celestial thunder descends as a guide, allowing furnace holders to enter.

The Thunder Celestial Temple is the realm’s strongest public authority, controlling access and safeguarding its power. Comprising 1,372 main halls taken directly from the realm itself, the temple is protected by a clone of the thunder spirit. Temple messengers, riding Thunder Beasts and wielding origin energy thunder spells, enforce its authority. The temple also organizes celestial title competitions, granting cultivators both status and access to powerful spells taught by Celestial Lord Qing Shui.

Throughout its history, the realm has endured repeated collapses, with spatial cracks causing widespread destruction. It has been the site of fierce battles involving life-and-death struggles, Thunder Beasts, and devastating origin energy attacks. Master Flamespark, a prominent figure, claimed most remaining fragments, leaving only smaller sections intact. The realm’s celestial gate, formed from the souls of celestials after its collapse, was taken by Wang Lin, while a massive thunder spirit and thunder lake continue to exert overwhelming power over the area.

Historically, the Thunder Celestial Realm served as a central power of the Ancient Celestial Realm, and its fall marked a major shift in the cultivation world. Its connection to ancient celestial legacies draws cultivators seeking lost treasures and spells. Despite its collapse, it remains a battleground and a symbol of power within the Allheaven Star System, often intersecting with conflicts involving the Alliance Star System.

world.title: Wang Ancestral City
world.introText: Wang Lin birth village. Later on, a great city was built up around the graves and old houses of the former village.

world.title: Wang Lin's Celestial Realm
world.introText: Wang Lin took the land from the Wind Celestial Realm, expanded it with the dust left behind in the Rain Celestial Realm after Qing Lin reconstructed it, and then used the silver sea of the Lightning Celestial Realm to create a boundary that only Cultivators at the Soul Formation stage can cross. After that he connected this realm to his Unnamed Wheel Formation to ensure that the Joss Flames and Celestial energy from the Outer Realm is sent here. The cultivators of the Sealed Realm then took pieces from the planet souls all over the Sealed Realm to create a connection so that Soul Formation Cultivators could be sent here upon breaking through their peak.
world.history:
Wang Lin took the land from the Wind Celestial Realm, expanded it with the dust left behind in the Rain Celestial Realm after Qing Lin reconstructed it, and then used the silver sea of the Lightning Celestial Realm to create a boundary that only Cultivators at the Soul Formation stage can cross. After that he connected this realm to his Unnamed Wheel Formation to ensure that the Joss Flames and Celestial energy from the Outer Realm is sent here. The cultivators of the Sealed Realm then took pieces from the planet souls all over the Sealed Realm to create a connection so that Soul Formation Cultivators could be sent here upon breaking through their peak.

This world was created to strengthen the Sealed Realm and Wang Lin asked Situ Nan to pass down the truth that they're living in a cave world both here and on every planet in the Sealed Realm for future generations as an insurance policy in the event that he fails to defeat the Seven Dao Sect. After defeating the Seven Dao Sect, Wang Lin forcefully reincarnated the Third Step Outer Realm Cultivators onto the Immortal Astral Continent, and then sealed the Cultivation of everyone else of the Outer Realm so that their Cultivation could never reach a threatening level again. Wang Lin then left the Cave World for the Immortal Astral Continent, while the Grand Empyrean Xuan Luo took the souls of Situ Nan, Red Butterfly, Zhou Li, Zhou Ru, Thirteen, Qing Shui, Qing Lin, Qing Shuang and Big Head to be reincarnated there.

Long after Wang Lin left the Cave World, a new sect named the Scarlet Soul Sect emerged in the Sealed Realm and began launching assaults on the New Celestial Realm. After Wang Lin returned, he destroyed it thoroughly with his disciple Thirteen.

world.title: Wind Celestial Realm
world.introText: In the past, the Wind Celestial Realm was ruled by Lan Yun, the Wind Celestial Emperor. His younger sister, Flower Imperial Concubine Han Yan, later married Qing Lin, linking the Wind Celestial Realm to key events in the broader cultivation world.
world.history:
In the past, the Wind Celestial Realm was ruled by Lan Yun, the Wind Celestial Emperor. His younger sister, Flower Imperial Concubine Han Yan, later married Qing Lin, linking the Wind Celestial Realm to key events in the broader cultivation world.

The realm has endured partial collapse following the fall of the Ancient Celestial Realm but has remained relatively intact compared to the Rain and Thunder Celestial Realms, thanks to the presence of mosquito beasts that dominated and protected its inner lands.

world.title: World
world.introText: There are many vast landmasses and continents in the World seeming to float in infinite space. The Heaven Trampling Bridges are said to exist over all or perhaps just multiple such Continents.
world.trivia: During the timeline of Renegade Immortal, the Devil Realm Continent of Pursuit of Truth should already exist, and the Paragon Immortal Realm has yet to be destroyed and remade into the Nine Mountains and Seas of I Shall Seal the Heavens.

world.title: Xue Yue
world.introText: Xue Yue is covered by ice and snow and their cultivation is often related to that as well. So whenever Xue Yue attacks another country, they use one-way rifts to cover the country with snow first and then attack.

characters.title: Li Muwan
characters.introText: Li Muwan, also known as Wan Er, is a main character in Renegade Immortal and its derivative works, authored by Er Gen . She is the only wife of the protagonist and future Wang Ancestor Wang Lin.
characters.appearance:
Li Muwan is exceptionally intelligent and a powerful figure who excels in defence, formations, and Alchemy.  Her strength does not lie in earth-shattering combat prowess, but in the fact that even in the direst of circumstances, she never lost herself or drifted away.

She is a person with no exceptional talent, no prestigious background, no innate halo, yet through her temperament, resilience, and kindness, she managed to firmly establish herself in a chaotic world. In the treacherous and dog-eat-dog world of cultivation, she is like a warm current, comforting to behold.

Her relationship with Wang Lin runs throughout the story and is the core emotional thread of the entire story. Wang Lin overturned the flow of nature and cultivated for a millennia, all for her. In his heart, there is only Li Muwan. In his eyes, only this figure existed. And in his ears, only the sound of her zither remained.

Her connection later extends to Slaughter, accross the countless cycles of reincarnation. Slaughter is the strongest avatar of Wang Lin, created using the Slaughter Origin and Silent Extinction Origin.
characters.personality:
Physical characteristics; With the appearance of a lotus flower, the voice of a bird, the spirit of the moon, the posture of willows, the bones of jade, the skin of ice and snow, the grace of autumn waters, and the heart of poetry, she shines like spring blossoms, like a lotus fairy, gentle and graceful, pure and elegant.

Personality traits; Gentle and considerate, resolute and independent, exceptionally intelligent and empathic. She faced life's challenges with optimism and perseverance.
characters.history:
Physical characteristics; With the appearance of a lotus flower, the voice of a bird, the spirit of the moon, the posture of willows, the bones of jade, the skin of ice and snow, the grace of autumn waters, and the heart of poetry, she shines like spring blossoms, like a lotus fairy, gentle and graceful, pure and elegant.

Personality traits; Gentle and considerate, resolute and independent, exceptionally intelligent and empathic. She faced life's challenges with optimism and perseverance.

characters.title: Liu Mei
characters.introText: Liu Mei is a major rival and sworn enemy of Wang Lin throughout the story.
characters.appearance:
Liu Mei stood up. Her thin clothes stuck to her body, revealing a perfectly curved and exquisite figure.

She wore a pale pink inner dress and then an outer white dress that revealed her alluring neck. The pleats of the skirt flowed lightly like splendid, white moonlight on the ground.

Three thousand strands of her hair were tied up with a ribbon with one strand hanging in front of her chest. Her skin was as white as snow and the faint, red blush that appeared on her face create a very charming and delicate aura. She was like a beautiful butterfly floating in the wind but at the same time as cold as ice

The Thousand Change Ruthless Domain (Earlier)

The Thousand Illusion Lust Domain (Later)
characters.history:
She is first introduced as a Xuan Dao Sect disciple alongside her twin "brother" Liu Feng. Liu Feng fights in the matches against the Heng Yue Sect at this time. She takes a passing interest in Wang Lin because he resisted her Charm ability despite being weaker than his peers at a glance.

She serves as the leader of the Xuan Dao Sect disciples fighting for the right to enter the Foreign Battleground.

She is revealed to be a disciple of Zhuque Zi in the Suzaku Sect. The Liu Mei of Xuan Dao Sect having only been her Avatar, and now long re-assimilated into her being. Her master orders her to plant the seed of herself into Wang Lin's Dao Heart so she can absorb his Life and Death Domain.

She enter Suzaku Tomb to retrieve her soul piece. Inside the Tomb, she wait for Wang Lin at the entrance to the Inner Tomb and try to devour his domain to complete her domain but end up fusing with the Lust Domain, Mei Ji, and end up doing it with Wang Lin.

During the last few hundred years, she was accepted as a disciple by a Allheaven Star System's Huan Family's Ancestor during his travel in the Alliance Star System.

Her hatred for Wang Lin filled her heart. This kind of hate was something even she herself felt was a bit unreal. However, deep in her heart, she couldn’t forget the youth she saw several hundred years ago at the Heng Yue Sect. What she couldn’t forget even more was Wang Lin’s tenderness toward Li Muwan.After she left planet Suzaku and found out that she was pregnant, her hatred became even stronger.

She encounter Wang Lin when she went to Planet Ran Yun and try to kill him, but failed and fled with Huan Wuqing's help. When they return to the Huan Family, a few days later, Wang Lin come and attack the Huan Family. She give her domain to Huan Wuqing on 2 conditions, to kill Wang Lin, if he can't, give him a bag of holding which she passed to Huan Wuqing to given to him. Then he killed her and absorbed Liu Mei's domain and produced Identityless Heavenly Devil Dao as devouring domain meant devouring origin soul. The holding bad contained a pill and a jade. Lui Mei's jade stated - “The pill is an antidote to the child’s resentment. Combine it with a thunder cultivator most of the resentment can be dissolved… Back then, Master told me to leave my shadow in your heart. Back then, I couldn’t do it… however, now I did.”

She appears in Wang Lin's Celestial Dream and confronts a 60 year old mortal scholar Wang Lin. Unable to explain the pain and familiarity in her heart, she gifts him a pill to extend his lifespan before she bids him farewell. After a while, Wang Lin tries to warn her to never get close to his Cultivator self, but she is long out of earshot.

characters.title: Situ Nan
characters.introText: Situ Nan is one of the major characters of Renegade Immortal. He was the previous owner of the Heaven Defying Bead.
characters.personality: Situ Nan is a lecherous, perverted, and happy-go-lucky man who does not have a care in the world. He rarely cultivates and is more interested in philandering with women. However, he still has a noble and soft heart for those close to him.
characters.history:
He sealed himself in the Heaven Defying Bead and watched Wang Lin cultivate in its world. The first time he speaks to him is after Wang Lin enters the world of the Heaven Defying Bead before trying to see through it with divine sense. From then on he consistently mocks him and his sect as well as their techniques.

He taught Wang Lin the Underworld Ascension Method which helped him advance through Foundation Establishment quickly. He used up all his saved-up origin energy to save Wang Lin from Teng Huayuan.

He didn't make another appearance until many centuries later when Wang Lin reached Soul Transformation and revived him. Situ Nan inhabited the body of a young male corpse with the excellent qualities of a demonic cultivator.

After leaving Planet Suzaku, Situ Nan robbed a trading planet and shared some treasures with Wang Lin before the two parted ways.

A few centuries later, Situ Nan was chased around by a sect master from Planet Fengluan. He escaped and went into closed-door cultivation to breakthrough into the Nirvana Cleanser realm and vowed to take revenge once he returned.

During the war between the Inner and Outer Realms, he became a third step cultivator under Qing Lin's tutelage.

He reincarnated into the Immortal Astral Continent, later Wang Lin finds him but Situ Nan stops him saying after he reincarnates into a king couple more times he will find him.
