characters.title: Bei Luo
characters.introText: A bold young man in red robes. He was very handsome and had a demonic sense of beauty. His head was completely smooth without a strand of hair.
characters.appearance: A bold young man in red robes. He was very handsome and had a demonic sense of beauty. His head was completely smooth without a strand of hair.
characters.history:
Bei Luo helped Wang Lin battle the divine retribution when the latter was breaking through to Ascendant. He later also helped Wang Lin trap the scattered devil, Tie Lan.

In return, Wang Lin helped Bei Luo weaken the fragmented ancient demon under the Fire Demon Country. Wang Lin's involvement helped give Bei Luo a single opportunity which resulted in him being able to devour the fragmented ancient demon under the Fire Demon Country.

To thank him, Bei Luo allowed Wang Lin to enter the diluted version of Shi Realm which allowed him to see the trap inside the Celestial Slaughter Art before it was too late. He also located Zhou Yi's spirit's location inside the Tide Abyss.

Many years later when Wang Lin returned to the East Demon Spirit Sea, he found that Bei Luo had already absorbed a majority of the nine fragmented ancient demons across the land. This allowed him to recover a majority of his cultivation from when he was still whole. Bei Luo entered the fifth cave along with Wang Lin's group.

characters.title: Black Tortoise Divine Emperor
characters.introText: During the war against the Cultivation Alliance and the Brilliant Void Cultivation Sect, the Black Tortoise Divine Emperor turned traitor which, along with the Azure Dragon Divine Emperor's disappearance, led to the Four Divine Sect's defeat and decline.
characters.appearance:
Many years later, Wang Lin stormed the Cultivation Alliance to save Qing Shui and destroy the Seven-Colored Realm inside the Alliance headquarters. There, he saw 100,000 mountain peaks each with a cultivator on top, a Black Tortoise that could cover the entire area inside the Seven-Colored Realm with the Black Tortoise Divine Emperor sitting on its head, and Qing Shui sealed atop the highest mountain peak with a seven-colored finger pointing to his forehead.

After seeing all this, Wang Lin realized that the 100,000 mountains turned into 10 thorns to seal Qing Shui’s body. The cultivators on the 100,000 mountains used their blood to nourish the Black Tortoise and their killing intent to stimulate Qing Shui. This Black Tortoise was, in fact, alive and was being used to trap Qing Shui’s soul. The purpose of all this was to create the slaughter essence with Qing Shui being the furnace for creating the slaughter essence.

The Black Tortoise Divine Emperor betrayed the Four Divine Sect because the Cultivation Alliance managed to find the Black Tortoise body somewhere. The Black Tortoise was most likely one of the four great generals under the Ancient Celestial Emperor. It contained the aura of the Black Tortoise clan, and as a descendant, the Black Tortoise Divine Emperor had to betray the Four Divine Sect since only this kind of temptation would be enough for him to become a traitor.

Qing Shui came to the Seven-Colored Realm to find the reason for his madness. He must have found something that caused him to become crazy again. That seven-colored finger is the root of all of this. The red gas it absorbs is slaughter essence.

characters.title: Blood Ancestor
characters.introText: Blood Ancestor was one of the strongest cultivators in the area surrounding Planet Tian Yun. He was the ruler of Blood Planet.
characters.history:
Many millennia ago when All Seer, Ling Tianhou and the other second step cultivators of Planet Tian Yun first entered the Demon Spirit Land, they learnt that there were three subordinate cultivation caves that had keys that opened the cultivation cave that housed Qing Lin. All Seer, Ling Tianhou and the Celestial Cloud Cultivation Couple, Wang Wei and Hu Juan, each took one of the caves. In fact, there were four subordinate cultivation caves with the last one being kept by Blood Ancestor, secretly.

Blood Ancestor gave the key to the fourth subordinate cultivation cave to his daughter, Yao Xixue, when she entered the Demon Spirit Land. After failing to enter the cave three times, she employed Wang Lin's help. However, she attempted to cheat him out of the promised reward but had the tables turned on her as Wang Lin trapped her inside a restriction. He kept her as so for over a century.

When Wang Lin escaped to the Allheaven Star System, Blood Ancestor followed him there by using an Allheaven stone that his deceased father left him. He beseeched the help of his grandfather, Blood God, who used his influence to allow the Thunder Celestial Temple to let him enter the Thunder Celestial Realm.

There, he ambushed Wang Lin but the latter managed to escape and set up an ingenious trap for the Blood Ancestor. Although Blood Ancestor managed to save Yao Xixue, it came at the cost of using up his remaining three Blood Soul pills which left him extremely weak and vulnerable. Afterwards, Master Flamespark found him and expedited the process of his recovery, only to steal half of his recovered origin soul which dropped his cultivation down from the mid stage of Nirvana Cleanser to the late stage of Nirvana Scryer.

Afterwards, Wang Lin ambushed him and forced him to use up half of his Blood Body which further dropped his cultivation from late stage of Nirvana Scryer to the peak of Corporeal Yang. After a deadly fight, he fled with a severely injured original soul. However, soon after, Wang Lin defeated him and gave him the ultimatum of meeting Yao Xixue again or dying. Blood Ancestor chose to surrender and was captured inside Wang Lin's One-Billion-Soul Soul Flag.

He died during the Heaven Order when Wang Lin exploded his Origin Soul to kill the pursuing cultivator.

His Soul was reformed with the help of Immortal Emperor Bai Fan's Magic Arsenal, and stayed in Wang Lin's 18 Layer of Hell Reincarnation Realm. He was later freed after Wang Lin resolved the Karma between them.

characters.title: Blood God
characters.introText: Blood God is the current ruler of Yao Family. He has been possessed by an Ancient Demon.
characters.history:
Under the possession of the Ancient Demon, Blood God poured the ancient lamp's weakened-spirit into his daughter's body and then refined his granddaughter, Yao Mengyun, into the ancient lamp's spirit.

He also poured a demon-ling inside Yao Yun, his younger son, to control him after he tried to rebel and save his two nieces, Yao Mengyun and Yao Bingyun.

His eldest son, Blood Ancestor's father, escaped to the Alliance Star System soon after he learnt that his father has been possessed by an Ancient Demon.

Many years later, when Wang Lin returns from the Outer realm, Wang Lin comes to resolve the feud between them, even though he was under the protection of Master Lu Fu, he still perishes under the hand of Wang Lin, forcing the 6 stars of the Ancient Demon hidding in his body to appear, Wang Lin captures the latter.

characters.title: Cao Yidou
characters.introText: Cao Yidou (曹一斗) was a cultivator from Tian Yun Wang Lin found from the Corpse Sect who became bound to Wang Lin during the latter’s journey to Planet Tian Yun.
characters.appearance:
Cao Yidou (曹一斗) was a cultivator from Tian Yun Wang Lin found from the Corpse Sect who became bound to Wang Lin during the latter’s journey to Planet Tian Yun.

Wang Lin made a deal with Cao Yiduo to become his slave for 100 years, promising to gift him a Soul Transformation body after that period. Cao Yiduo agreed, despite the risks, because obtaining a Soul Transformation body was extremely valuable and rare. Wang Lin needed Cao Yiduo's knowledge about planet Tian Yun and intended to use him as a guide. After receiving Cao Yiduo's soul blood, Wang Lin put him inside a soul flag to keep him under control, then proceeded to head toward the Heavenly Fate Sect on Tian Yun, guided by Cao Yiduo's information

characters.title: Celestial Ancestor
characters.introText: Later, when Wang Lin confronts Lian Daozhen of the Celestial Clan, he discovers that the latter had hidden the Celestial Ancestor's head.
characters.personality: For whatever reason he was not much fond of anything foreign to the Immortal Astral Continent. He sealed 72 such entities away during his lifetime and together with the Ancient Ancestor he established the Law of the Immortal Astral Continent, which kills anyone who tries to enter the continent but lacks the proper bloodline, this includes Cave World Cultivators.
characters.history:
At least once, he attempted to seal or enslave the Ancient Clan Ancestor. He failed, but this resulted in the Ancient Clan Ancestor hating all Celestials, a hatred he passed down his bloodline.
Originally, the Celestials had only one continent, however the Celestial Ancestor created the 72 Celestial Continents by sealing away beasts, cultivators and entities that were foreign to the Immortal Astral Continent. It is stated in many dubious legends that his sword was destroyed in at least one such battle, however these legends are numorous and contradicting.

He laid down rules for the Celestial Clan to ensure they remained free, for he believed that's how they should be. Hence he ensured that the Imperial Family would only intervene in their lives to a small degree if any. As such, the various Celestial Clan Emperors over the eons have rarely given out edicts, but when such an edict is given disobedience is seen as betrayal of the entire Celestial Clan.

He created the Empyrean Exalt Trial to help those at the peak of Void Tribulant go further, together with his rival, the Ancient Ancestor, who did something similar independantly, they then made a single superior trial.

After his death, his bodyparts appear to be scattered, his head was with the Celestial Emperor while at least his hand was fused with the Mountain Sea Continent's Mountain Sea Tree Seal.

His head was later taken by Wang Lin along with Lian Daozhen's soul.
characters.trivia:
In Book 5 - AWWP, it is revealed that he once walked the path of The Immortal and this most likely was the reason for his death at the hands of Allheaven. Therefore, it can be said that he was one of those who could become The Immortal.

In Book 6 - BT, there is information that he drew inspiration for the creation of the Eight Extreme Daos from a totem that depicted a crystal broken into 10 pieces, in which he saw the moment of the birth of the Star Ring.

characters.title: Celestial King Carefree
characters.introText: Xiao Yao Zi (逍遥子, Xiāo Yáo Zǐ) was an ancient cultivator of the Ancient Celestial Realm and one of the powerful Celestial Kings who lived before the destruction of the Ancient Celestial Realm. He was a Ninth-Rank Celestial King at the height of his cultivation and was the master of Long Daozi. Although Xiao Yao Zi never appears directly in the main story as a living character, his influence extends into several major events of Renegade Immortal. His surviving treasures, disciples, paintings, and arrangements eventually become important to Wang Lin, particularly during his exploration of the Thunder Celestial Realm and his encounter with Long Daozi.
characters.personality:
Very little of Xiao Yao Zi's personality is shown directly because he had already died long before Wang Lin's rise. Nevertheless, several aspects of his character can be inferred from his actions.

Xiao Yao Zi appears to have been deeply attached to his son and carried considerable guilt over his relationship with him. After becoming a Celestial, he was willing to sacrifice cultivation time and opportunities to search for a method capable of preserving his son's soul. He also appears to have been highly knowledgeable and cautious. His acquisition of the Heaven-Avoiding Coffin, his arrangements for Long Daozi, and his understanding of the coming destruction of the Celestial Realm demonstrate considerable foresight.

However, his actions toward Long Daozi were also extremely controversial. Long Daozi spent countless years guarding the coffin after being reduced to little more than a head and primordial spirit. Eventually, Long Daozi came to believe that Xiao Yao Zi had deliberately deceived him and possibly intended for him to die after fulfilling his purpose. Whether Xiao Yao Zi truly intended to kill Long Daozi remains unclear.
characters.history:
Xiao Yao Zi lived during the era of the ancient Celestial Realm, long before Wang Lin's generation. He was already an extremely powerful existence during that period, eventually reaching the Ninth-Rank Celestial King realm. Little is revealed about his early life. Unlike many ancient experts whose origins and cultivation paths are extensively explained, Xiao Yao Zi remains intentionally obscure. Most information about him is revealed indirectly through his belongings and through the memories and experiences of Long Daozi. At some point during his mortal life, Xiao Yao Zi had a son. He deeply regretted failing to fulfill his responsibilities toward his son. After becoming a Celestial, he continued searching for a way to compensate for this regret.

According to the information left behind by Xiao Yao Zi, he eventually obtained the Heaven-Avoiding Coffin, an ancient treasure capable of nourishing a soul and reconstructing a physical body. He placed a fragment of his son's soul inside the coffin in the hope that his son would one day awaken.
This arrangement became one of the most important reasons behind Long Daozi's punishment and his countless years of suffering.

characters.title: Chang Dawei
characters.introText: Chang Dawei (常大伟) is one of the Outer Region Managers of the Soul Refining Sect, operating alongside figures like Hong Maozi on Planet Suzaku. With a cultivation base at the early stage of Core Formation, he upholds sect laws and monitors the movements of outer disciples and newcomers. Known for his stern demeanor and rigid personality.He was an inner disciple, but because he remained in Core Formation for too long, he was demoted to a manager of the outer region. He hopes to increase his cultivation so he can return to the inner region of the sect. That is why, when Wang Lin breaks through to the late stage of Foundation Establishment in only three month, he becomes jealous. He thinks Wang Lin is cultivating a special treasure or practising a special technique. He then thinks about stealing Wang Lin's treasure so that he can use it to break through faster and return to the inner region, but he underestimates Wang Lin and is ultimately killed by him.
characters.appearance: Chang Dawei (常大伟) is one of the Outer Region Managers of the Soul Refining Sect, operating alongside figures like Hong Maozi on Planet Suzaku. characters.title: Chen Chong
characters.history: Carved 10% of the Divine Path from memory.

characters.title: Chen Tao
characters.introText: He looks like a skinny middle-aged man and gives off the feeling of being a respectable gentleman.
characters.appearance: He looks like a skinny middle-aged man and gives off the feeling of being a respectable gentleman.
characters.history:
He reappeared 100 years after Sun Yun disappeared during the battle for the title of the True-Disciple of Purple Division. He barely managed to defeat Wang Lin even with his Ascendant cultivation and regained his title of the True-Disciple of Purple Division.

He, once again, met Wang Lin inside the capital of Sky Demon Country in the East Demon Spirit Sea. At this time, however, his cultivation had dropped from the Mid-stage Ascendant to the peak of Late-stage Soul Transformation due to an ambush by the Da Lou Sword Sect. He became Shi Xiao's helper for the Demon General Competition.

Before Wang Lin went to the Allheaven Star System, when Wang Lin kill Shi Xiao, he warn him to be careful of All-Seer.

characters.title: Chen Tianjun
characters.introText: He was with Wang Lin in Seven-Colored Realm

characters.title: Chi Hu

infobox.Title: Chi Hu
infobox.occupation(s): Patriarch of the Giant Demon Clan

characters.introText: After Wang Lin became "Lord of The Sealed Realm," he returned home to Planet Suzaku, only to find the planet completely changed and most of his old friends long dead, including Chi Hu.

characters.title: Chi Mu
characters.introText: Chi Mu was a six leaf warrior and from the Forsaken Immortal Clan.
characters.appearance: He was a burly and well built man. He specialized in strength and not magic/spells. He fought with honor and didn't use any tricks or schemes.
characters.history:
When Wang Lin was trying to escape the Forsaken Immortal Clan, Chi Mu caught up to him. He was very interested in Wang Lin because he believed Wang Lin was very strong and could be his match. However, he ended up being defeated when Wang Lin took out the God Slaying War Chariot and he was killed by the beast spirit.

Appearance: Episode 78

characters.title: Chu Yunfei
characters.introText: He was wearing a black robe and was very skinny, but his eyes lit up as he looked toward the Immortal Graveyard.

characters.title: Dao Feishan
characters.introText: He is a very vulgar, perverted and lascivious person as he not only likes women but also handsome men and will do anything to have his way with them before killing them.
characters.personality: He is a very vulgar, perverted and lascivious person as he not only likes women but also handsome men and will do anything to have his way with them before killing them.
characters.history: He participated in the final battle of the Third Sealed-Outer Realm War in the Allheaven Star System. During that time, he deliberately hunted Mu Bingmei due to her beauty and also due to the fact that she was involved with Wang Lin.

characters.title: Dao Master Blue Dream
characters.introText: His wife's body was taken over by the Fifth Concubine. The Fifth Concubine coerces him into doing things for her benefit while promising to not destroy his wife's soul as long as he cooperates with her. Due to this he has a crack in his Dao Heart, thus halting his progression in cultivation.
characters.history:
He met Wang Lin in the Cloud Sea Star System's Seven-Colored Realm after Wang Lin devoured Sovereign's Dao Fruit. He attacked Wang Lin with his palm and told him that if he can survive for a year under his palm he will be left alive. However, after he noticed the bracelet that Li Qian Mei gave Wang Lin. Knowing that the bracelet won't protect someone unless the previous owner gave permission for it to be taken, Dao Master Blue Dream spares him.

After Wang Lin saved Li Qian Mei from the vortex near Demon Sect, he took her to the Blue Silk Clan as he had no other way to stop her continuously dissipating vitality. There, Dao Master Blue Dream offered to him on as his disciple and guaranteeing that he will be safe from Sovereign and reach the Third-Step in 100 years as long Wang Lin gives up the Inner Realm, gives up Li Muwan and marries Li Qian Mei. Wang Lin instantly refused which disappointed Dao Master Blue Dream but he still passed on two celestials spells called Light and Shadow Shield and Heaven Reversal Stamp also a Dao Spell called Dao Fusion. These spells allowed Wang Lin to successfully battle and defeat the Seventh Concubine's avatar that had been following him to devour his "divinity".

Later, Dao Master Blue Dream appeared at the Young Emperor Trial of the Fallen Land along with Li Qian Mei.

Afterwards, Wang Lin left the Fallen Land and attacked Sovereign's clone in the Fire Sparrow Clan's Holy Land. Unbeknownst to him, Wang Lin was caught in the Sovereign's Fishing the Moon from the Well and would have almost certainly died if not for Dao Master Blue Dream stepping in and stopping the Sovereign.

During the first battle of the Third Sealed-Outer Realm War, Dao Master Blue Dream chose to help Wang Lin one last time by sparing him even after the latter refused his request of letting the defeated Outer Realm cultivators leave.

Dao Master Blue Dream finally acted merciless against Wang Lin when Sovereign used Fishing the Moon from the Well on Wang Lin at Planet Suzaku. When Wang Lin was inches from escaping after having killed Ice Boy, Second Concubine, Sixth Concubine, Grey-robed Old Man, Black-robed Old Woman and even having injured Sovereign by using Master Scarlet Soul, Dao Master Blue Dream appeared and pushed him back into the trap world.

72 years later, after Wang Lin set up the Unnamed Wheel Formation, Sovereign appeared at the Blue Silk Clan and asked Dao Master Blue Dream to destroy the formation. In exchange, he promised to help free Dao Master Blue Dream's wife's soul from inside the Fifth Concubine.

18 months later, Dao Master Blue Dream brought Li Qian Mei along to visit Wang Lin. He offered to move his Blue Silk Clan to the Inner Realm and fight for the Inner Realm so long as Wang Lin promised to marry Li Qian Mei. After pondering over the matter for a few months, Wang Lin refused. Angered, Dao Master Blue Dream stated that Wang Lin reconsider. He also lowered his condition to Wang Lin promising that if Li Muwan was revived he and Li Qian Mei would become brother and sister, however, if Li Muwan was unable to be revived he and Li Qian Mei would get married. After struggling to make a decision for months, Wang Lin finally assented to this after he saw Li Qian Mei's tears and remembered all that she had done for him.

Thus, Dao Master Blue Dream intercepted Dao Master Miao Yin, Devil Master Nine Heavens and Esteemed Great Desolation that were freed from Ye Mo's Ancient Tomb by Seven-Colored Daoist. After three days of battle, Dao Master Miao Yin was seriously injured, so much so that his cultivation level fell to peak Spirit Void and he became unable to reach to his peak cultivation in 100 years. Devil Master Nine Heaven’s injuries were slightly less severe than Dao Master Miao Yin’s, but his Joss Flame Realm was destroyed which injured his mind and resulted in his cultivation level falling to early-stage Arcane Void. Esteemed Great Desolation was injured the most and escaped using a secret spell. His injuries were so bad that his lifespan fell to just 10 years.

A few months later, Wang Lin returned to the New Celestial Realm having rid himself of Seven-Colored Daoist. There, he saw the Blue Silk Clan. Later, Dao Master Blue Dream appeared when Wang Lin was consulting Qing Lin about All-Seer's avatar. He informed the two about the Ancient Celestial Sovereign's spell which All-Seer might be using and sent Wang Lin to kill All-Seer if he wished to rid himself of the spell.

When the Scarlet Soul Sect and Master Scarlet Soul wage war against the Cave World, he along with Master South Cloud become the main opposition against him. However, they were no match for Master Scarlet Soul and Blue Dream was severely injured.

When Wang Lin returns to the cave world and heals his injuries, he becomes overjoyed. However, when Wang Lin confesses that he has not found Li Qianmei after she reincarnated, he becomes bitter and lashes out at Wang Lin. His anger dissipates when he realizes that Wang Lin tried his best and that it seemed like Li Qianmei was intentionally avoiding him. Knowing his daughter well, he knew that if she did not want Wang Lin to find her, it would be very difficult for him to locate her.

He witnesses Wang Lin's newfound power when he effortlessly kills Master Scarlet Soul with his Grand Empyrean Sun.

characters.title: Dao Master Miao Yin
characters.introText: Unlike the calm and virtuous Dao Master Blue Dream, the indifferent Esteemed Great Desolation, and the grand Sovereign, Dao Master Miao Yin is a man that easily lets his emotions, especially his greed, surface to the top and dictate his thinking.
characters.personality: Unlike the calm and virtuous Dao Master Blue Dream, the indifferent Esteemed Great Desolation, and the grand Sovereign, Dao Master Miao Yin is a man that easily lets his emotions, especially his greed, surface to the top and dictate his thinking.
characters.history:
He sent his mid-stage Spirit Void avatar to the Fallen Land to partly partake in the Fallen Council competition and also to see Wang Lin. After seeing the Heaven Defying Bead in Wang Lin's possession he immediately believed Daoist Water's reports and began making plans to ambush Wang Lin outside of the Fallen Land and steal the bead from him. However, before he could do so, the Ancient Order Tomb opened up and he sent his avatar over there.

He attempted to forcefully enter the Tomb which resulted in him burning up all of his over 10 Billion Joss Flames disciples. He finally managed to enter the Tomb but his cultivation was pushed down to the early-stage of Nirvana Void from the previous mid-stage Spirit Void.

He attempted to steal Esteemed Great Desolation's grade 4 Dao Spirit inside the Tomb. However, he was interrupted by Wang Lin who killed all his followers and captured his maid, Feng Zhiman. The latter then worked in tandem with Esteemed Great Desolation to injure him so severely that Esteemed Great Desolation managed to possess his avatar and Wang Lin managed to steal almost 30% of his Joss Flames to upgrade his ancient slave, Ling Dong.

Enraged, he entered the Ancient Tomb with his original body after the expulsion fog retracted. However, he ended up trapped inside the Tomb after Wang Lin closed it.

Over a century later, Sovereign begged Seven-Colored Daoist to allow Dao Master Miao Yin, Devil Master Nine Heavens and Esteemed Great Desolation to escape the Tomb so that they could destroy Wang Lin's Unnamed Wheel Formation and draw his remaining two arrows from Li Guang's Bow.

The three appeared to kill Wang Lin but were intercepted by Dao Master Blue Dream. After three days of battle, Dao Master Miao Yin was seriously injured, so much so that his cultivation level fell to peak Spirit Void and he became unable to reach to his peak cultivation in 100 years.

Later, he sent his avatar to kill Wang Lin after the latter used up both his Li Guang's Bow arrows to seal the Outer Realm's Ancient Celestial Realm only to have its body destroyed and origin soul captured by Wang Lin.

Afterwards, Wang Lin sought out Dao Master Miao Yin in the eastern part of the Ancient Primordial Star System on a water planet  filled with spiritual energy. There were no continents on it, only some islands. The rest of the planet was covered by the sea. The sea was not blue, but golden. Waves were set off in the golden sea by the wind. There were some beasts swimming in the sea, sometimes revealing their shadows. They were very large. Wang Lin sealed his soul and forced him to reincarnate in the Immortal Astral Continent so that he may not become a volatile factor inside the Cave after Wang Lin left.

characters.title: Dao Xu
characters.introText: Dao Xu is an elder of Heng Yue Sect. Master of Wang Zhuo. He forces Wang Lin to fight against Zhou Peng despite Elder Sun’s objection.

characters.title: Dao Yi
characters.introText: Out of all the Nine Suns and Grand Empyrean's, he is considered the weakest.
characters.appearance: He is a young-looking man who wears a dao robe. He only looks around 20-something. He has black hair and sharp brows. He is very handsome and has star-like eyes that would make one lose themselves if one looked into them. He wears a simple dao robe and looks very ordinary. However, the heavens don’t move, the wind doesn’t move, nothing moves. Even the operation of the heavens and earth seems to completely stop when he arrives.
characters.history:
Dao Yi harassed Xuan Luo when the latter entered the Celestial Clan's territory while following the inheritance Wang Lin received from the Ancient Ancestor.

A few decades after Xuan Luo returned to the Immortal Astral Continent from the Cave, he was forced to leave the Celestial Clan's territory by Dao Yi and, a freshly awoken, Lian Daozhen.

Over a century later, Dao Yi appeared on the Green Devil Continent to protect Devil Dao Sect's Ancestor from death while the latter was facing off against Wang Lin. He also offered to take Wang Lin in as his underling and promised that he, himself, would never die and, thus, Wang Lin would never die. The Devil Dao Sect's Ancestor was surprised to hear this as Grand Empyrean Dao Yi had only provided him protection for 100,000 years.

However, Wang Lin declined his offer euphemistically. Dao Yi did not take offense as he, himself, didn't have a habit of forcibly subordinating Empyrean Exalts.

Around half a century later, Dao Yi, Wu Feng, and Jiu Di appeared outside the Mountain Sea Island on the Mountain Sea Continent. Jiu Di had appeared to rescue his disciple, Hai Zi, from the malfunctioning seal on the Mountain Sea Tree but he was stopped by Dao Yi and Wu Feng as they wished to see if Wang Lin had any connections with Xuan Luo. However, the three were absolutely shocked to see Wang Lin use his faith spell, Sundered Night, which is something that only Grand Empyreans can use.

When Wang Lin passes the 10th palace of the Empyrean Exalt Trial he personally arrives to complete with Wu Feng in recruiting Wang Lin.

After Wang Lin passes the 13th palace and is accused by Lian Daozhen for relying on his soul armor, all the Empyrean Exalts begin to turn on Wang Lin. He begins to question whether or not he should continue to recruit Wang Lin and eventually decides against it. However, his reaffirms his choice once more when he witnesses Wang Lin pass through the 14th, 15th, and eventually 16th palace all at once.

He later joins Jiu Di, Wu Feng, and Gemini in their fight against the Celestial Emperor Lian Daozhen. They manage to defeat him, but all end up receiving the Celestial Ancestor's curse as a result. He later fights Wang Lin and due to being afflicted with the curse, is defeated when Wang Lin forms the outline of his Grand Empyrean Sun.

Because of his losses against Wang Lin and being the weakest Grand Empyrean overall, the curse accelerates and ravages his body the most. Returning to the Dao Yi Sect, he sacrifices countless disciples and elders in order to save himself from the majority of the curse, leaving the Dao Yi Sect nearly desolate.

When all the Grand Empyrean Sun's rise into the sky to signal the birth of a new Grand Empyrean, he is shocked when he discovers that it is actually Wang Lin.

Sensing the battle between Grand Empyrean Gu Dao and an unknown cultivator he rushes to the site of the battle with the rest of the Nine Suns. Through Jiu Di's recall spell, he is frightened when he discovers that Wang Lin had actually defeated Gu Dao and was now the strongest being in the Immortal Astral Continent.

Right when he returned from the site of Gu Dao and Wang Lin's battle, Wang Lin pulls him through a vortex that took him directly to the Cave World. Wang Lin said that Master Scarlet Soul was the disciple of an Empyrean Exalt under him and asked if it was true. Dao Yi immediately denied this and begged Wang Lin to let him go, which he did shortly after, returning him to the Dao Yi Sect. After returning, he trembled from feeling the new disparity in strength between himself and Wang Lin.

characters.title: Dao Yun
characters.introText: Dao Yun was Teng Three's beloved wife. She died early in her years as a mortal because she was forcibly separated from her husband. Teng Three's Sword was named after his wife and his sword had her aura in it.
characters.history: Dao Yun was Teng Three's beloved wife. She died early in her years as a mortal because she was forcibly separated from her husband. Teng Three's Sword was named after his wife and his sword had her aura in it.

characters.title: Daoist Scattered Spirit
characters.introText: Wang Lin regards him as the most talented person he has ever met, even more so than Situ Nan, Red Butterfly, Liu Mei, or Li Qian Mei. On top of that, Wang Lin thinks of him as the most determined, unwavering, spirited and admirable person he has ever met. All in all, Wang Lin believes Daoist Scattered Spirit should be the role of every cultivator that has ever lived and even slightly looks up to him.
characters.history:
He met Wang Lin through one of his avatars when the latter was infiltrating the Scatter Thunder Clan's 7 Million Worlds. Daoist Scattered Spirit told him about his life and begged Wang Lin to lure the Head Elder of Scatter Thunder Clan to the 7 Million Worlds.

After Wang Lin lured the Head Elder of Scatter Thunder Clan to the 7 Million Worlds, Daoist Scattered Spirit ambushed the already severely injured elder. Then, Daoist Scattered Spirit led the residents of the 7 Million Worlds to resist the Eternal Thunderbolt inside the Scatter Thunder Clan's Holy Land while Wang Lin battled the Head Elder.

After Wang Lin killed the Head Elder, Daoist Scattered Spirit led his people to the skies beyond the 7 Million Worlds.

characters.title: Daoist Water
characters.introText: This person looked like a boy, but his hair was grey.
characters.appearance: This person looked like a boy, but his hair was grey.
characters.personality: He is a cruel person and takes pleasure in witnessing others' misery; he loves destroying the treasures of weaker cultivators and watching their reaction.
characters.history:
Soon after Wang Lin entered the Cloud Sea Star System, Daoist Water sensed the aura of the previous Lord of the Sealed Realm and began investigating into who it was coming from.

After the ranking competition at the Everlasting Sect concluded, Daoist Water's disciple, Wang Shanshan, sent him a recording of Wang Lin's battles in which he saw Wang Lin use the Stop Spell and became convinced that Wang Lin was actually the reincarnated Lord of the Sealed Realm.

He stopped the ranking competition held between the rank 8 sects and soon after rushed to the Rank 5 Region to kill Wang Lin. During the battle, Wang Lin managed to awaken his five essences: Thunder, Fire, Life & Death, Karma, and True & False. This terrified the already weak-minded Daoist Water and further strengthened his determination to kill Wang Lin. However, before he could do so, the Lord of the Sealed Realm appeared from the Sealed Realm Jade, injured Daoist Water, and forced him to retreat.

Many years later, Wang Lin returned from the Outer Realm and killed him.

characters.title: Devil Master Nine Heavens
characters.introText: In the past, he stormed the Fallen Land but was forced to run with his tail tucked between his legs after facing off against the Vermillion Bird Ancestor. He was seriously injured and is still forced to remain in closed-door cultivation to this day, much like Sovereign.
characters.history:
He entered the Ancient Order Tomb. He was fastest person to get his stone platform to the 7th level before he was overtook by Wang Lin.

After Wang Lin's stone platform reached the 9th level, a giant arm rushed towards, crushing everything between itself and the platform. Devil Master Nine Heaven's three-in-one avatar received a direct hit and he attempted to fight back against it. Although he still lost his body, his avatar's destruction gave him enough time to barely escape with his soul.

Enraged, he entered the Ancient Tomb with his original body after the expulsion fog retracted. However, he ended up trapped inside the Tomb after Wang Lin closed it.

Over a century later, Sovereign begged Seven-Colored Daoist to allow Dao Master Miao Yin, Devil Master Nine Heavens and Esteemed Great Desolation to escape the Tomb so that they could destroy Wang Lin's Unnamed Wheel Formation and draw his remaining two arrows from Li Guang's Bow.

The three appeared to kill Wang Lin but were intercepted by Dao Master Blue Dream. After three days of battle, Devil Master Nine Heaven’s was heavily injured as his Joss Flame Realm was destroyed which injured his mind and resulted in his cultivation level falling to early-stage Arcane Void.

Later, he sent his avatar to kill Wang Lin after the latter used up both his Li Guang's Bow arrows to seal the Outer Realm's Ancient Celestial Realm only to have its body destroyed and origin soul captured by Wang Lin.

Afterwards, Wang Lin sought out Devil Master Nine Heavens in the eastern part of the Ancient Primordial Star System on a crescent-shaped planet. This planet had an irregular shape that was rare and was filled with death aura. The planet was covered in yellow sand. There was no day on his planet, only night. Due it being incomplete, there was no grass or trees, only large rocks that rotated around the planet. Wang Lin sealed his soul and forced him to reincarnate in the Immortal Astral Continent so that he may not become a volatile factor inside the Cave after Wang Lin left.

characters.title: Dong Lin
characters.introText: He was the only one (at least among the Celestial Clan) who completely relied on his own strength to become a Grand Empyrean, cultivating essence true bodies to breakthrough instead of receiving a fortune from the Immemorial God Realm like many others.
characters.history:
He was the First Generation's Ancestor of the Dong Lin sect. Before he fell, he was known as the number one Grand Empyrean in the Celestial Clan, with even the much older Grand Empyrean Jiu Di dreading him. He was also the only one to reach the 19th palace of the Empyrean Exalt trial as an Ascendant Empyrean.

At one point in his life, he journeyed to Mount Gu Dao in the Ancient Clan's territory. The full details of what transpired are unknown, but it was stated that Dong Lin attempted to ascend the mountain (Potentially to challenge Gu Dao). Although he failed to reach the top, he still impressed Gu Dao and was acknowledged by him as the only Celestial to ever attempt the challenge.

He died sometime after this, with his body unable to be found even by other Grand Empyreans.
characters.trivia: He is the only Celestial to ever ascend Mount Gu dao

characters.title: Du Jian
characters.introText: Du Jian is a member of the Red division of the Heavenly Fate Sect on Planet Tian Yun.
characters.history:
He entered Tide Abyss inside the East Demon Spirit Sea along with Wang Lin, Murong Zhuo, Zhao Yixuan and Xu Fei(Corpse Yin Sect (of the Corpse Sect). He attempted to guide Wang Lin into a trap but was pushed into the trap by Wang Lin instead and ended up with just a weak origin soul.

Afterwards, Wang Lin refined him into a Celestial Guard using Qing Lin's technique. He offered him freedom after he worked for 1000 years. Alas, Du Jian self-exploded himself in a battle against Blood Ancestor to allow Wang Lin to escape.

characters.title: Du Qing
characters.introText: Du Qing is extremely vindictive and cares a lot about his reputation as seen by his outburst after Wang Lin destroyed his sect and escaped, "Only I, Du Qing, can steal other people’s things and destroy other sect’s caves… No one has ever dared to destroy my sect!!!”
characters.personality:
Du Qing is extremely vindictive and cares a lot about his reputation as seen by his outburst after Wang Lin destroyed his sect and escaped, "Only I, Du Qing, can steal other people’s things and destroy other sect’s caves… No one has ever dared to destroy my sect!!!”

He is also someone that easily becomes jealous of others as seen by his disdain for Wang Lin repeatedly trying to use Spatial Bending, "'I want to see how long he plans to try. When he still fails in the end, what kind of expression will he make…' There was a hint of contempt in Du Qing’s eyes, but there was also jealousy. 'How come I, Du Qing, was not accepted by a Grand Empyrean… Do Grand Empyreans all like fools like this?' Du Qing was unconvinced."
characters.history:
Du Qing rushed back from the Great Soul Sect when he learnt from Elder Zhou that his sect was under attack. However, by the time he returned, Wang Lin had escaped. Enraged at his decimated sect, Du Qing soul-searched one of the sect disciples and saw what happened. He even sentenced Elder Sun Mengde to be sealed for 100 years due to his slip of words. He then ordered the sect to use their entire resources to look for Wang Lin and himself began tracking Wang Lin.

He continued tracking Wang Lin for months using a tracking spell he received from the Great Soul Sect. During the months Du Qing chased him, Wang Lin had managed to devour 16 branch earthen fire veins. When he finally caught up to him, he saw that Wang Lin was in the process of devouring a child earthen fire vein that was many times stronger than the branch earthen fire veins. He attacked Wang Lin but the latter mitigated all the damage to the child earthen fire vein. Du Qing wanted to attack him again but was gobsmacked when Wang Lin daunted him by using the World Sect's War Spirit Print, the Dong Lin Sect's Seven-Colored Lance, the Dark Moon Sect's Dark Moon Art, and the Three Dao Sect's Song Yun Dao's Realm Burning Umbrella. Still, he decided to attack Wang Lin while thinking that he must have stolen those spells (although he himself was not convinced of that statement). However, he was further shocked to see Wang Lin's seven essences. Moreover, he almost passed out from fear when Wang Lin took out the golden print Xuan Luo gifted him.

Immediately, he turned his entire approach 360° and even began guarding Wang Lin in hopes that the latter may allow him to meet the Grand Empyrean that gifted him the golden print. After absorbing the child earthen fire vein, Wang Lin only managed to form the legs of his Fire Essence True Body. So, he then attracted the remaining branch earthen fire veins in the area that his divine sense could cover and after absorbing them he managed to form the two arms, as well. He also lured the two child earthen fire veins in the area and made Du Qing suppress one of them while he battled and absorbed the other. After absorbing the two of them, his Fire Essence True Body was almost complete except for the head.

Du Qing then invited Wang Lin back to his sect and promised that he would send his disciples to for earthen fire veins in the area. He even gifted Wang Lin the best cultivation cave in the sect. Although he kept his distance, he kept observing Wang Lin through his divine sense. When he noticed Wang Lin attempt to use Spatial Bending, he was surprised but soon enough he began looking towards Wang Lin with contempt. Wang Lin continued attempting to use Spatial Bending for a year when he finally managed to connect to his avatar in the void and succeeded. Du Qing was genuinely shocked and was unable to make sense of Wang Lin using Spatial Bending as he knew that one needed to be at least at late-stage Void Tribulant for this art to work and he knew for a fact that Wang Lin not yet reached the Void Tribulant stage.

Wang Lin then left for the Great Soul Sect where the Heavenly Bull Continent's main earthen fire vein was located.

characters.title: Duanmu Ji
characters.introText: Green robed old man with an Golden Plum Flower on his shirt. He has a green gourd.
characters.appearance: Green robed old man with an Golden Plum Flower on his shirt. He has a green gourd.
characters.history: He need Wang Lin help with his Death Spell to pass Land of the Ancient God third trial. In panic of Desolate Beast attack, he enter first trial together with Wang Qingyue and got separated with others. Wang Lin see the two again in third trial fighting Wandering Souls. After that the two captured by demonized Hunchback Meng and thrown them away to a rift that lead to Blood Sea where they will turned into a demon by Tuo Sen.

characters.title: Dun Tian
characters.introText: Dun Tian was a Soul Transformation cultivator of the Soul Refining Sect and the last ancestor of the Soul Refining Sect on Planet Suzaku before it was destroyed by the Fourth Generation Suzaku. At the peak of the Soul Transformation realm with the One Billion Soul Flag in his hand, he was able to fight against Ascendent cultivators.
characters.appearance: He was wearing a blue robe with hair extending to his waist. This person’s face was grey and he looked very old, but his eyes shined like the stars.

characters.title: Earth Commander-in-Chief
characters.introText: The Earth Commander-in-Chief of the Sky Demon Country is a prominent figure among the demon generals and commander-in-chiefs. He is particularly noted in  the demon general competition, a prestigious event where demon generals compete for the chance to become vice commander-in-chiefs, a rank just below commander-in-chief.In the competition, the Earth Commander-in-Chief is portrayed as highly knowledgeable about the talents of various demon generals. For instance, when Demon General Mo Fei participates, a general highly regarded for his abilities the Earth Commander-in-Chief expresses admiration. He remarks that if Mo Fei could experience the baptism at the dragon lake one more time, he could be considered among the top three vice commander-in-chiefs. This highlights both Mo Fei’s potential and the Earth Commander-in-Chief’s role as an evaluator and supporter of promising talent. He also demonstrates a personable side, humorously acknowledging his fondness for geniuses like Mo Fei.

He is particularly noted in  the demon general competition, a prestigious event where demon generals compete for the chance to become vice commander-in-chiefs, a rank just below commander-in-chief.In the competition, the Earth Commander-in-Chief is portrayed as highly knowledgeable about the talents of various demon generals. He remarks that if Mo Fei could experience the baptism at the dragon lake one more time, he could be considered among the top three vice commander-in-chiefs. This highlights both Mo Fei’s potential and the Earth Commander-in-Chief’s role as an evaluator and supporter of promising talent. He also demonstrates a personable side, humorously acknowledging his fondness for geniuses like Mo Fei.

Beyond competitions, the Earth Commander-in-Chief is actively involved in military campaigns. During the mobilization against the Fire Demon Country, he leads the left army of 10 million demon soldiers toward Songtao city. Mounted on a demonic beast, he maintains a serious and silent demeanor, commanding respect from other high-ranking officials.

characters.title: Eight Ancient Imperial Concubines
characters.introText: After obtaining the Heavenly Dao, Su Dao backstabbed his Dao Companion Fan Shanmeng so that no one may know that he had the Heavenly Dao and escaped to his Cave World. However, she survived due to her sect's special art. She immediately informed her younger sister Fan Shanlu of Su Dao's treachery.
characters.history:
Wang Lin met the First Concubine's avatar within the vortex inside Cloud Sea Star System.

Later, he saw the Fourth Concubine charge towards Tuo Sen after their battle outside the Moongazer Clan was abruptly ended.

Soon after Tuo Sen and his battle ended, Wang Lin felt someone following him so he escaped towards the Blue Silk Clan where he had to deliver Li Qian Mei to Dao Master Blue Dream. There, Dao Master Blue Dream taught him three Dao-Spells to allow him to protect himself from the Seventh Concubine who was following him. Wang Lin battled her and figured out that she was just a illusory avatar which allowed him to kill her.

Many months later, Wang Lin entered Ye Mo's Ancient Tomb where he encountered the Third Concubine. The two mutually helped each other: she helped Wang Lin escape when he was being followed by Devil Master Nine Heavens, Dao Master Miao Yin and Esteemed Great Desolation. In return, he allowed her to leave the Tomb when he was closing it and trapping the Outer Realm cultivators inside.

Wang Lin encountered the Second Concubine when her avatar ambushed him inside Sovereign's Fishing the Moon in the Well. She caused him great pain when cast a spell with her harp which turned his five organs into black liquid. However, he managed to overcome him and killed her avatar when he fired Li Guang's arrow.

Wang Lin encountered the Sixth Concubine when her avatar ambushed him inside Sovereign's Fishing the Moon in the Well. She continuously attacked him and hard to kill. Even after Wang Lin fired Li Guang's arrow, she managed to avoid it and survive. However, she finally died when Wang Lin released Master Scarlet Soul who devoured her body before breaking through the Sovereign's Fishing the Moon in the Well.

Wang Lin fought the Fifth Concubine during the final battle at the Allheaven Star System where he sealed her inside his Ancient God Emperor Furnace along with the Grey-robed Old Man that ambushed Wang Lin previously. Later, he handed her to Dao Master Blue Dream.

characters.title: Elder Lu
characters.appearance: Black clad middle aged man.

characters.title: Elder Ma

characters.title: Elder Zhang

characters.title: Esteemed Great Desolation
characters.introText: He wears beast skin clothing and has huge piercings throughout his entire face. He has three needles on his lips that he refined from the three Great Desolation Celestials. They contain a deadly poison.
characters.appearance:
He wears beast skin clothing and has huge piercings throughout his entire face. He has three needles on his lips that he refined from the three Great Desolation Celestials. They contain a deadly poison.

His mount is a huge lizard.
characters.history:
He appeared at the Fallen Land during the Fallen Council competition. He taunted and challenged the Second Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor to a battle. Afterwards, he left.

Soon after, he arrived at the Ancient Order Tomb. Due to not having any avatars, he forcefully threw multiple cultivators inside the Tomb and finally possessed the one that qualified to enter the Tomb.

Wang Lin and he worked together to kill Dao Master Miao Yin's avatar inside the Tomb. He possessed the latter's body while Wang Lin stole almost 30% of his Joss Flames to upgrade his ancient slave, Ling Dong.

Subsequently, the two were caught by an Ancient God hand and transported further inside the Tomb. This gave Wang Lin a chance to escape from Esteemed Great Desolation as while he seemed like a nice guy, he was merely working together with Wang Lin as they had a common goal.

After Wang Lin's stone platform reached the 9th level, a giant arm rushed towards, crushing everything between itself and the platform. Esteemed Great Desolation's avatar received a direct hit and was instantly destroyed along with his soul.

Enraged, he entered the Ancient Tomb with his original body after the expulsion fog retracted. However, he ended up trapped inside the Tomb after Wang Lin closed it.

Over a century later, Sovereign begged Seven-Colored Daoist to allow Dao Master Miao Yin, Devil Master Nine Heavens and Esteemed Great Desolation to escape the Tomb so that they could destroy Wang Lin's Unnamed Wheel Formation and draw his remaining two arrows from Li Guang's Bow.

The three appeared to kill Wang Lin but were intercepted by Dao Master Blue Dream. After three days of battle, Esteemed Great Desolation was injured the most and escaped using a secret spell. His injuries were so bad that his lifespan fell to just 10 years.

characters.title: Esteemed Nan Zhao
characters.introText: Like Esteemed Great Desolation, he is a poison cultivator.
characters.history:
He attacked Wang Lin soon after the latter appeared. He forcibly teleported Wang Lin to his Joss Flame Realm where he tried to kill him. If not for Wang Lin's life-saving Ancient God spell, he would be dead. Soon after Wang Lin his spell, Master Hong Shan appeared, saved Wang Lin, and severely wounded Esteemed Nan Zhao. This forced the Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor, Master Enlighten East, two other Nirvana Void cultivators and, even, Esteemed Nan Zhao to attack him together.

For some time Master Hong Shan managed to stall the five until he fell in Grandmaster Yun Luo's trap and was sneak-attacked by the Sixth Concubine. Furthermore, Ice Boy appeared to continue holding him back. This allowed the Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor to leave and confront Wang Lin who was rushing to kill Grandmaster Yun Luo. However, the former was easily sliced in half by the Heaven-Splitting Axe in Wang Lin's possession.

Ice Boy decided Wang Lin had to be stopped and forcibly sent Esteemed Nan Zhao and a Nirvana void cultivator from Bai Lei Clan out of the encirclement to kill Wang Lin. However, Wang Lin retaliated with a poison sneak-attack upon Esteemed Nan Zhao that resulted in the latter's death. The Nirvana void cultivator from Bai Lei Clan was too terrified to attempt to block Wang Lin and escaped.

characters.title: Esteemed Teacher Tian Zhao
characters.introText: He attempted to stop Wang Lin when the latter stormed the Cultivation Alliance to save Qing Shui. However, he was easily killed by Wang Lin after he released his Celestial Qi.
characters.history:
He attempted to stop Wang Lin when the latter stormed the Cultivation Alliance to save Qing Shui. However, he was easily killed by Wang Lin after he released his Celestial Qi.

Wang Lin also took his three Joss Flames Dragon Soul and gifted one to Master Flamespark and one to Shengong Hu while he freed the last one after it killed all the Outer Realm cultivators present in the Alliance headquarters.

characters.title: Fan Shanlu
characters.introText: In the past, she was a core disciple of Great Soul Sect but her elder sister, Fan Shanmeng, took her to become Su Dao's concubine.
characters.history:
During the three years Wang Lin was guarding the Unnamed Wheel Formation, he contacted Fan Shanlu through the jade she gave him centuries ago when he met her in the vortex inside the Cloud Sea Star System.

After destroying the Outer Realm's Ancient Celestial Realm, Wang Lin killed the Sovereign, once again, sealed the avatar souls of Dao Master Miao Yin and Devil Master Nine Heavens and gravely injured the Seventh Concubine. At this point, Seven-Colored Daoist appeared to reclaim Li Guang's Bow that he had "lent" to Wang Lin. However, Wang Lin immediately crushed the jade Fan Shanlu had given him and was instantly teleported to the vortex inside the Cloud Sea Star System.

There, he learnt about the demise of the Seven Dao Sect from Fan Shanmeng who entered Fan Shanlu's body through the use of a bloodline spell. Fan Shanmeng then lured him onto the Soul Devil Ship where she him put under her Great Soul True Illusion spell. Even Fan Shanlu was put under that spell so that Wang Lin may not notice any flaws. However, he still managed to realize the reality and broke through the spell. Fan Shanlu simply found it impossible to believe that her sister could jeopardize her, as she did.

She left for the Immortal Astral Continent when Wang Lin opened the Cave's exit.

She helped Wang Lin enter the hall close to the Great Soul Sect's main earthen fire vein, even at the cost of compromising herself. She did this as she felt a closeness to Wang Lin that she didn't feel to anyone on the Immortal Astral Continent; this was because she had spent most of her life in the Cave which made the Immortal Astral Continent seem like a foreign land.

characters.title: Fan Shanmeng
characters.introText: She is a treacherous woman who uses her charm on men to succeed in life. She charmed Su Dao into marrying her and then, supposedly, had an affair with Lian Daofei which was one of motivations behind Su Dao killing her despite his love for her.
characters.personality: She is a treacherous woman who uses her charm on men to succeed in life. She charmed Su Dao into marrying her and then, supposedly, had an affair with Lian Daofei which was one of motivations behind Su Dao killing her despite his love for her.
characters.history:
During the three years Wang Lin was guarding the Unnamed Wheel Formation, he contacted Fan Shanlu through the jade she gave him centuries ago when he met her in the vortex inside the Cloud Sea Star System.

After destroying the Outer Realm's Ancient Celestial Realm, Wang Lin killed the Sovereign, once again, sealed the souls of Dao Master Miao Yin and Devil Master Nine Heavens and gravely injured the Seventh Concubine. At this point, Seven-Colored Daoist appeared to reclaim Li Guang's Bow that he had "lent" to Wang Lin. However, Wang Lin immediately crushed the jade Fan Shanlu had given him and was instantly teleported to vortex inside the Cloud Sea Star System.

There, he learnt about demise of the Seven Dao Sect from Fan Shanmeng who temporarily took over Fan Shanlu's body by using a bloodline spell. Fan Shanmeng led him onto the Soul Devil Ship, a mid-level treasure of her Great Soul Sect. The ship was in fact made entirely of ancient restrictions from the Immortal Astral Continent. There, Wang Lin learnt the complete Four Great Ancient Restrictions which would allow him to create his restriction essence.

In reality, from the time Wang Lin entered the ship, he was put under Fan Shanmeng's Great Soul True Illusion spell. Even Fan Shanlu was put under that spell so that Wang Lin may not notice any flaws. However, he still managed to realize the reality and broke through the spell.

Despite the damage he caused inside the Great Soul Sect, Wang Lin was invited to be an elder of the sect by Esteemed Green Bull. While leaving for his Fire Vein Mountain, Wang Lin noticed Fan Shanmeng and asked Yan Lu to give her to him as a servant girl. Although Yan Lu was initially incensed by this request, she later accepted it as a way to vent her anger at Fan Shanmeng for causing troubles with Wang Lin inside the Cave World which may have influenced him to come to the Great Soul Sect.

characters.title: Feng Luan
characters.introText: Feng Luan is one of the Ancestors of War God Shrine Sect, and mother of Zhou Zihong.

characters.title: Feng Yin
characters.introText: A character who appears as a woman wearing armor, with a tattoo covering much of her body, though parts of it are obscured by the armor. She is associated with a powerful demonic wind and is identified as a Demon Guardian, specifically “Demon Guardian Wind Song” of Scattered Devil Tai Jia. Her combat abilities revolve around wind and weapon techniques, including the use of a silver dagger and the ability to transform into a cold breeze for rapid, elusive attacks.
characters.appearance:
A character who appears as a woman wearing armor, with a tattoo covering much of her body, though parts of it are obscured by the armor. She is associated with a powerful demonic wind and is identified as a Demon Guardian, specifically “Demon Guardian Wind Song” of Scattered Devil Tai Jia. Her combat abilities revolve around wind and weapon techniques, including the use of a silver dagger and the ability to transform into a cold breeze for rapid, elusive attacks.

She was sent together with De Gui to kill Wang Lin after he directly attacked Devil Tower, the place where the Scattered Devil resides. During her confrontation with Wang Lin, she fights using these techniques but is ultimately forced to retreat after being struck by Wang Lin’s Soul Lasher whip and a powerful palm strike imbued with slaughter energy. Her eyes reveal shock and fear, and in that moment she no longer intends to kill, only to flee as quickly as possible. However, Wang Lin refuses to let her escape and uses the Celestial World Hand Seal, a giant hand that descends from the sky and kills her

characters.title: Feng Zhiman
characters.introText: Soon after Wang Lin left the Fallen Land and grievously wounded the Sovereign's avatar at the Fire Sparrow Clan, she helped Zhou Jin track him down. The two stayed on Wang Lin's track as he ran towards the Ancient Order Tomb. On the way, Wang Lin killed all the members of a branch of the Esteemed Heavenly Wolf Clan which incited Zhou Jin's hatred. Wang Lin used that to assault the latter with his Ethereal Flame. He also used that opportunity to kill Feng Zhiman once and exhausted one of her three lives.
characters.history:
Soon after Wang Lin left the Fallen Land and grievously wounded the Sovereign's avatar at the Fire Sparrow Clan, she helped Zhou Jin track him down. The two stayed on Wang Lin's track as he ran towards the Ancient Order Tomb. On the way, Wang Lin killed all the members of a branch of the Esteemed Heavenly Wolf Clan which incited Zhou Jin's hatred. Wang Lin used that to assault the latter with his Ethereal Flame. He also used that opportunity to kill Feng Zhiman once and exhausted one of her three lives.

Subsequently, the duo accidentally entered the fog surrounding the Ancient Order Tomb which resulted in Feng Zhiman dying once again and being left with her last life. Luckily, her last life allowed her to gain the qualification to enter the Tomb. The two got separated after entering the Tomb. Feng Zhiman ended up being teleported to the same location as Wang Lin. She tried to unite the others there against Wang Lin but before she could do so, he displayed his might and cowed all of them. Later, Ling Dong's group appeared and tried to break open the restrictions sealing the rank 4 Dao Spirit which resulted in the entire group separating.

After leaving that location, Wang Lin found Dao Master Miao Yin and Esteemed Great Desolation fighting and he decided to lend a hand to the latter. Wang Lin struck like lightning and killed the Dao Master's followers and kidnapped his maid in an instant. Then, he worked in tandem with Esteemed Great Desolation to injure the Dao Master so severely that Esteemed Great Desolation managed to possess his avatar and Wang Lin managed to steal almost 30% of his Joss Flames to upgrade his ancient slave, Ling Dong.

Later, Wang Lin unsealed Feng Zhiman and learned the secrets of the Sealing Extermination Clan from her. He took her clan symbol and decided to release her after exiting the Tomb.

characters.title: Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor
characters.introText: He kidnapped Liu Jinbiao from the Fallen Land after Wang Lin planted some of his own Vermillion Bird blood inside him. This led him to falsely believe Liu Jinbiao to the be the Sixth Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor.
characters.history:
He kidnapped Liu Jinbiao from the Fallen Land after Wang Lin planted some of his own Vermillion Bird blood inside him. This led him to falsely believe Liu Jinbiao to the be the Sixth Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor.

He handed Liu Jinbiao over to the Third Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor who is one of the Sovereign's clones. This allowed Wang Lin to infiltrate the Fire Sparrow Clan. He teleported there through his connection to Liu Jinbiao and severely wounded the Sovereign's clones by using the Vermillion Bird feather given to him by the Vermillion Bird Ancestor and the Realm Burning Umbrella spell passed down to him by the Second Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor.

Afterwards, the Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor took part in the war against the Sealed Realm. After Master Hong Shan appeared, saved Wang Lin, and severely wounded Esteemed Nan Zhao, the Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor along with Master Enlighten East, two other Nirvana Void cultivators and, even, Esteemed Nan Zhao attacked him together.

For some time Master Hong Shan managed to stall the five until he fell in Grandmaster Yun Luo's trap and was sneak-attacked by the Sixth Concubine. Furthermore, one of the Five Masters appeared to continue holding him back. This allowed the Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor to leave and confront Wang Lin who was rushing to kill Grandmaster Yun Luo. However, the former was easily sliced in half by the Heaven-Splitting Axe in Wang Lin's possession.

characters.title: Flower Imperial Concubine Han Yan
characters.introText: She was very beautiful, almost to a demonic level. Even though Liu Mei didn’t lose to her in appearance, she lacked an unspeakable feeling. She was like a flower of the world that would bloom and wither along with the world.
characters.appearance:
She was very beautiful, almost to a demonic level. Even though Liu Mei didn’t lose to her in appearance, she lacked an unspeakable feeling. She was like a flower of the world that would bloom and wither along with the world.

She was said to be above the rest of Qing Lin's seven concubines.
characters.history:
She stopped Wang Lin and company from entering the fourth minor celestial cave in the East Demon Spirit Sea. She is far stronger than even the likes of Qing Shui and Master Flamespark.

She only allowed Wang Lin to enter after he used the Stop Spell and showed her Qing Shuang's corpse.

characters.title: Fourth Ancestor of the Forsaken Immortal Clan
Fourth Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor
characters.introText: In the past, the Third Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor betrayed the Vermillion Bird Divine Sect, stole a lot of their treasures, and sealed the three Vermillion Birds into the Fallen Land such that the First Vermillion Bird cannot leave the Heaven Test, the Second Vermillion Bird cannot leave the Great Emperor Planet, and the Fourth Vermillion Bird cannot leave the Earth Test.
characters.history:
In the past, the Third Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor betrayed the Vermillion Bird Divine Sect, stole a lot of their treasures, and sealed the three Vermillion Birds into the Fallen Land such that the First Vermillion Bird cannot leave the Heaven Test, the Second Vermillion Bird cannot leave the Great Emperor Planet, and the Fourth Vermillion Bird cannot leave the Earth Test.

It is speculated by the Vermillion Bird Ancestor that he was sent by the Sovereign Council who then used the treasures he stole to help create the Fire Sparrow Clan.

characters.title: Ge Yang
characters.introText: Wang Lin killed him because of Ma Liang's last wish.

characters.title: Gemini
characters.introText: She was originally the strongest Celestial Grand Empyrean, possessing strength that even Jiu Di was wary of. However, during her last reincarnation, her soul split into Han Han and Wa Wa and she lost much of her strength. Furthermore, her two halves were not yet mature enough to fully use their potential as a Grand Empyrean without causing irreparable harm to themselves.
characters.history:
When Wang Lin broke through to the Third Step and destroyed the Cave World's Tribulation, he encountered Wa Wa when he projected his divine sense out of the Cave to the Immortal Astral Continent. (edit : Book Eleven chapter 1617, she said her name is "Doll"(WaWa))

Later, he encountered Han Han and Wa Wa, again, when he entered the Ancient One altar inside the spatial crack near the Cloud Sea. He also saw Greed with them when they inadvertently helped scare off Seven-Colored Daoist for him.

She aids Wang Lin greatly throughout his time in the Immortal Astral Continent. She is also the only Grand Empyrean to do so without any ulterior motive. Wang Lin recognizes this when the other Celestial Clan Grand Empyrean's come to recruit him and picks her solely due to this karma, much to her (Han Han and Wa Wa's) delight.

Gemini helps Wang Lin once again later on by engaging Lian Daozhen while he dealt with the Immortal Imperial Teacher. In order to combat the her fellow Grand Empyrean, she used a special technique that allowed Han Han and Wa Wa to fuse back into her original form. Though the fusion was unstable, it allowed her to contend with the Celestial Emperor until the unexpected arrival of Jiu Di, Dao Yi, and Wu Feng.

She was also the only Grand Empyrean to not be affected by the Ancestral Curse of the Celestial Ancestor as she chose not to fight Lian Daozhen with the others for the Celestial Ancestor's Head.

When Wang Lin pilfered the Celestial Ancestor's head from Lian Daozhen after revealing that he was actually alive, he gave her the Celestial Ancestor's eyes. According to Jiu Di they would be able to fully restore the power she loss during her split and even make her stronger.

However, when Wang Lin demanded to take Lian Daofei she reluctantly opposed him along with the other Celestial Grand Empyrean's. She informed him that Lian Daofei was needed to maintain the seal on the 72 Foreign Beasts that were sealed by the Celestial Clan and if he were not there, the entire Celestial Clan could be destroyed.

When the other Celestial Clan Grand Empyrean's go their separate ways to recover from the backlash of the Celestial Ancestor's Ancestral Curse, she admits to Wang Lin that she knew about his ties to the Ancient Clan, to which the latter thanks her for doing so much for him despite knowing the truth.

When Wang Lin completes his Grand Empyrean Sun, she celebrates in the form of Han Han and Wa Wa.

She later appears with the rest of the Nine Suns in her true form due to sensing the great battle between Wang Lin and Gu Dao. She agrees with Jiu Di's request to pour their powers together to reverse time and witness the events that had transpired before their arrival, and is shocked to discover that Wang Lin had defeated Gu Dao and was now the strongest being in the Immortal Astral Continent.

When the opening of the Immemorial God Realm began, she decided to stay in the Celestial Clan and did not join the rest of the Celestial Grand Empyrean's.

characters.title: Giant Demon Clan Ancestor
characters.introText: The Giant Demon Clan Ancestor was one of the most fearsome Soul Transformation cultivators in the southeastern region of Planet Suzaku, hailing from the nearly extinct and once-mighty Giant Demon Clan (巨魔族). In a desperate attempt to restore his clan’s former glory, he formed an alliance with Li Yuanfeng, the Sect Head of Snow Country, plotting to seize Wang Lin’s body and the mysterious artifact hidden within him—the legendary Heaven Defying Bead (天逆珠). To ensure secrecy and eliminate any witnesses, he ruthlessly slaughtered those who knew of the bead’s existence, including members of his own clan and the Zhao State envoy Lin Yi. Wielding the Giant Demon Clan’s ancestral weapon, the infamous Sky-Cleaving Axe (开天巨斧)—a relic said to be stained with the blood of ancient gods—he sought to dominate the battlefield. Wang Lin called in the help of Sun Tai, which cause him to retreat in the Battle giving Wang Lin a chance to escape

characters.title: Gong Mo
characters.introText: Founded the War God Shrine. Found the Divine Path. The second year after Gong Mo found the Divine Path, there was a traitor, so the news of the Divine Path suddenly spread far and wide. Soon after, the rank 4 cultivation country, Tian Gang, arrived. After secretly talking to Gong Mo, they took it away. Gong Mo then left the War God Shrine and never came back.
