characters.title: Greed
characters.introText: A man wearing a blue robe was standing on top of the waves and walked closer step by step.
characters.appearance:
He appeared at Planet Suzaku some time before the Suzaku Tomb was opened by Zhu Quezi. Like before, he was looking for the Heaven Defying Bead.

A few years later, he appeared at Planet Da Lou around the same time as the opening of the East Demon Spirit Sea. As an acquaintance of Ling Tianhou, he was sent in with the latter's 12 Swords Disciples to look after them and to fortify the seal put upon Zhou Yi.

Wang Lin first encountered Greed in the Demon Spirit Land's Tide Abyss where he and most of Ling Tianhou's disciples were trapped by a swarm of Mosquito Beasts. There, Wang Lin freed Zhou Yi and together they ambushed Greed and the 12 Swords Disciples. During the confusion, Wang Lin killed all of the 12 Swords Disciples except Chen Long. He even captured the Ancient Thunder Dragon Greed unleashed upon him before disappearing in the depths of the cave. This Ancient Thunder Dragon became the foundation of his future Thunder essence.

After Wang Lin escaped to the Allheaven Star System, Greed was sent after him by the Ling Tianhou, All-Seer and the others to retrieve the key fragment in his possession. However, before he could do so, he was trapped inside Planet Yun Xia's Moongazer Serpent for a century because of touching the serpent's moonflower.

Afterwards, Wang Lin appeared to steal the Moongazer Serpent moonflower which allowed Greed to escape. However, Wang Lin ransacked all of his treasures while a mad Moongazer Serpent assaulted Greed. Still, Greed survived and escaped.

Many centuries later, Wang Lin encountered Greed in the Outer Realm's Fallen Land where Wang Lin once again robbed all of his treasures such as the Starling Swords, the Bone Protection Nine Tablets, the Heaven Burial Wood Spirit, the Ancient Demon Emperor Furnace, the Ancient Devil Lance, the Ancient One Stop Leaves, the Devil Soul Bottle, and the Ancient Celestial Sovereign's statue. Finally, Wang Lin let him go and even removed the Moongazer Serpent's stench that had been haunting him for centuries from his body.

After escaping the Fallen Land, he encountered the war between the Inner and Outer Realms. This war made him extremely excited as it was an opportunity for him to obtain even more treasures and raise his cultivation level. Greed followed the Outer Realm army to the Cloud Sea Star System and then secretly left. Following his sense for treasure, he found the spatial rift in the Cloud Sea and entered it.

As soon as he entered it, he sensed the aura of a powerful treasure. Greed followed his treasure sense inside the cave and found the Ancient One Alter. He also saw the world inside the rift that the corner of the altar was stuck in. He saw countless celestial grasses. Almost all of them could increase his cultivation level once he refined them.

Aside from celestial grass, he saw extremely gentle celestial beasts that had terrifying cultivation levels. The celestial beasts were chasing and playing with each other. From his experience, he knew they wouldn’t bother him if he didn’t provoke them. Although he was ecstatic, he kept his cool and carefully observed the rift. After observing for several days, he saw two little girls appear. In his view, these two little girls posed no threat. Greed laughed happily and entered the rift.

The barrier on the rift had no effect on him at all. Greed didn’t feel this was strange at all, he had encountered things similar to this many times. After entering the rift, he saw that the girls were shocked to see him, and waved his hand to trap the two little girls and began to pick the celestial grasses.

The two little girls were startled for a while. Then the girl named Wa Wa step forward, completely ignoring Greed’s entrapment. She appeared behind him and gave him a kick. After this kick, Greed’s misery began. The two forced him to tell them interesting stories for over a hundred years.

Finally, after seeing the girls not paying attention to him, he managed to rush back out of the rift. However, what he saw terrified him. What he say was Wang Lin being chased by Seven-Colored Daoist and rushing towards him. He was instantly terrified and begged the two girls for help. The two girls used Greed as a medium to use their Grand Empyrean powers inside the Cave. This scared him out of his wits and he instantly escaped.
characters.history:
He appeared at Planet Suzaku some time before the Suzaku Tomb was opened by Zhu Quezi. Like before, he was looking for the Heaven Defying Bead.

A few years later, he appeared at Planet Da Lou around the same time as the opening of the East Demon Spirit Sea. As an acquaintance of Ling Tianhou, he was sent in with the latter's 12 Swords Disciples to look after them and to fortify the seal put upon Zhou Yi.

Wang Lin first encountered Greed in the Demon Spirit Land's Tide Abyss where he and most of Ling Tianhou's disciples were trapped by a swarm of Mosquito Beasts. There, Wang Lin freed Zhou Yi and together they ambushed Greed and the 12 Swords Disciples. During the confusion, Wang Lin killed all of the 12 Swords Disciples except Chen Long. He even captured the Ancient Thunder Dragon Greed unleashed upon him before disappearing in the depths of the cave. This Ancient Thunder Dragon became the foundation of his future Thunder essence.

After Wang Lin escaped to the Allheaven Star System, Greed was sent after him by the Ling Tianhou, All-Seer and the others to retrieve the key fragment in his possession. However, before he could do so, he was trapped inside Planet Yun Xia's Moongazer Serpent for a century because of touching the serpent's moonflower.

Afterwards, Wang Lin appeared to steal the Moongazer Serpent moonflower which allowed Greed to escape. However, Wang Lin ransacked all of his treasures while a mad Moongazer Serpent assaulted Greed. Still, Greed survived and escaped.

Many centuries later, Wang Lin encountered Greed in the Outer Realm's Fallen Land where Wang Lin once again robbed all of his treasures such as the Starling Swords, the Bone Protection Nine Tablets, the Heaven Burial Wood Spirit, the Ancient Demon Emperor Furnace, the Ancient Devil Lance, the Ancient One Stop Leaves, the Devil Soul Bottle, and the Ancient Celestial Sovereign's statue. Finally, Wang Lin let him go and even removed the Moongazer Serpent's stench that had been haunting him for centuries from his body.

After escaping the Fallen Land, he encountered the war between the Inner and Outer Realms. This war made him extremely excited as it was an opportunity for him to obtain even more treasures and raise his cultivation level. Greed followed the Outer Realm army to the Cloud Sea Star System and then secretly left. Following his sense for treasure, he found the spatial rift in the Cloud Sea and entered it.

As soon as he entered it, he sensed the aura of a powerful treasure. Greed followed his treasure sense inside the cave and found the Ancient One Alter. He also saw the world inside the rift that the corner of the altar was stuck in. He saw countless celestial grasses. Almost all of them could increase his cultivation level once he refined them.

Aside from celestial grass, he saw extremely gentle celestial beasts that had terrifying cultivation levels. The celestial beasts were chasing and playing with each other. From his experience, he knew they wouldn’t bother him if he didn’t provoke them. Although he was ecstatic, he kept his cool and carefully observed the rift. After observing for several days, he saw two little girls appear. In his view, these two little girls posed no threat. Greed laughed happily and entered the rift.

The barrier on the rift had no effect on him at all. Greed didn’t feel this was strange at all, he had encountered things similar to this many times. After entering the rift, he saw that the girls were shocked to see him, and waved his hand to trap the two little girls and began to pick the celestial grasses.

The two little girls were startled for a while. Then the girl named Wa Wa step forward, completely ignoring Greed’s entrapment. She appeared behind him and gave him a kick. After this kick, Greed’s misery began. The two forced him to tell them interesting stories for over a hundred years.

Finally, after seeing the girls not paying attention to him, he managed to rush back out of the rift. However, what he saw terrified him. What he say was Wang Lin being chased by Seven-Colored Daoist and rushing towards him. He was instantly terrified and begged the two girls for help. The two girls used Greed as a medium to use their Grand Empyrean powers inside the Cave. This scared him out of his wits and he instantly escaped.

characters.title: Gu Dao
characters.introText: He is one of the Nine Suns on the Ancient Clan's side as well as the strongest out of the nine. His power surpasses that of the other suns to such a degree that his Grand Empyrean sun is said to be larger then all of the others combined.
characters.history:
At the height of the Celestial Clan's power, when they possessed 9 Grand Empyrean's, he killed 2 them even though they fought together. He was also later ambushed by another, which he killed as well.

At some point in time, he was visited by Grand Empyrean Dong Lin, who personally ventured to the Ancient Clan and challenged Mount Gu Dao. While the details of what transpired are unknown, Gu Dao acknowledged him as the only Celestial to have ever challenged the Mountain.

characters.title: Gu Yundun
characters.introText: Demon Emperor Gu Yundun is one of the most powerful and authoritative figures in the Demon Spirit Land, ruling as the supreme sovereign of the Sky Demon Country. From his first appearance, he is portrayed as a cold, ruthless, and commanding presence whose authority is unquestioned. He is often seen wearing bright red robes embroidered with golden threads, a striking contrast to the icy, murderous aura he emits—an aura described as being colder than never-melting ice. This visual and spiritual contrast reinforces his nature as a ruler who embodies both absolute control and latent violence.
characters.appearance:
Demon Emperor Gu Yundun is one of the most powerful and authoritative figures in the Demon Spirit Land, ruling as the supreme sovereign of the Sky Demon Country. From his first appearance, he is portrayed as a cold, ruthless, and commanding presence whose authority is unquestioned. He is often seen wearing bright red robes embroidered with golden threads, a striking contrast to the icy, murderous aura he emits—an aura described as being colder than never-melting ice. This visual and spiritual contrast reinforces his nature as a ruler who embodies both absolute control and latent violence.

Despite his cold nature, Gu Yundun’s attitude toward Wang Lin is notably cordial and pragmatic. He does not view Wang Lin as a subordinate, but as a valuable ally whose existence aligns with greater forces. At the same time, their interaction reveals Gu Yundun’s personal complexity particularly through his relationship with his niece, the Emperor Sword Spirit. Her presence creates subtle awkwardness during their meetings, especially when she displays undisguised emotional reactions toward Wang Lin. While Wang Lin’s own sword spirit conceals her thoughts, Gu Yundun perceptively notices the lustful gaze cast toward Wang Lin, highlighting both his sharp awareness and the unusual interpersonal dynamics surrounding him.

Following this encounter, Gu Yundun formally announces Wang Lin’s identity as the Ancient Demon’s messenger throughout the Sky Demon Country. This declaration dramatically alters Wang Lin’s standing, granting him legitimacy, military merits, and access to resources that would otherwise take centuries to acquire. It also reinforces Gu Yundun’s strategic mindset rather than opposing a rising power, he integrates it into the existing structure to serve broader objectives during the ongoing war.
characters.trivia: Gu Yundun (also known as Gu Yunchi in some translations)

characters.title: Hai Zi
characters.introText: She is currently the only remaining living member of Immortal Astral Continent's Mourning-Death Clan.
characters.history:
She first met Wang Lin when the latter was trying to obtain Wood Essence.

As a way to bypass the seal restricting the Mourning-Death Clan, she was born between a female Mourning-Death member and Grand Empyrean Jiu Di, resulting in a Mourning-Death Soul but an Immortal body. As such, she was able to bypass the restrictions and roam freely.

She is also the true Celestial Imperial Teacher. Born as part of a plan to free the Mourning-Death Clan from the Celestial Clan's Royal Family, her memories were sealed until the death of the fake Imperial Teacher during the confrontation between Wang Lin and the Celestial Emperor Lian Daozhen.

characters.title: Han Yan
characters.introText: She is the dao companion and wife of Immortal Lord Qing Shui, and the mother of Red Butterfly.
characters.history:
She was the quiet miracle in a life built on blood.

Qing Shui had spent centuries as a blade—sharp, cold, and unreachable. Hatred had carved him hollow. The Ji Realm of Slaughter burned in his eyes, and the world learned to fear the man who once rejected heaven and earth.

Then Han Yan appeared, and somehow, impossibly, she reached past all of it. She did not conquer him with force or grand gestures. She simply stayed. In her presence the killing intent softened. The ice around his heart began to melt. For tens of thousands of years she lived beside him as dao companion, wife, and the only person who ever saw the man beneath him.

She gave him a home that was not built on corpses. She gave him a daughter, Red Butterfly. She gave him ordinary, steady days of warmth that Qing Shui had never believed he deserved.

Han Yan must have known the danger she lived with. She must have felt the residual killing aura that never fully left him, the storms that still moved behind his eyes. Yet she chose him anyway. She chose the long, quiet work of loving someone the world had taught to be a weapon. In return he set aside the pure path of slaughter for her. For a time, they were simply two people who had found each other in an endless, cruel cultivation world.

Then the madness came.

When the Ji Realm swallowed Qing Shui completely, he became the instrument of her death. In the chaos of the Thunder Celestial Realm’s fall, Qing Shui killed without recognition—friends, disciples, kin… and her. The last thing she did was reach for him. With the final strength left in her body she tried to touch his face, as if even then she was trying to call him back, to remind him who he was.

Han Yan’s story is not one of power or glory. It is the quieter, deeper tragedy of the person who became light for someone living in the darkness, only to be extinguished by the very hands she had warmed. She lived long enough to prove that even the most broken heart could still love. And she died proving that some losses can never be undone.

In the long centuries that followed, every rare softness that surfaced in Qing Shui carried her shadow. She remained the silent center of his grief— the one who once made him human, and whose final reach he could never answer.

characters.title: Heaven Master Void God
characters.introText: Heaven Master Void God ambushed Wang Lin inside Sovereign's Fishing the Moon in the Well. He appeared suddenly while Wang Lin was encircled by the Second and Sixth Concubine. Initially, he was disinterested in this ambush as he felt it was overkill for so many Arcane Void cultivators to attempt to kill a Second-Step cultivator. However, after he saw Wang Lin's Immortal Celestial Body, he immediately attacked him and tried to possess his body to become a Celestial. He would have succeeded if not for Wang Lin's background as a Soul Devourer as he right after being possessed he called all the wandering souls from Planet Suzaku's Foreign Battleground to help him dispel Heaven Master Void God from his body.
characters.history:
Heaven Master Void God ambushed Wang Lin inside Sovereign's Fishing the Moon in the Well. He appeared suddenly while Wang Lin was encircled by the Second and Sixth Concubine. Initially, he was disinterested in this ambush as he felt it was overkill for so many Arcane Void cultivators to attempt to kill a Second-Step cultivator. However, after he saw Wang Lin's Immortal Celestial Body, he immediately attacked him and tried to possess his body to become a Celestial. He would have succeeded if not for Wang Lin's background as a Soul Devourer as he right after being possessed he called all the wandering souls from Planet Suzaku's Foreign Battleground to help him dispel Heaven Master Void God from his body.

He then pulled out Li Guang's Bow and shot it. It destroyed the Second Concubine's avatar and severely injured the Sixth Concubine's avatar as she had used a treasure given to her by Su Dao. It then flew killed Ice Boy's avatar and then flew towards Heaven Master Void God but he managed to evade it as he is infamously known as the "most elusive and toughest to kill among the Five Masters."

72 years after Wang Lin was ambushed by Sovereign's Fishing the Moon in the Well, Master South Cloud led the remnants of the Alliance to battle against the Outer Realm. The battleground was near Planet Suzaku where the Inner Realm cultivators fought to defend the Lord of the Inner Realm's homeland.

The battle was in a deadlock with the Outer Realm's Zhou Jin and Ice Boy facing off against Master South Cloud, Situ Nan, Master Lu Fu and Master Long Pan until the Heaven Master Void God's avatar appeared. This immediately tilted the balance of power against the Inner Realm cultivators and forced them to retreat inside the formation of Planet Suzaku. When all hope was lost, Wang Lin triggered the Great Void Gate and appeared to lift the spirits of the weary Inner Realm cultivators. He reached the Third Step and destroyed Heaven Master Void God's avatar with a shot from Li Guang's Bow. This resulted in severe injuries to his original body forced him to hide until his injuries healed.

Afterwards, Wang Lin sought out Heaven Master Void God in the southern part of the Ancient Primordial Star System in an area filled with debris. There was originally a planet here, but it had collapsed, creating an area of death covered in rocks. As soon as he saw Wang Lin appear, he gave up all resistance. After Heaven Master Void God learned of Wang Lin's plans to reincarnate him, he acquiesced. Wang Lin then sealed his soul and left.
characters.trivia: Heaven Master Void God is called “Void God” because his body is like void. It could be said that his body is not real and is only a mass of energy.

characters.title: Hong Maozi
characters.introText: Hong Maozi (红毛子) is the Outer Region Manager of the infamous Soul Refining Sect on Planet Suzaku. With a cultivation base at the early stage of Core Formation, he oversees operations and discipline among the lower-ranking disciples and cultivators in the sect’s periphery. His appearance is marked by a robe glowing with crimson spiritual light and a ferocious, fiery aura surrounding him, reflecting the brutal and soul-centric practices of the sect. While not a top-tier powerhouse himself, his loyalty to the sect's cruel hierarchy and his role in enforcing its dark laws make him a dangerous figure for new cultivators entering its domain.
characters.appearance:
Hong Maozi (红毛子) is the Outer Region Manager of the infamous Soul Refining Sect on Planet Suzaku. With a cultivation base at the early stage of Core Formation, he oversees operations and discipline among the lower-ranking disciples and cultivators in the sect’s periphery. His appearance is marked by a robe glowing with crimson spiritual light and a ferocious, fiery aura surrounding him, reflecting the brutal and soul-centric practices of the sect. While not a top-tier powerhouse himself, his loyalty to the sect's cruel hierarchy and his role in enforcing its dark laws make him a dangerous figure for new cultivators entering its domain.

He refused to let Wang Lin become a disciple of Soul Refining Sect, saying the period for that was long over and he should come back in three years. However, he allows Wang Lin to join the Soul Refining Sect after Wang Lin bribes him, He gives him a treasured sword.

characters.title: Hongdie
characters.introText: Hongdie was an extremely talented cultivator from the cultivation country of Xue Yue on Planet Suzaku. She held the record of reaching the Soul Formation/Deity Transformation stage in under a single century.
characters.appearance: A beautiful young woman with deep and bright red hair and eyes. She has a pair of beautiful phoenix eyes which are filled with endless pride. She is a gorgeous woman but her temperament transforms her into a valiant beauty.
characters.personality: Due to her supreme talent and young age, Hongdie acted very naive and confrontational as she lacked experience and patience. This allowed Wang Lin to gain several victories against her early on.
characters.history:
She was initially hostile towards Wang Lin as he destroyed one of her spirits, as well as due to her knowledge of a prophecy foretelling her downfall at another's hand. This hostility grew along with her losses.

However, when she falls into the hands of Qian Feng who tortures her and uses her as a refining furnace all for his sick amusement and cultivation, she realizes that the one she had been warned about was Qian Feng, not Wang Lin. Subsequently, she is turned into a puppet with no will of her own. 

Later, when Wang Lin finds her, her will resurfaces and she asks him to release her and also kill her tormentor. Wang Lin complies out of respect for her, killing her and letting her be reborn.

At least some aspect of her reincarnated as the blue rose that she offered Wang Lin as payment for killing Qian Feng. This would later become the spirit within the Golden Crown (aka Celestial Emperor Crown), which he summons to assist him in battle.

Her reincarnated self reappears as a woman in blue serving as the Cultivation Alliance's war commander during the war against the Allheaven Star System. She frequently reappears after this stating to Wang Lin "Lord doesn't know me, but I know you"

When Wang Lin returns to Planet Suzaku during the war with the Outer Realm, he learns of her revival and then sees her in his Dream Dao as a baby.

During the final battle of the Third Sealed-Outer Realm War in Allheaven, a seriously-injured Qing Shui appears to save her from a Third-Step Outer Realm cultivator. She is surprised that someone with high status like Qing Shui would risk injury to save her. After Wang Lin ends the war, Qing Shui tells her about her identity and their relation.

She follows Wang Lin while he defends the Inner Realm with his Unnamed Wheel Formation. She talks with Wang Lin and they reconnect as old friends. She finally leaves after one year and goes on to meet Qing Shui.

After Wang Lin created the New Celestial Realm, Qing Shui and Hongdie took a mountain and made it their home. There Hongdie accompanied her father as he helped her with her cultivation.

After the war, she chose to reincarnate on the Immortal Astral Continet together with her father.

She ultimately reincarnated on the Immortal Astral Continent in the Sun and Moon Sect as Qing Hong, where she was comsidered an extremely talented disciple and reached the Third Step in under a thousand years. She could sense the existence of her past life, and long knew Wang Lin would come to her seeking to restore her memories. However, she chose her new life over her past one, and talking with her gave Wang Lin great insight into the concept of reincarnation.
characters.trivia: She has undergone the most deaths and rebirths/reincarnations of any character in Renegade Immortal, having died as Qing Shui's daughter, then herself, then chosen to reincarnate as the woman in pink to become Qing Hong, furthermore she is aware that she was reborn at least once more before any of this. As such, she had died four times and lived five lives.

characters.title: Hu Juan
characters.introText: She was wearing a lavender dress embroidered with small, pink flowers. Her hair was loosely tied into a bun with a lavender hairpin inside. Although it looked casual, it didn’t lose its elegance. She had light makeup on, and her lips were red without the use of any cinnabar.
characters.appearance:
She was wearing a lavender dress embroidered with small, pink flowers. Her hair was loosely tied into a bun with a lavender hairpin inside. Although it looked casual, it didn’t lose its elegance. She had light makeup on, and her lips were red without the use of any cinnabar.

It could be said that her body was soft and her aura was fragrant!

Appearence Ep 129

characters.title: Huan Dong
characters.introText: Huan Dong is a member of the Huan family from the planet Thousand Illusion. He is described as a handsome man in his early thirties. Acting under Liu Mei’s orders, he is sent to handle a specific matter on the planet Ran Yun, expressing full confidence that he will not disappoint her.

characters.title: Huan Wuqing
characters.introText: Ancestor of the Huan Family on Thousand Illusion Planet, head planet in the Allheaven Star System’s Northern Domain. He was traveling in the Alliance Star System for thousands of years searching for the heaven defying bead, but met Liu Mei who was cultivating the Thousand Illusion Ruthless Domain instead and accepted her as a disciple. He later adopted Liu Mei and inducted her into the Huan Family by performing the bloodline ritual. The bloodline ritual refines the purest Huan family blood from of tens of thousands of Huan family members, turn that into one thousand blood runes that will imprint on a person, and then finally extract all of the blood in that person’s body.
characters.history:
Ancestor of the Huan Family on Thousand Illusion Planet, head planet in the Allheaven Star System’s Northern Domain. He was traveling in the Alliance Star System for thousands of years searching for the heaven defying bead, but met Liu Mei who was cultivating the Thousand Illusion Ruthless Domain instead and accepted her as a disciple. He later adopted Liu Mei and inducted her into the Huan Family by performing the bloodline ritual. The bloodline ritual refines the purest Huan family blood from of tens of thousands of Huan family members, turn that into one thousand blood runes that will imprint on a person, and then finally extract all of the blood in that person’s body.

When Liu Mei loses her battle with Wang Lin on planet Ran Yun, Huan Wuqing saves her by sending his origin soul through the void. However, Wang Lin says that if he saves Liu Mei, he will wipe out the Huan Family.

Later he dies on scattered devil.

characters.title: Huang Long
characters.introText: He is also the Avatar of Lu Yun. He went to the East Demon Spirit Sea and made the Formation that protected the Valley where the Soul Refining Tribe lived.
characters.appearance: Huang Long is the sect head of the Heng Yue Sect, a once-powerful cultivation sect that has fallen on hard times over the past 500 years. He is portrayed as a calm and experienced leader who is deeply concerned about the declining strength and future of his sect. During an exchange event with the Xuan Dao Sect, Huang Long observes the new disciples and feels worried about the appearance of powerful members from the rival sect, especially those with strong single-element spirit roots

characters.title: Huang Yu
characters.introText: Huang Yu  is a short old man from the Refining Feather Sect. He entered the Demon Spirit Land because he was being chased and hunted by his enemies. After arriving, he decided to stay in the Demon Spirit Land as it was safer for him, provided he was careful. Despite being a mid-stage Ascendant cultivator, his origin soul possessed a power very different from the celestial guardians, making him cautious about the use of soul search spells against him

characters.title: Huo Pao
characters.introText: He was from a small tribe and had already awakened his demonic spiritual energy. He had two stars of demonic spiritual energy when he joined and was the number one expert from that small tribe.

characters.title: Ice Boy
characters.introText: He is the first Arcane Void cultivator that died in the war.
characters.appearance: Ice Boy looks like a child about seven or eight years old. His eyes are extremely strange as there are three pupils inside each eye.
characters.history:
He attacked the Realm Sealing Formation along with Dao Master Blue Dream, Fifth and Sixth Concubine, Qing Jiuyan and Sovereign to tear a massive hole in it.

Later, he appeared to hold off Master Hong Shan who was injured by the by the Sixth Concubine's sneak-attack and was battling Master Enlighten East, Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor, Esteemed Nan Zhao and two other Nirvana Void cultivators alone. This allowed Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor to leave and attack Wang Lin who was approaching Grandmaster Yun Luo, however, that only resulted in former's death.

Ice Boy decided Wang Lin had to be stopped and forcibly sent Esteemed Nan Zhao and a Nirvana void cultivator from Bai Lei Clan out of the encirclement to kill Wang Lin. However, Wang Lin retaliated with a poison sneak-attack upon Esteemed Nan Zhao that resulted in the latter's death. The Nirvana void cultivator from Bai Lei Clan was too terrified to attempt to block Wang Lin and escaped. Soon reinforcements from the Cloud Sea Star System and Summoned River Star System appeared and forced Ice Boy to retreat.

A few decades later, Sovereign used Fishing for the Moon in the Well upon Wang Lin while he was in Planet Suzaku. Ice Boy participated in the ambush against Wang Lin but was severely injured by Wang Lin's Realm Burning Umbrella and later by Li Guang's arrow.

72 years later, Master South Cloud led the remnants of the Alliance Star System to battle against the Outer Realm. The battleground was near Planet Suzaku where the Inner Realm cultivators fought to defend the Lord of the Inner Realm's homeland.

The battle was in a deadlock with the Outer Realm's Zhou Jin and Ice Boy facing off against Master South Cloud, Situ Nan, Master Lu Fu and Master Long Pan until the Heaven Master Void God's avatar appeared. This immediately tilted the balance of power against the Inner Realm cultivators and forced them to retreat inside the formation of Planet Suzaku. When all hope was lost, Wang Lin triggered the Great Void Gate and appeared to lift the spirits of the weary Inner Realm cultivators. He easily defeated Ice Boy whose cultivation had dropped to peak Spirit Void after the injuries he sustained during the time Sovereign used Fishing for the Moon in the Well upon Wang Lin. Wang Lin even pulled out his Ice essence through the use of Karma Print. Although this didn't take his entire essence, it still took a majority of it which resulted in injuries that would take centuries to heal.

Wang Lin killed him by using Li Guang's arrow.

characters.title: Immortal Imperial Teacher
characters.introText: It is said that his strength surpasses that of the three Imperial Teachers of the Ancient Clan even if they worked together. He cultivates the dao of void/nullity.
characters.history:
He plotted along with the genius of the Mourning-Death Clan, the Great Soul Sect's founder, against the Celestial Royal Family to get their freedom. Eventually receiving the rank of Imperial Teacher, he became the Sect Master of the Dao Sect in the Central Continent as well as Lian Daozhen's attendant.

He was the Imperial Teacher and servant of the Celestial Emperor, Lian Daozhen. His entire clan was enslaved to serve the Celestial Ancestor and his descendants. He secretly schemed against Lian Daozhen to obtain Wang Lin's body in order to break the seal placed on him and his clan. He tried to tempt Wang Lin by offering him the inheritance and power of the Celestial Ancestor. When he captured Wang Lin, he thought he had destroyed Wang Lin's soul, but Wang Lin tricked him by going into the Heaven Defying Bead. The Imperial Teacher was able to absorb the Celestial Ancestor's power and inheritance, but it only ended up benefiting Wang Lin when Wang Lin took back his body. At the last moments of his life, he remembered that he wasn't the true Imperial Teacher and in fact it was Hai Zi.

characters.title: Ji Du
characters.introText: He recognizes Wang Lin as the White-haired Ascendant Empyrean and then begs him to be his benefactor. He accepts Wang Lin as his Godfather.

characters.title: Ji Mo
characters.introText: He was a cultivator that put a spell on Zhang Hu's body. When Wang Lin Killed Zhang Hu's body, Ji Mo was able to see everything that happened. In his anger, he sent Teng Huayuan’s great-great-grandson to come after Wang Lin. He later met Wang Lin as he was heading to the Tang Clan and was killed by Wang Lin.

characters.title: Jin Ye
characters.introText: Fifth ranked of purple branch of Heavenly Fate Sect

characters.title: Jiu Di
characters.introText: Currently, he ties with Lian Daozhen as the strongest Grand Empyrean on the Celestial Clan's side, after Gemini's soul split.
characters.personality:
He looked on in shock from Mount Emperor when the Grand Empyrean suns aligned together to signal the birth of a new Grand Empyrean, which turned out to be Wang Lin. While he was not entirely surprised that Wang Lin became a Grand Empyrean he was baffled by the speed of which he did so (around 100 years), especially when he noticed that he had also refined the Celestial Ancestor's head as well.

When Wang Lin crossed the Second Heaven Trampling Bridge and covered the entire Celestial Clan with his divine sense, causing the 72 Foreign Beasts to cry out in fear within their seals, Hai Zi informs him that the beasts were restless due to feeling the presence of Heaven Trampling power. immediately recognizing the significance of this Jiu Di started to panic. For the first time ever since he became a Grand Empyrean he rushed out of Mount Emperor and bowed within the sky, beseeches the mysterious individual and states his real name, Zhou Luojiu.

Sensing a battle between Gu Dao and an unknown cultivator, he rushes out with the rest of the Nine Suns to investigate. When they arrive, the battle was already over and he suggests to the other eight Grand Empyrean's that they pool their energy into his spell, which would allow them to turn back time and view the events that had transpired. He is shocked to discover that Wang Lin had actually defeated Gu Dao and was now the strongest being in the Immortal Astral Continent. Immediately thinking back to the powerful divine sense he felt from before, he speculated whether it could have been Wang Lin.

↑ 2.0 2.1 Chapter 1995
characters.history:
He was born around the time the Celestial Ancestor and Ancient Ancestor were still alive. At the time of their disappearance, he was an Empyrean Exalt.

Because he was around during the era of the Celestial and Ancient ancestor's, he is aware of the Half Heaven Trampling and Heaven Trampling realms, the level above Grand Empyrean.

At some point in time he formed a very strong relationship with the Mourning-Death Clan. It was due to their help that he became Grand Empyrean and also why he never had to worry about maintaining his longevity through reincarnation like the other Grand Empyreans. In order to repay them, he took a role in the plot to free the clan from their servitude to the Imperial Family. As part of this plot, he married and had a child with one of the last remaining members of the Mourning-Death Clan to bypass the restriction placed upon all members of the clan when they are born. This child was Empyrean Exalt Hai Zi.

He initially dismisses Hai Zi's suggestion of recruiting Wang Lin, but reconsiders after seeing him pass the 13th palace of the Empyrean Exalt Trial.

When Dao Yi and Wu Feng offer their recruitment terms to Wang Lin, he arrives after and stated that if he chose to follow him, he would guarantee him entry to the Immemorial God Realm and act as his Dao Protector when the realm opens so that he could become a Grand Empyrean. He is displeased when Gemini shows up shortly after and Wang Lin chooses her over him, due to having a connection to the Cave World which he did not.

When Wang Lin is ambushed by the Celestial Clan's Imperial Teacher, he saves Hai Zi from Wang Lin's Slaughter Clone.

During Wang Lin and Gemini's battle with Lian Daozhen and the Imperial Teacher, he intervenes along with Dao Yi and Wu Feng. He states the truth behind the Mourning-Death Clans plot to regain their freedom from the Imperial Family, acknowledging his role within it. Hai Zi, who had at that point regained her memories reveals that the entire plan revolved around Lian Daozhen coveting the power of the Celestial Ancestor's head and trying to inherit his power. However, even if he had not, the Mourning-Death Clan had a back up coup utilizing the 72 foreign beasts sealed within the Immortal Astral Continent, which would have forced Lian Daozhen to attempt to inherit the power anyway in order to seal the beasts back up lest the Celestial Clan fall into chaos.

However, the plan wasn't as gracious as it seemed as Jiu Di had no intention of actually letting Lian Daozhen inherit the Celestial Ancestor's power. Instead, he planned on maintaining the balance of power between the Celestial Grand Empyreans by splitting the Celestials Ancestor's head and dividing it's parts amongst them. He offered the eyes to Gemini which would have allowed to her permanently fuse back into her original form as well as increase her power, the ears to Wu Feng which would allow him to reach the peak of his martial dao, the skull to Dao Yi so he could fully unite his soul with his body, and the brain for himself (likely so he could find out how to access the Heaven Trampling Bridges in the Ancestor's memories).

Jiu Di states that the time of the Celestial Ancestor and Imperial Family was over and that the Celestial Clan needed change. He also admits that the only reason he was even given a choice was that he feared the balance of power between the Celestial Clan and Ancient Clan should they lose a Grand Empyrean. Unfortunately, he had miscalculated Lian Daozhen's character as he decided to self-detonate and release the Ancestor's curse upon all of them.

Being the next strongest Celestial Grand Empyrean, he deals with the curse much better than the others. However, when it is discovered that Wang Lin actually survived and snatched the Celestial Ancestor's head and Lian Daozhen's soul away from them he becomes enraged. He offers Wang Lin protection once more when the Immemorial God Realm opens in exchange for the head, but Wang Lin refuses. Due to the curse, he tries to intimidate Wang Lin, but fails and begrudgingly relents. However, when Wang Lin said that he would also be taking Lian Daofei away as well, he warns that he would risk accelerating the curse to stop him if he tried. This was because without Lian Daozhen to hold back the 72 Beasts the Celestial Clan sealed away, they needed Lian Daofei to act as a substitute. When Wang Lin reluctantly agrees to this Jiu Di and the other Celestial Grand Empyrean's forcibly raise Lian Daofei's cultivation to Grand Empyrean and seal him into a mountain to hold back the 72 Celestial Beasts. Before parting ways, he warns Wang Lin that the next time they meet he had better be a Grand Empyrean lest a calamity await him in the future if he was not.

He looked on in shock from Mount Emperor when the Grand Empyrean suns aligned together to signal the birth of a new Grand Empyrean, which turned out to be Wang Lin. While he was not entirely surprised that Wang Lin became a Grand Empyrean he was baffled by the speed of which he did so (around 100 years), especially when he noticed that he had also refined the Celestial Ancestor's head as well.

When Wang Lin crossed the Second Heaven Trampling Bridge and covered the entire Celestial Clan with his divine sense, causing the 72 Foreign Beasts to cry out in fear within their seals, Hai Zi informs him that the beasts were restless due to feeling the presence of Heaven Trampling power. immediately recognizing the significance of this Jiu Di started to panic. For the first time ever since he became a Grand Empyrean he rushed out of Mount Emperor and bowed within the sky, beseeches the mysterious individual and states his real name, Zhou Luojiu.

Sensing a battle between Gu Dao and an unknown cultivator, he rushes out with the rest of the Nine Suns to investigate. When they arrive, the battle was already over and he suggests to the other eight Grand Empyrean's that they pool their energy into his spell, which would allow them to turn back time and view the events that had transpired. He is shocked to discover that Wang Lin had actually defeated Gu Dao and was now the strongest being in the Immortal Astral Continent. Immediately thinking back to the powerful divine sense he felt from before, he speculated whether it could have been Wang Lin.
