characters.title: Kunpeng Zi
characters.introText: Kunpeng Zi is a cultivator from the Yellow Division of the Heavenly Fate Sect, known for his long-standing devotion to his Master, the All-Seer, and his role as one of the Heavenly Fate Seven Disciples the core representatives and true disciples of the sect.
characters.appearance: Kunpeng Zi is a cultivator from the Yellow Division of the Heavenly Fate Sect, known for his long-standing devotion to his Master, the All-Seer, and his role as one of the Heavenly Fate Seven Disciples the core representatives and true disciples of the sect.
characters.history:
Kunpeng Zi was personally acknowledged by the All-Seer, who publicly recognized him as the Yellow Division’s true disciple. During this recognition, the All-Seer bestowed upon him a yellow crystal, symbolizing his position among the Seven Disciples and his status within the sect. The All-Seer further promised that if Kunpeng Zi could uphold the title of true disciple for1,000 years, he would be taught a low-quality celestial spell a rare and valuable form of divine cultivation art and be granted life-saving treasures as rewards.

Having followed the Master for over 2,000 years, Kunpeng Zi displayed deep respect and gratitude for this honor. Despite his humility, he was fully aware of the immense strength of his peers, especially Senior Apprentice Brother Yundao Zi , the oldest disciple of the Yellow Division. Yundao Zi had previously held the true disciple title for    800 years before it was taken by Kunpeng Zi’s Third Brother. Although Yundao Zi was reputed for his arrogance and aloofness, he had since grown indifferent toward competition, living a carefree and detached life within the sect.

characters.title: Lei Daozi
characters.introText: He is a Thunder Celestial Envoy of Thunder Celestial Temple from Allheaven Star System's Northern Domain.

characters.title: Lei Ji
characters.introText: Lei Ji is a Royal Giant Demon from Planet Giant Demon. He fled Planet Giant Demon to keep his life with his people and wandered the Star until he met Ye Wuyou. Ye Wuyou offer him a place, far from the Forsaken Immortal Clan's Sacred Ground, for his peoples help against the Forsaken Immortal Clan, to repay Ye Wuyou's kindness, he entered the war. After a battle, he was injured and ambushed by Corpse Sect's member and imprisoned under Zhao's Corpse Sect's Headquarter.
characters.history: During his imprisonment, Wang Lin found him but he didn't think he could help him. Later he encounter Wang Lin when the later came to take his Royal Giant Blood that contain Ancient God Blood and try to delay him so he can be freed. The third time Wang Lin come, he submit to Wang Lin and ask him to help him by saying all the truth he know. Later his bloodline is stimulated by Wang Lin's Ancient God Roar and truly submit.
characters.trivia:
He really like Ye Wuyou's righteous personality but dislike Situ Nan's demonic personality.

He hope Wang Lin can help him take revenge on Planet Giant Demon.

characters.title: Li Guang
characters.introText: He was called upon by Su Dao to help him kill Ye Mo inside the Cave World.

characters.title: Li Qian Mei
characters.introText: Li Qian Mei is one of supporting characters in Renegade Immortal. She was a core disciple of the Heaven Breaking Sect located in the Rank 9 Region of the Cloud Sea Star System.
characters.personality:
Li Qian Mei was first introduced asking a powerful Cultivator 3 questions, all of them being "what is Dao". She liked his answers and then accompanied him to the Origin Sect. There she met Wang Lin and then asked him those same three questions related to Dao; his answer satisfied her the most. In return, she gave him a rank 10 healing pill and a semi-complete pill infused with a rank 10 beast soul.

After this she accompanied Wang Lin to Peng Lai's Treasured Jade Sect's auction. She left soon after the auction ended as she was called back by her sect to the Rank 9 Region, but she left Wang Lin her jade bracelet that served as a protection treasure. In return, Wang Lin gave her his Golden Celestial Brush. She was then dispatched to the Demon Sect.

Afterwards, when Wang Lin was being suppressed by her father Dao Master Blue Dream in the Seven-Colored Realm, he recognized this bracelet which prompted him to spare Wang Lin's life.

100 years later, she left the Demon Sect to go to the Everlasting Sect where she hoped to meet Wang Lin present with the Origin Sect. She was surprised to see his unbelievable growth in strength but was more delighted to see him.

While Daoist Water and Wang Lin battled, she was under house arrest in her sect. Initially, she didn't understand why until she felt that it may be related to Wang Lin. She went as far as breaking her ties with her sect and her master to be allowed to leave the sect. Tearfully and heartbroken, she rushed to the Rank 5 Region. There, she found a petrified Wang Lin and was informed by Wind Celestial Realm Master to continuously cover his body with her blood if she wished for him to awaken. She did so for over a decade while Wang Lin was in the Dao Realm with the Lord of the Sealed Realm. This continuous expense on her vitality resulted in her lifespan shrinking down tremendously and her cultivation becoming extremely weak.

After Wang Lin awoke, he felt very grateful and even more guilty. He rushed to the vortex near Demon Sect to save her. Inside, he encountered Fan Shanlu's avatar and made a deal to help her if she allowed him to quickly exit the vortex.

After leaving the vortex, Wang Lin rushed to the Outer Realm's Blue Silk Clan so that Dao Master Blue Dream may save Li Qian Mei. While saving her, Dao Master Blue Dream erased all her memories related to Wang Lin so that she would not have to pine for someone who's heart belonged to someone else.

She is heartbroken by the fact that her father is forced to help the Outer Realm invade the Sealed Realm as his wife's soul is being held hostage.

After the end of the war, while Wang Lin was guarding the Unnamed Wheel Formation, Dao Master Blue Dream appeared with Li Qian Mei to meet Wang Lin and propose that Wang Lin take his daughter as his wife and hand over Fifth Concubine who had possessed his own wife's body. In exchange, he vows to become Wang Lin's ally against Seven-Colored Daoist and Old Ghost Zhan. Wang Lin was left with no choice and has to accept Li Qian Mei, and marry her after he revives Li Muwan. Later on, he cried holding Li Muwan’s coffin and apologized that he had no other choice but to accept her.

Li Qian Mei chooses to reincarnate in the Immortal Astral Continent after mulling over the matter for a long time as her father chose to stay back in the Cave.

She notices Wang Lin and Li Muwan depart the Ancient Clan after they reunite after he finally resurrects her. She sheds tears as she believes she has understood Wang Lin's choice and decides to sever her ties and forget all memories of him. However, she suddenly hears a soft voice call out to her and turns to see a familiar figure standing behind her with a smile on his face.
characters.history:
Her story started from chapter 1166. Wang Lin was operating under an alias, and she asked him three questions. Wang Lin refused, she offered to play flute for him but Wang Lin refused again. Li Qianmei then requested and Wang Lin answered after demanding an item for his every answer.

What began as philosophical inquiry quickly became a foothold. Once Wang Lin answered in a way that resonated with her Dao, she treated that intellectual spark as an invitation into his personal life. He signaled distance and handed her the painting, a parting gift.

After the auction, Li Qianmei intercepted Wang Lin in the star fog, reasoning with she remember that Wang Lin promised to send her off, ostensibly to say goodbye before she departs for a potentially dangerous mission. She fulfilled her promise of giving him a third gift for answering her questions earlier. She offers him a personal and precious protective bracelet. Wang Lin, however, perceived the weight of such a gift. With his characteristic guarded nature and reluctance to incur emotional debt, he refused. The rejection was physical, audible, unmistakable. She simply refused to accept the sound of it.

Chapter 1178— "You answered my three questions. I won’t let you escape.”

When Wang Lin turned to go, Li Qianmei then discarded the bracelet into the endless star fog, a dramatic act of letting go. She then returned the painting. Wang Lin, in turn, left her a powerful treasure (a celestial pen with a rune) as a final protective gift, balancing their exchange while maintaining his emotional distance, and then departed. Which she used later in the battle inside spatial crack as an exchange so her blood can be sent to Wang Lin's statue.

The true architecture of her hold is built later, in the long silence after Water Daoist’s attack. Wang Lin’s body had become a statue; skin the color of old ash, surface cracked like dried river mud, eyes sealed under a film of stone. Li Qianmei deserted her responsibilities, found him, hid him, and spend ten years nourishing the statue with her own blood. She did this while he could not speak, could not refuse, could not even know. When he finally woke up, the debt was already carved into the air between them. She had nearly destroyed herself for him. This created an unpayable debt/obligation.

In cultivation terms, it is a form of emotional binding. She did not simply protect him or seek external help; she turned his survival into a ten-year ritual of her own blood and essence, that forced him into lifelong guilt. When he later saved her in return, the dynamic was already skewed—she had manufactured a situation in which any coldness on his part appeared ungrateful.

Her father’s intervention added another layer. Blue Dream Dao Venerable arrived with the weight of political and military stakes of the Inner/Outer Realm conflict to extract concessions. Blue Dream did not need to raise his voice. The pressure was atmospheric—thick and unavoidable. Wang Lin, already carrying the corpse and the unfinished resurrection of his wife, Li Muwan, was offered a clean political solution that happened to require him to accept Li Qianmei.

What was started as philosophical admiration turned into unpayable debt. She did not consider that binding a man through guilt and physical sacrifice was its own form of coercion. Whether she actively directed her father’s negotiations or simply allowed the situation to unfold, the outcome served her goal of remaining attached to him. Wang Lin, already a man whose existence was defined by debts and corpses, now carried one more.

The “promise” Wang Lin eventually made—to take her as his woman after Li Muwan is revived—tasted of iron and resignation. They were not desire. They were the sound of him accepting the only exit he was left with. The philosophical doorway, the discarded gifts she refused to treat as discarded, the decade of blood sacrifice that generated debt, the political reinforcement, the refusal to dissolve even after death and rebirth—all of it formed a single continuous act of compulsion. And the only repayment she wanted from him was the acceptance of her.

Li Qianmei’s tragedy was real, but it was a self-authored one. She chose to love a man whose path and heart were already elsewhere. Upon witnessing Wang Lin crying holding Li Muwan’s coffin, she chose to let go, as she could not accept that Wang Lin did not have her in his heart.

Chapter 1743 laid the truth bare. Inside the Ghostly Sail, Wang Lin has sealed himself away on this particular dayone day he still remembers. The day he still remembers when he can no longer recall his own age or birthday. He drew out a jug of wine, drank without tasting, and spoke to the woman Li Muwan who has accompanied him for more than two thousand years.

The ten years of blood sacrifice created a debt he could not refuse. He spoke the words of acceptance. But the promise never touched the place where Li Muwan still lived—the only place that ever held the whole of him. After her departure, love became a wound he could not risk again. Accepting Li Qianmei did not heal that wound. It only added another weight to the same broken place.
The public words were spoken under the pressure of unrepayable kindness and the necessities of war. The private ones were spoken to the only person who ever held the whole of him. Everything else—every reluctant claim, every political concession, every clone left behind was only the residue.

Wang Lin’s eventual decision to left a clone was the cleanest exit he could manage from a bond she repeatedly refused to let dissolve and cut the karmic thread. It was the final severance, a piece of himself cut free and set down like a marker so he could finally walk away without being burdened by her tears against his back.
characters.trivia:
As of the end of the Sealed and Outer Realm war, Bingmei is regarded by Wang Lin as the mother of his child, Qianmei as his "woman" and Li Muwan his wife.

The figure who calls out to her at the end of the novel is heavily implied to be  one of Wang Lin's clones .

She is the only Cave World cultivator to have reincarnated as a member of the Ancient Clan, as the rest of those who were brought to the Immortal Astral Continent were reborn within the Celestial Clan.

characters.title: Li Qiqing
characters.introText: Li Qiqing is a disciple of the Lou He Sect, elder brother of Li Muwan. He raised Li Muwan by himself after their parents passed away.

characters.title: Li Yuan
characters.introText: He was previously possessed by the servant of a celestial from the Thunder Celestial Realm. He was freed from his prior condition after Wang Lin caused the death of the aforementioned servant. Moreover, he was also freed from the slave imprint that was forced upon generations of his bloodline. In return, he shared all his knowledge about restrictions with Wang Lin and promised to take him back to his clan to impart the Annihilation Restriction upon him along with giving Wang Lin half of his heart of restriction which is necessary for one to truly master the Annihilation Restriction.
characters.history:
He was previously possessed by the servant of a celestial from the Thunder Celestial Realm. He was freed from his prior condition after Wang Lin caused the death of the aforementioned servant. Moreover, he was also freed from the slave imprint that was forced upon generations of his bloodline. In return, he shared all his knowledge about restrictions with Wang Lin and promised to take him back to his clan to impart the Annihilation Restriction upon him along with giving Wang Lin half of his heart of restriction which is necessary for one to truly master the Annihilation Restriction.

He entered the storage space of a Celestial along with Wang Lin where he found nine quasi-celestial short swords. He helped Wang Lin set up the ambush against Blood Ancestor but left before Blood Ancestor arrived to keep his involvement a secret.

After parting ways with Wang Lin, he was chased by a young master of the Yao Family. He, along with his cousin and his subordinate, toyed with Li Yuan for 13 days until he decided to soul-search him to learn more about the nine quasi-celestial short swords. However, Wang Lin arrived just before he could proceed with the soul-search and killed the three.

The two then went inside a sealed entrance inside the ruined marketplace of the Thunder Celestial Realm and met the sealed Qing Shui. Qing Shui attempted to charm Li Yuan into committing suicide and giving him his origin energy but the latter was saved by Wang Lin.

After escaping from Qing Shui, the two reached the Celestial Pavilion. There, Li Yuan guarded outside while Wang Lin went inside to try his luck at getting a celestial spell.

After coming out, they noticed a mad, now un-sealed, Qing Shui rampaging around. Wang Lin threw Li Yuan out of the Thunder Celestial Realm before Qing Shui closed the gate.

Later, Wang Lin arrived at Planet Annihilation and Li Yuan gave him half of his Annihilation Heart.

Appearence ep 149
characters.trivia: Li Yuan's name is borrowed from the first emperor of the Tang Dynasty.

characters.title: Li Yuanfeng
characters.introText: His cultivation was forced to the early Soul Transformation stage through a lot of medicine and pills. He was the weakest of the Soul Transformation cultivators.
characters.history: Li Yuanfeng wanted to get revenge for Red Butterfly's constant demise against Wang Lin. He was also afraid of Wang Lin's growth. As a result, he schemed against Wang Lin to kill Wang Lin. He contacted the Giant Clan's ancestor to help him set a restriction to trap Wang Lin so he couldn't teleport away. When they attacked Wang Lin, they almost killed him but Wang Lin was saved by Sun Tai. Sun Tai was able severely injure Li Yuanfeng and Li Yuanfeng escaped the battle. After Wang Lin recovered from his injury, he came to the Xue Yue Sect and killed Li Yuanfeng and prohibited the entire Xue Yue Sect from having anyone higher than a Nascent Soul cultivation.

characters.title: Lian Daofei
characters.introText: He is the younger brother of Lian Daozhen who is the Celestial Clan's Emperor and currently rules over the Celestials of the Immortal Astral Continent.
characters.history:
After he went mad, he was trapped inside of a Seven-Colored Realm until that realm was swallowed by the Nether Beast. Following this, he searched the Nether Beast's inner world for ages seeking any sign of life. He eventually stumbled upon an unconscious Wang Lin and tried to heal him by giving him his Celestial Clan blood and three Markings. This inheritance was incompatible with Wang Lin's Ancient Order inheritance, causing them to clash and nearly kill him. The Heaven Defying Bead, however, allowed the two to start merging, saving Wang Lin and allowing him to awaken.

Wang Lin then tricked Lian Daofei into giving him chants for the War Spirit Print, Realm Burning Umbrella, Li Guang’s Heaven Shattering Bow Dao and the Seven-Colored Lance. But, he also took pity on Lian Daofei and took him along when he left the Nether Beast's belly.

He then left Xu Liguo and Liu Jinbiao to take care of Lian Daofei while he went to destroy the Cultivation Alliance and save Qing Shui.

After he returned, he saw that Xu Liguo and Liu Jinbiao had tricked Lian Daofei into giving them a lot of his celestial blood. Enraged, Wang Lin wasted over 30% of Xu Liguo's cultivation and took away Liu Jinbiao's chance at a great fortune and forced him to stay as a slave for another 1,000 years. However, when Lian Daofei insisted that the two be punished more, Wang Lin looked at him revealed that all the dozens of drops of "celestial blood" he had given the two would not even be equivalent to half a drop of true celestial blood even after being refined. This showed that while Lian Daofei was mad, he still had enough intellect remaining to understand when he was being fooled.

Wang Lin took him along when he went to Planet Suzaku to visit his parent's grave. However, he soon fell asleep and then left to go somewhere "more exciting." During this time, Wang Lin was ambushed by Sovereign's Fishing the Moon in the Well. When Wang Lin's demise was almost certain, Lian Daofei entered the false Suzaku through the hole Master Scarlet Soul previously made and protected Wang Lin with his body.

Wang Lin met Lian Daofei inside his Dream Dao World and felt a sense of attachment and familiarity with him so he took him in. Throughout the entire 72 year long dream, Lian Daofei, who was dubbed Big Fortune (Dàfú) by Wang Lin, followed him as his attendant.

After Wang Lin left his Dream Dao, he put an unconscious Lian Daofei inside his storage space before leaving the crack he was thrown into previously.

Wang Lin met Little Red, Lian Daofei's old servant, in the Outer Realm just before the Four Generals descended from the Ancient Celestial Realm.

Immediately after Wang Lin took Lian Daofei and Woman in Silver out of his storage space after entering the Immortal Astral Continent, Lian Daozhen sensed his aura and teleported the latter to him.

He later has his cultivation forcibly raised to Grand Empyrean to suppress the 72 spirit beasts of the Celestial Clan after his brother weakens the seal by self-detonating his body and damage the Celestial Ancestor's skull.

After Wang Lin defeats Gu Dao and becomes the strongest being in the Immortal Astral Continent, he breaks Lian Daofei from his slumber and offers to take him away from the Celestial Clan so that he could roam freely. However, he declines and tells Wang Lin that with the death of his brother it was now his duty to lead the Celestial Clan as its new emperor. After Wang Lin leaves he declares that once the Celestial Clan no longer needs him he would seek out Wang Lin and accompany him on his adventures.== Links and References ==

characters.title: Lian Daozhen
characters.introText: He is the Emperor of the Celestial Clan that rules the Eastern and Southern Regions of the Immortal Astral Continent and the elder brother of Lian Daofei. Like his brother, he also possesses the Immortal Celestial Body.
characters.history:
Immediately after Wang Lin took Lian Daofei and Woman in Silver out of his storage space after entering the Immortal Astral Continent, Lian Daozhen sensed Lian Daofei's aura and teleported the latter to him. His words indicated that he was aware that Lian Daofei would disappear but as his Imperial Teacher assured him that it would not result in any major harm to the latter, he did not try to find Lian Daofei until he returned to the Immortal Astral Continent.
He sent three Imperial Edicts to the Heavenly Bull Continent and Green Devil Continent; two of them stated that the war between the two continents should end and the top geniuses of the continents enter the Imperial City ancestral temple. The final Imperial Edict that was sent to the Devil Dao Sect's Sect Master stated that he had betrayed the Celestial Clan and that he be executed; if he was already killed by a cultivator named Wang Lin then Wang Lin was invited to visit the Imperial City as the Celestial Emperor's guest.

He spectates Wang Lin during the Empyrean Exalt Trial and fans the flames of war between Ming Dao and Wang Lin. When Wang Lin passes the 13th palace and is attacked by Ming Dao, he stops Wu Feng from interfering. He exposes Wang Lin's soul armor in an attempt to downplay his achievements in the eyes of the various Empyrean Exalts. This was also done to deter the other Grand Empyrean's from recruiting him. He then makes a bet with Wang Lin saying that if he can pass the 15th palace of the Empyrean Exalt Trial he will name him the number one cultivator under the Grand Empyrean's.

Wang Lin eventually reclaims his prestige by simultaneously breaking through the 14th, 15th, and even 16th palace, essentially giving him a slap in the face. When Wang Lin breaks through the 17th palace he admits defeat and returns to the Imperial City. He laments that fact that he didn't kill Wang Lin earlier and gave him so much time to grow. He then plans to capture Wang Lin when he meets him in the Imperial City and hand him over to the Imperial Teacher.

He later battles Grand Empyrean Gemini, Jiu Di, Wu Feng, and Dao Yi all at once. Seeing that he is about to lose, he chooses to detonate his body and possess his brother Lian Daofei instead. However, Wang Lin stops him and takes his soul before he can merge.

Wang Lin later refines his soul in conjunction with the Celestial Ancestor's Head to condense his Grand Empyrean Sun.

characters.title: Lian Ning
characters.introText: Wang Lin killed her with heavenly calamity, which drew attention of suzaku protector Ou zhi but wang lin was able to escape from him

characters.title: Liao Qian
characters.introText: He along with other corporeal yang cultivators from thunder celeatial temple was killed by wang lin  and many cultivators to escape from Thunder celestial realm.

characters.title: Lil Mosqi
characters.introText: Lil Mosqi was part of a herd of Mosquito Beasts on Planet Suzaku before he met Wang Lin. Initially, it attacked Wang Lin in Hou Fen but was subdued by him. After some time, Lil Mosqi became more docile towards Wang Lin.
characters.history:
Lil Mosqi was part of a herd of Mosquito Beasts on Planet Suzaku before he met Wang Lin. Initially, it attacked Wang Lin in Hou Fen but was subdued by him. After some time, Lil Mosqi became more docile towards Wang Lin.

Lil Mosqi was very aggressive towards the Thunder Toad that Wang Lin obtained in the Land of the Ancient God. This feeling was reciprocated by the Thunder Toad; it may be because they are natural nemesis as one is a mosquito while the other is a toad.

Wang Lin fed it the Golden Spirit Root he stole from the Da Lou Sword Sect elders which resulted in it evolving and becoming a "Mosquito King."

In the Demon Spirit Land's Tide Abyss, Wang Lin found Greed and a few members of the 12 Swords Disciples surrounded by a herd of Mosquito Beasts. Their king was somehow controlled by Greed which gave him control of the whole herd. Lil Mosqi fought the other Mosquito King and became the new king of the herd after killing and absorbing it. However, since it had to follow Wang Lin, all the older Mosquito Beasts committed suicide as only the younger Mosquito Beasts could enter a cultivator's storage bag.

After leaving the Seven-Colored Realm, Wang Lin took it inside the Wind Celestial Realm where he helped it ambush other Mosquito Kings to further strengthen its bloodline and evolve. He even used it to amass an army of thousands of Mosquito Beasts among which there were even a few Blue Mosquito Beasts that could rival a Nirvana Cleanser cultivator.

Lil Mosqi and its followers devoured the fierce beasts Wang Lin encountered inside Ye Mo's Ancient Tomb. There, they drank from the river of blood from the fierce beasts which allowed them to grow much larger and stronger. Finally, the over 10,000 Mosquito Beasts became ever more fierce and powerful.

During the climax of the first battle of the Third Sealed-Outer Realm War, Wang Lin obtained Li Guang's Bow but was unable to refine it as he lacked a Celestial bloodline. In fact, it caused him severe injuries which forced him to call out the Nether Beast. It appeared and spat out the golden energy it previously devoured which tore a large hole in the Realm-Sealing Formation. During the chaos, Lil Mosqi and its followers got thrown elsewhere and disappeared. Meanwhile, the Nether Beast shrunk and quickly escaped.

After they lost Wang Lin, Lil Mosqi and its followers ended up in the Wind Celestial Realm where they rampaged around and devoured other Mosquito Beasts for almost a century. Finally, Wang Lin appeared and Lil Mosqi was overjoyed. It led Wang Lin into the Wind Celestial Realm's depths where, shockingly, Wang Lin found a huge nest with Mosquito Beast eggs. Wang Lin stored all the eggs to feed them to Lil Mosqi later and destroyed the hidden area and the door further ahead leading to the Immortal Astral Continent which was used by the Gui Yi Sect members to enter the Cave. Destroying that area allowed Wang Lin to be assured that the Gui Yi Sect members could not leave the Cave and become a hurdle in his plans.

Lil Mosqi led its followers to the Immortal Astral Continent after Xuan Luo opened up a portal to it. As soon as the Mosquito Beasts entered the portal, they unlocked their Ancestor's memories. This allowed all of them to grow exponentially stronger in an instant, but suddenly the Mosquito Beasts began exploding and dying. Eventually, only 11 remained from the initial tens of thousands of Mosquito Beasts. However, these 11 gave off pure golden light that contained a terrifying aura. Even Xuan Luo was astonished by the aura.

characters.title: Lin Yi
characters.introText: almost killed by wang lin with heavenly tribulation

characters.title: Ling Dong
characters.introText: In the past, he was a member of the Ling Dong Clan.
characters.history:
He and his followers met Wang Lin's group inside the Ancient Order Tomb where he ordered his follower, Xiao Jing, to open the restriction sealing the rank 4 Dao Spirit. His follower attempted to trick him by blowing up the formation and acted as if he was dead. However, Wang Lin had seen through his tricks and ambushed him. Similarly, Ling Dong had also seen through his follower's tricks and waited a while before appearing. Wang Lin acted as if he was caught off guard which caused Ling Dong to enter the formation and fall into Wang Lin's trap.

Wang Lin then had him fight and weaken the Dao Spirit before refining him into his ancient slave using the Ancient God Emperor Furnace and his Dao Spell: Dream Dao.

Afterwards, he teamed up with Esteemed Great Desolation to kill Dao Master Miao Yin's avatar. After the kill, Esteemed Great Desolation possessed the Dao Master's body while Wang Lin managed to steal almost 30% of his Joss Flames to allow Ling Dong to reach the Third Step.

Sometime later, Wang Lin arrived in the Forest where Greed found Su Dao's statue and the Ancient Leaf and there he taught Ling Dong the Dao Master Blue Dream's Dao Spell: Fuse to absorb Dao Master Miao Yin's Joss Flames which allowed him to finally reach the Third Step.

Subsequently, Zhou Jin attempted to ambush Wang Lin only to fall in the latter's trap.

characters.title: Ling Tianhou
characters.introText: Ling Tianhou is the sect leader of the Da Lou Sword Sect on Planet Da Lou. He is the, self-proclaimed, rival of All-Seer but he has yet to beat him even once. But despite all his defeat, he has never given up.
characters.appearance: Ling Tianhou is the sect leader of the Da Lou Sword Sect on Planet Da Lou. He is the, self-proclaimed, rival of All-Seer but he has yet to beat him even once. But despite all his defeat, he has never given up.
characters.history:
When the East Demon Spirit Sea opened, he sent Greed with his disciples to look after them. He also gave his 12 disciples a sliver of his sword energy, each, as a live-saving treasure.

After a few centuries, he, Blood Ancestor, All-Seer and others entered the East Demon Spirit Sea but they instantly found that something was wrong. Soon after, they heard from Greed that Wang Lin stole the main token required to enter Celestial Emperor Qing Lin's main cultivation cave. They chased after Wang Lin only to see him escape to the Allheaven Star System. They then sent Greed after Wang Lin to the Allheaven Star System.

A few centuries later, when Wang Lin returned to Planet Tian Yun, he was the first to spar with him. He was shocked to find that Wang Lin could easily block one of his spells.

Later, he saved Wang Lin from All-Seer after the former took the dying Bai Wei's Extreme Yang. He then invited Wang Lin to be an elder of the Da Lou Sword Sect.

he has dao of tyranny

characters.title: Ling'er
characters.introText: She is extremely beautiful with silky, long black hair and a voice as sweet as honey. She was big eyes that always seem like they're sparkling.
characters.appearance: She is extremely beautiful with silky, long black hair and a voice as sweet as honey. She was big eyes that always seem like they're sparkling.
characters.personality: She is quite curious of everything as anything new that she sees attracts her interest immediately. She is also very innocent despite being a Nascent Soul cultivator due to being sheltered. This is because she has a water spirit body which would easily make her the target of people looking to use her as a cultivation incubator. She has most likely never killed a soul which leaves her with a pure heart, still.
characters.history:
She met Wang Lin in Ghost Eye City on Planet Tian Yun. Wang Lin felt a sense of goodwill towards her for unknown reasons. At the time he thought that it must be because she has a water spirit body like Liu Mei which caused him to be slightly sentimental. He gifted her the hat that Yun Quezi gave him and two small chiming bells that she put on her wrist.

Afterwards, he met her on Planet Blue Spirit when he was invited to stay by Master Yi Chen. A few days later, Wang Lin refined the Azure Ancient God Shield and caused a scene as a enormous Ancient God silhouette appeared in the sky. Ling'er saw the Ancient God silhouette and that night she had the same dream again, except this time she saw the dream until the end.

A few days later, she visited Wang Lin to ask about her dreams. She made the gesture of summoning an Ancient God that she saw in her dreams and Wang Lin's five stars appeared without his control. After seeing the stars she passed out. She woke up the next day with all her memories from her past incarnation. Wang Lin sent her away as he was in the process of reaching the Shi Realm.

characters.title: Little Red
characters.introText: He followed Lian Daofei when the latter entered the Cave World to steal the Heavenly Dao from the Ancient Celestial Sovereign. He was separated from Lian Daofei after the latter had his divine sense devoured by the Heavenly Dao.
characters.history:
Wang Lin saw Little Red when he met the Second Vermillion Bird as he witnessed the Second Vermillion Bird lure Little Red out from his lake and steal his Dragon Heart blood.

After the Young Emperor Trial ended, the Second Vermillion Bird freed Little Red and allowed it to leave. In fact, he had placed a seal upon him which would allow Wang Lin to control it and gain a Third Step protector when he left the Fallen Land. However, Ye Mo's Ancient Tomb opened up soon after Wang Lin left the Fallen Land which resulted in him forgetting about Little Red. This allowed Little Red to escape and gain freedom for almost two centuries. He even set up his own Celestial Dragon Sect.

172 years later, Wang Lin met him just a few hours before the Four Generals descended from the Ancient Celestial Realm. He learned of Little Red's identity then but put him away as he needed to have a calm state of mind for the things to come and couldn't be distracted by Little Red's revelations.

characters.title: Little Violet
characters.introText: Little Violet had no intelligence and was far from being as smart as Little White. However, this tiger was completely purple and 30 feet long. It gave off a very oppressive aura.
characters.appearance: Little Violet had no intelligence and was far from being as smart as Little White. However, this tiger was completely purple and 30 feet long. It gave off a very oppressive aura.
characters.history: When Wang Lin and Zhou Ru traveled to an moon from Planet Suzaku, Wang Lin had promise Zhou Ru to get her a larger tiger to replace Little White. In the northern part of the moon, they caught a large tiger and Zhou Ru named him Little Violet. Wang Lin left an imprint on the tiger's soul, making Zhou Ru its master so it couldn't possibily turn on Zhou Ru.

characters.title: Little White
characters.introText: Little White was a demonic tiger that was caught by Zhou Ru in the Country of Chu. He was very proud but was very scared of Zhou Ru because of Wang Lin. He watched Zhou Ru grew up. Later, he became Zhou Ru's best companion and cared for her deeply, even willing to betray Wang Lin for her sake.
characters.history: Little White was a demonic tiger that was caught by Zhou Ru in the Country of Chu. He was very proud but was very scared of Zhou Ru because of Wang Lin. He watched Zhou Ru grew up. Later, he became Zhou Ru's best companion and cared for her deeply, even willing to betray Wang Lin for her sake.

characters.title: Liu Jinbiao
characters.introText: Within the cave world he was portrayed with a mind filled with avarice and lust.
characters.personality:
Within the cave world he was portrayed with a mind filled with avarice and lust.

After reincarnating in the Immortal Astral Continent, he maintains his greedy and scamming personality. However, it is shown he also has a good heart as he helped mortal children with meager talents get into sects albeit to receive rewards from those sects.
characters.history:
He used the Sealed Realm Jade to extort sects that don't have Nirvana Shatterer cultivators.

Wang Lin used All-Seer's clairvoyance ability to divine that he could only survive from Daoist Water with the help of someone named Liu Jinbiao. Right after he did this, Liu Jinbiao's clone stormed the Origin Sect and attempted to extort them which allowed Wang Lin to locate his true body. After a short battle, Wang Lin took the Sealed Realm Jade from Liu Jinbiao and sealed his origin soul along with Xu Liguo.

Liu Jinbiao was reincarnated in the North of the Eastern Continent of the Immortal Astral Continent. He grew up in a small village and left at the age of 10 and took the name of Jin Baiozi. He had a inherent skillset to deceive people and used it to gain fame as a celestial. He would go to a mortal village and proclaim himself as a celestial and the mortal people would worship him, hoping that he could take their children away and make them into celestial. His slogan was "Once one becomes a celestial, even chickens and dogs can rise to the heavens!"
When Wang Lin was passing through the Eastern Continent toward the Dong Lin Sect, he noticed a familiar aura and it turned out to be Liu Jinbiao. Liu Jinbiao was using his art of deception on a mortal village and took away some children with the promise of making them celestials. Wang Lin decided to follow them to see what Liu Jinbiao was up to. After Liu Jinbiao took the children away, he revealed to them that he was a conman. He confessed that he could teach them the Dao of Deception in order to get into the Great Sage Sect to potentially become a real celestial. As a result of "recruiting" these children into the sect, he would get various materials from the sect. However, he didn't force the children and gave them a choice. If they wanted to enter the Great Sage Sect, he would teach them the Dao of Deception, and if they didn't he would erase their memory and send them back home.

"Talent is not important. What’s important is for your heart to be determined!" -Liu Jinbiao

characters.title: Liu Ziuyang
characters.introText: Liu Ziuyang was an elder of the Devil Dao Sect. He was also a descendant of the Devil Dao Sect's Sect Master and, thus, had a distinguished status.
characters.history: He was part of the assault force to take control of the Third Meridian among the Heavenly Bull's Seven Meridians. He, along with three other early-stage Void Tribulant cultivators, fought against the Heavenly Bull Continent's three early-stage Void Tribulant cultivators that included Yan Lu and Xu Dongde. While he retreated to heal during the first skirmish between the two sides, he was ambushed by Wang Lin who attacked him with quick barrage of attacks that left him unable to defend himself. Even his life-saving treasure given to him by the Devil Dao Sect's Sect Master was unable to save him as he perished.

characters.title: Lord of the Sealed Realm
characters.introText: He is the creator of the Stop Spell. Sovereign used 94 Seven-Colored God Void Nail to kill him; however his soul lingered on inside a treasure which itself was sealed inside the Heaven Defying Bead. His cultivation was at the very minimum within the later stages of Arcane Void.

characters.title: Lou Hou
characters.introText: He entered the East Demon Spirit Sea to obtain three drops of Qing Lin's blood. In exchange for that someone would greatly boost his cultivation.
characters.history: He entered the East Demon Spirit Sea to obtain three drops of Qing Lin's blood. In exchange for that someone would greatly boost his cultivation.

characters.title: Lu Song
characters.introText: He lost to the Xuan Dao Sect during one of their previous exchanges with Heng Yue Sect 20 years ago, but managed to impress them.
characters.history:
He represents Heng You Sect as their 3rd fighter against Xuan Dao Sect's Xu Mu. He is superior, but is ultimately victor by foul when he is ambushed by Zhou Peng.

He is among the few disciples who remains loyal and leaves with the Ancestors when the Heng You Sect is taken over by the Xuan Dao Sect.
He is happy when Wang Kin turns Renegade, as that means he is now the Head Disciple again.

characters.title: Lu Songyi
characters.introText: Lu Songyi, Shi Fang, and a short elder of the Da Lou Sword Sect were looking for Brillian Golden Fruits. When they met Wang Lin, they decided to attack and injure Wang Lin but failed. Lu Songyi was interrogated by Wang Lin before he was killed.
characters.history: Lu Songyi, Shi Fang, and a short elder of the Da Lou Sword Sect were looking for Brillian Golden Fruits. When they met Wang Lin, they decided to attack and injure Wang Lin but failed. Lu Songyi was interrogated by Wang Lin before he was killed.

characters.title: Lu Yanfei
characters.introText: She has a great like for anything associated with the color "red" as she wears red clothes and her residence is also made of deep red stones.
characters.appearance: She has a great like for anything associated with the color "red" as she wears red clothes and her residence is also made of deep red stones.
characters.history: Rudy and Song Wude attacked the Origin Sect after hearing the news of its Old Ancestor passing away only to end up offending Wang Lin and dying a meaningless death.

characters.title: Lu Yingjie
characters.introText: He practice evil technique which requires many female Cauldron. He was killed by Wang Lin.
characters.history: He practice evil technique which requires many female Cauldron. He was killed by Wang Lin.

characters.title: Lu Yun
characters.introText: Lu Yun was born in the ancient qi refiner world. He became the alchemy boy of the Fourth Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor who taught him qi cultivation.
characters.history:
Lu Yun was born in the ancient qi refiner world. He became the alchemy boy of the Fourth Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor who taught him qi cultivation.

At the age of 1,327, he gained some achievements as a qi refiner. He followed the Divine Emperor and witnessed the glory of the Vermillion Bird Divine Sect.

At age 2,945, he became an elder of the Vermillion Bird Divine Sect.

At age 4,760, he became one of the head elders and passed his first Heaven’s Blight.

At age 6,215, he was given the Vermillion Bird Mark and achieved his first awakening. He defeated everyone else that had awakened and became number one among the awakened.

At age 7,912, with the help of the fourth Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor, he completed his second awakening. From then on, he was selected to be the next Divine Emperor, the young lord of the Vermillion Bird Divine Sect.

At age 11,463, the Tattoo Clan invaded from outside and stirred up the world. Vermillion Bird Divine Sect helped the Celestial Realm battle the Tattoo Clan. Afterwards, the fourth Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor left with the other three Divine Emperors to head to the outside world. Before they left, he was designated the fifth Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor. At that time, he had just passed his second Heaven’s Blight with the help of the fourth Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor.

characters.title: Lu Yuncong
characters.introText: He did not have any sort of distinguished background but he still managed to grow the Purple Dao Sect into one of the strongest sects in the Rank 5 Region.
characters.history:
He did not have any sort of distinguished background but he still managed to grow the Purple Dao Sect into one of the strongest sects in the Rank 5 Region.

Despite his low cultivation, even masters in the rank 9 region are interested in him and hold him in high regards because of his wisdom and intelligence.

characters.title: Luo Chen
characters.introText: In the past, he was a full-grown 8-star adult ancient god. Currently, his appearance is that of a juvenile ancient god.
characters.appearance: In the past, he was a full-grown 8-star adult ancient god. Currently, his appearance is that of a juvenile ancient god.
characters.history:
After escaping the Thunder Celestial Realm, Wang Lin found that Blood God had issued a Heaven Order for his assassination. Among his pursuers was Yao Bingyun who could also use Spatial Bending which left him no choice but to lure his pursuers towards the dormant moongazer serpent to agitate it into slaughtering his pursuers.

Inside the moongazer serpent, Wang Lin found a location where the life-force of captured people was being used to birth new moongazer serpents. Further inside he saw a young ancient god with six shattered stars. Lou Chen told him to bring his clansman (i.e. Wang Lin's original body).

During the war between Allheaven Star System and Alliance Star System, Wang Lin entered the void along with the Moongazer Serpent, Qing Shui, Yi Muzi and Wudo Chan. There, he managed to meet Lou Chen and challenged the latter to complete his Ancient God coming-of-age ceremony.

During the battle, a Moon Devourer Clan cultivator from the Outer Realm broke the agreement and interfered with their battle in an attempt to absorb Lou Chen, Wang Lin, Qing Shui and Moongazer Serpent to boost his cultivation and purify his bloodline. However, the Heaven Defying Bead activated and aborbed his crescent moon mark leading him to retreat. Alas, Lou Chen and Moongazer Serpent had already exited the barrier separating the Outer and Sealed Realm.

His Moongazer Serpent reappear after Wang Lin obtain the Ancient Order Inheritance.

He was separated from the Moongazer Serpent by Xuan Luo when he was taken out of the Immortal Cave.

characters.title: Luo Yun
characters.introText: Luo Yun was member of Heavenly Ghost Sect.His master Daoist Ghost can be considered as All-Seers peer.
characters.appearance:
Luo Yun cultivated the path of the Heavenly Ghost, and possessed his own ghost spirit, which he used both for combat and protection. He encountered Wang Lin within the East Demon Spirit Sea, this area was known for harboring ancient demons and serving as a deadly trial ground that opened every 5,000 years. Luo Yun possessed a demon spirit crystal, an object of immense value that drew Wang Lin’s attention.

During their confrontation, Wang Lin performed a soul search on Luo Yun’s origin soul, causing him unbearable pain and rendering his soul almost transparent. Wang Lin then reached into Luo Yun’s dantian to seize the demon spirit crystal. Despite Luo Yun’s warnings that his master would seek revenge, Wang Lin remained unshaken and ultimately killed him, sealing his origin soul within a soul flag.

Before his death, Luo Yun revealed key information about the Heavenly Ghost Sect and its dark rituals. He explained that the sect’s ghosts were created using the blood of mortal pregnant women and the essence of powerful men, with the cultivator’s Nascent Soul serving as the medium. The ritual took forty-nine years to complete, binding the heavenly ghost to its master for life. Luo Yun’s own ghost was the weakest of nine such entities, and due to incomplete refinement, it betrayed him in the end.

characters.title: Ma Liang
characters.introText: Ma Liang was the disciple of War Temple and went to foreign battlefield. There he was killed and eventually his body was possessed by Wang Lin who was transmitting his consciousness through the rift formed.

characters.title: Master Ashen Pine
characters.introText: In the past, he accidentally found the Seven-Colored Realm.
characters.history:
Master Ashen Pine invited Wang Lin along with Master Cloud Soul, Pang Decai, Duanmu, the Battle Beast Sect's Chen Tainjun, and Old Woman Zhao.

Inside the seven-colored realm, the six, with the exception of Master Cloud Soul who was made to teleport elsewhere by Wang Lin, defeated a rank 12 fog dragon and obtained its treasures.

Afterwards, Duanmu was captured by one of the Lost Ones while Chen Tainjun left soon after.

Master Ashen Pine then helped Wang Lin obtain tens of thousands of origin crystals by luring the fog beasts away with crushed celestial jades. Then he led the group to Sima Mo's cultivation cave.

On the way, the group faced an ancient restriction which no one was able to break through. Finally, Wang Lin stepped up and broke through. At the same time, he acted as if he had been gravely injured in the act.

This led to Master Ashen Pine leaving him alone with Pang Decai to recover while he moved on with Old Woman Zhao. Soon after the two left, Pang Decai attacked Wang Lin but contrary to expectation Wang Lin was perfectly fine and easily turned the tables on Pang Decai. He killed Pang Decai, stole all his treasures, and soul-searched his soul which allowed him to learn the way to leave the seven-colored realm.

Meanwhile, unaware that Wang Lin was secretly following him, Master Ashen Pine led Old Woman Zhao to the main temple where he sacrificed quite a few of his items to allow her to open the portal sealing the temple. After entering the temple, he trapped Old Woman Zhao while he stole the main treasure of the temple: a jade bottle filled with black liquid.

As he was escaping, Old Woman Zhao went mad and attacked him. Just as he was about to escape the temple, Wang Lin swooped in and stole the jade bottle from him. He pursued Wang Lin and started a deadly battle with him which led to both of them being seriously injured. He even lost his body and was only left with an injured origin soul.

characters.title: Master Devil God
characters.introText: He is an extremely cautious man to point of being timid. He never does anything which he does not have 100% confident of completing. This results in him never leaving behind any tracks of his presence.
characters.personality: He is an extremely cautious man to point of being timid. He never does anything which he does not have 100% confident of completing. This results in him never leaving behind any tracks of his presence.
characters.history: He layed-low during Qing Shui and Wang Lin's assault on the Slaughter Realm. He only acted when he saw Wang Lin being injured by Master Empty Fantasy. Alas, he was killed by Qing Shui's Ji Realm.

characters.title: Master Enlighten East
characters.introText: He attacked Master Hong Shan after the latter appeared and severely wounded Esteemed Nan Zhao. He banded together with Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor, two other Nirvana Void cultivators and, even, Esteemed Nan Zhao to attack him together.
characters.history:
He attacked Master Hong Shan after the latter appeared and severely wounded Esteemed Nan Zhao. He banded together with Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor, two other Nirvana Void cultivators and, even, Esteemed Nan Zhao to attack him together.

However, Master Hong Shan managed to stall the five until he fell in Grandmaster Yun Luo's trap and was sneak-attacked by the Sixth Concubine. Furthermore, Ice Boy appeared to continue holding him back. This allowed the Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor, Esteemed Nan Zhao and a Nirvana void cultivator from Bai Lei Clan to leave the encirclement to kill Wang Lin. However, this only resulted in the Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor and Esteemed Nan Zhao's death while the Nirvana void cultivator from Bai Lei Clan escaped in terror.

Just as the Outer Realm's morale was at an all time low, reinforcements from the Cloud Sea Star System and Summoned River Star System appeared which caused their morale to reach rock-bottom and forced the Outer Realm's Third-Step cultivators to retreat.

characters.title: Master Flamespark
characters.introText: Master Flamespark is the current Lord of the Thunder Celestial Temple of the Allheaven Star System. He is the mastermind behind the war between the Allheaven Star System and the Alliance Star System.
characters.history:
Master Flamespark refined 49 fragments of Thunder Celestial Realm into a powerful treasure and used 49 origin souls as its treasure spirit; these included 28 Illusory Yin origin souls, 14 Corporeal Yang origin souls, two Nirvana Scryer origin souls, Blood Ancestor's and another Nirvana Cleanser's origin souls, two Nirvana Shatterer origin souls, and the origin soul of the Slaughter Celestial Lord, Rain Celestial Realm’s rank 6 Celestial Lord.

Appearence ep 148

characters.title: Master Hong Shan
characters.introText: In the past, he made a deal with Lord of the Sealed Realm to fight for the Sealed Realm when the Realm-Sealing Formation is breached.
characters.history:
While Wang Lin was battling Daoist Water, he appeared along with Master South Cloud to spectate. However, when Daoist Water attempted to self-destruct the Golden Bell and destroy the Cloud Sea Star System, he rushed to stop him.

He was the first to accept and proclaim Wang Lin as the new Lord of the Sealed Realm.

After the Outer Realm cultivators breached the Realm Sealing Formation, he appeared to battle them. He killed thousands of Outer Realm cultivators in an instant and almost killed Esteemed Nan Zhao. After learning of his identity, Master Enlighten East, Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor, two other Nirvana Void cultivators and, even, Esteemed Nan Zhao attacked him together.

For some time Master Hong Shan managed to stall the five until he fell in Grandmaster Yun Luo's trap and was sneak-attacked by the Sixth Concubine. Furthermore, Ice Boy appeared to continue holding him back. This allowed the Fire Sparrow Clan Ancestor to leave and confront Wang Lin who was rushing to kill Grandmaster Yun Luo. However, the former was easily sliced in half by the Heaven-Splitting Axe in Wang Lin's possession.

Ice Boy decided Wang Lin had to be stopped and forcibly sent Esteemed Nan Zhao and a Nirvana void cultivator from Bai Lei Clan out of the encirclement to kill Wang Lin. However, Wang Lin retaliated with a poison sneak-attack upon Esteemed Nan Zhao that resulted in the latter's death. The Nirvana void cultivator from Bai Lei Clan was too terrified to attempt to block Wang Lin and escaped.

After Wang Lin was injured by Li Guang's Boy and escaped along with the Nether Beast, the war turned for the worse for the Sealed Realm. Before the Sealed Realm's Third Step cultivators could destroy the Seven-Colored Realms, the Outer Realm waged another war. Master Hong Shan was ambushed in the the Seven-Colored Realm in the Summoned River Star System and was sealed inside a Dao Fruit.

A few decades later, Wang Lin appeared along with Qing Shui and Master Long Pan and freed Master Hong Shan from the Dao Fruit. Moreover, they also managed to capture the Heaven Punishment Palace Lord Qing Jiuyan.

characters.title: Master Long Pan
characters.introText: In the past, he was greatly helped by the previous Lord of the Sealed Realm.
characters.history:
He awoke after Wang Lin stormed the Cultivation Alliance. He was ready to battle Wang Lin before he heard of Master Zhong Xuan's traitorous acts from the latter. He asked Zhang Xi if this was true but the latter hesitated which only served to strengthen his suspicions. In his rage, he killed Zhang Xi and soul-searched the third Head Elder beside Master Zhong Xuan. Finally, under the pressure of Master Long Pan's gaze, Master Zhong Xuan was forced to confess to his crimes.

Disappointed and regretful, Master Long Pan plead mercy for Master Zhong Xuan from Wang Lin. In exchange, he pledged to cut off his vitality, burn his origin soul to forcefully boost his cultivation to the early-stage of Arcane Void, kill all the Outer Realm cultivators in the Sealed Realm, destroy the remaining Seven-Colored Realms, and take back the Summoned River Star System in exchange for Master Zhong Xuan’s life.

A few decades later, Master Long Pan was fighting against the Heaven Punishment Palace Lord Qing Jiuyan inside Summoned River's Seven-Colored Realm to free Master Hong Shan who trapped there. He was struggling until Wang Lin appeared along with Qing Shui and freed Master Hong Shan from the Dao Fruit. Moreover, they also managed to capture the Heaven Punishment Palace Lord Qing Jiuyan.

72 years after Wang Lin was ambushed by Sovereign's Fishing the Moon in the Well, Master South Cloud led the remnants of the Alliance to battle against the Outer Realm. The battleground was near Planet Suzaku where the Inner Realm cultivators fought to defend the Lord of the Sealed Realm's homeland.

The battle was in a deadlock with the Outer Realm's Zhou Jin and Ice Boy facing off against Master South Cloud, Situ Nan, Master Lu Fu and Master Long Pan until the Heaven Master Void God's avatar appeared. This immediately tilted the balance of power against the Inner Realm cultivators and forced them to retreat inside the formation of Planet Suzaku. When all hope was lost, Wang Lin triggered the Great Void Gate and appeared to lift the spirits of the weary Inner Realm cultivators.

characters.title: Master Lu Fu

infobox.occupation(s): Ancestor of the Allheaven Star System

characters.introText: He was a Celestial during the days of the Thunder Celestial Realm.
characters.history:
He first appears when Qing Shui was defending Wang Lin from the Yao Family Ancestor.

He later fought against Tuo Sen during the war against the Alliance Star System.

characters.title: Master Scarlet Soul
characters.introText: He claims to serve a cultivator called Xun Shanqing, who is an Empyrean Exalt under Grand Empyrean Dao Yi.
characters.history:
He founded the Scarlet Soul Sect and after regaining his cultivation, waged war against the entire Cave World. Originating from the Immortal Astral Continent, his power was too much for the Cave World's experts to handle, severely injuring Dao Master Blue Dream and rendering Master South Cloud into nothing more than a mere origin soul.

His goal was to absorb the life essence of all the cave world's inhabitants to push his cultivation base to Golden Exalt (Peak of late-stage Void Tribulant). Afterwards, he planned on returning to the Immortal Astral Continent and become a head elder of a sect. Combining a sect's backing and his personal stash of resources hidden within the continent he claimed to have a high chance of breaking into Empyrean Exalt as well. He would then request to serve under Grand Empyrean Dao Yi, as he knew that his first choice, the Celestial Emperor would surely reject him due to being too weak.

When Wang Lin returns to the Cave World, he believes that he is much stronger than him. However, when he discovers that one of his companions possesses a Golden Exalt sea dragon he begins to panic. He mistakenly believes that Liu Jinbiao is the owner of the sea dragon and Wang Lin's benefactor. He then claims his master is under the protection of Grand Empyrean Dao Yi and requests Liu Jinbiao to allow him to kill Wang Lin. However, Wang Lin proves that it is actually him with all of the power when he forcibly establishes contact with Dao Yi all the way from the Cave World. After seeing Dao Yi act completely subservient to Wang Lin, Master Scarlet Soul spirals into insanity, proclaiming that everything Wang Lin did was fake despite having felt Dao Yi's aura.

After Wang Lin reveals his Grand Empyrean Sun and Lian Daozhen's assimilated soul, his mind completely shatters. He suffers a mental breakdown before Wang Lin kills him using his Grand Empyrean Sun.

characters.title: Master South Cloud
characters.introText: He saved three of the Corpse Sect's Eight Kings when they entered the Land of the Ancient God inside the Sea of Devils after hearing about it from Wang Lin. Meanwhile, the other five of the Eight Kings died to Tuo Sen.
characters.history:
He saved three of the Corpse Sect's Eight Kings when they entered the Land of the Ancient God inside the Sea of Devils after hearing about it from Wang Lin. Meanwhile, the other five of the Eight Kings died to Tuo Sen.

After Wang Lin returned from the Outer Realm, he executed the traitor Daoist Water. During that time, Daoist Water attempted to destroy the Golden Bell he received from the Ancient Celestial Realm to destroy the Cloud Sea Star System and escape to the Outer Realm. Master South Cloud, Master Hong Shan, Zhou De, Cloud Edge and Esteemed Great Void attempted to stop him but could not. Just when they began despairing, Wang Lin's Nether Beast appeared and swallowed the golden storm energy from the destroyed Golden Bell. 

After the Outer Realm cultivators breached the Realm Sealing Formation, he appeared to battle them. While Master Hong Shan distracted most of the enemy Third Step cultivators, he attempted to repair the breach on the Realm Sealing Formation. He borrowed Zhou Jin and Ling Dong from Wang Lin to guard him while he did so.

Master South Cloud was assisted by the reinforcements from Summoned River Star System led by Purple Dream who held off the Sixth Concubine while he repaired the Realm Sealing Formation.

After Wang Lin was injured by Li Guang's Boy and escaped along with the Nether Beast, the war turned for the worse for the Inner Realm. Before the Inner Realm's Third Step cultivators could destroy the Seven-Colored Realms, the Outer Realm waged another war. Master South Cloud was injured by Sovereign and was forced to go into closed-door cultivation for decades.

72 years after Wang Lin was ambushed by Sovereign's Fishing the Moon in the Well, Master South Cloud led the remnants of the Alliance Star System to battle against the Outer Realm. The battleground was near Planet Suzaku where the Inner Realm cultivators fought to defend the Lord of the Inner Realm's homeland.

The battle was in a deadlock with the Outer Realm's Zhou Jin and Ice Boy facing off against Master South Cloud, Situ Nan, Master Lu Fu and Master Long Pan until the Heaven Master Void God's avatar appeared. This immediately tilted the balance of power against the Inner Realm cultivators and forced them to retreat inside the formation of Planet Suzaku. When all hope was lost, Wang Lin triggered the Great Void Gate and appeared to lift the spirits of the weary Inner Realm cultivators.

characters.title: Master Void
characters.introText: Master Void was an elder of the Cultivation Alliance and the younger brother of Master Zhong Xuan. He was sent to the Demon Spirit Land in order to protect Xi Xuan and her group.
characters.history:
When he entered the Demon Spirit Land, he was constantly trying to kill Wang Lin because Wang Lin had awaken the Vermillion Bird Divine Mark. Master Void could not allow Wang Lin to grow any further because this would guarantee the rise of the Vermillion Bird Divine Sect. In the  Celestial Emperors Tower, Master Void first tried to kill Wang Lin with his cultivation of Peak Nirvana Shatterer. However, Wang Lin set up a killing formation and display his source origin in order to lure Master Void into the trap. When Master Void was trying to comprehend the Source Origin, Wang Lin attacked with his killing formation. Wang Lin was able to escape into a transfer array into the Celestial tower while heavily injuring Master Void. Wang Lin caused enough damage to bring his cultivation down to the mid Nirvana Shatterer realm.

When Master Void and Wang Lin met again, they were in the Celestial Emperors Tower. Master Void wanted to attack Wang Lin but Zhou Yi, Wang Wei, Hu Juan, and Bei Luo coldly stared at him. However, in that instant, Wang Lin moved to attack, causing  Zhou Yi, Wang Wei, Hu Juan, and Bai Wei to attack as well. Just at that moment, the All-Seer and Ling Tianhou arrived. Master Void tried to ask for him from All-Seer, but instead, All-Seer schemed against him, causing everyone's attack to fall upon him. This injured his body and soul even further and dropping his cultivation to almost the Peak of early Nirvana Shatterer.

When they were all in the 9th level of the Celestial Emperors Tower,  Master Void sneak-attacked the heavily injured Wang Wei. Wang Lin used his furnace to switch places with Wang Wei and defended against Master Void's attack. When Ta Jia was able to possess Qing Lin's body, everyone was forced to escape the Celestial Emperors Tower. Master Void was later sealed by Ta Jia. When Wang Lin was fighting All-Seer, Wang Lin used sundered Night and end up killing two of All-Seer's avatars along with Master Void.

characters.title: Master Yi Chen
characters.introText: In the past, Master Hollow Wind attempted to kidnap Ling'er, his granddaughter, and use her as a cultivation incubator as she has a water spirit body. However, he dreaded the master behind the Three Chen Brothers.
characters.history:
He attempted to embarrass Wang Lin as he had unwittingly spread his divine sense over the city. However, Wang Lin soon turned the tables on him and injured him. Three Chen Brothers all came to apologize and Wang Lin accepted their apology. Afterwards, Master Yi Chen invited Wang Lin to tea and he introduced his granddaughter, Ling'er, to him.

Soon after, All-Seer attacked Wang Lin because he took the Extreme Yang from the dying Bai Wei. Master Yi Chen, along with the City Lord of Ghost Eye City, went close to witness their battle but two were pushed back and injured from the shockwaves of Wang Lin using the Summon the Rain crystal Qing Shui gave him.

Afterwards, he met Wang Lin when the latter was passing through his home planet after subduing Master Hollow Wind. Wang Lin accepted Master Yi Chen's invitation to stay on Planet Blue Spirit.

characters.title: Master Zhong Xuan
characters.introText: He is the ruler of the Alliance while Master Long Pan slumbers.
characters.history:
He trapped Qing Shui inside the Seven-Colored Realm located in the Alliance headquarters after the latter stormed the Alliance headquarters to uncover the secret behind the Heavenly Madness.

Many years later, after the First Battle of the Third Sealed-Outer Realm War, he defected to the Sovereign Council after seeing the Outer Realm's might. He allowed the Outer Realm full use of the Seven-Colored Realm located in the Alliance headquarters and also suppressed the cultivators of the Alliance Star System.

A few decades later, Wang Lin returned from the belly of the Nether Beast and stormed the Alliance headquarters. He also awoke Master Long Pan and informed him of Master Zhong Xuan's traitorous acts. Under the pressure of Master Long Pan's gaze, Master Zhong Xuan was forced to confess to his crimes.

Disappointed and regretful, Master Long Pan plead mercy for Master Zhong Xuan from Wang Lin. In exchange, he pledged to cut off his vitality, burn his origin soul to forcefully boost his cultivation to the early-stage of Arcane Void, kill all the Outer Realm cultivators in the Sealed Realm, destroy the remaining Seven-Colored Realms, and take back the Summoned River Star System in exchange for Master Zhong Xuan’s life.

characters.title: Mo Fei
characters.introText: Mo Fei was one of the most talented and mysterious demon generals in the Demon Spirit Land, renowned even among high-ranking demon cultivators. Three hundred years ago, he held the title of number one demon general, a position earned through overwhelming strength, extraordinary skill, and an innate talent described as being “blessed by the heavens.” His cultivation path was unusual and deeply mysterious, marked by abilities that even other demon generals could not understand. His signature ability, the Great Rotating Disk spell, was powerful enough to reverse and reflect enemy attacks. This spell demonstrated its terrifying might when Mo Fei reflected Mo Lihai’s Hundred Wave Demon Sea technique back at him, overturning the battle entirely and forcing Mo Lihai into defeat.
characters.appearance: Mo Fei was one of the most talented and mysterious demon generals in the Demon Spirit Land, renowned even among high-ranking demon cultivators. Three hundred years ago, he held the title of number one demon general, a position earned through overwhelming strength, extraordinary skill, and an innate talent described as being “blessed by the heavens.” His cultivation path was unusual and deeply mysterious, marked by abilities that even other demon generals could not understand. His signature ability, the Great Rotating Disk spell, was powerful enough to reverse and reflect enemy attacks. This spell demonstrated its terrifying might when Mo Fei reflected Mo Lihai’s Hundred Wave Demon Sea technique back at him, overturning the battle entirely and forcing Mo Lihai into defeat.
characters.history:
Mo Fei’s brilliance was further displayed during the demon general competition, where demon talents were tested against the demon drum. He struck the drum six times without sustaining any injury, an achievement that immediately stunned the crowd and established him as a cut above the rest. However, Mo Fei did not stop there. Despite the increasing backlash with each strike, he managed to hit the drum a seventh and then an eighth time. The seventh strike contained such powerful killing intent that his armor exploded, and the eighth shattered multiple protective mirrors, yet he survived by stabilizing his body using demonic seals. These feats were beyond extraordinary—so much so that even veteran demon generals and vice commander-in-chiefs openly admired his strength.

With unstoppable determination, Mo Fei pushed even further and ultimately struck the demon drum eleven times, a result considered nearly impossible. This accomplishment shocked everyone present. Demon generals grew silent, vice commanders darkened their expressions, and many affirmed that Mo Fei surpassed most experts of his generation. There were widespread expectations that, following his eventual baptism in the dragon lake, his cultivation would break past its current limits and he would ascend to the rank of vice commander-in-chief.

His appearance also reinforced his reputation. Mo Fei possessed an imposing presence, a cold and calm demeanor, and wore distinct armor and a demonic mask. During the drum competition, his mask shattered from the backlash, revealing a handsome face that stunned the spectators. Wang Lin immediately recognized his appearance—Mo Fei looked identical to a mysterious black-haired man Wang Lin had previously encountered in the depths of Hong Prison, raising questions about Mo Fei’s identity and origins.
