characters.title: Mo Zhi
characters.introText: Mo Zhi, is an important supporting character in the novel. His true identity is a disciple of the overlord of Chu Yun Kingdom, a level-eight cultivation nation in Kun Xu. Possessing the cultivation level of a second step cultivator, he can perceive the laws of heaven and earth and wields destructive power. He once served as an envoy of the Cultivation Alliance stationed at Planet Suzaku.
characters.appearance:
Mo Zhi, is an important supporting character in the novel. His true identity is a disciple of the overlord of Chu Yun Kingdom, a level-eight cultivation nation in Kun Xu. Possessing the cultivation level of a second step cultivator, he can perceive the laws of heaven and earth and wields destructive power. He once served as an envoy of the Cultivation Alliance stationed at Planet Suzaku.

In a rainy night at a ruined temple in Zhao Kingdom, through a philosophical discourse on life and death, he helped Wang Lin break through the bottleneck of the Deity Transformation stage, subtly guiding him to comprehend the mysteries of the Extreme Realm. Later, he intervened as a mediator in key events such as the Vermilion Bird Tomb Battle. His actions are essentially manipulated by Tian Yunzi, and he shares a hidden secret relationship as fellow apprentices of All-Seer with Wang Lin.
characters.personality: When Mo Zhi encountered Wang Lin by chance on a rainy night at the border of Zhao Kingdom, he used the metaphor "fire as life, falling rain as human existence" to guide Wang Lin to a breakthrough in the Soul Transformation stage, achieving a complete realization of his conceptual realm. By introducing the philosophy of when the heart perishes, one forgets, Mo Zhi led Wang Lin to comprehend the Law of Life and Death, laying a crucial ideological foundation for his future cultivation.

characters.title: Mu Bingmei
characters.introText: For her Avatar, and its role in Books 1-7, see: Liu Mei
characters.personality: She is portrayed as exceptionally beautiful—peerless, with cold, aloof features, long black hair, and an icy, proud, noble temperament that makes her seem almost otherworldly and emotionally distant. Over time her demeanor softens into more tranquility as her arc progresses. She is calculating and initially committed to a ruthless, emotion-severing path, but develops complex internal conflict, guilt, and residual feelings.
characters.history:
Somehow, she became Zhou Ru's Teacher after she left Planet Suzaku. Before Wang Lin left the Alliance Star System, he visited the Brilliant Void Realm to leave Zhou Ru under Qing Lin. At that time, he ended all his past disputes with Liu Mei (and in effect with Mu Bingmei).

During the 100 years when Wang Lin was stuck in the Seven-Colored Realm, Tuo Sen escaped from the Sea of Devils. He nearly destroyed the Allheaven Army, the Four Divine Sect, the Cultivation Alliance, and the Corpse Sect. He also killed every one from the Brilliant Void Realm except Zhou Ru, who was with Qing Lin, and Mu Bingmei on whom he left an imprint. Mu Bingmei escaped to the Cloud Sea Star System where she met Wang Lin and told him about Tuo Sen's escape. Wang Lin also absorbed Tuo Sen's imprint which helped to further stabilize his sixth star.

When Wang Lin invited others to reincarnate on the Immortal Astral Continent, she ultimately chose to remain inside the Cave World. She appeared only to see Wang Lin off.

After Wang Lin returns to the Cave World, he puts himself and Mu Bingmei in a Dao Dream for one lifetime together. Mu Bingmei lives as Liu Mei for this life time, becoming the mother of Wang Ping in a mortal life. After they wake, Wang Lin asks her to close her eyes. When she opens her eyes she departs with a Wang Lin who she cannot tell whether it is the original or an avatar, leaving the Cave World for parts unknown.
characters.trivia: It is implied that the Wang Lin Mu Bingmei departs with was created by Wang Lin using his True and False Domain, as he describes there being "No real answer" to whether or not it is the real him or an Avatar.

characters.title: Mu Yun
characters.introText: He was defeated by Shi Xiao during demon general competition.after that his companion fighted shi xiao and becouse shi xiao despised cultivators from outer world, he killed him.
characters.appearance:
He was wearing armor and was very thin. His eyes were sunken in and his face had a sickly, yellow color to it.Mu Yun! This person can be considered top 30 among the demon generals. Rumor has it that he cultivates the Nine Deaths Nine Lives cultivation method and that 300 years ago he had already reached five deaths and five lives

Demon General Mu Yun is a notable figure among the demon generals, recognized as one of the top 30 demon generals. He cultivates the "Nine Deaths Nine Lives" cultivation method and, impressively, had reached the "five deaths and five lives" level 300 years ago. His appearance is quite distinctive: he is thin, with sunken eyes and a sickly yellow complexion, and he stands motionless like an ancient pine tree, exuding a dark and ominous aura. His smile resembles that of a corpse, adding to his eerie presence.
In a confrontation with Demon General Shi Xiao, who is ranked among the top three demon generals, Mu Yun displays powerful abilities.

He can manipulate five strands of life and death demonic energy, which manifest as five green snakes that twist and extend aggressively toward Shi Xiao. These strands are potent enough to create powerful gusts of wind and emit a foul smell that shocks onlookers. However, Shi Xiao counters Mu Yun's attack with a diamond-shaped light that destroys the green demonic energy strands and forces Mu Yun to retreat, showing that although Mu Yun is formidable, he is not invincible.
Mu Yun also has a powerful helper named Tian Lui from the Giant Spirit Sect, who is huge, weighing hundreds of kilograms, and whose steps cause the ground to shake. Tian Lui is capable of emitting celestial spiritual energy and uses it to aid Mu Yun in battle.

characters.title: Murong Zhuo
characters.introText: Murong Zhuo is introduced as a fourth-generation disciple of the Ink Sect. He is described as a loner who rarely speaks, and when he does, his words are brief and concise, making his solitary nature well known among his peers. Despite his minimal speech, he is highly skilled in spells, displaying a wide variety of techniques and never using the same spell twice. His escape spells are particularly remarkable, making it difficult for others to catch him if he chooses to flee.
characters.appearance:
Murong Zhuo is introduced as a fourth-generation disciple of the Ink Sect. He is described as a loner who rarely speaks, and when he does, his words are brief and concise, making his solitary nature well known among his peers. Despite his minimal speech, he is highly skilled in spells, displaying a wide variety of techniques and never using the same spell twice. His escape spells are particularly remarkable, making it difficult for others to catch him if he chooses to flee.

Murong Zhuo’s presence is mysterious and difficult to read. At times he appears transparent and clear, while at other times he resembles pitch-black water, making it hard for others to discern his thoughts. He is cautious and perceptive; after being warned about the two women from the Corpse Sect accompanying Wang Lin, he becomes more vigilant, showing his awareness of potential threats.

He aids Wang Lin and the others in navigating dangerous areas, using his spells to help them pass through hazardous zones. His demeanor remains calm, and he even shows a rare smile when parting ways with Wang Lin, suggesting a level of respect or camaraderie

characters.title: Na Duo
characters.introText: He is the 1st external cultivator Wang Lin encounter on Planet Suzaku. He was injured and cultivated for 10000 years in the War God Shrine's Divine Path Cave to be able to recover 30% of his power, Early stage Soul Transformation, to have a chance to return home.
characters.appearance:
He is the 1st external cultivator Wang Lin encounter on Planet Suzaku. He was injured and cultivated for 10000 years in the War God Shrine's Divine Path Cave to be able to recover 30% of his power, Early stage Soul Transformation, to have a chance to return home.

He's the first person with a Ji Realm, Five Colored Ji Realm, that Wang Lin encounter. He explain to Wang Lin how to break past the Ji Realm's bottleneck, to use a Cultivation Planet Crystal. He's surprised by Wang Lin, because he didn't think a waste planet like Suzaku could have a Ji Realm cultivator and a Divine Retribution inducing treasure.

Later, Wang Lin learned from Dun Tian, the ancestor of the Soul Refining Sect, that Na Duo was one of the foreign cultivators who fought with Situ Nan for the Heaven Defying Bead.

characters.title: Nangong Han
characters.introText: Nangong Han is an  talented and powerful cultivator who has always been strongest person amongst those at the same cultivation as him. He is a member of the  Nangong Family.
characters.personality: He seems to have a knack for annoying people as he can talk endlessly for days.
characters.history: When Wang Lin came to the southern realm to complete for a spot in the Thunder Celestial Temple, Nangong Han was the only person able to fight him. However, because Wang Lin was able to use Spatial Bending, Nangong Han wasn't able to to beat him. Nangong Han later because obsessed with Wang Lin and often times bothered him, hoping to gain some enlightenment on Spatial Bending.

characters.title: Old Ghost Zhan
characters.introText: He is something of an enigma, for while he and Seven-Colored Daoist have repeatedly pitted the Sealed and Outer Realms against each other to find the third soul, he resisted the will of the Celestial Emperor inside him and knelt to the ghosts of dead Sealed Realm cultivators. In the past, he sought to learn the truth of the world, but the revelations he discovered seem to have left him with his current melancholic mindset.
characters.history:
Sovereign killed his descendant Zhan Xingye and used their blood connection to figure out where Old Ghost Zhan was hiding as he believed him to be seriously injured from his 4th Arcane Tribulation.

He appeared in the flesh to take Li Guang's Bow from the Sovereign and gave it to the Sealed Realm, where Wang Lin claimed it. He then appeared to destroy the Sovereign's Avatar after the latter ambushed Wang Lin on the Fake Suzaku, where he witnessed Wang Lin and Lian Daofei get sucked into the Cave Door.

He witnesses Wang Lin's return and ascension to the Third Step, as well as his final Divine Tribulation and entry into the Ancient Celestial Realm that it incured. This caused him to wonder if Wang Lin might be the third soul. He then bows his head to the Sealed Realm's dead Cultivators against the will of the Celestial Sovereign inside of him when Wang Lin summons them to serve as the treasure spirit of his Unnamed Wheel Formation.

After the Four Generals were freed from the Ancient Celestial Realm, he followed the four while they looked for the third soul. He encountered Wang Lin during the search. He was surprised to by the Nether Beast's amazing cloaking ability and attempted to coerce Wang Lin into giving him the beast. Enraged, Wang Lin fought off the Four Generals and killed a few Celestial Soldiers before ordering the Nether Beast to devour the 80 Celestial Soldiers. This left the Four Generals terrified and they immediately escaped. Even Old Ghost Zhan was astonished and he fled.

A few months later, he appeared in Allheaven after he felt someone absorb the third soul. He was shocked to see Wang Lin there but was relieved since he felt it would be easier to retrieve the third soul from Wang Lin than from Seven-Colored Daoist. He was the second to pursue Wang Lin into the 300 Destroyed Worlds. Wang Lin set up seven ambushes in one of the 300 worlds. The seven ambushes resulted in the death of Sixth Concubine, Azure Dragon General and many other celestials. It also resulted in severe injuries to Sovereign and Seven-Colored Daoist which made Old Ghost Zhan pursue him to seal him as this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for him.

Afterwards, Old Ghost Zhan pursued Wang Lin to obtain the third soul from him and become whole. However, he was intercepted by Dao Master Blue Dream and Ancestor Ma. Meanwhile, two of Gui Yi Sect's other ancestors kept the Vermillion Bird General and the Black Tortoise General engaged. Although the generals were unwilling to follow Old Ghost Zhan's orders, they realized that he was almost certain to become the Ancient Celestial Sovereign again and reluctantly accepted.

During the battle, Old Ghost Zhan suddenly escaped Dao Master Blue Dream and Ancestor Ma's encirclement and attacked the two ancestors from Gui Yi Sect to allow the Vermillion Bird General and the Black Tortoise General to pursue Wang Lin who entered Ye Mo's Tomb to obtain his heart and complete his inheritance except for the left eye.
characters.trivia:
He at one point claims to be at Early-stage Void Tribulant, but this is retconned soon after when the concept of Arcane Tribulation is introduced and he is noted to have completed 8 of the 9. Unless he's had another breakthrough since, his words are patently false. Unless of course he is referring to his battle prowess being at Early-stage Void Tribulant which could be possible considering he is just below Wang Lin in terms of his mysterious abilities that might allow him to jump levels in strength, much like Wang Lin.

He is also someone who broke the Ten Thousand Bone Void Gate

characters.title: Ouyang Hua
characters.introText: Soul Refining Ascension (complete low quality celestial spell)
characters.appearance: A white-haired old man with a black cane.
characters.personality: Ouyang Hua is described as having a bad temper, particularly during his alchemy refining work, but his obsession with alchemy and dedication make him likely to reach the Soul Formation stage. Despite his age and initial cultivation limitations, he grows into a respected and intelligent leader, deeply loyal and grateful to Wang Lin, who he views as both a savior and ancestor. Ouyang Hua also learns to work with demonic spiritual energy and demon jades under Wang Lin’s instruction, further cementing his role in the tribe’s growth and defense.
characters.history:
Ouyang Hua is an important elder and key figure within the Soul Refining Tribe, a valley tribe protected by a powerful formation that has existed for countless years. The tribe itself has largely forgotten its origins, though Ouyang Hua explains that his ancestors were settled in the valley by Huang Long long ago. The tribe has lived in relative isolation, with the valley functioning as a quiet village before Wang Lin’s arrival. Most villagers are mortals, and while Ouyang Hua possesses a thin, silk-like aura of demonic spiritual energy in his dantian, his blocked meridians limit circulation and cultivation. Despite this, he controls the protective formation around the valley and can create illusionary bodies.

When Wang Lin arrives, he forcibly helps Ouyang Hua by opening a meridian in his dantian using a direct, painful method. This intervention dramatically increases Ouyang Hua’s cultivation from being stuck at rank 1 to reaching two stars of demonic spiritual energy. Deeply grateful, Ouyang Hua kneels and kowtows to Wang Lin, addressing him as "Supreme Celestial." Following this, he is entrusted with learning and teaching the Soul Refining Spell, which he pledges to pass on to the villagers, greatly enhancing their cultivation abilities.

Under Wang Lin’s guidance, Ouyang Hua leads the tribe in cultivating the soul refining spell and preparing for combat against enemy tribes. He plays a key role in battles, refining the souls of the dead and supporting the defense of the valley. His status within the tribe grows as Wang Lin returns and is honored as an ancestral figure, in part due to a stone statue carved in Wang Lin’s likeness. Ouyang Hua greets him with profound respect and excitement. As a reward for his centuries of dedication and hard work, Wang Lin later gives Ouyang Hua a complete low-quality celestial spell called Soul Refining Ascension, elevating his power despite his abnormal cultivation state.

After Wang Lin departs to attend to other matters, Ouyang Hua continues to lead the tribe, implementing Wang Lin’s orders to disperse members to surrounding tribes to spread cultivation knowledge and resist memory-wiping potions. He is involved in preparations for attacking a cave and leads the tribe through a period of increased aggression and expansion to gain higher-level chants, marking the beginning of a new crusade for the Soul Refining Tribe

characters.title: Ouyang Long
characters.introText: He met Wang Lin when the latter had just entered Peng Lai. Wang Lin saw him trading celestial jades for origin crystals so he approached him to do business. In fact, Ouyang Long was just a proxy for his Uncle-Master, Master Ashen Pine.
characters.history:
He met Wang Lin when the latter had just entered Peng Lai. Wang Lin saw him trading celestial jades for origin crystals so he approached him to do business. In fact, Ouyang Long was just a proxy for his Uncle-Master, Master Ashen Pine.

He also invited Wang Lin to Master Ashen Pine's private auction on the latter's behalf.

characters.title: Ouyang Zi
characters.introText: He's madly obsessed about alchemy. His life goal is to refine a rank 6 pill which he did when he got instructions from Wang Lin to create it so that Li Muwan could reach Nascent Soul Stage.

characters.title: Pang Decai
characters.introText: In the past, he followed Master Ashen Pine into the Seven-Colored Realm the latter had accidentally found.
characters.history:
He participated in Master Ashen Pine private auction, same as Wang Lin. There, he was surprised by the amount of celestial jades Wang Lin had and made plans to rob him soon after he left the city. However, after seeing Wu Qing, who had the same cultivation as himself, being effortlessly killed by Wang Lin, he was extremely terrified of the Wang Lin.

Master Ashen Pine invited him along with Master Cloud Soul, Wang Lin, Duanmu, the Battle Beast Sect's Chen Tainjun, and Old Woman Zhao.

Inside the seven-colored realm, the six, with the exception of Master Cloud Soul who was made to teleport elsewhere by Wang Lin, defeated a rank 12 fog dragon and obtained its treasures.

Afterwards, Duanmu was captured by one of the Lost Ones while Chen Tainjun left soon after.

On the way, the group faced an ancient restriction which no one was able to break through. Finally, Wang Lin stepped up and broke through. At the same time, he acted as if he had been gravely injured in the act.

This led to Master Ashen Pine leaving Wang Lin alone with him to recover while he moved on with Old Woman Zhao. Soon after the two left, he attacked Wang Lin but contrary to expectation Wang Lin was perfectly fine and easily turned the tables on him. Wang Lin killed him, stole all his treasures, and soul-searched his soul which allowed him to learn the way to leave the seven-colored realm.

characters.title: Punnan Zi

infobox.occupation(s): Ancestor of the Xuan Dao Sect
infobox.cultivation_base: Middle Stage Nascent Soul (On Introduction) Peak of Nascent Soul (End)

characters.introText: Punnan Zi is the Nascent Soul Ancestor of the Xuan Dao Sect and acknowledged strongest Cultivator in the Country of Zhao at the beginning of the story.
characters.personality: He has seen innumerable brushes with death in his life, imbuing him with a desire for strength.
characters.history:
Nascent Soul of Punnan Zi outside Heng Yue Sect

After his sect lost to the Heng Yue Sect in their exchange, he showed up and personally seized Heng Yue Mountain. He stole the sect's disciples and any elders willing to join him. He also wanted to recruit Wang Lin, but Wang Lin refused him to protect the secrets on his body.

He is summoned to the Tower of Heaven alongside all the other Nascent Soul cultivators in Zhao in preparation for opening the Foreign Battleground. He later witnesses Wang Lin's fight with Teng Huayuan.

During the 400 years, the Heaven Tower’s Messager, Lin Yi, suppressed all the other first-rank sect and imposed a rule to help Teng Family cultivate a Soul Formation Expert under any means. He was forced to help the Teng Family, although he dislike them, because the Heaven Tower's Messenger wanted to experiment the creation of a Giant Demon cultivator with a cultivation technique (on Teng One, Teng Huayuan's little brother).

Punnan Zi shows up and saves Teng Huayuan by the order set by Heaven Tower Messager, Lin Yi. He shows his dislike in saving Teng Huayuan. Teng Huayuan tells him that if he didn’t, then his Xuan Dao Sect would be in deep trouble with Lin Yi. He manages to take a few of Wang Lin’s moves and was barely able to hang on until Lin Yi’s arrival. Which saves them.

At the end, when Wang Lin controls and was about bring down the wisp of Heaven Tribulation on Lin Yi. Lin Yi uses Punnan Zi as a shield and tries to escape back to his country, but Punnan Zi burns his lifespan energy to temporarily increase his strength to hold back Lin Yi, so he would be brought down with him. He tells Lin Yi that you want to return to your country, he will not allow that and the entire Country of Zhao will not allow that. Lin Yi manages to break free, but it was too late and they both ended up being struck by the wisp of Heaven Tribulation. characters.title: Qing Lin
characters.introText: Qing Lin was the strongest Celestial Emperor and the strongest person inside the Sealed Realm during the reign of the Celestial Domain.
characters.appearance: He is a middle-aged man. He wore a golden robe with nine purple dragons embroidered on it; the purple dragons revealed a ferocious expression. His long hair was tied with a yellow ribbon. He looked very handsome and gave off the aura of a celestial.
characters.personality: Qing Lin is a ruthless man when he needs to be but he is not an evil person. As the nominal Supreme of the Sealed Realm, he is required to make cool-headed decisions at all times. However, he is not a man without emotions as is seen by him leaving Qiu Yao alive despite her betrayal.
characters.history:
After Wang Lin entered his fifth cave, he was sent to the Bottle World where he battled Ming Hai. When he used Nether Guide, it was interfered with and he was summoned to Qing Lin's chambers. Qing Lin gave him a yellow bag but Wang Lin didn't dare to open it.

After Qiu Yao self-destructed, Qing Lin's avatar entered the yellow bag.

Later, Ta Jia managed to extinguish all 99 candles and possessed Qing Lin's body. In fact, Wang Lin had worked in tandem with Hu Juan, Wang Wei and Zhou Yi to fool Ta Jia into entering Qing Lin's body as Qing Lin immediately used Wang Lin's soul to trap and refine Ta Jia. Although Ta Jia managed to escape, he was killed by a revived Qing Lin. Qing Lin took Wang Lin in as his disciple and later he also took in Situ Nan as his disciple after seeing his talent.

Wang Lin left Zhou Ru and Thirteen in Qing Lin's care when he left for the Cloud Sea Star System as only Qing Lin could keep them safe from Tuo Sen. In fact, Tuo Sen entered the Rain Celestial Realm as he felt Wang Lin's aura but he was sent off by Qing Lin.

After Daoist Water spread Wang Lin's image across the Inner Realm and spread false rumors about him, Qing Lin sent out a divine message that deterred any from attempting to harm Wang Lin.

After Wang Lin was injured by Li Guang's Boy and escaped along with the Nether Beast, the war turned for the worse for the Sealed Realm. Before the Sealed Realm's Third Step cultivators could destroy the Seven-Colored Realms, the Outer Realm waged another war. Qing Lin was injured during a battle by Ice Boy and was forced to enter closed door cultivation to heal.

A few decades later, Sovereign used Fishing for the Moon in the Well upon Wang Lin while he was in Planet Suzaku. In a desperate attempt, Wang Lin unsealed Master Scarlet Soul from Ye Mo's Earth Palace who then escaped and in the process broke through the realm Wang Lin was trapped inside. This allowed all the Inner Realm Third Step cultivators to immediately feel the danger looming upon Wang Lin. Old Ghost Zhan, Situ Nan, Qing Shui, Master Long Pan, Master South Cloud, Master Hong Shan and Qing Lin immediately rushed to Planet Suzaku. Alas, they were unable to stop the Sovereign's Seven-Colored Lance and Wang Lin fell inside the outer cave rift.

In the 70 years during which Wang Lin was missing, Qing Lin used a life-threatening spell to seal the Inner Realm for 30 years. Although this allowed the Inner Realm some much needed rest, Qing Lin's injuries were further exacerbated and he was unable to fight in the battle to protect Planet Suzaku. He also used a treasure to allow Situ Nan to reach the Nirvana Void.

She laid motionless in a tower built by Zhou Yi  for 2000 years and required large amounts of celestial spiritual energy every 1000 years.

Because Wang Lin had secretly erased and rewrote all of her memories (for selfish reasons), she was very much in love with Qing (reincarnated Zhou Yi). When Wang Lin met her and Zhou Yi again, he regretted tampering with her memory.

characters.title: Qing Shui
characters.introText: Qing Shui is one of Wang Lin's few friends. They share a similar tragic past and they both walked down the path of slaughter and solitude. He eventually breaks through to the Third Step with the Slaughter Essence.
characters.appearance:
Qing Shui's appearance changes noticeably throughout his life, reflecting both his cultivation and his turbulent mental state. In his normal state, he is an imposing figure who appears to be around forty years old. He possesses a tall, broad frame reminiscent of a celestial war god, with long hair that drifts as though moved by an invisible wind. His features are resolute and dignified, while his eyes shine like lightning, radiating an overwhelming majesty that causes even powerful cultivators to instinctively lower their heads in his presence. He is often seen wearing a purple robe, with a three-eyed sable resting upon his shoulder, its gaze as cold and sharp as his own.

At other times, Qing Shui is described as having a thinner build. His hair is frequently disheveled and unkempt, particularly during periods of emotional turmoil, madness, or prolonged slaughter. In some instances, his messy hair hangs over most of his face, concealing his features and leaving only his eyes visible. These eyes are often bloodshot and filled with madness, grief, and overwhelming killing intent, giving him a frightening and almost demonic appearance.

His eyes are among his most distinctive features. As the inheritor of the Ji Realm, Qing Shui's right eye can emit a dense crimson light capable of releasing a terrifying destructive aura. When activated, the eye glows blood-red, inspiring fear in those who meet his gaze and revealing the immense power contained within him. Despite this terrifying aspect, his eyes are also capable of conveying profound emotion. In calmer moments, they reveal deep sorrow, determination, tenderness, and gentleness, particularly when he is with those he cherishes.
characters.personality:
Qing Shui was once a prince of the country of Clear Water, a status that should have afforded him a life of privilege. Instead, his world was shattered early, and from the wreckage of that devastation came the awakening of his Ji Realm through monstrous hatred and killing intent. What followed was a life soaked in slaughter. During periods of madness, he became something closer to a bloodthirsty demon than a man, and even after ascending to the rank of Celestial Lord, the violence of his past never fully left him. His immense power was always shadowed by sorrow and despair, two forces that seemed to war with his strength rather than being erased by it. The turning point in his psychology came when he personally killed his own lover. This act, devastating and irreversible, became paradoxically the catalyst for his return to sanity. the horror of that act was enough to shock him back toward clarity, implying a conscience that had been buried, not destroyed.

Despite the violence that colors his history, Qing Shui possesses a genuine capacity for loyalty and care. This is most visible in his relationship with  Wang Lin. He doesn't merely tolerate or use Wang Lin he actively teaches him spells, passes down inheritance, and invests in his growth out of a real sense of gratitude and duty. This behavior mirrors the way his own master once treated him, he repays what was given to him by extending the same care to those who come after. It's a quiet, almost old-fashioned form of honor one that exists in stark contrast to his battlefield ruthlessness, and reveals that his harshness is selective, reserved for enemies and circumstance rather than being his default nature.

When it comes to combat or protecting what matters to him, Qing Shui is uncompromising. He fights powerful enemies without hesitation and has shown willingness to kill even members of his own realm if the situation demands it. His killing intent is described as monstrous, and his combat style as ruthless  qualities that make him a genuinely fearsome presence rather than a reformed or softened figure. This ferocity isn't reckless; it's an expression of resolve. Whatever softness exists in his private relationships, it vanishes entirely when he's confronted with a threat.

Qing Shui is not a man who has successfully buried his trauma; he carries it visibly, even if only in private or unguarded moments. He grieves for the people he's lost. He regrets the things he's done. And yet, he's also capable of joy particularly in his interactions with Wang Lin, where laughter and genuine warmth break through the weight of his past. His tears and emotional expressions are significant precisely because they're rare; for a man of his power and reputation to show such vulnerability speaks to how deeply he feels, despite or perhaps because of  everything he's endured. He is haunted, but not numb.

Physically and mentally, Qing Shui is extraordinarily resilient. He endures poison, life-threatening injuries, and prolonged suffering, yet continues to fight, cultivate, and pursue his goals without surrendering to despair. This endurance isn't framed as effortless  it's clearly taxing  but his will consistently proves stronger than his circumstances. This resilience ties back to his origin story: a man who awakened his power through hatred and loss has, by necessity, developed an extraordinary tolerance for pain, both physical and emotional.

Later in his story, Qing Shui's protectiveness becomes most clearly defined through his role as a father. Even in a weakened state, he's willing to fight fiercely to defend his daughter. This represents perhaps the purest expression of the loyalty and love that exist beneath his violent exterior when it comes to his child, his ferocity and his tenderness merge into a single, unified drive to protect.
characters.history:
Qing Shui was originally the crown prince of a mortal kingdom known as the Country of Clear Water. During his youth, his nation was overthrown, forcing him into exile. Carrying deep resentment toward those who had destroyed his homeland, he eventually entered the path of cultivation.He ended up entering a cultivation sect, Rather than finding refuge there, he was humiliated and mistreated by the people around him. For a boy who had already lost his country and his former life, this added layer of degradation proved to be the final blow. Standing alone on a mountain peak, weak and battered, he let out a cry of pure hatred  rejecting the heavens, the earth, and all living beings around him.It was during this period of suffering and hatred that he awakened the legendary Ji Realm.

Despite his tragic beginnings, Qing Shui possessed extraordinary talent. After ascending to the Celestial Realm, he joined the Thunder Celestial Realm and rapidly rose through the ranks, eventually becoming a Celestial Lord. His cultivation, talent, and potential were so exceptional that he became the foremost disciple of the Celestial Emperor Bai Fan and was widely regarded as the most likely successor to the position of Celestial Emperor.

After ascending to the Celestial Realm, Qing Shui rose rapidly through the ranks of the Thunder Celestial Realm, eventually becoming the renowned Celestial Lord Qing Shui. Possessing extraordinary talent and cultivation, he earned the trust of Celestial Emperor Bai Fan and was regarded as the most promising candidate to inherit the position of Celestial Emperor. During this period, he established his own lineage, accepted disciples, and gained immense prestige throughout the Celestial Realm. Despite his cold and isolated nature, Qing Shui eventually met a woman who changed his life. She became his dao partner and was the one person capable of warming his guarded heart. For her sake, he gradually abandoned the path of slaughter and hatred that had defined much of his early life, choosing instead to pursue a peaceful existence alongside those he cared for. Under her influence, he became one of the most respected and admired Celestial Lords of the Thunder Celestial Realm, seemingly leaving behind the darkness of his past.

However, the happiness Qing Shui had finally found proved tragically short-lived. After years of loneliness, he believed he had at last discovered a peaceful life alongside his dao partner, family, and disciples. For a time, he lived in genuine contentment, leaving behind much of the hatred and bloodshed that had shaped his past. Yet that happiness was as fragile as a reflection of the moon upon water and was ultimately shattered by a sudden calamity.

For reasons unknown even to the Celestials, Qing Shui abruptly lost control and descended into a state of madness. Under the influence of his Ji Realm, he became consumed by an overwhelming desire for slaughter, turning into a terrifying force of destruction. In his insanity, he indiscriminately massacred countless Celestials, including friends, disciples, descendants, and, most devastatingly, the dao partner who had brought light back into his life. His rampage plunged the Thunder Celestial Realm into chaos, transforming one of its greatest protectors into its most feared calamity

The Celestials ultimately joined forces to suppress Qing Shui, but even their combined strength struggled against the overwhelming power of his Ji Realm. In the end, Celestial Emperor Bai Fan personally intervened and managed to subdue his disciple. At the moment of his brief awakening, Qing Shui saw his dao partner reaching out to him with her final strength, attempting to touch his face. As her hand fell lifelessly, he let out a desperate roar unlike anything in his life, a cry that marked the complete collapse of his former world. From that moment onward, all traces of happiness vanished from his existence. Although Bai Fan had the opportunity to kill him, he could not bring himself to do so. Instead, Qing Shui briefly regained clarity and was forced to confront the full extent of his actions. Realizing he had personally slaughtered those he cherished most, he was consumed by unbearable grief and guilt. In despair, he attempted to end his own life and destroy both his body and origin soul.

Fearing that the Ji Realm might one day resurrect him and repeat the tragedy, Qing Shui used his treasure, the Sealing Vortex, to split his body and origin soul into nine separate seals, dispersing them across different locations. This act ensured that even if one part were to awaken, he could not easily return in full.Moved by grief and pity for his disciple, Celestial Emperor Bai Fan did not destroy him. Instead, he placed a healing formation over the nine seals, hoping that over time Qing Shui might suppress the madness within the Ji Realm, recover his sanity, and eventually return to his original self.
characters.trivia: Qing Shui is one of the few cultivators who owns the Ji Realm.

characters.title: Qing Yi
characters.introText: She was about in her twenties with black hair like a waterfall. Although she wasn’t an absolute beauty, she gave of a very refreshing feeling.
characters.appearance:
Qing Yi shares a deep and affectionate bond with Wang Ping. Their relationship develops gradually, with Qing Yi willingly accompanying him through hardship and uncertainty.

Wang Ping, in turn, shows her great tenderness and affection, and their connection eventually matures into a lifelong companionship. Out of devotion, Qing Yi chooses to age alongside Wang Ping, wishing to share his mortal years rather than seek immortality alone.

Throughout her life, Qing Yi faces numerous challenges — including being expelled from the Sun family and captured by others. Nevertheless, Wang Lin supports her and vows to help her reach the Nascent Soul stage.

With Wang Ping’s protection and Wang Lin’s guidance, Qing Yi continues her cultivation journey, overcoming adversity through perseverance and love.

After years of struggle, Qing Yi grows older yet retains her gentle and sentimental nature. She values emotion and companionship over ruthless ambition, expressing a desire to remain “a person of feeling” rather than a cold and detached celestial.

Her story concludes peacefully — she and Wang Ping settle in a quiet mountain village, living out their remaining years together in serenity and mutual affection.

characters.history: When Wang Lin arrived on the Fallen Land, he made the Dark Scorpion Clan his subordinates. When Wang Lin was fighting Sima Mo's  5th Heaven's Blight avatar, the Second Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor said if Wang Lin can kill Sima Mo's avatar within 5 breaths, he will protect Wang Lin at any cost. However, during the last breath, the Second Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor decided to take action and kill Sima Mo's avatar with his own hands. He then gave Wang Lin the title of Young Emperor (of the Fallen Lands). characters.title: Seven-Colored Daoist
characters.introText: His soul contained most of the Ancient Celestial Sovereign's cultivation and spells which made him the strongest person inside the Cave World except for when Xuan Luo entered the cave.
characters.personality:
His soul contained most of the Ancient Celestial Sovereign's cultivation and spells which made him the strongest person inside the Cave World except for when Xuan Luo entered the cave.

As he only contains a lot of power with no memories or comprehension, he is prone to fits of rage as soon as something does not go his way. His wisdom does not run parallel to his strength, as is usually the case.
characters.history:
He told Sovereign to throw Li Guang's Bow near the tear in the Realm-Sealing Formation to lure Wang Lin to take the bow.

Wang Lin encountered him, for the first time, in the Seven-Colored Realm inside the Cultivation Alliance. He stood by as he watched Wang Lin slowly pull out the thorns that bound him. He even gifted Wang Lin a Dao Fruit.

Seven-Colored Daoist attacked Wang Lin right as he used one of his few remaining Li Guang's Bow arrows to destroy the Outer Realm's Ancient Celestial Realm, kill Sovereign, injure Seventh Concubine and capture both Dao Master Miao Yin and Devil Master Nine Heavens. However, Wang Lin used the jade Fan Shanlu gave him years ago and escaped to the vortex inside Cloud Sea. Seven-Colored Daoist pursued him but was trapped in Fan Shanmeng's Double Illusion. In fact, he wasn't trapped but wished to use the illusion to go through his memories to find the third soul. However, he was interrupted by Wang Lin before he could do so. He immediately chased after Wang Lin filled with rage and malice. He chased Wang Lin down to the Ancient One's Alter that housed Ye Mo's right arm. Before he could harm Wang Lin, however, Greed appeared from the spatial rift connecting the Ancient One's Alter to the Purple Sun Sect's Beast Farm. This allowed Wa Wa and Han Han to cycle their Grand Empyrean cultivation through Greed and enter the Cave. Seven-Colored Daoist instantly escaped in terror.

A few months later, he appeared in Allheaven after he felt someone absorb the third soul. He was shocked to see Wang Lin there but was relieved since he felt it would be easier to retrieve the third soul from Wang Lin than from Old Ghost Zhan. He was the first to pursue Wang Lin into the 300 Destroyed Worlds. After some searching, he finally found Wang Lin inside one of the worlds. Wang Lin escaped and got Seven-Colored Daoist off his trail after some effort. He then prepared seven ambushes for those that came to hunt him. The seven ambushes resulted in the death of Sixth Concubine, Azure Dragon General and many other celestials. It also resulted in severe injuries to Sovereign and Seven-Colored Daoist which made Old Ghost Zhan pursue him to seal him as this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for him.

He was subsequently sealed by Old Ghost Zhan but he waited to absorb him together with the third soul. Alas, he did not get the chance as he was killed by Wang Lin using the seals Xie Qing created.

characters.title: Shengong Hu
characters.introText: Shengong Hu is a member of the Shengong Family of the four Great Families of the Southern Domain of the Allheaven Star System. He, alongside Tang Yanfeng and Zhan Konglie, is known as Southern Domain's Three Calamities.
characters.history:
He met Wang Lin inside the thunder pond in the Southern Domain of the Allheaven Star System. As Wang Lin had just looked past the door inside the heaven-defying bead, he mistook Wang Lin for a Third Step Cultivator and acknowledged him as his Lord. This led him to being isolated by his family and the Thunder Celestial Temple.

He was saved by Wang Lin from the mad Qing Shui inside the Thunder Celestial Realm.

He met Wang Lin during the qualifiers for the Celestial Bestowment Tournament. By this point, he had learnt that Wang Lin was not a Third Step Cultivator. Although he was no longer fanatic about Wang Lin, he still respected him greatly. He vouched for Wang Lin during the tournament.

When they spotted the Brilliant Golden Fruits, they saw Nine Multitude Bugs surrounding the fruit and guarding it. However, in order to lure the bugs away, he decided that they would use the younger generation they met to be the bait. When they saw Wang Lin obtain the Brilliant Golden Fruit, his eyes were full of greed and he planned to take it away from Wang Lin. Shi Feng's group attached Wang Lin, they knew they weren't his match, but he didn't think Wang Lin would battle them to the death because they thought Wang Lin would have to expend a lot of energy to fight the three elders. When Wang Lin destroyed his body, his soul escaped and then possessed Guo Xingyi. In fear, he tried to reason and plea with Wang Lin, but Wang Lin still ended up killing him.
