characters.title: Shi Xiao
characters.introText: Shi Xiao is a powerful demon general whose cultivation ranks among the top three within the demon general domain. His appearance is distinctly demonic, accompanied by a cold and prideful demeanor, a dark gaze filled with ambition, and a faint, almost mocking smile that hints at his past. His temperament is ruthless and aggressive, shaped heavily by a long history of conflict. One defining event from three hundred years ago was the scar Mo Lihai left on his face—an insult Shi Xiao never forgot and never forgave. This humiliation fueled his violent nature, deep hatred, and his relentless desire to prove his superiority over his rivals.
characters.appearance: Shi Xiao is a powerful demon general whose cultivation ranks among the top three within the demon general domain. His appearance is distinctly demonic, accompanied by a cold and prideful demeanor, a dark gaze filled with ambition, and a faint, almost mocking smile that hints at his past. His temperament is ruthless and aggressive, shaped heavily by a long history of conflict. One defining event from three hundred years ago was the scar Mo Lihai left on his face—an insult Shi Xiao never forgot and never forgave. This humiliation fueled his violent nature, deep hatred, and his relentless desire to prove his superiority over his rivals.
characters.history:
Over the years, Shi Xiao’s cultivation surged dramatically. By the time of the demon general competition, he had risen to a level comparable to an early-stage Ascendant cultivator, his entire body filled with fierce demonic spiritual energy. This power, combined with his speed, precision, and ruthlessness, made him both respected and feared. His confidence in battle was absolute. During the competition, he declared that Mu Yun was no match for him and demanded that Mu Yun admit inferiority. When Mu Yun unleashed five strands of life-and-death demonic energy, Shi Xiao shattered the attack with a diamond-shaped burst of light, striking Mu Yun directly between the eyebrows and forcing him into a grievous retreat. His speed and destructive techniques left a deep impression on all who witnessed them.

Shi Xiao’s hostility extended especially toward outsiders; he repeatedly stated that while demon generals do not engage in true life-and-death battles with each other, foreigners exist only to be killed. After defeating Mu Yun, he attempted to challenge Mo Lihai, but Mo Lihai refused. Shi Xiao then redirected his killing intent toward Wang Lin, whom he despised. His confrontations with Wang Lin were marked by arrogance, threats, and attempts to intimidate him. Shi Xiao even confronted Wang Lin when Wang Lin broke into his mansion, expressing killing intent and attempting to strike him down. Despite his ferocity, there were moments during these confrontations when he hesitated—revealing that beneath his cruelty was someone capable of fear.

Shi Xiao was also involved in several other encounters. One notable fight occurred when Mu Yun relied on help from Tian Lui of the Giant Spirit Sect. Shi Xiao swiftly defeated Tian Lui with a decisive, surgically precise attack. His connections with other demon generals were strained as well. His relationship with Chen Tao, the senior apprentice brother of Shi Xiao’s junior apprentice brother, was tense and hostile, shaped by past disagreements and differing stances regarding Wang Lin.

Shi Xiao’s ambition was clear: he wanted to dominate the demon general competition and rise to the highest position available to him. His power, reputation, and ruthless presence shaped the political and interpersonal dynamics of the demon general mansion. However, his downfall came from the very hatred he cultivated. When he confronted Wang Lin again, Shi Xiao charged forward with killing intent and prepared a powerful spell. Before he could release it, Wang Lin unleashed a terrifying Yin–Yang shadow technique. A dark shadow surged from the ground, passed through Shi Xiao in an instant, and shattered his life force completely. Shi Xiao collapsed with his eyes still wide open, full of killing intent, but utterly lifeless. Wang Lin stated that he had promised long ago to take Shi Xiao’s life, and this moment fulfilled that vow.

Shi Xiao’s end was swift and absolute. His ambitions, grudges, cruelty, and pride all led him directly to the fatal confrontation he sought. His death marked the conclusion of a violent and turbulent path—one defined by power, hatred, and an unyielding desire to dominate, but ultimately cut short by the one opponent he could never surpass: Wang Lin.

characters.title: Sima Mo
characters.introText: Sima Mo was the Head Disciple of the Heaven Breaking Sect back when they were a rank 8 sect almost 18,000 years ago.
characters.history:
He was informed of the kill order on Wang Lin and so he sent his Fifth Heaven's Blight avatar to capture the former. He arrived at the location divined soon after Wang Lin left but was surprised to feel the aura of the Great Void Gate. However, he was even further dumbfounded when he felt no trace of Joss Flames and realized that Wang Lin had managed to slightly open the Great Void Gate. After figuring this out, he went after Wang Lin with renewed ambition and curiosity.

He tracked him to the Fallen Land where he used the help of the Ninth Fallen Elder to give him a "just reason" to capture Wang Lin. During their battle, Wang Lin figured out that Master Simo was actually the Heaven Breaking Sect's Sima Mo. In the middle of the battle, the Great Emperor of the Fallen Land decreed that if Wang Lin manages to defeat Simo Mo within 5 seconds his safety would be guaranteed. Wang Lin manages to do so and forces a grievously injured Simo Mo to escape only to be killed by the Great Emperor.

A few months later, Sima Mo appeared in his original body for the Fallen Elder Competition. There, he met Wang Lin, once again. After Wang Lin awakened his Ethereal Flame, he challenged Sima Mo to a battle which the latter readily accepted. During the battle, Wang Lin managed to overpower and seal Sima Mo inside his Ancient God Furnace and used his Dao Spell, Dao Dream upon him. This allowed him to see Sima Mo's past and why he defected to the Outer Realm. Wang Lin then let him go as he felt he might have done something similar if Wan Er was the condition.

characters.title: Sima Rufeng
characters.introText: A blue figure suddenly appeared in the sky. This was a young man who was about 30 years old.

characters.title: Sima Yan
characters.introText: Sima Yan  was a gloomy-faced and ambitious cultivator who served as the vice commander of an army of ten thousand demon soldiers. Operating under Commander Wang Lin, he played a key role in the military affairs surrounding Wang Lin’s rise to command. Known for his calculating demeanor and deep killing intent, Sima Yan’s eventual downfall came as a result of his cruelty, ambition, and defiance against Wang Lin’s authority.
characters.appearance: Sima Yan  was a gloomy-faced and ambitious cultivator who served as the vice commander of an army of ten thousand demon soldiers. Operating under Commander Wang Lin, he played a key role in the military affairs surrounding Wang Lin’s rise to command. Known for his calculating demeanor and deep killing intent, Sima Yan’s eventual downfall came as a result of his cruelty, ambition, and defiance against Wang Lin’s authority.
characters.personality: Sima Yan was characterized by his dark, brooding expression and aura of restrained hostility. Upon first encountering Wang Lin, he was visibly shocked, but his surprise quickly gave way to killing intent. He was cunning, power-hungry, and prone to manipulating those under him. Despite his rank as vice commander, he commanded loyalty from the demon soldiers more than Wang Lin did initially, reflecting both his influence and the troops’ mistrust of outsiders.

characters.title: Sima Yun
characters.introText: He was friendly and doesnot had bad intentions.he even invited Wang Lin in his sect as a guest.

characters.title: Sky Devil Magician
characters.introText: Xu Liqing's master that sacrificed himself so his disciple can escape from Land of the Ancient God 1000 years ago.
characters.history:
In Land of Ancient Gods third trial Xu Liqing meet his master again, apparently got revived and demonized as Demon God Tu Si. The truth is his death was planned all along, and actually that is his third time he come to Land of the Ancient God. When he first arrive at fourth realm thousands year ago he won an inheritance treasure golden arm bone and realize that this place contains unimaginable fluctuations of desires. He decide to leave using the arm bone. He then spend years to studying desires until he created the Mysterious Sky Devil Cultivation Method. On the second time he came here, he realize the fluctuation became even larger, he also starting to see cultivators that turned into a demon. After this he make a plan, taking Xu Liqing as disciple to cultivate Mysterious Sky Devil Method, bring him to Land of Ancient God and handed him the inheritance treasure before death, and wait him back to this place again so he can absorb the Ancient God's desires in fourth realm and finally be a sacrifice to open a tunnel that lead to Ancient God's inheritance of knowledge. In the end, he successfully obtained the inheritance crystal albeit only a piece of it and got stopped before he can absorb the knowledge by Duo Mu. Unfortunately all his painstaking plans got crushed, as the crystal turn into pieces by that person. He is then got dragged away by him to search a soul devourer. Unknown to them the place when the crystal got shattered, crystal shards start to reform into a whole of crystal again. Seeing this, Wang Lin take out the crystal for himself.

S1 EP33 First Appearance As Demon God Tu Si

characters.title: Slaughter
characters.introText: Slaughter, also known as Lu Mo, is a main character in Renegade Immortal and its derivative works.
characters.appearance:
Slaughter is the combination of Wang Lin's Slaughter and Absolute End Essences. Born with the Independent consciousness, he is an extremely powerful and terrifying being, able to combat Grand Empyrean's despite sacrificing Wang Lin's other Essences, his Heavenly Bull Armor and a significant part of his Cultivation to exist.

Slaughter reached the realm of Heaven Trampling (4th step) before Wang Lin and was sent back in time by Wang Lin, using Flowing Time spell, to find a way to resurrect Li Muwan. Wang Lin had a hard time controlling Slaughter, and generally needed to use prohibitions and restrictions to suppress him. If Slaughter did not self-destruct, Wang Lin had no way to erase him and could only suppress him.

At the end of the series, he decided to relinquish his free will and fused back into Wang Lin so he could be with Li Muwan again.
characters.personality:
Dressed in black, with extremely pale skin, his extremely long-black hair fluttering like a black dragon, his gaze as cold as a blade, silent and melancholic, only showing a gentle expression when looking at Li Muwan

Born with its own independent consciousness, immortal and indestructible, exceptionally cold and bloodthirsty, even looking down on its original self; Wang Lin.
characters.history:
Slaughter’s birth was an accident, which even startled Wang Lin himself, leading to the use of many other origins to suppress him. The origin of the Slaughter was initially derived from the Slaughter Immortal Technique taught to Wang Lin. After developing a killing intent, he comprehended a trace of the Slaughter Origin. Later, Qing Shui gave him a Slaughter Sword, which contained a complete Slaughter Origin, and the fusion formed Wang Lin's Slaughter Origin.

The origin of Absolute End Essence was born from the perception of night devouring light at the Dong Lin Pond, and Wang Lin had the incomplete Slaughter experience it together to form it.

The long street was a killing field, Wang Lin couldn’t handle it so he had no choice but to release Slaughter to save him. The true Slaughter is a fusion of two origins, Slaughter and Absolute End. He is the embodiment of death; with a blink of an eye, those with low cultivation will instantly vanish. There is also a key point that Slaughter can expel its avatar, and Wang Lin's avatar, because Wang Lin’s avatars are a burden to Slaughter. Slaughter expelled these other avatars and used Wang Lin's original body as a vessel to contain the will of Slaughter.

Wang Lin, unless it is his true self with the imprint that can forcibly suppress, other clones are no match for Slaughter. Wang Lin's five-element avatar wanted to protect the  Hai Zi, but was directly dispersed by Slaughter. Slaughter’s intention was that since he has been released, he must kill enough to make it worthwhile; there should be no living person in front of him. In this assassination setup, Hai Zi was the bait; if it weren't for Slaughter, Wang Lin would have died here.

From then on, Wang Lin could no longer suppress him and made a deal with Slaughter, to alternated between appearing during the day and night, with Wang Lin almost falling into a deep sleep. In order to save the Madman, Wang Lin used a technique to turn day into night and transformed into Slaughter. Slaughter, besides his killing nature, has nothing in his heart, and currently, Slaughter was still controlled by Wang Lin, who ordered him to save the Madman. This battle demonstrated Slaughter’s immortal and indestructible qualities. In the early stage, Slaughter was essentially Wang Lin's killing tool; when Wang Lin couldn't handle it, he would switch to Slaughter.

Slaughter and the Five-Elements Avatar joined forces to kill enemies; the Five Elements Avatar is a collective embodiment of Wang Lin's cultivation, and it is Wang Lin's consciousness. The Slaughter at this time is half Slaughter and half Wang Lin.

Later, Wang Lin and Slaughter fled into a rage, working together to save Li Muwan’s remnant soul.

In the Late seige, Wang Lin integrated the fierce soul of Luo Hou into Slaughter, completely separating Slaughter from himself and after witnessing Slaughter’s battles against the Heavenly Dao to save Li Muwan, he let Slaughter to continue the loop and sent back millions of years ago by using the Flowing Time Spell, to resurrect Li Muwan. Slaughter gained complete freedom.

Slaughter returned to countless years before Wang Lin's birth. During these countless years, he unleashed his own unique Dream Dao technique to reincarnate in 36,000 parallel universes; each time he used it, he repeatedly experienced his encounters, love, and separations with Li Muwan. He treated Wang Lin’s life as a story, crafting his own narrative within it, evolving and deducing to discover a way to resurrect her. Thus, entering the timeline at any point— whether during Li Muwan’s childhood or a time when only Li Muwan existed. Slaughter witnessed Li Muwan’s childhood, when Wang Lin—who had never seen her in her childhood— encountered a version of her he did not recognized.

In this process, he tried countless times, failing countless times. Each failure meant starting over with a new round, as the Dream Dao could not easily alter reality. It was only later-after becoming a 4th step cultivator, he realized the way to revive her was to use the Boundary compass’s spirit to obtain the One Realm Essence.

He discovered the Old Man Extermination and realized that he was also a Heaven Trampling (4th step) cultivator. Slaughter then went to find him, and during a game of chess, he learned that the universe contains four great realms, each with a unique Void Annihilation Magic Treasure—a Heaven-Trampling magic treasure. This Void Annihilation Magic Treasure can forcibly resurrect a person outside of reincarnation, allowing that person to directly transcend reincarnation. The Void Annihilation Magic Treasure of the Reverse Dust Realm is the Boundary Compass.

Slaughter borrowed the Boundary Compass from Old Man Extermination and left the chess game mid-way. Then, he launched a new round of attempts, repeatedly using the Boundary Compass Compass to perform Dream Dao techniques. Yet, failed again and again. Each failure left behind a white bead, because the white bead was the core of the Boundary Compass. This was also the origin of the countless failed white beads in the Seven-Colored Realm. Slaughter discovered that the reason for the failure was that something was missing.

Meanwhile, during countless attempts over the years since Slaughter borrowed the compass, the spirit of the compass, All-Seer, awakened. It didn't remember who it was, where it came from, or why it had become the spirit of the compass. It began to fear Slaughter, and it hid in the shadows, observing...

In every attempt, when he crossed the Heaven Trampling Bridge at the end, he always awakened because he failed to find a way to revive Li Muwan. At that time, All-Seer, as the spirit of the compass, observed his thousands of attempts, and destroying the world everytime he failed.

All-Seer later extracted Li Muwan’s remnant soul to scheme, making Wang Lin commit more killings to open the Immemorial God Realm. He still feared Slaughter, as Slaughter’s past Dream Dao left psychological shadows on him.

Slaughter purposely set the spirit free, All-Seer. Then he began to make progress. Yet, entering in the Boundary Compass caused him to dissipate, so he shattered it; by placing one half in the Immortal Astral Continent and the other one in the Void, he created a dreamlike, illusory atmosphere. It was the fusion of reality with his Dream Dao that finally allowed him to influence the reality itself—even the Ancient Ancestor and the Celestial Ancestor were deceived by Slaughter’s Dream Dao, leading them to commit suicide in their pursuit of the Dao.

The compass’s spirit, the All-Seer became excited. After so many years, it was finally free. Next, it carried out its great undertaking of possession. Once it successfully possessed Slaughter, it could search for its origins and its homeland. Because it knew Slaughter’s life trajectory inside and out, it multiplied into countless forms, taking on different identities at every important juncture, such as All-Seer, Seven-Colored Immortal Venerable, Imperial Preceptor, and so on, quietly awaiting Slaughter's next reincarnation.

Slaughter manipulated time and space, destroyed the Dong Lin sect, and forcefully interwined in the original timeline. He created Seven-Colored Realm, and left crucial clues for Wang Lin;

First, the failed white beads of the Seven-Colored Realm, leaving a voice telling Wang Lin that one was missing.

Second, a skull. Inside the skull, he left the complete method to revive Li Muwan, leaving behind his unique killing intent. Only the original Wang Lin could discover what he left behind.

Third, the strands of white hair in the Heavenly Lion Beast Soul. When this white hair encountered the real Wang Lin, it dissipated. This tells Wang Lin that Slaughter, in the past, found a way to revive Li Muwan.

Fourth, The Heaven Defying bead only needed to return to where Wang Lin first obtained it, returning everything to the Wang Lin's starting point, everything back on track, so that the real Wang Lin could begin his plan to resurrect Li Muwan. Therefore, Slaughter placed the Heaven Defying bead in the Seven Paths Sect of the Immortal Astral Continent, and through the hands of the Seven-Colored Immortal Venerable, he orchestrated a series of events to return the bead to Wang Lin's birthplace.

Then Slaughter just went into deep slumber, letting Wang Lin to complete the loop. After a few kalpas, Wang Lin is born, and after that the first Chapter of Renegade Immortal started.

Chapter 1900-1902; When Wang Lin started generating the Slaughter Thunder, Slaughter woke up, feeling another of his kind, from the ruins of Dong Lin sect, and flew towards the direction.

When the connection between Wang Lin and Slaughter had been severed, Wang Lin was unaware of exactly what Slaughter had done; he only knew the clues Slaughter left behind for him, and later witnessed the outcome. In the final chapters, Wang Lin got into the Immerial God Realm, defeated All-Seer, and used the One Realm Essence to revive Li Muwan, Slaughter gave up his own consciousness and merged into Wang Lin's body. So he would eternally be with Li Muwan. Wang Lin then met the Old Man Extermination and finished the chess game left behind by Slaughter. And just like that, the loop is closed.
characters.trivia:
Slaughter sits in meditation and is in the deep slumber on the statue of Li Muwan, where he was awakened one Kalpa earlier, feeling another of his kind.

When Wang Lin wanted to cultivate, while the Empyrean Exalt Hai Zi wanted to chat with him. Wang Lin refused and released Slaughter to stand between them. Slaughter stared at the Hai Zi with a murderous aura, leaving her speechless.

Slaughter Battled the Heavenly Dao twice in every 36,000 lifetimes where his love reached its peak, without Li Muwan, Slaughter’s hatred leaded to the destruction of the world everytime he lost her. Li Muwan’s inevitable death had never changed, so Slaughter always remained the one left behind, his hatred for the heavens reached its utmost limit. Wang Lin wanted to see this scene clearly. He was indeed afraid that Li Muwan cannot be resurrected and wanted to know if this scene is from his past life, so he delved into Slaughter’s heart, feeling his sorrow, despair, and anger.

characters.title: Song Tian
characters.introText: He claims to have become a Grand Empyrean and completed his dao at the first mountain born in the Ancient Shi, known as Origin Mountain and had refined its power, which possessed strength equivalent to the Ancient Ancestor's finger.

characters.title: Song Wude
characters.introText: In the past, he was beaten by the previous Ancestor of Origin Sect when he attempted to kidnap Lu Yanfei at Rudy's behest.
characters.history: After hearing the news of the death of the previous Ancestor of Origin Sect, he stormed the place, once again, attempt to to kidnap Lu Yanfei. However, Wang Lin killed him before he could harm anyone.

characters.title: Sovereign
characters.introText: Sovereign was the most powerful cultivator and public ruler of the Outer Realm. Despite such status, he was still just a puppet for the competition between Old Ghost Zhan and Seven-Colored Daoist.
characters.history:
Wang Lin entered the Seven-Colored Realm in Cloud Sea Star System and found the remains of Zhan Xingye and saw a image that showed Sovereign using Zhan Xingye's bloodline to track a weakened Old Ghost Zhan. There, he also consumed the Dao Fruit the Sovereign was growing. Immediately, Sovereign noticed him. Wang Lin even obtained the Sovereign's Seven-Colored God Void Nails.

A decade later, Wang Lin appeared in the Outer Realm. After he left the Fallen Land and ambushed the Third Divine Bird in the holy land of the Fire Sparrow Clan, Sovereign attempted to use his Fishing the Moon in the Well to kill him but was stopped by Dao Master Blue Dream.

Later, when Sovereign attempted to enter Ye Mo's Tomb to rescue Esteemed Great Desolation, Dao Master Miao Yin and Devil Master Nine Heavens, Wang Lin used Ye Mo's aura to let out a roar that seriously injured Sovereign and forced him to escape.

During the first battle of the Third Sealed-Outer Realm War, Sovereign attempted to kill Wang Lin by having his disciple, Feng Yi, kill Wang Lin by using Li Guang's Bow but the latter survived and even obtained Li Guang's Bow.

A few decades later, Sovereign used his Fishing the Moon in the Well on Wang Lin when he was in Planet Suzaku and allowed the shadows of Ice Boy, Second Concubine, Sixth Concubine, Heaven Master Void God, Grey-robed Old Man, Black-robed Old Woman, Dao Master Blue Dream and himself to enter the spell. However, this resulted in Wang Lin killing Grey-robed Old Man and Black-robed Old Woman with his Realm Burning Umbrella and then killing Second Concubine, Sixth Concubine, ice boy and Heaven Master Void God with a shot from his Li Guang's Bow. Wang Lin even almost managed to escape the spell after he caught Sovereign off-guard by released Master Scarlet Soul but he was stopped by Dao Master Blue Dream. Still, he survived as Lian Daofei suddenly appeared and shielded Wang Lin from Sovereign's Seven-Colored Lance.

72 years later, Wang Lin reappeared and killed Sovereign with a shot from his Li Guang's Bow and ended the war after he killed or captured the remaining Outer Realm Arcane Void cultivators. As a user of the Sealing Extermination Clan's Three-Life Spell, Sovereign managed to survive and then sent the remaining five Nirvana Void cultivators of the Outer Realm to draw out Wang Lin's remaining arrows but they failed. Even Ye Mo's Child failed and instead had his eight drops of origin blood absorbed by Wang Lin.

Then, Sovereign begged Seven-Colored Daoist to rescue Esteemed Great Desolation, Dao Master Miao Yin and Devil Master Nine Heavens from Ye Mo's Tomb to force Wang Lin to release his remaining arrows but they were attacked by Dao Master Blue Dream. After three days of battle, Dao Master Miao Yin was seriously injured, so much so that his cultivation level fell to peak Spirit Void and he became unable to reach to his peak cultivation in 100 years. Devil Master Nine Heaven’s injuries were slightly less severe than Dao Master Miao Yin’s, but his Joss Flame Realm was destroyed which injured his mind and resulted in his cultivation level falling to early-stage Arcane Void. Esteemed Great Desolation was injured the most and escaped using a secret spell. His injuries were so bad that his lifespan fell to just 10 years.

Three years later, Wang Lin destroyed the Outer Realm's Ancient Celestial Realm with two arrows from his Li Guang's Bow. Ecstatic, Sovereign appeared to kill Wang Lin as he believed he only had two arrows remaining. However, to his terror, Wang Lin shot another arrow from Li Guang's Bow which resulted in Sovereign's death, once again, Dao Master Miao Yin and Devil Master Nine Heavens' souls being sealed and the Seventh Concubine being gravely injured. As a result, Sovereign exhausted all three lives that his Three-Life Spell provided him and was only left with the one life he was born with. Also, his Dao Heart was cracked as he miscalculated that Wang Lin only had two arrows left.

After Wang Lin obtained the third soul and opened the core of the Cave, Sovereign entered the core along with the rest of the celestials in the cave. He followed Wang Lin to the Fourth Flower among the Five Flowers Eight Doors where he was defeated by Wang Lin and company and then his origin soul was sacrificed to summon the Yi Si Puppet.
characters.trivia:
He is the father of Qiu Yao and, through her, ancestor to the Tattoo Clan.

He is one of the few cultivators in the Cave World who originate from the Immortal Astral Continent

He seems to resurface in Beyond the timescape as a memory of the technique user of "Fishing the moon in the well!"

The destruction of the Celestial Realm was caused by The Sovereign (掌尊, Zhangzun). The massive palm that appeared during the catastrophe was his own divine ability, His palm strike was powerful enough to shatter the Celestial Realms.

characters.title: Su Dao
characters.introText: Even though he was something close to a god in the Cave, on the Immortal Astral Continent he was just slightly strong cultivator who founded his own small sect. Still, his talent was amazing even in the entire Eastern Continent.
characters.personality: His Cultivation Fragment, Seven-Colored Daoist appeared before Wang Lin as he rescued Qing Shui in the Alliance Star System's Seven-Colored Realm, where he answered Wang Lin's questions as incentive for his efforts.
characters.history:
During his youth, he was very talented and should have been protected by the sect. However, his teacher was always in closed door cultivation, and his talent attracted a lot of jealousy. His life in the sect was not good.

Moreover, due to his weak character, he was scared by Zhou Li’s cold gaze and hesitated when he took the test to succeed the sect's Cloud Dao Heavenly Art. His speed slowed down and he took 20 breaths to complete a cycle. Due to Zhou Li’s cold gaze, his mind wasn’t focused and he failed in the test. He was given the inferior Seven-Colored Celestial Art to cultivate instead. This incident warped his personality until he was finally expelled from the sect. He met his Ancestor and studied under him, eventually becoming the powerful Cultivator he would later be known as and, together with his Dao Companion, he founded the Seven Dao Sect and became its Sect Master. He also killed Zhou Li very cruelly on the day he completed his dao.

He eventually stole a Heavenly Dao and used it to construct his Cave World. In retaliation, his sect was besieged by two of the Nine Suns and he was forced to flee to his Cave World to survive. He and his Dao Companion, Fan Shanmeng, stayed back and fought to buy time for his Four Generals and 100 Soldier Celestials to enter the Cave World. His Dao Companion did not return. Fan Shanmeng herself claims that she was betrayed by him, but the memories of Seven-Colored Daoist point towards her betrayal.

Many years later, Su Dao lured Ye Mo into the Cave World, where he ambushed him with Li Guang's Bow and eventually managed to kill him. Afterwards, he enslaved his Ancient Clan underlings and started using their bodies to enforce his will upon the Cave World's inhabitants as well as allow his subordinates to heal from their wounds by gestating inside their Ancient Clan members' petrified corpses.

Many more years passed when the door to his Cave World was opened by Fan Shanmeng from the outside and three Celestial Clan cultivators led by Lian Daofei broke in and started a new war. In order to defeat Lian Daofei, Su Dao summoned the Heavenly Dao and forced it to devour him. This caused Lian Daofei to go mad as his divine sense was consumed by the Heavenly Dao to later manifest as the All-Seer, while the other half of the Heavenly Dao became the Nether Beast.

During these events, he and his sect were further damaged and Su Dao himself had his soul and origin soul mix and then break into exactly ten parts: three main souls and seven soul fragments. Only if the three main souls came together again would he manage to consume the fragments and become whole.

The Heavenly Dao then devoured his Madness Soul Fragment, while his feelings of love and hatred for Fan Shanmeng manifested as Mu Bingmei. His talent became Situ Nan, his conscience became Qin Lin, and all the slaughtered souls he'd killed in his life fused with one fragment, creating the Slaughter Fragment, which became Qing Shui. His instinct, representing a desire to plant roots and spread out many branches (reproduction) became Daoist Scattered Spirit.

Of his three main souls, his understanding of Law would reincarnate as a beast, which would then stumble upon a dying Old Ghost Zhan after failing his Arcane Tribulation and fuse with him, saving his life while also partially possessing him, while his Cultivation of Spells would reincarnate as Seven-Colored Daoist. His memory, meanwhile, chose almost deliberately to reincarnate out of their reach for countless years, becoming men, women, trees and animals, at least once even a Core Formation Cultivator.

Old Ghost Zhan and Seven-Colored Daoist would then lead the Sealed and Outer Realms respectively in an endless war to try and force their third soul out of hiding, hoping to devour him and seize the advantage over one another that they would need to become the new Su Dao.

Eventually, the Memory chose to reincarnate on Planet Suzaku and become a mortal Scholar named Su Dao. This Scholar took on Wang Lin as a disciple during his Dream Dao to reach the Third Step, and then died of old age. After that he reincarnated in the Allheaven Star System as one fish after another on the same tiny planet, as if awaiting the day that he, now reincarnated as Xie Qing, would meet Wang Lin again.

characters.title: Sun Dazhu
characters.introText: An elder of the Heng Yue Sect who took Wang Lin as disciple only to try to know about his secret bead, but he failed. He was the first person Wang Lin ever killed.

characters.title: Sun Lei
characters.introText: Sun Lei is a cultivator from the Da Lou Sword Sect, a large and influential sect based on Planet Da Lou. Within the Celestial Realm, he becomes entangled in a complex encounter with Wang Lin. Although Sun Lei’s true cultivation is only at the Middle stage of Soul Formation, he conceals his strength and behaves with caution, maintaining a guarded and strategic attitude toward Wang Lin.
characters.appearance:
Sun Lei is a cultivator from the Da Lou Sword Sect, a large and influential sect based on Planet Da Lou. Within the Celestial Realm, he becomes entangled in a complex encounter with Wang Lin. Although Sun Lei’s true cultivation is only at the Middle stage of Soul Formation, he conceals his strength and behaves with caution, maintaining a guarded and strategic attitude toward Wang Lin.

Sun Lei’s goal is to obtain a celestial sword hidden within a perilous cave. However, he is unable to claim it, as the weapon is bound by a powerful restriction that requires prolonged refinement before it can be wielded. Seeking assistance, Sun Lei proposes a cooperation with Wang Lin—offering the other two treasures found in the cave, a celestial jade and a celestial metal, in exchange for help in acquiring the sword. Wang Lin refuses, aware of the sword’s limitations and the potential danger involved.

Despite mutual suspicion, the two proceed together cautiously. Wang Lin protects Sun Lei during moments of cultivation and while fending off beast feeds, yet underlying tension persists. Sun Lei hesitates to part with a valuable purification wood and continues to distrust Wang Lin’s hidden power.

Eventually, after a fierce battle near the cave’s entrance, Wang Lin helps restore Sun Lei’s damaged cultivation. When Sun Lei later attempts to seize the celestial sword himself, the sword’s restriction backfires—gravely injuring him. In contrast, Wang Lin escapes unharmed, using a Restriction flag to flee the collapsing cave, leaving Sun Lei wounded and unable to obtain the treasure he desires.

characters.title: Sun Lingwu
characters.introText: Sun Lingwu is an elder of outer Cloud Sky Sect at the middle stage of Nascent Soul and Sun Zhenwei's father.
characters.history:
Sun Lingwu was a respected elder of the outer Cloud Sky Sect. Thanks to him, his son Sun Zhenwei was promoted to elder of one of the sect's gardens, and Lingwu also covered up all of his son's misdeeds and crimes. Thanks to Sun Lingwu's influence, the sect issued a marriage order between his son and Li Muwan, despite the latter repeatedly refusing Sun Zhenwei any relationship beyond professional.

At his son's signal, Sun Lingwu attacked Wang Lin, and since the latter was unable to quickly deal with the enemy, Wang Lin dealt a powerful blow to the protective formation of one of the sect's gardens. While Sun Lingwu repaired the garden's formation, Wang Lin escaped.

Later, Lingwu secured an order forbidding Li Muwan from leaving her residence until the wedding. Lingwu also consoled his son after the latter experienced a fit of rage and hysteria when he was unable to discern Li Muwan's plans. Furthermore, Sun Lingwu hushed up the murder of Zhou Lin, a junior elder and Li Muwan's disciple, committed by Sun Zhenwei.

During his son and Li Muwan's wedding, he forced the latter to perform the entire ceremony, but the wedding was interrupted by Wang Lin's breakthrough to the Nascent Soul stage. During this breakthrough, it quickly became clear that his former opponent had become much stronger, which is why Sun Lingwu initially hesitated to take action. However, after Wang Lin killed Sun Zhenwei in retaliation for Li Muwan's assassination attempt, Sun Lingwu furiously attacked Wang Lin, but the attack was easily repelled, and Lingwu was killed by his opponent's counterattack.

characters.title: Sun Ning
characters.introText: An elder that showed up at the treasure pavilion business of the Sun family when Wang Lin under the alias of Xu Mu was blocked at entrance of the pavilion.
characters.history:
(Donghua) - Wang Lin (disguised as Xu Mu) was prevented from entering the Sun Family's treasure pavilion by Sun Feng who thought that this foreign golden-core cultivator was new here and had no idea of the treasure pavilion's rules.

Then when Wang Lin brought out a sword he infused with spatial traversing abilities, Sun Feng thought the sword was barely worth anything and attempted to drop it before Sun Ning showed up.

He was interested in the sword that Wang Lin presented, wondering if Wang Lin took his family's ancestral treasure out to sell it but ended up buying it for 3,000 celestial jades.

As he turned to return back to his duties in the treasure pavilion, Wang Lin took out another item that caught his eye, a hand-held mirror infused with heavenly inscriptions that may help him further advance his cultivation.

The cost Wang Lin quoted was 50,000 celestial jades, which would practically empty out his pockets. But if he missed this opportunity then he might regret it forever. So he purchased that item as well.

Then Wang Lin brought out his final item, a hairpin that seemed to come from a celestial immortal (an immortal inheritance of some kind) but the price was too extravagant (100,000 celestial jades).

Despite refusing to purchase the item, he was planning to rob Wang Lin (thinking that he was just an ordinary golden-core cultivator), not knowing that this was a trap from Wang Lin.

characters.title: Sun Qiming
characters.introText: Black robed man who was elder of sun family in peak soul transformation

characters.title: Sun Ruonan
characters.introText: Sun Ruonan is the little sister of Sun Yunshan. She was involved in a complex situation related to the Cultivation Alliance and the control exerted by a figure known as the "Ancestor".
characters.appearance:
Sun Ruonan is the little sister of Sun Yunshan. She was involved in a complex situation related to the Cultivation Alliance and the control exerted by a figure known as the "Ancestor".

Initially, Sun Ruonan was bewitched by the "Ancestor" and became a member of the Cultivation Alliance. After meeting her brother Sun Yunshan, she tricked him into joining this organization. When Sun Yunshan realized something was wrong and tried to escape, the "Ancestor" appeared and captured the martial uncles that came with him. These uncles had their memories wiped and became puppets, and Sun Yunshan himself had a celestial seed planted in his body, restricting his freedom and placing his life under control.

Wang Lin later intervened in this matter. He held both Sun Yunshan and Sun Ruonan in his hands and was able to remove the green lines (the restrictions) from Sun Yunshan and saved Sun Ruonan from the "Ancestor"’s control. After this, Wang Lin released the short old man who claimed to be from the Celestial Realm and left.Sun Ruonan was among three women sitting opposite the old man in the tower within the miasma, indicating she was held captive or under observation until Wang Lin’s intervention. After her rescue, she was thrown toward Sun Yunshan, symbolizing her return to her brother and presumably freedom from control.

Sun Yunshan expressed great joy upon seeing Sun Ruonan again but also complex emotions due to the events. The removal of the restrictions was significant and was facilitated by Wang Lin, who gave Sun Yunshan a jade to delay the celestial seed's effect in emergencies.This  revealed that Sun Ruonan was manipulated and used by the "Ancestor" as part of a scheme that involved controlling Sun Yunshan and his martial uncles, but thanks to Wang Lin’s intervention, she was freed and reunited with her brother.

characters.title: Sun Tai
characters.introText: Sun Tai is the former Corpse Sect Head Elder of the Suzaku Branch who was enslaved to Wang Lin by Zhou Yi.
characters.history:
He first met Wang Lin in the Rain Celestial realm while Wang Lin was at the early Soul Formation stage, Zhou Yi helps Wang Lin in exchange for a favor and imprints a slave brand on Sun Tai forcing him to obey Wang Lin's orders.

One of his tasks as Wang Lin's slave was watching over his son Wang Ping in a mortal village and acting as his protector. While originally taking it as a mere job, he eventually warms up to Wang Ping and the life of a mortal, coming to think of him as his own grandson. When Wang Ping expresses his desire to become an immortal, Sun Tai supports him, even telling Wang Lin that with his approval, he could personally teach him and even pass down his abilities.

As time continues to pass, Sun Tai eventually passes away from old age. Before dying, he gave all of his belongings to Wang Lin with his dying wish being that Wang Lin could bring his ashes to Planet Dark Moon to be buried at the village where he was born at the foot of the sky piercing mountain.

characters.title: Sun Xi
characters.introText: He had black hair and wore purple robes with nothing embroided on them

characters.title: Sun Xiao
characters.introText: Leader Sun was a regiment leader in the demon army who opposed Wang Lin during the latter’s early command. Known for his arrogance and contempt, he openly insulted Wang Lin by calling him "trash," displaying defiance toward the new commander.
characters.appearance:
Leader Sun was a regiment leader in the demon army who opposed Wang Lin during the latter’s early command. Known for his arrogance and contempt, he openly insulted Wang Lin by calling him "trash," displaying defiance toward the new commander.

Following Wang Lin’s appointment as commander, Leader Sun’s disdain sparked a violent confrontation. Wang Lin, unhesitating and strategic, suppressed and killed Leader Sun. This action provoked anger among the demon soldiers loyal to Sun, who charged at Wang Lin. Utilizing his Celestial Sword and Half-Moon Blade, Wang Lin defeated many of them, demonstrating his authority and martial prowess.

Leader Sun’s death marked a pivotal turning point in Wang Lin’s control over the demon army. The incident not only subdued immediate opposition but also shifted the relationship between the regiment leaders and Sima Yan, the vice commander, making Wang Lin’s authority widely recognized among the demon soldiers.

characters.title: Sun Xueshan
characters.introText: He and Ran Yue were saved Wang Lin from poisonous insects. Afterwards, he, Ran Yue and a few others led Wang Lin to Planet Ran Yun.

characters.title: Sun Yun
characters.introText: Sun Yun was a prominent figure in the Purple Division of the Heavenly Fate Sect and held the position of Seventh Disciple. A genius of his generation, he rose a thousand years ago to become the top disciple in the Purple Division, replacing the previous sixth disciple as one of the All-Seer's direct disciples (there's a total of 7 spots, because there are 7 colors of the rainbow aka known as Tian Yun Qi Zi). Sun Yun resided in the Purple Cloud Pavilion, a prestigious location within the division.
characters.appearance:
Sun Yun was a prominent figure in the Purple Division of the Heavenly Fate Sect and held the position of Seventh Disciple. A genius of his generation, he rose a thousand years ago to become the top disciple in the Purple Division, replacing the previous sixth disciple as one of the All-Seer's direct disciples (there's a total of 7 spots, because there are 7 colors of the rainbow aka known as Tian Yun Qi Zi). Sun Yun resided in the Purple Cloud Pavilion, a prestigious location within the division.

About a hundred years ago, Sun Yun betrayed the Heavenly Fate Sect and fled for unknown reasons. Despite this, the sect's ancestor personally pursued him, returning alone after a month. Following this event, the Purple Cloud Pavilion was sealed, and it was declared that its next occupant would be chosen from the seven direct disciples of the All-Seer.
Sun Yun's betrayal had a profound impact on the Purple Division. Already considered the weakest among the sect’s seven divisions, it suffered from intense infighting and instability in the position of true disciple. This internal strife was cited as a primary reason for the division's decline in strength and prestige after Sun Yun's departure.

Later, Wang Lin, the new Seventh Brother of the Purple Division, came to live in the Purple Cloud Pavilion. He faced discrimination and hostility from other disciples due to Sun Yun's legacy and the pavilion's mysterious reputation. The pavilion remained heavily guarded, and few dared approach it, underscoring the lingering influence and enigma surrounding Sun Yun.Sun Yun's name continued to inspire both fear and respect. He was rumored to have slain countless people in the Demon Spirit Land and was eventually hunted by the Master and seven seniors of the sect, though he managed to escape. His reputation as a fearsome and devilish figure persisted throughout the sect's history.

Behind his death there is apparently a huge secret regarding All-Seer.
characters.history: While Wang Lin was assisting Bei Luo to absorb the Fire Demon in the Demon Spirit Land, this person, Sun Yun was mentioned again. As one of the most talented cultivators Bei Luo has ever seen and only the second person to ever receive a gift from Bei Luo (helping one attain true enlightenment of a celestial technique).

characters.title: Sun Yunshan
characters.introText: Sun Yunshan is the junior sect master of the Xuan Yuan Sect on Earth Planet, a cultivator at the mid stage of Soul Transformation. Originally a member of the Heavenly Fate Sect, he left due to its highly competitive and combative nature, seeking a peaceful place for cultivation. His search led him to the Demon Spirit Land, where he eventually settled and came to oversee the Xuan Yuan Sect. It was here that he met Wang Lin, greeting him with warmth and respect and personally arranging a tranquil and beautiful residence for him.Sun Yunshan’s personality is marked by courtesy, humility, and a quiet sense of responsibility. He lives with his younger sister, Sun Ruonan, who once disobeyed restrictions by attempting to travel to the East Demon Spirit Sea, an act that nearly cost her life. She was saved by Wang Lin, further deepening the bond between the two cultivators.
characters.appearance:
Sun Yunshan is the junior sect master of the Xuan Yuan Sect on Earth Planet, a cultivator at the mid stage of Soul Transformation. Originally a member of the Heavenly Fate Sect, he left due to its highly competitive and combative nature, seeking a peaceful place for cultivation. His search led him to the Demon Spirit Land, where he eventually settled and came to oversee the Xuan Yuan Sect. It was here that he met Wang Lin, greeting him with warmth and respect and personally arranging a tranquil and beautiful residence for him.Sun Yunshan’s personality is marked by courtesy, humility, and a quiet sense of responsibility. He lives with his younger sister, Sun Ruonan, who once disobeyed restrictions by attempting to travel to the East Demon Spirit Sea, an act that nearly cost her life. She was saved by Wang Lin, further deepening the bond between the two cultivators.

However,  Sun Yunshan’s life took a darker turn due to the influence of the Cultivation Alliance and  the Celestial Realm Ancestor. The Ancestor had bewitched Sun Yunshan, implanting a celestial seed within him that allowed full control over his body and soul. This seed not only threatened his life but also forced him into obedience, making him a tool of the Cultivation Alliance. His sister, Sun Ruonan, had also been ensnared by the Alliance tricked and manipulated into joining it while Sun Yunshan’s four martial uncles were captured, had their memories erased, and turned into puppets under the Ancestor’s control.

When Wang Lin discovered the truth, he intervened to help  Sun Yunshan and Sun Ruonan, temporarily suppressing the celestial seed’s power and freeing them from immediate control. He also rescued one of  Sun Yunshan’s martial uncles, later refining the origin soul of the short old man from the Cultivation Alliance who claimed to hail from the Celestial Realm. Grateful for this deliverance,  Sun Yunshan vowed to repay Wang Lin if he ever returned to Planet Tian Yun, offering both loyalty and assistance in future conflicts.

Despite being freed, Sun Yunshan continued to struggle internally with the celestial seed’s lingering influence, a mark that could not be easily removed. Wang Lin entrusted him with a jade talisman, which could temporarily suppress the celestial seed’s effects in times of crisis. This gift symbolized both Wang Lin’s trust and  Sun Yunshan’s continued dependence on him for survival and guidance.

During the confrontations against the Cultivation Alliance,  Sun Yunshan accompanied Wang Lin through several dangerous encounters. His deep respect and faith in Wang Lin never wavered, and he provided valuable information about the Cultivation Alliance and its leader, proving instrumental in Wang Lin’s efforts to dismantle its influence.

characters.title: Sun Zhongan
characters.introText: He came in Heavenly Fate Sect to gift All Seer present and listen to his dao lessons.

characters.title: Ta Jia
characters.introText: He looks pale with sunken eyes and gives off a frightening aura.
characters.appearance: He looks pale with sunken eyes and gives off a frightening aura.
characters.history:
Wang Lin fought against a scattered devil of Ta Jia in the Ancient Battleground close to Fire Demon Country. Bei Lou helped him trap the scattered devil.

Many years later when Wang Lin returned to the East Demon Spirit Sea and opened the fifth cave, Ta Jia made an appearance. He was hell-bent on killing Wang Lin to absorb the latter's Ancient God bloodline.

characters.title: Tang Yanfeng
characters.introText: Tang Yanfeng is a member of the Tang Family of the four Great Families of the Southern Domain of the Allheaven Star System. He, alongside Shengong Hu and Zhan Konglie, is known as Southern Domain's Three Calamities.
characters.history:
Tang Yanfeng met Wang Lin in the Thunder Celestial Realm and hated him. However, when he saw Wang Lin battle with the Blood God and other more power cultivators, he had believed that Wang Lin (Xu Mu) was an old monster in disguise.

Yang Yanfeng later found out that Want Lin was no more than a mere junior at the Corporeal Yang stage, the fear of Wang Lin disappeared and instead was replaced with spite and hatred.

When Wang Lin later showed up at the Southern Domain's Thunder Celestial tournament, Tang Yanfeng was the first to attack Wang Lin. However, Wang Lin had already become an early stage Nirvana Scryer and not at the Corporeal Yang as he thought, Tang Yanfeng was beaten miserably with one move. Afterward, a Tang elder showed hostile killing intent toward Wang Lin, Wang Lin activated the destruction energy that was left inside Tang Yanfeng's body and killed him on the spot.

Appearence ep148

characters.title: Teng Ba
characters.introText: The Teng Clan has nine core family members. Besides Teng Huayuan, very few people knew what cultivation level these people were at. It could be said that they were the people Teng Huayuan was training to take over the Teng family. In order to help those nine people’s cultivation, Teng Huayuan spent a lot of effort and resources to open up nine spirit caves. The nine of them spent most of their time cultivating inside. All of the pills, magic treasures, and techniques needed were supplied by the family. The nine people’s only job was to cultivate. Every once in a while, Teng Huayuan would take the nine of them to the dangerous areas in the neighboring countries to train. It could be said that whether it was their cultivation or combat experience, both had reached their peaks. These nine could be said to have been created from all of the resources of the Teng family. In addition to all that, it wasn’t like the nine never changed. Every 50 years, the Teng family members had a chance to challenge any of these nine people. If they win, they immediately take their spot and gain access to all of the benefits of being one of those nine and gain the full support of the Teng family.

characters.title: Teng Five
characters.introText: Teng Five was a very handsome middle aged man. It could be said he looked very much like Teng Li from back then.
characters.appearance: Teng Five was a very handsome middle aged man. It could be said he looked very much like Teng Li from back then.
characters.history: When he was only 10,000km away from the Teng Clan, he saw black clouds appear in the sky. When the black clouds descended, it killed him and took away his Nascent soul.

characters.title: Teng Huayuan
characters.introText:
He is an extremely self-centered man and has absolutely no qualms about letting his relatives bully, steal from and kill others. When this backfired upon his grandson and led to his death at Wang Lin's hands, he murdered the entire Wang Clan and sealed their souls into a soul flag to bait Wang Lin out. This act of slaughtering mortals earns him some disdain even from his fellow Cultivators. He furthermore destroyed several of those souls while waiting for the then Foundation Establishment stage Wang Lin.
200 years later when Wang Lin returns as his equal, a Nascent Soul stage expert by the standards of their country and purges his Teng Clan with similar fury, he makes a final bid to pretend his will is broken to buy time until help arrives, unfortunately for him, Wang Lin simply killed him instead.

characters.title: Teng Li
characters.introText: Teng Li is a minor antagonist in Renegade Immortal. He is the first Foundation Establishment Cultivator seen to die in the series and his Foundation was stolen by Wang Lin.
characters.personality: He is greedy, as shown by his desire to kill Wang Lin and steal his treasures, as well as self entitled, because he comes from a powerful clan and believes he can break even their own rules if he gives a convincing excuse.
characters.history: He was asked by his good friend Chen Zhong to kill Wang Lin and Zhang Hu after the former killed the latter's master, Bai Zhan, who was also Chen Zhong's junior brother under Ji Mo he waited to ambush Wang Lin at the inn he was staying at and sent his men after Zhang Hu. After a lengthy chase, Wang Lin outwitted him and stole his Foundation, resulting in him dying a horrific death. However, he promised that his grandfather would avenge this act, which resulted in Teng Huayuan wiping out the Wang Clan and then going after Wang Lin.

characters.title: Teng San
characters.introText: Teng San didn’t look young. His hair was already white and he looked to be about 40 or 50 years old. If one looked closely, they could see that Wang Zhuo’s wife looked like him
characters.appearance: Teng San didn’t look young. His hair was already white and he looked to be about 40 or 50 years old. If one looked closely, they could see that Wang Zhuo’s wife looked like him
characters.history:
One of the Teng Family's core members (numbered from Yi (one) to Jiu(Nine), he's ranked third so referred to as Teng San (three),  but his real name is Teng Hai.

When Wang Lin was approaching him, he threw his daughter, Teng Xiu Xiu and Wang Zhao into an oval ring of light to teleport them to safety so he can battle Wang Lin. If he was allowed to choose the way he would die, he would hope to die along with this sword. With battle intent, he rushed toward Wang Lin but was caught by Wang Lin’s Ji Realm and died on the spot.

characters.title: Teng Si
characters.introText: Teng Four’s cultivation was not high. He was only in the early stage of Nascent Soul. After all, he had only received the position of core family member 20 years ago.
characters.history: He felt very grief stricken because of the family members that had died. One of them was his own younger brother. He left his hidden chamber to get revenge for his little brother. Unfortunately, this was a quest for vengeance he could never complete, because the current him didn’t even notice the cloud above him become more dense.

characters.title: Teng Six
characters.introText: Although his cultivation level was only Nascent Soul, his cultivation method allowed him to transform murderous aura. Since he transformed all of the murderous aura in his body, he gained a new ability. This ability has saved his life many times. He was a very decisive person.
characters.personality: Although his cultivation level was only Nascent Soul, his cultivation method allowed him to transform murderous aura. Since he transformed all of the murderous aura in his body, he gained a new ability. This ability has saved his life many times. He was a very decisive person.
characters.history: When Wang Lin was approaching him, he used a forbidden technique and burned his soul to fly faster and get away. During the fight, Wang Lin used Xu Liguoo and the 3rd devil appeared to protect his bronze mirror. Wang Lin sent out a black gas and completely devoured Teng Six's soul.

characters.title: Teng Xingsen
characters.introText: He was the family head of the Teng Clan and reached the Nascent Soul stage in the last 500 years.
characters.history:
He was the family head of the Teng Clan and reached the Nascent Soul stage in the last 500 years.

He was also Wu Feng Valley’s minister, so his position was very high. Because the Teng Family had an ancestor like him, no one dared to mess with them, even though they weren’t a big sect.

characters.title: Teng Xiu Xiu
characters.introText: Teng Xiu Xiu was Teng Three's beloved daughter. She was in love with Wang Zhuo and wanted to follow him no mater what. However, she knew that her father did not like him very much and would always disagree with her when it came to Wang Zhuo.
characters.history: During the Teng Clan's crisis, she was thrown in a light ring with Wang Zhuo to escape from Wang Lin. She knew that her father would die but she didn't know who was behind everything. When Wang Zhuo and her were teleported a safe distance away, she clung onto Wang Zhuo and pleaded him to stay with her. However, Wang Zhuo still had hatred in his heart for the Teng Clan and couldn't make up his mind. He knew he loved her but how could he betray the ancestors of his clan? Teng Xiu Xiu was pushed away by Wang Zhuo and she begin leaving, but Wang Zhuo had a change of heart. When Wang Lin appeared, Wang Lin told them to go far away and he spared both their lives. However, Wang Zhuo decided to swiftly and painlessly end Teng Xiu Xiu's life as well as his down life so that they could die together.

characters.title: Teng Yi
characters.introText: Teng One's whole body was black and there were no muscles in his body at all. On his head were only a few patches of hair. The whole person looked very terrifying. His eyes had a ghostly light.
characters.appearance: Teng One's whole body was black and there were no muscles in his body at all. On his head were only a few patches of hair. The whole person looked very terrifying. His eyes had a ghostly light.
characters.history: When Wang Lin used his Ji Realm on Teng One, Teng One was able to block it and only lost his arm. This shocked Wang Lin greatly because this was the first time the Ji Realm wasnt able to kill someone in the same realm. With Wang Lin's immense battle experience, he was able to out whit Teng One causing him to flee. Teng One realize that he was no match for Wang Lin. In his attempt to escape, Wang Lin hit him with a giant hand and destroyed him. He left a golden drop of blood behind. This golden blood turned out to have traces of the Ancient God's bloodline.
characters.trivia: Based on what was shown in the donghua, the purpose of Teng Yi's cultivation was to transform him into an ancient god by infusing the new body of First Teng with a drop of ancient god's blood and absorbing a huge amount of qi from the spirit roots of the mortals of the Zhao country.

characters.title: Third Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor
Thirteen
characters.introText: Thirteen is the strongest member of the Soul Refining Tribe. He worships Wang Lin like a deity. He is Wang Lin's first disciple.
characters.history:
Thirteen was the first indigenous person Wang Lin saw after entering the East Demon Spirit Sea. He followed Thirteen to the Valley and there he later created the Soul Refining Tribe.

After Wang Lin spread the techniques of the Soul Refining Sect, he found that Thirteen had great talent for cultivating them as his cultivation grew the fastest amongst everyone.

Afterwards, Wang Lin ordered the members to invade the surrounding tribes to grow their numbers.

While Thirteen was returning from one such expedition, he had his cultivation wasted and his spirit veins crippled by a soldier from Ancient Demon City of the Sky Demon Country. However, he didn't give up and continued trying to cultivate which forced the demonic energy into his flesh. Wang Lin took pity on him and gave him the Body Refining Technique of the Giant Demon Clan from Planet Suzaku to cultivate.

Soon after, Wang Lin left for Ancient Demon City and took Thirteen and Huo Pao with him. He received the position of Vice-Commander and was thrown in the middle of a conflict caused by the previous Vice-Commander who was now his subordinate.

Wang Lin was then invited by Yao Xixue to enter a sealed cave. He only returned after over a year and learnt that the previous Vice-Commander had thrown Thirteen and Huo Pao inside a torture chamber. He was enraged and murdered him on the spot and then saved Thirteen but found that he had, yet again, been crippled. He was very impressed with Thirteen's loyalty towards him for he would rather get crippled than disobey Wang Lin's orders so this time he used the Nine Cultivation of a Titan technique to reform Thirteen's cultivation.

A few centuries later, Wang Lin returned and found that the Soul Refining Tribe had taken over the territory of the Fire Demon Country. Thirteen was now the strongest cultivator of the tribe. In his heart, Wang Lin acknowledged Thirteen as his disciple and even gifted him a mid-quality Celestial Spell. Wang Lin also noticed that the people of the Soul Refining Tribe had created a statue of himself that somehow became similar to a Ancient Demon fragment such that worship could allow it to absorb demonic energy and grow stronger. Since the statue was originally Wang Lin's, it believed itself to be Wang Lin's avatar which allowed him to absorb it later to form his Ancient One form.

Wang Lin ordered Thirteen to guard the statue which Thirteen did wholeheartedly. Later, Wang Lin moved Thirteen to Qing Lin's Rain Celestial Realm before leaving for Cloud Sea.

After Wang Lin led the Inner Realm to victory in the first battle of the Third Sealed-Outer Realm War, he was acknowledged as the Lord of the Sealed Realm by every Inner Realm cultivator. After returning from inside the Nether Beast, Wang Lin went to Summoned River where he met Thirteen. He gifted Thirteen a golden seed which contained his comprehension of the fire and thunder essences. The seed also contained some of Wang Lin's noble Celestial Clan bloodline. After taking his Ancient Demon avatar, he left.

He attains a high position in the Golden Furnace Sect after reincarnating as a Celestial in the Immortal Astral Continent. He meets Wang Lin again after the latter decides to return to the Cave World and follows him. Wang Lin raises his cultivation level and bestows upon him several spells, including the Extreme Fire Dao of the Celestial Ancestor's Eight Extreme Dao. He demonstrates his usage of the spell when Wang Lin orders him to kill Master Scarlet Soul's disciple, who Wang Lin showed no sympathy for despite being a descendant of the Wang Clan.
characters.trivia:
Thirteen habitually imitates Wang Lin's style of doing things

He can fight above his own cultivation realm

He was extremely loyal to Wang Lin. He always followed Wang Lin firmly and provided support without hesitation, no matter what situation Wang Lin was in. Thirteen is not good with words. He preferred to express his feelings and attitudes through actions. When faced with various complex situations, Thirteen is always able to remain calm and rational. He is not easily swayed by emotions, but would calmly analyze the problem and make wise decisions.

characters.history: Wang Lin entered the Land of the Ancient God and managed to get half of Tu Si's inheritance of knowledge.
characters.trivia: Tu Si (and by effect Wang Lin) has the "Royal" Ancient God bloodline but this is only because his lineage comes from Ye Mo (who was a complete member of the Ancient Clan before it split into the god, demon and devil clans). However, if Tu Si goes outside the cave world then his bloodline is common, at best. Moreover, the bloodline of the ancient gods (Lou Chen), ancient demons (Bei Lou) or ancient devils (Ta Jia) inside the Sealed Realm could only be considered inferior in the Immortal Astral Continent where the true Ancient Clan exists.

characters.history:
Wang Lin entered the Land of the Ancient God located inside the Chaotic Broken Stars in the Sea of Devils on Planet Suzaku.

There, he met a sealed Tuo Sen and after outwitting him, and with a bit of help from Tu Si's Moongazer Serpent, he obtained part of Tu Si's inheritance of knowledge and Tuo Sen obtained the entire inheritance of power. S1 EP33 Donghua First Appearance

Afterwards, Tuo Sen sent an avatar that was at the peak of Ascendant to kill Wang Lin while the cultivators of Suzaku were fighting for control of the Cultivation Planet Crystal. Fortunately, Mo Zhi appeared and saved Wang Lin from Tuo Sen's avatar.

Over one thousands years later, Wang Lin gave the cultivators of Allheaven and Corpse Sect information regarding the sealed Tuo Sen inside the Land of the Ancient God. There, Tuo Sen made his Ancient Qi cultivator followers kill most of the weaker invaders while he fought Master Lu Fu. He also absorbed a sealed Master Wuji into one of his Ancient God stars.

Finally, in the span of the next century, he broke his seal and escaped from the Land of the Ancient God. After escaping, he killed tens of thousands of Allheaven cultivators, seriously injured the Azure Dragon Divine Emperor, sealed the Brilliant Void Realm's Ancestor, Lu Yundao, in one of his stars, destroyed the Brilliant Void Realm, seriously injured Mu Bingmei, killed quite a few members of the Corpse Sect, and then left the Alliance after talking to Qing Lin.

After Wang Lin entered the Outer Realm, Tuo Sen immediately sensed his aura and rushed towards him. He pursued Wang Lin for a long time before the latter stopped near a Moon Devourer Clan branch and the two fought. During the climax of the battle, Tuo Sen suddenly escaped as Fourth Concubine used a spell on him to attempt to bind his will.

Later, inside Ye Mo's Ancient Tomb, Tuo Sen battled with Wang Lin in Ye Mo's throne room. Wang Lin used the energy from Ye Mo's inheritance to battle a much stronger Tuo Sen on equal grounds. After receiving Ye Mo's inheritance, Wang Lin became much stronger and managed to defeat Tuo Sen. However, Wang Lin still gave up his bit of inheritance of knowledge he got from Tu Si to Tuo Sen as he had already obtained a much stronger Ye Mo's inheritance.

However, Wang Lin informed him that obtaining the entire inheritance might backfire as it might be Tu Si's backup plan in case something went wrong while practicing the dangerous Flowing Ink Transformation Divine Technique.

After Wang Lin exited the Cave's Dong Lin Sect, he entered the Fourth Flower among the Five Flowers Eight Doors after hearing Tuo Sen's roar from within it. He then realized that the Fourth Flower was connected to Ye Mo's Ancient Tomb. Wang Lin opened the Tomb and inside he found Tuo Sen who had attained Tu Si's complete inheritance. In fact, Wang Lin believed that this "Tuo Sen" was actually 50% Tuo Sen while the other 50% was Tu Si. He helped Wang Lin seal the Sovereign's soul to summon the Yi Si Puppet. He also held off Old Ghost Zhan and Vermillion Bird General and Black Tortoise General while Wang Lin entered the Tomb to obtain Ye Mo's complete inheritance.

Afterwards, he bid farewell to Wang Lin and chose to stay back in the Cave World instead of reincarnating in the Immortal Astral Continent.

While Tuo Sen is considered to be a royal Ancient God in the cave world, he is only slightly above average at most in the Immortal Astral Continent. This is due to his bloodline being derived directly from Ye Mo, who although was a royal Ancient Clansmen in the Immortal Astral Continent, was not a very pure one. Since all the other members of the Ancient Clan in the Immortal Astral Continent are tied directly to the Ancient Ancestor, their bloodlines, especially the royals like Ye Dao and Ji Du, are much higher than

characters.title: Vermillion Bird Ancestor
characters.introText: He is the progenitor of the Vermilion Bird Divine Sect and is hailed as the Great Emperor of the Fallen Land. In the past, he was one of the Ancient Celestial Emperor's Four Generals.
characters.history:
In the past, the Third Generation Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor betrayed the Vermillion Bird Divine Sect, stole a lot of their treasures, and sealed the three Vermillion Birds into the Fallen Land such that the First Vermillion Bird cannot leave the Heaven Test, the Second Vermillion Bird cannot leave the Great Emperor Planet, and the Fourth Vermillion Bird cannot leave the Earth Test.

It is speculated by the Vermillion Bird Ancestor that he was sent by the Sovereign Council who then used the treasures he stole to help create the Fire Sparrow Clan.

characters.title: Void Cloud
characters.introText: In the past, he went to the Northern Continent and entered Grand Empyrean Wu Feng's Sect to learn his dao.
characters.history:
The Green Devil Continent's Three Great Sects, Devil Dao Sect, Poison Devil Sect, and Wu Ji Sect, sent him to revert the half Celestial Pill that created the Pill Sea back into a pill and use it to break the barrier dividing the two continents as it would also allow his reputation to skyrocket and allow him to enter the Celestial Imperial Capital in the Central Continent to obtain the qualification to enter the ancestral temple. 

He appeared before Wang Lin when the latter was working on breaking through the formation set by the Green Devil Continent to trap and kill the Heavenly Bull Continent cultivators inside the Pill Sea. Wang Lin managed to escape, however, at the cost of Yi Si losing one of his arms. Still, Void Cloud's avatar was also damaged quite severely.

However, even though Wang Lin had managed to escape, he could not calm down his heart from the loss her suffered. So, he sent off Vermillion Bird, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger to the Heavenly Bull Continent before returning to the Pill Sea. There, he infiltrated the Green Devil Continent's headquarters and killed everyone there. He also stole the compass that controlled the restriction upon the Pill Sea.

He then stalked Void Cloud while he attempted to refine the Pill Sea. As the sea had contracted down to 1,000 feet, Wang Lin suddenly attacked with the Blood Slaughter Sword. However, Void Cloud managed to counter it. But, just as he countered the strike, Wang Lin's Fire Essence True Body suddenly attacked with the sword which resulted in Void Cloud losing control of the Pill and it exploded right then and there.

In the explosion, every Green Devil Continent cultivators present died as did Void Cloud's avatar. Also, the two continents were both damaged by the explosion.

characters.title: Wang Hao
characters.introText: Wang Lin’s cousin, who bribed his way into being a helper in the Heng Yue Sect's pill division.

characters.title: Wang Ping
characters.introText: When Wang Lin launched a soul that contains the domain of seduction, Liu Mei successfully absorbed this soul and when the domain of seduction was merged, Liu Mei lost control over the domain which caused Wang Lin and Liu Mei to have physical contact.
characters.history:
When Wang Lin launched a soul that contains the domain of seduction, Liu Mei successfully absorbed this soul and when the domain of seduction was merged, Liu Mei lost control over the domain which caused Wang Lin and Liu Mei to have physical contact.

Two hundred years after the events on Suzaku, Wang Lin enters the Allheaven Star System and finds Liu Mei who was forcefully raised to Peak Late Stage Ascendant but due to not comprehending her domain, her cultivation was unstable and led to her defeat; in order to leave a mark on Wang Lin's heart she tormented her unborn child over the two hundred years turning him into a resentful spirit whom was only ever told "Wang Lin is your father, and he abandoned you" and used him in her battle with him, ultimately she was killed by being absorbed by her "teacher" for her dao and left behind a Jade Slip with details on how to remove the effects of the resentful spirit on Wang Ping. (Whom she named Li'er)

Wang Lin spends roughly 80 years raising Wang Ping as a mortal to understand what it means to live, and broaden his horizons but refuses his plea to cultivate three times; unbeknown to him the reason is that he is unable to cultivate as he is a resentful spirit in a false body. (His body was made from two strands of sword qi)

Eventually he comes to understand life, learns of his origin and is still thankful to his father thus dispelling all of his resentment, when he dies of old age Wang Lin returns him to the Heaven Defying Bead hoping to one day resurrect him, Qing Yi says she wishes to forever be in the same place with Wang Ping and gives up her life so that she can stay besides him in death. (She was a peak soul transformation cultivator as Wang Lin saw that Wang Ping liked Qing Yi so he made a deal with her which included Nascent soul cultivation if she was willing to stay with Ping'er. )

Wang Ping and Qing Yi settled down in a ordinary mountain village and they lived a quiet life. They were no longer young, and the passage of his life often flashed across Wang Ping’s eyes.

His entire life was 18 years of ordinary life, eight years of travel with his father, 25 years of battle, and ten years of being the supreme leader(Emperor of Heaven Empire). Although it was a short life, it was more exciting than anything ordinary people would experience.

However, in the end he still returned to his starting point, back to his ordinary life. When he died he was 72 years old and Wang Lin revealed that his body and soul were made from sword spirit energy and that is why he wouldn't let him cultivate  otherwise he would die from the resentment left in his body. This was also the reason he didn't conceive a child with Qing Yi. Wang Lin then made his and Qing Yi's ball of light enter the Heaven Defying Bead and hence they rested next with Li Muwan's Nascent soul. He then declared Li Muwan (or Wan'er as Wang Lin called her sweetly) as his mother and left with heavy heart thus increasing his life and death domain to Late Ascendant stage. He is later expected to be revived by Wang Lin

characters.title: Wang Tian Shan
characters.introText: Sometime in the past he and his brothers, excluding Fourth Uncle, schemed against Wang Tian Shui to successfully steal his portion of their inheritance.
characters.history:
He is seen at Wang Tian Shui's home, mocking his brother on how his son, Wang Lin, will fail the Heng You Sect's tests, while also remarking how talented his own Wang Zhou is. Sure enough, Wang Lin does fail and is met with Wang Tian Shan's public mockery and scorn alongside the entire Wang Ckan and their neighbours. When Wang Lin runs away, his brother abd Fourth Uncle force him to reluctantly ask the Heng Yue Sect to look for him.

He is unsurmoniously slaughtered alongside the entire Wang Clan by Teng Huayuan in an act of revenge against Wang Lin for killing his grandson.

characters.title: Wang Tian Shui
characters.introText: He was born as the child of a concubine and eventually his brothers, except for Fourth Uncle, conspired against him to steal his portion of the inheritance. After this, he set up a shop in town and became a carpenter.
characters.history:
When Fourth Uncle offered Wang Lin a chance to join the Heng Yue Sect, he and his wife threw a party to celebrate. This tragically set up Wang Lin's deep sense of failure when he was not accepted and caused him to leave home. After this, Wang Tian Shui and Fourth Uncle forced Wang Tian Shan to ask the sect for help finding Wang Lin. They were quite happy when he got into the sect thanks to Fourth Uncle's bribes.

With the help of Fourth Uncle, Wang Tian Shui manages to regain his inheritance. He also takes on a few apprentices including Wang Lin's childhood playmate Little Six. He is later slaughtered, alongside the entire Wang Clan, by Teng Huayuan in retaliation for Wang Lin killing his great grandson. His soul was sealed into a soul flag and used as a weapon against Wang Lin. However, Wang Lin managed to retrieve his parents souls.

Finally accepting the reality that his parents are just mortals and allows their souls to enter the cycle of reincarnation.

characters.title: Wang Zhuo
characters.introText: At the beginning of the story, he was arrogant and contemptful of Wang Lin due to his superior talent, however, he is ultimately humbled when Wang Lin proves to be far more powerful than he is after four years at the Heng Yue Sect.
characters.personality:
At the beginning of the story, he was arrogant and contemptful of Wang Lin due to his superior talent, however, he is ultimately humbled when Wang Lin proves to be far more powerful than he is after four years at the Heng Yue Sect.

He matures well into a calmer and more responsible man, but his heart is filled with hatred when the Wang Clan is exterminated, as well as self-loathing and humiliation at his failure to avenge them and his marriage into the Teng Family who's patriarch is responsible for the purge. He ultimately kills his own wife and then commits suicide to prove his loyalty when Wang Lin returns to purge the Teng Family.
characters.history:
Cousin to Wang Lin who he has a bad relationship with and acts as his rival. He was accepted into Heng Yue Sect during the first test.

Unlike Wang Lin, he was born with talent as is shown by the fact that it took him 3 months to reach 1st Layer of Qi Condensation. Because of his natural talent, the Wang Family received 2 other slots to have their youngsters join the Heng Yue Sect. These two spots eventually went to Wang Hao (son of 3rd Uncle) and Wang Lin.

After his first death, Wang Lin took his soul and made him take over the body of a not yet born baby from his Fourth Uncle's descendant.
