characters.title: Woman in Silver
characters.introText: In the past, she was a part of the Seven-Colored Sect. She was deployed to the Ancient Celestial Realm. She supposedly opened the seal on the Seven Colour Sect's Cave World and allowed cultivators from the Immortal Astral Continent which ultimately resulted in Su Dao's death and current chaos between the Outer and Sealed Realm.
characters.history:
Wang Lin first saw her when she was being used as a corpse puppet by the Cultivation Alliance during the war between the Alliance Star System and the Allheaven Star System. He stole her from the Alliance's control during the chaos of the war.

Later, he had her guard him while he cultivated to reach the late-stage of Nirvana Scryer before returning to the Demon Spirit Land.

When Wang Lin encountered the Flower Imperial Concubine Han Yan, she spoke for the first time and her advise allowed Wang Lin to placate the Flower Imperial Concubine. She even gave him the location of Qing Lin's seal.

When Wang Lin entered the Seven-Colored Realm inside the Cloud Sea Star System, he fooled Master Ashen Pine and the others and secretly followed them. He broke through the imitation Life and Death Restriction placed by Old Woman Zhao with the help of the Woman in Silver who was able to use the authentic Life and Death Restriction. He tried to soul-search her to understand her origin but was blocked from doing so by Su Dao's seal.

In the Outer Realm, Wang Lin obtained Su Dao's statue from Greed. When he showed the statue to the Woman in Silver, she had a mental breakdown and passed out in sheer terror while yelling, "I didn't open the door!"

Immediately after Wang Lin took Lian Daofei and Woman in Silver out of his storage space after entering the Immortal Astral Continent, Lian Daozhen sensed Lian Daofei's aura and teleported the latter to him. He was surprised that she was with Lian Daofei but thought that she could become his maid.

characters.title: Wu Feng
characters.introText: It has been said that he became a Grand Empyrean through the dao of martial arts.
characters.history:
He travels to the Mountain Sea Continent with Dao Yi and Jiu Di and witnessed Wang Lin's faith spell Sundered Night. Like Dao Yi, he was interested in recruiting Wang Lin, but was wary of his origin and wanted to confirm he was not the cultivator Xuan Luo had come to retrieve many years ago.

When Wang Lin passed the 10th palace of the Empyrean Exalt Trial, he personally came to recruit Wang Lin with his real body to show his sincerity.

When Wang Lin passed the 13th palace and was exposed by Lian Daozhen for using his soul armor, he backed up Wang Lin. He went against Lian Daozhen in order to gain the favor of Wang Lin, knowing that even if he failed in recruiting him he would at least be able to forge a good relationship with Wang Lin.

He later works together with Gemini, Jiu Di, and Dao Yi to stop Lian Daozhen from receiving the Celestial Ancestor's inheritance. When Wang Lin takes the Celestial Emperor's soul, he receives the Celestial Ancestor's ears from him.

characters.history: His abandoned body turned into a Zombie which possesses a Green Core and a consciousness all its own. This Zombie was discovered by Wang Lin who used it to help bring down Teng Li. Two years later, his Corpse Puppet, Amu, wakes and uses the Zombie to track him down.

characters.title: Xie Qing
characters.introText: In the past, he was a mortal scholar that helped Wang Lin by accident in his search for enlightenment. Afterwards, he was accepted by Wang Lin as an honorary disciple but he only cultivated his soul. He has completely given up spells and only cultivates domain. This is a cultivation method that didn’t exist in this world. It is similar to how the ancient gods only cultivated their bodies, but Xie Qing only cultivated his domain.
characters.history:
In the past, he was a mortal scholar that helped Wang Lin by accident in his search for enlightenment. Afterwards, he was accepted by Wang Lin as an honorary disciple but he only cultivated his soul. He has completely given up spells and only cultivates domain. This is a cultivation method that didn’t exist in this world. It is similar to how the ancient gods only cultivated their bodies, but Xie Qing only cultivated his domain.

He doesn't have the ability to fight or any cultivation level but he is enlightened in the way of the heavens such that even Nirvana Scryer cultivators are inferior to him. His domain had reached the level of Nirvana Cleanser and he even caught a glimpse of laws.

While the war between the Inner and Outer Realm raged, he regained his memories from his previous reincarnation and understood his identity. So he escaped from Planet Qing Lin to another planet in Allheaven. He hid himself and pondered over his situation for over a century.

characters.title: Xu Huichuan
characters.introText: The warden of Xu, the warden of Hong Prison, oversees a specialized section of the prison where inmates are hand-picked and destined for execution. He cultivates the Demon Slaughter Dao, a path that refines the heart through slaughter and killing intent. Xu emphasizes that immersing oneself fully in slaughter is essential to forging a powerful killing heart, the foundation of his Dao. His cultivation level is comparable to Mo Lihai’s, both reaching the peak late stage of Soul Transformation.
characters.appearance:
The warden of Xu, the warden of Hong Prison, oversees a specialized section of the prison where inmates are hand-picked and destined for execution. He cultivates the Demon Slaughter Dao, a path that refines the heart through slaughter and killing intent. Xu emphasizes that immersing oneself fully in slaughter is essential to forging a powerful killing heart, the foundation of his Dao. His cultivation level is comparable to Mo Lihai’s, both reaching the peak late stage of Soul Transformation.

Recognizing Wang Lin’s extraordinary potential and calm disposition, Xu offers to help him cultivate his own slaughter spell. However, he sets a condition: Wang Lin must assist him in killing the demon general Shi Xiao using the slaughter spell, thereby allowing Shi Xiao to die in accordance with the path of slaughter. Since Xu cannot leave Hong Prison and Shi Xiao would never enter it voluntarily, this cooperation is necessary.

Xu personally guides Wang Lin deeper into Hong Prison, especially into the underground sections where the concentration of killing intent and resentment is far stronger. He explains that the prison’s visible structure is largely a facade; the true purpose of Hong Prison’s four divisions in Sky Demon City is to generate killing intent to fuel the Demon Emperor’s sword. Xu warns that merely killing ordinary prisoners will not produce sufficient murderous intent for true advancement, implying that Wang Lin must experience real slaughter to cultivate his Dao fully.

Despite the oppressive and hostile environment, Xu has adapted over hundreds of years and demonstrates both strategic acumen and patience. As their cooperation progresses, he leads Wang Lin into increasingly dangerous, darker regions of the prison, where the killing aura is strongest.

At the conclusion of Wang Lin’s time in Hong Prison, the Emperor’s swordan immensely powerful entity sustained by the prison’s killing intent—arrives and causes widespread devastation. Xu expresses regret, acknowledging that sending Wang Lin there may have been a mistake, given the chaos it unleashed.

characters.title: Xu Liguo
characters.introText: Xu Liguo initially had a close relationship with the Corpse Sect, as it suffered a lethal wound and required the services of this sect, which was precisely to offer the corpses of other cultivators to extend life. When Wang Lin found him, he was using the body of an Foundation Establishment as storage for his nascent soul, so he was very weak and easily trapped.
characters.personality:
Shameless and silver-tongued, he is always ready to flatter Wang Lin with the hope of reaping good rewards. He is also very treacherous and vengeful, always seeking and debating an opportunity to betray and kill Wang Lin. However, these plans usually fail miserably and has him begging for his life on a constant basis.

He also believes that enjoying life is essential. Women or Men, he wants them all to serve him (well, only the prettiest ones). Being acclaimed and praised is, for Xu Liguo, as important as showing off his status of a devil under a devilishly powerful fiend.
characters.history:
Xu Liguo is a Nascent Soul cultivator from the Tian Gang Sect who was refined into a devil by Wang Lin and becomes his servant. Later, he becomes the Sword Spirit of the Rain Celestial Sword when Wang Lin receives its inheritance from Zhou Yi.

When Wang Lin sends the souls of those in the cave world to be reincarnated in the Immortal Astral Continent, Xu Liguo is one of them. Becoming human again, he reincarnates in the Celestial Clan and is seen in the Central Continent, serving Lian Daofei. After meeting with Wang Lin again he serves him once more, but is released by him at the end of the novel.

characters.title: Xu Liqing
characters.introText: He bring along a youth to enter Land of the Ancient God together with Duanmu Ji, Wang Qingyue, Gun Lan, Hunchback Meng, and Wang Lin.
characters.history: Meet again with his teacher Sky Devil Magician in third trial and got sacrificed by him to open tunnel that lead to inheritance of knowledge.

characters.title: Xu Ting
characters.introText: Xu Ting is the successor of the Xu Family of Planet Dong Lin of the Allheaven Star System. Like most members of the Xu Family, he is a vicious and bloodthirsty man who would slaughter another for so much as making eye contact with him.
characters.history:
He participated in the Thunder Celestial Temple's 108 Celestial Titles trial and took second place in the human, earth, and heaven trials after Wang Lin. He also lost to Wang Lin in the one line to heaven trial so he believes Wang Lin to be his rival as he has never lost to someone his age before. But even more so, he has a dense desire to kill Wang Lin as the latter overshadowed his glory, multiple times.

He accepted the baptism of the Celestial Bestowment pool and gave up his domain so that he could grow more powerful and gain the upper hand against Wang Lin.

characters.title: Xu Yun
characters.introText: She is quite beautiful but what makes her even more attractive is her gentle temperament and delicate features.
characters.appearance: She is quite beautiful but what makes her even more attractive is her gentle temperament and delicate features.
characters.history: In an attempt to breakthrough to the Corporeal Yang stage, she ingested a Soul Parting Death Pill which would have led to her death if not for the help of Wang Lin.

characters.title: Xuan Bao
characters.introText: Xuan Bao is an elder of the Cultivation Alliance of the Alliance Star System and the Great Elder of the Xuan Palace.
characters.appearance: He is slightly thin and wears white but this makes him seems like a celestial. His eyes are bright and seemed to be filled with endless depth. He gives off an air of a refined elderly scholar.
characters.history: Xuan Bao appeared during the war between the Alliance and Allheaven Star System after the death of Ji Xiantian. He, singlehandedly, offset the disadvantageous position of the Alliance army by severely wounding the Moongazer Serpent.

characters.title: Xuan Luo
characters.introText: Xuan Luo is one of the Nine Suns of the Immortal Astral Continent. He belongs to the Dao Country of the Ancient Clan and becomes Wang Lin's final teacher.
characters.appearance: He looked like a young man with a head of black hair and he wore a black robe.
characters.history:
In the past, he fought with Grand Empyrean Dao Yi over a storage fragment that had somehow flown out from the Immemorial God Realm.

Unbeknownst to both him and Dao Yi, the storage fragment was broken and the missing piece landed in the Ancient Celestial Sovereign's hand, who quickly took the missing piece and escaped inside his Cave World.

When Wang Lin managed to obtain both the heritage of Ancient Clan Ye Mo and the direct heritage of the Ancient Ancestor, this caught Xuan Luo's attention and he decided to personally visit Wang Lin in the Cave World.

He later fights Dao Yi again in the Immortal Astral Continent when passing through the Celestial Clan's territory to get to the cave world to find Wang Lin.

There he saw him but decided to observe him for a period of time in order to judge his attitude and actions as he could not let just any cultivator receive the legacy of the Ancient Ancestor. Wang Lin passed the tests without even knowing it and Xuan Luo invited him to be his sole disciple in the Ancient Clan.

He bestows many gifts upon Wang Lin when he arrives in the Ancient Clan, some of which greatly boosted his comprehension of his essences. He was displeased at his nephew Ye Dao's obvious jealousy of having Wang Lin as his apprentice, but tries to get the two on amiable terms.

When he presents Wang Lin to Grand Empyrean Gu Dao, the ruler of the Ancient Clan, he is exasperated when Gu Dao rejected his disciple. He becomes infuriated when Gu Dao nearly kills Wang Lin by giving him the impossible task of ascending Mount Gu Dao and prepares to fight. However, Wang Lin surpasses all expectations and stuns both Gu Dao and Xuan Luo when he triggers the Nine Songs and Three Signs that signaled the sucessor of the Ancient and Celestial Ancestors.

He later goes into closed door cultivation to produce a treasure for Wang Lin as a gift before undergoing his reincarnation.

However, when Wang Lin attempts to kill Ye Dao for scheming to control him using Li Muwan's soul which was attached to Song Zhi, he interferes. He is moved when he finds out that Wang Lin actually had a plan to revive all the Ancient Dao members he had killed in his quest to take Ye Dao's life. His emotions become even more complex when Wang Lin relinquishes his position as his disciple so that he would not get into trouble with Gu Dao and even kills himself with Three Life spell once to show his sincerity and cut his teacher-disciple bond.

His sun was seen in the assembly of Grand Empyrean Sun's when Wang Lin formed his own after reaching Half Heaven Trampling.

When Wang Lin battled Gu Dao at the border between the Ancient Clan and the Celestial Clan, he along with the other members of the Nine Suns rushed to the scene. The battle having ended well past the time they came, he and the other suns pooled their energies together to activate Grand Empyrean Jiu Di's technique which would allow them to witness the events that had transpired prior to their arrival. Much like the other's he was shocked to discover that Wang Lin had actually defeated Gu Dao and was now the strongest being in the Immortal Astral Continent.

When the Immemorial God Realm opens ahead of schedule, Xuan Luo arrives along with the Ancient Clan's army to try and get as many of their members into the realm as possible. When Wang Lin acknowledges Xuan Luo as his teacher in front of the entire Ancient Clan despite having relinquished the position long ago, he status soars, even in the eyes of the other Ancient Clan Grand Empyrean's. He later retreats back to the Ancient Clan along with the rest of the army as per Gu Dao's orders, due to the rejection force being too strong for any cultivator without Half Heaven Trampling power.

Throughout Wang Lin's life, he had said that he would not bow before the heavens or the earth. He would only respect his parents and kneel to Situ… Now there was one more person he would kneel to, and that is Xuan Luo.== Links and References ==

characters.title: Xuan Vice Commander-in-Chief
characters.introText: The Xuan Vice Commander-in-Chief is one of the six vice commander-in-chiefs serving under the Demon Emperor of the Sky Demon Country, a position that places him just beneath the eight commander-in-chiefs in the rigid demon military hierarchy. Within the Demon Spirit Land, this rank is one of immense authority, and his presence alone is enough to command fear and respect from demon generals and lesser officers. He is known for his pale complexion, calm posture, and aloof bearing, often sitting with his eyes closed in meditation even in the presence of other high-ranking figures. This habit is not arrogance alone but reflects a deep inward focus, suggesting that his cultivation and awareness constantly turn inward, even while major events unfold around him.
characters.appearance:
His cultivation stands at the peak of early-stage Ascendant, a level far above ordinary demon generals and only one step away from mid-stage Ascendant. However, he has been trapped at this threshold for a very long time, unable to take the final step forward. This prolonged stagnation shaped his temperament into one of restraint and quiet vigilance. Though outwardly calm, he is deeply aware of the difficulty of breaking through, and this awareness makes him especially sensitive to extraordinary existences that defy conventional cultivation logic.

His interest in Wang Lin begins before the demon general competition, during a previous encounter in which Wang Lin injured him despite being in a much lower realm. That clash forced the Xuan Vice Commander-in-Chief to acknowledge Wang Lin as an anomaly, someone whose true combat power far exceeded his cultivation level. From that point on, he no longer viewed Wang Lin with contempt, but with caution and attention, recognizing him as a dangerous variable within the Demon Spirit Land.

During the demon general competition in Sky Demon City, the Xuan Vice Commander-in-Chief’s attention remains firmly fixed on Wang Lin. While most vice commander-in-chiefs and demon generals dismiss Wang Lin due to his late-stage Soul Transformation cultivation, he does the opposite. He openly places a wager with the Yellow Vice Commander-in-Chief, asserting that Wang Lin will take first place. This decision shocks those around him, as it directly contradicts common expectations and highlights his confidence in his own judgment.

The defining moment comes when Wang Lin strikes the demon drum fifteen times. This feat is utterly unprecedented in the history of the Sky Demon Country. Never before has any demon general, or even vice commander-in-chief, caused the demon drum to sound so many times. Each strike carries terrifying soul force and intent, shaking Sky Demon City and causing even high-ranking demon experts to tremble. The fifteenth strike, in particular, pushes the demon drum beyond all recorded limits, stunning the commander-in-chiefs, vice commander-in-chiefs, and countless demon generals into silence.

For the Xuan Vice Commander-in-Chief, this moment is profoundly transformative. As the demon drum resonates with Wang Lin’s soul, it stirs his own long-stagnant cultivation. Insights that had eluded him for countless years surge forth, and he clearly senses that his bottleneck has loosened. Wang Lin’s fifteen strikes do not merely demonstrate power, they reveal a fundamentally different cultivation path, one that disregards established limits and conventions. This realization deeply shakes the Xuan Vice Commander-in-Chief and reignites his pursuit of breakthrough.

After the demon drum falls silent, the Xuan Vice Commander-in-Chief comes to a decisive conclusion: Wang Lin is no ordinary cultivator. He believes that Wang Lin may be the person the Demon Emperor has been waiting for across endless years, an existence capable of reshaping the Demon Spirit Land. When Wang Lin’s gaze later sweeps across the vice commander-in-chiefs, most instinctively avoid eye contact, unsettled by his presence. The Xuan Vice Commander-in-Chief does not. He meets Wang Lin’s eyes directly, and in that silent exchange there is no hostility, only acknowledgment, respect, and a trace of regret for ever having underestimated him.

From that moment on, the Xuan Vice Commander-in-Chief’s attitude toward Wang Lin fully shifts. He recognizes Wang Lin’s strength as something far beyond other demon generals and even comparable to higher authorities. His own cultivation, once stagnant, begins to move again, inspired by the shock of Wang Lin’s fifteen drum strikes. Though his personal history remains largely unknown, his actions and reactions during this event firmly establish him as one of the few high-ranking demon figures capable of recognizing true greatness when it appears.

characters.title: Yao Bingyun
characters.introText: Yao Bingyun is a member of the Yao Family of the Allheaven Star System. She was the second to arrive to execute Wang Lin under the Heaven order released by the Yao Family. She arrived soon after Wang Lin killed Yao Changdong and left.
characters.history:
When she was young, her mother, the most talented person of her generation, was devoured by the ancient lamp's spirit under Blood God's control. Afterwards, her mother gave birth to her and her younger sister named Yao Mengyun.

Later, Blood God ordered Yao Yun to bring the two sisters to his hall and declared the two were to be refined into the ancient lamp's spirit. In the end, only her younger sister was refined while she was spared. She vowed that she would save her sister one day.

She took part in the pursuit against Wang Lin in hopes of asking for Yao Mengyun's return as a reward for killing Wang Lin.

characters.title: Yao Changdong
characters.introText: Yao Changdong is a member of the Yao Family of the Allheaven Star System. He was the first one to arrive to execute Wang Lin under the Heaven order released by the Yao Family. He received intel of Wang Lin being near Planet Black Earth of the Western Domain.
characters.appearance: Yao Changdong is usually dressed in a pristine white robe.

characters.title: Yao Mengyun
characters.introText: When she was young, her mother, the most talented person of her generation, was devoured by the ancient lamp's spirit under Blood God's control. Afterwards, her mother gave birth to her elder sister named Yao Bingyun and her.
characters.history:
When she was young, her mother, the most talented person of her generation, was devoured by the ancient lamp's spirit under Blood God's control. Afterwards, her mother gave birth to her elder sister named Yao Bingyun and her.

Later, Blood God ordered Yao Yun to bring the two sisters to his hall and declared the two were to be refined into the ancient lamp's spirit. In the end, only she was refined while her elder sister was spared.

characters.title: Yao Xixue
characters.introText: Yao Xixue is a complex character with a tumultuous history involving cultivation, family ties, and powerful ancient forces. She is the daughter of the Blood Ancestor, a formidable figure around Tian Yun planet, known for his high cultivation level and mastery of unique blood spells. The Blood Ancestor kept Yao Xixue largely isolated, personally teaching her all his techniques and awakening her bloodline powers through defying the heavens.
characters.appearance: Yao Xixue is a complex character with a tumultuous history involving cultivation, family ties, and powerful ancient forces. She is the daughter of the Blood Ancestor, a formidable figure around Tian Yun planet, known for his high cultivation level and mastery of unique blood spells. The Blood Ancestor kept Yao Xixue largely isolated, personally teaching her all his techniques and awakening her bloodline powers through defying the heavens.
characters.personality:
She had red phoenix eyes, her beautiful brows contained killing intent, and she was wearing a white robe that when compared to the blood-red jade below her, it created a powerful visual contrast.

Although she was sitting in the lotus position, one could still see her slim figure. She had a head of silky, black hair, a tender and white sunflower seed face, skin as smooth as crystal, an exquisite nose, and her red phoenix eyes glowed like the blazing sun shining on the lake on the surface but contained well-hidden depth and coldness within. If one were to accidentally get caught inside her eyes, they would be out of luck…

characters.title: Yao Yun
characters.introText: Yao Yun is a second-generation member of the Yao Family. He has been possessed by a demon-ling.
characters.history:
In the past, his elder brother, Blood Ancestor's father, escaped the Allheaven Star System for the Alliance Star System. At the time he was not able to understand the reason behind his brother's actions but afterwards when his father, Blood God, devoured his elder sister and further refined his niece, Yao Mengyun, into the ancient lamp's spirit, he understood it all.

Afterwards, Blood God poured a demon-ling inside Yao Yun to control him after he tried to rebel and save his two nieces, Yao Mengyun and Yao Bingyun.

characters.title: Yao Yunhai
characters.introText: Yao Yunhai is one of the many cultivators that chased after Wang Lin after the Yao Family sent out a Heaven order against the latter. He pursued Wang Lin until they reached the Moongazer Serpent.

characters.title: Ye Dao
characters.introText: As Emperor, he has absolute control over the members of the Dao Clan which surpasses even that of his uncle Xuan Luo.
characters.history:
Before he became the emperor, Ye Dao would frequently visit the former Emperor Ye Wei and slowly gain her favor. This along with Xuan Luo being his uncle, would make his chances at becoming the next Emperor of the Dao Clan much higher.

When Wang Lin goes through the God, Devil, and Demon tribulations back in the Cave World and receives the Ancient Ancestor's soul blood he becomes extremely displeased. After hearing that his uncle Xuan Luo was going to make Wang Lin his disciple, his displeasure shifts to extreme jealousy. This was because despite being his nephew, Xuan Luo never accepted his request to make him his disciple. He then swears in his heart that if Wang Lin should ever came to the Dao Country, he would make him bow before him and use his status to suppress him regardless of whatever acknowledgement he may have received from his uncle or the Ancient Ancestor.

With the help of the Ancient Dao Imperial Teacher, he acquires Li Muwan's soul and plants it within a member of the Shi Clan known as Song Zhi. He intended to marry her and use Li Muwan as a hostage to control Wang Lin and use his power to become the emperor of the entire Ancient Clan.

When Wang Lin arrives in the Dao Country with Xuan Luo, he assesses his will by being overbearing and demanding him to kneel before him. This does not work as well as he intends and he decides that using Li Muwan as a bargaining chip was now an absolute necessity.

Formally declaring Song Zhi as his empress, he invites the entire Ancient Clan to his wedding, including Wang Lin and Xuan Luo. Wang Lin attends the wedding briefly, only as a formality and to give Ye Dao Xuan Luo's wedding gift. However, Wang Lin quickly returns when he discovers Li Muwan's soul inside Song Zhi and swears to kill him for his treachery.

Massacring all of the Dao Country's strongest forces Wang Lin corners him. He threatens Wang Lin that he has the protection of Grand Empyrean Gu Dao, but this does not faze him. Desperate, he activates a treasure given to him by Gu Dao that tethers his life to Song Zhi's. He then orders the entire Ancient Dao to turn against Wang Lin, but his orders fell on deaf ears when Wang Lin releases the aura of the Ancient Ancestor and summons his hand, which dispels the curse put on Li Muwan's soul. In his last moments of life he cries desperately for someone to help him (Ye Wei hesitates, but allows Wang Lin to kill him) and is crushed by the Ancient Ancestor's hand created by Wang Lin.

characters.title: Ye Mo
characters.introText: While he was alive, he possessed a full 27 Stars, mastering the arts of the Shi and Ji Branches of the clan as well.
characters.history:
After Wang Lin gained all eight drops of Ye Mo's Origin Soul Blood, Ye Mo attempted to possess Wang Lin's body and revive. Normally, this would've been simple since the person he would be possessing would be his successor. However, Wang Lin was different. He had obtained the recognition of the Ancient Ancestor and the Ancient Ancestor’s soul blood. As a result, he was an existence even more noble than Ye Mo, so Ye Mo couldn’t succeed.

Later, his heart tried to resist being absorbed by Wang Lin, but Wang Lin finally convinced Ye Mo to yield by promising to find his left eye.

characters.title: Ye Mo's Child
characters.introText: He has a middle aged look to him and black hair. He has three Ancient Devil and Demon stars in his eyes and two Ancient God stars on his forehead.
characters.appearance: He has a middle aged look to him and black hair. He has three Ancient Devil and Demon stars in his eyes and two Ancient God stars on his forehead.
characters.personality: Like Yun Na, who was created from the 9th and last Essence Blood drop, he believes himself to be Ye Mo's son and thus he feels entitled to Ye Mo's Inheritance, which provokes him to challenge Wang Lin to a death duel.
characters.history: He is summoned by the Outer Realm to fight Wang Lin in the hopes of at least damaging his Unnamed Wheel Formation and luring out one of his two remaining shots of Li Guang's Bow. He promptly engaged Wang Lin in a death duel. His presence was also sensed by the female Ancient God in Allheaven. He was ultimately trapped inside Wang Lin's True and False illusion and was cut in half by Wang Lin, his eyes remained clouded until the very final moment.
characters.trivia:
Each of his eight stars is actually one of Ye Mo's nine Essence Blood drops.
Ye Mo's Daughter's blood drop is shown to be able to turn into 7 Ancient God Stars and back again, explaining the Child's massive disparity in power relative to his visible Cultivation Level.

Known as the Vermilion Bird Saint Emperor (朱雀圣皇), he established Suzaku Mountain as the heart of governance and became a historical pillar for all later generations.

characters.title: Yi Fu
characters.introText: Yi Fu - disciple of Zhou Wutai, an elder of the Bai Yun Sect. Many disciples of the sect believed that the master was spoiling his subordinate too much, but no one guessed the fate awaiting Yi Fu. Wang Lin, upon encountering Yi Fu and Zhou Wutai, quickly discerned the latter's intentions and stated that the disciple would not live more than a hundred years from this encounter.

characters.title: Yu Fei
characters.introText: Yu Fei is a member of the Slaughter Realm under the Cultivation Alliance of the Alliance Star System. He is part of a duo known as the "Soul Killer Duo."
characters.appearance: He has a gloomy face and wears deep blood-red robes for clothes.
characters.personality: He has a twisted, cruel and bloodthirsty personality developed due to the tens of thousands of murders he has committed. He is also supremely arrogant as he is a member of the Slaughter Realm under the Cultivation Alliance.
characters.history: He was sent to kill Xu Mu (Wang Lin) after he left Planet Suzaku. In the beginning, he held the advantage against Wang Lin and his entourage (Big-Head, Ta Shan, Lei Ji) due to his superior cultivation and seven early-stage Nirvana Scryer avatars. However, Wang Lin fused with his original Ancient God body soon after and severely injured Yu Fei. Yu Fei even managed to escape to the Slaughter Realm but Wang Lin killed him inside the Slaughter Realm through the portal Yu Fei escaped through.

characters.title: Yu Sen
characters.introText: He is the only person among the demon generals not holding a city and spending most of his time in the Fire Demon Country.

characters.title: Yun Na
characters.introText: In the past, she was created by the Ancient Celestial Sovereign from a drop of Ye Mo's heart blood. The Celestial Sovereign also created an Ancient Devil Elder  and an Ancient Demon Elder but they both died in their sleep due to the Cave World's core being closed for so long.
characters.appearance: She has black hair and attractive features.
characters.history:
She ordered Dong Lingtai, the Xiang Family's ancestor, to spare Wang Lin after she sensed that he was an Ancient God.

After Wang Lin returned from the Outer Realm, he went to Planet Dong Ling to get revenge on Dong Lingtai for almost killing him and causing irreparable damage to Li Muwan's soul.

After he killed Dong Lingtai, a member of the Dong Ling Sect suddenly appeared through a portal and attempted to pass a death sentence upon him but was almost killed by a single punch from Wang Lin. He was spared by Wang Lin as he sensed the aura of the 7-star Ancient God from inside the portal.

She sensed the aura of Ye Mo's Child when he appeared to fight Wang Lin while the latter guarded the Inner Realm with his Unnamed Wheel Formation.

Afterwards, she gave Wang Lin her drop of Ye Mo's heart blood as he was the first to enter the Dong Ling Sect inside the second flower. Initially, she stated that it was due to her orders being so but she admitted that she wished to leave the Cave World and go to the Immortal Astral Continent and, thus, wanted Wang Lin to be strong enough to open the door.
characters.trivia: Xuan Luo notes that female Ancient Gods are extremely rare existences within his Dao Clan and considers making her Wang Lin's maid. This is regardless of her roots as well as her giving up her Ancient God powers to Wang Lin almost completely.

characters.title: Yun Quezi
characters.introText: Yun Quezi is a member of the Forsaken Immortal Clan; he is the current head of its branch on Planet Suzaku.
characters.appearance: This person was wearing a red robe, his face was old, he gave off an ancient aura, and a powerful pressure could be felt from him.
characters.history:
He chose Wang Lin as one of the four candidates for inheriting the title of next Suzaku. He gave him a straw hat that conceals the wearer's presence. This hat allowed Wang Lin experience the domains of Soul Formation cultivators which helped him breakthrough to Soul Formation.

After Wang Lin returned to Planet Suzaku during the war between the Allheaven Star System and the Alliance Star System, Yun Quezi followed him to the Immortal Graveyard. There, they reached the 17th floor when Huang Long stopped them from proceeding further.

When Wang Lin returned to Suzaku after being known as the Lord of the Sealed Realm, Zhou Wutai stated that Yun Quezi had passed away as his lifespan had reached its end.
characters.trivia:
He was appointed as the next Suzaku by Qian Pinghai, the 13th Suzaku. The title was stolen by Zhuque Zi. After he lost some kind of wager and he was sentences to a thousand years of exile.

There is some discussion as to his real cultivation level. Either he has a 10-Leaf cultivation or he is Middle stage Ascendant. He most likely has a normal Qi cultivation because he used to be the disciple of the Suzaku and it would've been hard to hide it from of him. He also is one of the only 2 members of the Forsaken Immortal Clan that have a domain with Mei Ji.

characters.title: Yun Yifeng
characters.introText: Yun Yifeng was very famous in the Gui Yi Sect back on the Immortal Astral Continent. He was ranked third among the core disciples.

characters.title: Yundao Zi
characters.introText: Yundao Zi is the oldest disciple of the Yellow Division within the Heavenly Fate Sect, a long-standing cultivator who has followed the All-Seer for more than 2,000 years. Once a prominent figure among the sect’s disciples, he held the true disciple title for 800 years before it was taken by his Third Brother. Despite his strength and seniority, Yundao Zi is distinguished by his lack of competitive spirit and carefree nature, preferring peace and detachment over rivalry and ambition.
characters.appearance:
Yundao Zi is the oldest disciple of the Yellow Division within the Heavenly Fate Sect, a long-standing cultivator who has followed the All-Seer for more than 2,000 years. Once a prominent figure among the sect’s disciples, he held the true disciple title for 800 years before it was taken by his Third Brother. Despite his strength and seniority, Yundao Zi is distinguished by his lack of competitive spirit and carefree nature, preferring peace and detachment over rivalry and ambition.

Physically, Yundao Zi is described as looking unusually thin, almost like a skinny monkey, giving him an eccentric and distinctive appearance. Though his outward form may appear frail, his cultivation and experience command respect among his peers.

During the selection of the Yellow Division’s true disciple, Yundao Zi voluntarily stepped forward and relinquished his claim to the position. He humbly acknowledged that the disciple most suited to bear the title was their Second Brother, Kunpeng Zi, who had received a  celestial treasure from the All-Seer. This act reflected Yundao Zi’s    humility and fairness, showing his willingness to yield to those he deemed more deserving rather than clinging to prestige.

When the All-Seer announced Kunpeng Zi as the new true disciple and revealed the yellow crystal a sacred symbol of the  Heavenly Fate Seven Disciples  Yundao Zi lowered his head respectfully and remained silent. However, at that moment, his eyes briefly revealed a trace of fear  before returning to calmness, a subtle reaction noticed by Wang Lin, indicating the deep reverence and awe he felt toward his Master’s authority.

Though he once held great status within the sect, Yundao Zi’s true character lies in his tranquil acceptance, humility, and non-attachment to power. He embodies the image of an elder cultivator who, after centuries of experience, values inner peace over worldly recognition.

characters.title: Zhan Konglie
characters.introText: Zhan Konglie is a member of the Zhan Family of the four Great Families of the Southern Domain of the Allheaven Star System. He, alongside Shengong Hu and Tang Yanfeng, is known as Southern Domain's Three Calamities.
characters.history:
He met Wang Lin inside the thunder pond in the Southern Domain of the Allheaven Star System. He mistook Wang Lin for a Third Step Cultivator after the latter guided Shengong Hu on the path to reaching the origin of Thunder.

He always regretted that he didn't take the opportunity to acknowledged Wang Lin as his Lord like Shengong Hu.

He was saved by Wang Lin from the mad Qing Shui inside the Thunder Celestial Realm.

He met Wang Lin during the qualifiers for the Celestial Bestowment Tournament. By this point, he had learnt that Wang Lin was not a Third Step Cultivator. He challenged Wang Lin to a duel but easily lost. Although he was no longer fanatic about Wang Lin, he still respected him greatly. He vouched for Wang Lin during the tournament.

He managed to gain slight enlightenment of the first Battle Scroll in eight seconds but was not able to absorb the sliver of source origin energy from it.

characters.title: Zhan Lie Yunzi
characters.introText: Zhan Li Yunzi is the ancestor and current ruler of the Zhan Family. Despite having an average cultivation amongst the top-brass of the Allheaven Star System, he has a very distinguished status there, even overshadowing Blood God who is much stronger than him. This is because he possesses the Zhan Family's treasures.
characters.personality: He is very moody and temperamental.
characters.history:
He fought against the Moongazer Serpent, alongside Master Flamespark, Ancestor Shengong, Xiang Yundong, Five-Color Daoist, Blood God, and the old man from Gongsun Family. In the end, they managed to seal the Moongazer Serpent with the help of Master Lu Fu.

He was the commander during the Northern Battle between the Alliance Star System and Allheaven Star System due to his control over the 18 Lou Fu.

After learning his ancestor Zhan Xingye's fate from Wang Lin, he buried the grudge between them and became extremely eager to fight with the Outer Realm, awakening his bloodline's Battle Will in the process.

characters.title: Zhan Xingye
characters.introText: He found himself trapped in a Seven-Colored Realm by the Sovereign, who was afraid of his ancestor Old Ghost Zhan and wanted to assess whether or not he was dead.
characters.history:
Wang Lin find his corpse inside a Seven Coloured Realm and inherited his Battle Will which later went to become one of his essences.

Wang Lin informs his descendant Zhan Li Yunzi of his fate, allowing him to bury his grudge with him and Master Lu Fu.
characters.quotes:
"Cultivators like us never shrink from a fight!" - about his Battle Will.
Inherited and rephrased by Wang Lin.

characters.title: Zhan Yun
characters.introText: She was one of the many saved by Wang Lin from collapsing Thunder Celestial Realm.

characters.title: Zhang Bai
characters.introText: He genius was from Puli’s Insect Demon Sect, and he was a late stage Nascent Soul cultivator. Then for some reason, he stole the sacred text of the Insect Demon Sect and betrayed his sect.Eventually, under the pursuit of a Soul Formation cultivator, Zhang Bai escaped into the Nine Ghost Desolate Valley. After escaping from the Soul Formation cultivator, he lived there for 100 years. No one knew how he had lived through those 100 years, but by the time he came out, he had reached the Soul Formation stage. What was even scarier was that he had tamed countless poisonous insects. He killed his way to the Insect Demon Clan. Surrounded by his mass of insects, even Soul Formation cultivators died to him. He was able to obtain a Rain Cauldron and become one of the people to enter the Celestial Realm.

characters.title: Zhang Hu
characters.introText: Zhang Hu was Wang Lin's roommate during his stay in Heng Yue Sect.
characters.personality: Zhang Hu is a reasonably friendly but equally ruthless young man. He showed Wang Lin the ropes around the sect, but decisively killed Liu when the 'Weasel' tried to dispose of him. He also has no problem killing witnesses to protect himself if need be.
characters.history:
Zhang Hu and Wang Lin bond over the latter's baked potatos and Zhang Hu tells Wang Lin all about the sect on his first few days. One day Wang Lin stumbles upon him and Liu having an argument that escalates to Liu wanting to silence Zhang Hu, even threatening his family. Wang Lin steps in and saves Zhang Hu's life, but Zhang Hu decides to flee the Heng Yue Sect before the deed is discovered.

After he left, he consumed some herbs and broke through to Qi Condensation's 1st Layer. He was then discovered by Bai Zhan, who made him his disciple to help him collect Blood Essence. On one particular day, however, he leads the Vulture Escort to attack the Mighty Escort Service and by chance runs into Wang Lin again. Wang Lin then kills Bai Zhan, thus setting Zhang Hu free of the poison he used to control him. Fearing that Ji Mo, Bai Zhan's master, will come after them, the two seek asylum in the Teng Family City. Soon after, the duo are attacked separately and Wang Lin is forced to flee the city, thus leaving Zhang Hu's fate unknown but likely bleak.

characters.title: Zhao Xingsha
characters.introText: Amongst All Seer's first generation disciples, he has been in the sect for the longest.
characters.appearance: He is a gentle looking man.
characters.history:
Many centuries later, when he received the title of the True-Disciple of Purple Division, Wang Lin suddenly came to Planet Tian Yun and was defeated by him. Subsequently, Wang Lin was defeated by Sun Tao who became the True-Disciple of Purple Division, once again. Still, he had deep hatred for Wang Lin.

Many centuries later, when Wang Lin returned to the Heavenly Fate Sect. he could finally get his revenge against Wang Lin and he was not shocked when he learnt that Wang Lin had reached Nirvana Scryer so when he saw him hold his own against Ling Tianhou. He instantly won fighting against Wang Lin and showed off his great cultivation.

characters.title: Zhao Xinmeng
characters.introText: She was extremely charming and despite having a voluptuous figure she looked graceful.
characters.appearance: She was extremely charming and despite having a voluptuous figure she looked graceful.
characters.history:
She sealed Wang Lin for a few days to pay off Zhao Xingsha's favor. To resolve the enmity between them, she taught Wang Lin Great Teleportation and the incomplete Nine Cycle Celestial Refining Tactic.

She battled Wang Lin for the title of the True-Disciple of Purple Division but she only did so as a sport as she wasn't really all that interested in the position.

Hundreds of years later, when Wang Lin returned to the Heavenly Fate Sect, she told him the secret about All-Seer that he devours all his disciples that reach Illusory Yin. Her real cultivation is at the Illusory Yin stage but she has kept it sealed for centuries in an effort to prolong her life. She is also in contact with Sun Hong and Lu Hai from the Red Division who also have their cultivations sealed.

She asked for Wang Lin's help in reinforcing her seal which has begun to loosen, in return she's willing to offer her maiden body to Wang Lin for the price as she was desperate and afraid of being devoured by All-seer. ultimately, Wang Lin refused her offer and from then on, she was never shown again.

Note: Whether if she has been devoured by All-seer or not remains unknown. But likely

characters.title: Zhao Yixuan
characters.introText: She had her hair in a bun and two strands fell down near her ears, like a willow. There was some crystal glitter between her eyebrows, and her half-moon-shaped eyebrows accented her pearl-like eyes. Her pretty, sunflower seed face was as smooth as jade. Although her beauty wasn’t peerless, it was enough to eclipse the moon. She looked like she was in her twenties, but the hint of intelligence in her eyes revealed a maturity far above the age of her appearance.She was wearing a white dress, and although it wasn’t a tight fit, it still revealed her curves and was very alluring.

characters.title: Zhao Zi
characters.introText: Fifth generation disciple of green division in Heavenly Fate Sect.

characters.title: Zheng Hao
characters.introText: He was killed by fellow Da Lou Sword Sect disciple Sun Lei in Rain Celestial Realm.

characters.title: Zhou Jin
characters.introText: Soon after Wang Lin left the Fallen Land and grievously wounded the Sovereign's avatar at the Fire Sparrow Clan, he tracked the former down with the help of Feng Zhiman. The two stayed on Wang Lin's track as he ran towards the Ancient Order Tomb. On the way, Wang Lin killed all the members of a branch of the Esteemed Heavenly Wolf Clan which incited Zhou Jin's hatred. Wang Lin used that to assault the latter with his Ethereal Flame. He also used that opportunity to kill Feng Zhiman once and exhausted one of her three lives.
characters.history:
Soon after Wang Lin left the Fallen Land and grievously wounded the Sovereign's avatar at the Fire Sparrow Clan, he tracked the former down with the help of Feng Zhiman. The two stayed on Wang Lin's track as he ran towards the Ancient Order Tomb. On the way, Wang Lin killed all the members of a branch of the Esteemed Heavenly Wolf Clan which incited Zhou Jin's hatred. Wang Lin used that to assault the latter with his Ethereal Flame. He also used that opportunity to kill Feng Zhiman once and exhausted one of her three lives.

Subsequently, the duo accidentally entered the fog surrounding the Ancient Order Tomb which resulted in Feng Zhiman dying once again and being left with her last life. The two got separated after entering the Tomb. At some point, Zhou Jin found two Ancient Leaves and fought Ling Dong for one of them.

Later, he arrived at the fifth area of the Tomb and attempted to ambush Wang Lin only to fall in his trap and have to face off against a now-Third Step ancient slave, Ling Dong.

Although he became Wang Lin's slave, he was not completely refined like Ling Dong as Wang Lin didn't have the time to do so.

Afterwards, Wang Lin returned to the Sealed Realm and used Zhou Jin to do his bidding. He even forced him to fight against the Outer Realm during the war. Unfortunately, Wang Lin was injured by Li Guang's Bow during the end of the battle and had to escape with the Nether Beast which resulted in Zhou Jin escaping Wang Lin's control.

Over a century later, he came to the Inner Realm together with his Heavenly Wolf Clansmen. He killed a lot of cultivators to wash away the shame he had as a slave of Wang Lin. He was fighting along with Ice Boy to destroy the remaining cultivators of the Alliance Star System when Wang Lin appeared and summoned the Great Void Gate.

characters.title: Zhou Li
characters.introText: On the surface, he was gentle, but in truth, he felt contempt toward Su Dao. He ignored all the people bullying him and maybe even promoted it, indirectly.
characters.personality: On the surface, he was gentle, but in truth, he felt contempt toward Su Dao. He ignored all the people bullying him and maybe even promoted it, indirectly.
characters.history:
When Su Dao was a disciple of the Dong Lin Sect, he was very timid and weak-willed. This resulted in a lot of people bullying him. This was even more so due the fact that he was very talented which attracted the jealousy of many.

Zhou Li knew that Su Dao was weak-willed so he frightened him with a mean glare before the latter took the test for determining the inheritor to the sect's Cloud Dao Heavenly Art. Due to Zhou Li’s cold gaze, Su Dao's mind wasn’t focused, his speed slowed down and he failed in the test. Thus, he was given the inferior Seven-Colored Celestial Art to cultivate while Zhou Li obtained the Cloud Dao Heavenly Art.

Five months later, Zhou Li placed 9th in the Inter-Sect Competition and became a dao pair with Qin Mei, whom Su Dao had a crush on.

After Su Dao completed his dao, he captured Zhou Li and cruelly murdered him.

characters.title: Zhou Lin
characters.introText: Ninth generation disciple Zhou Lin of Cloud Sky Sect. He was a disciple of Li Muwan and the master of Wang Lin when he joined the Cloud Sky Sect using his newly formed avatar.

characters.title: Zhou Peng
characters.introText: Middle Aged Xuan Dao sect disciple; 4th fight vs Zhang Kuang, “Assassin” No1 expert in Zhao guo region.

characters.title: Zhou Ru
characters.introText: To revive Li MuWan, Wang Lin put her nearly shattered Nascent Soul into a new born baby. He thought that this baby had no soul yet and so Li Muwan could grow up through this body and dodge Divine Tribulation. This way Wang Lin and her could be together again.
characters.history:
To revive Li MuWan, Wang Lin put her nearly shattered Nascent Soul into a new born baby. He thought that this baby had no soul yet and so Li Muwan could grow up through this body and dodge Divine Tribulation. This way Wang Lin and her could be together again.

The new baby was named Zhou Ru and shortly after her birth within a couple years she was taken away from her mortal parents by Wang Lin to raise her. He soon discovered though that Zhou Ru had a soul besides Li Muwan. The only way for Li Muwan to revive fully now was to devour Zhou Ru's soul. Wang Lin hardened his heart to let this happen, but he struggled as he raised Zhou Ru like his own child. This was further reinforced when Li Muwan resisted the process of devouring Zhou Ru's soul. She willingly sacrificed herself and weakened again so Zhou Ru had a chance to live.

Wang Lin placed Li Muwan's soul into the heaven defying bead and took Zhou Ru back to her parents after taking her with during the Suzaku Arc. Wang Lin then decided to give a bag of holding to the Soul Formation cultivator of Chu stating that if Zhou Ru would reach Nascent Soul the bag of holding should be given to her. This is most likely a method to reach Wang Lin to become his disciple.

Later on she reaches the Soul Transformation stage with the help of Tie Yan and leaves planet Suzaku to find Wang Lin. Shortly after leaving, she encounters danger where she is saved by Mu Bingmei and is taken as her disciple. Later on, Wang Lin enters the Brilliant Void Sect and takes Zhou Ru back to the Rain Celestial Realm to be protected before Tuo Sen's destruction of the Brilliant Void Sect.

When leaving the cave world she chooses to reincarnate and Wang Lin finds her many years later but since she was living a happy mortal life he chose not to awaken her memories and gave the black dog with her (which was the reincarnated white tiger) the ability to awaken her memories if she ever decided to move on.

“After 19 years of time…. Wang Er, thank you for allowing me to understand… I should let things that are lost in the world stay lost and those that still exist to remain existing.”

“This rain was born in the sky but doesn’t die when it hits the earth. On the earth it will gain new life; it will help plants grow and then it will turn into clouds once more. This change is life!”

“I can’t let go of my parents’ soul and your departure. In truth, I wasn’t filial to my parents, and to you I have always been neglectful. Although this emotion is real, it was more of a sense of duty… because I was moved…”

Wang Lin’s parents’ souls flew out from his brow. They gently gazed at him as they slowly disappeared. They didn’t die but entered a different realm of life.

characters.title: Zhou Rui
characters.introText: She was one of the few friends Wang Lin had inside the Heng Yue Sect.
characters.appearance: She is a pretty and lively looking girl. While not as eye-catchingly gorgeous as Liu Mei, she still attracted quite a lot of attention from men
characters.history:
She had a decent talent for cultivation and was among the best of her generation. She was friendly towards Wang Lin despite him being an outcast.

Wang Lin has a dream involving her and Xu Fei after he consumes three Dao Fruits to complete his Life and Death, Karma and True and False Essences. He encounters her in the rain and is welcomed onto her boat. Sensing some familiarity, Zhou Rui uses a spell to let him rest.
characters.trivia: Her full name, Zhou Rui, is revealed in a dream sequence in Book Ten, a full eight books since her last physical appearance in the story.

characters.title: Zhou Wan
characters.introText: Second ranked disciple of purple branch of Heavenly Fate Sect

characters.title: Zhou Wutai
characters.introText: Wang Lin first meet him while he was trying to comprehend life and death domain as a mortal. He was one of the 4 chosen of Yunque Zi to becomes the next suzaku. He has the inheritance of a green dragon. Zhou Wutai finnaly becames the 15th Suzaku after Zhuque Zi. It was Wang Lin who decided to passed it to him.
characters.history: Wang Lin first meet him while he was trying to comprehend life and death domain as a mortal. He was one of the 4 chosen of Yunque Zi to becomes the next suzaku. He has the inheritance of a green dragon. Zhou Wutai finnaly becames the 15th Suzaku after Zhuque Zi. It was Wang Lin who decided to passed it to him.

characters.title: Zhou Yi
characters.introText: In the past, he entered the Rain Celestial Realm and there he fell in love with the corpse of a deceased celestial. In fact, what he fell in love with was the ghost spirit born off a small part of the celestial, not the celestial herself. For her, he betrayed his sect and raided their treasury for anything that would revive the ghost back into a person.
characters.appearance:
Wang Lin finally returned to the Brilliant Void when Allheaven waged war against them. He soon returned to the Demon Spirit Land and entered it along with All-Seer, Ling Tianhou and Brilliant Void's many other hidden experts, including a few elders from the Cultivation Alliance.

There, he reunited with Zhou Yi and met Wang Wei and Hu Juan from whom he learned of the Demon Spirit Land's true origin that confirmed his speculations. The four then began working together to try and revive Qing Lin from his half-dead state. They managed to revive Qing Lin after a hard fought battle against Ta Jia and All-Seer. To Zhou Yi's joy, Qing Lin also quickly revived Qing Shuang. However, he quickly realized that current "Qing Shuang" and "Ting'er" he knew were two very different people. Still, he continued following her, waiting for the day she would accept him or at least acknowledge his existence.
characters.history:
Wang Lin encountered him when he entered the Rain Celestial Realm. There, he helped Wang Lin by trapping the Corpse Sect's Suzaku Branch Elder into becoming his servant. Soon after, Ling Tianhou appeared and stole two of the four Celestial Sword that Zhou Yi received from Ting'er. Enraged, he rushed after Ling Tianhou despite knowing that it may be a trap. As a precautionary measure, he gave Wang Lin the pagoda where he kept Qing Shuang's corpse and an Ascendant crystal that he formed when he reached Ascendant Stage. This Ascendant crystal was extremely precious as it would increase the consumer's chance of reaching the Ascendant Stage by 30%.

As Zhou Yi predicted, Ling Tianhou's plan was to trap him as he was the sword spirit and with him present the Rain Celestial Sword he stole could function at full power. Ling Tianhou then trapped Zhou Yi inside the Demon Spirit Land's Tide Abyss.

A few decades later, Wang Lin entered the Demon Spirit Land's Tide Abyss as he had received Zhou Yi's distress signal. After much struggle, he managed to free him when the two observed Greed and Ling Tianhou's remaining disciples trapped between a swarm of Mosquito Beasts. Together, they ambushed Greed and the 12 Swords Disciples. During the confusion, Wang Lin killed all of the 12 Swords Disciples except Chen Long. He even captured the Ancient Thunder Dragon Greed unleashed upon him before disappearing in the depths of the cave.

Zhou Yi was distressed by Wang Lin's disappearance but, after months of waiting, he reluctantly decided to leave the Tide Abyss. Outside, he met Wang Wei and Hu Juan who somehow knew of his connection to Qing Shuang. With nothing else to do, he decided to follow them.

Wang Lin finally returned to the Brilliant Void when Allheaven waged war against them. He soon returned to the Demon Spirit Land and entered it along with All-Seer, Ling Tianhou and Brilliant Void's many other hidden experts, including a few elders from the Cultivation Alliance.

There, he reunited with Zhou Yi and met Wang Wei and Hu Juan from whom he learned of the Demon Spirit Land's true origin that confirmed his speculations. The four then began working together to try and revive Qing Lin from his half-dead state. They managed to revive Qing Lin after a hard fought battle against Ta Jia and All-Seer. To Zhou Yi's joy, Qing Lin also quickly revived Qing Shuang. However, he quickly realized that current "Qing Shuang" and "Ting'er" he knew were two very different people. Still, he continued following her, waiting for the day she would accept him or at least acknowledge his existence.

Alas, that day never came. Even after almost a thousand years, she never once looked at him. So, Wang Lin intervened.

When Qing Shuang was reincarnating into the Immortal Astral Continent, he wiped out all her memories from her time in the Cave. He also made it so her soul was linked to Zhou Yi's soul. And so, Wang Lin found them in the Meng Earth Continent's Earth Sect as Qing and  Zhou Yiting. He gave Zhou Yi some advice and a pill that would allow him recover all his memories from his time in the Cave but it was up to him whether he wished to use that pill or not.

"On the spring of one year, I walked under a tree and looked at a leaf. I liked it very much. When autumn came, I came to the tree again, but I could not find that green leaf. I thought I couldn’t find it...

But I didn’t know that it was still there, it’s just that its color had changed… When I turned to leave, the autumn wind blew by and the yellow leaf flew off. It circled me and accompanied me along the way, but in my melancholy from missing the green leaf, I never noticed that the leaf I was looking for was by my side the entire time..."

characters.title: Zhou Zihong
characters.introText: When she met Wang Lin for the first time, she was a Foundation Establishment student of War God Temple in Huofen Kingdom and the child of Feng Luan. She's attracted to Ma Liang, treating her like a brother or perhaps potential love interest.  She was greatly disappointed knowing that Ma Liang died before surrendering her soul blood to Wang Lin. Her mother realized something was wrong with her. That's why she chased Wang Lin to take back her soul blood. Later, after the war to take root in the neighboring country because of the Fire Beast Calamity, she asked Wang Lin to kill Ma Liang's junior sister (childhood friend) and her lover (Zhou An) who had ill-intention towards Ma Liang in exchange of the map Wang Lin needs.
characters.appearance:

She appears again in the storyline where the inner realm (sealed realm) was in a great war against outer realm. She's currently with the fellow daoist of Summoned River Star System, where most of the cultivators are fellow ladies/women. They're talking about the legend of the Lord of Sealed Realm. Zhou Zihong commented on the possibility that she met The Lord of the Sealed Realm previously as Ma Liang (who got taken over) and Wang Lin happened to be there listening to that conversation.

characters.title: Zhu Quezi

infobox.Title: Zhu Quezi
infobox.enemie(s): Wang Lin Yun Quezi Dun Tian

characters.introText: Zhu Quezi was the previous owner and 14th of title of Suzaku. He was succeeded by Zhou Wutai who was selected by Wang Lin when he himself refused the title.
characters.trivia: His name "Zhu Quezi" means Vermillion Bird which means Suzaku which indicates that his "name" isn't actually a name but a title. But that begs the question about what is the story behind the name "Yun Quezi" (Zhu Quezi's younger brother) which means Cloud/Cloudy Bird.

characters.title: Zi Shu
characters.introText: HE was wearing blue robes and had big sword on his back.

characters.title: Zi Xin
characters.introText: She wore a light purple, cotton dress. Her eyes shined like the stars and there was faint, plum-colored lipstick applied to her elegant lips. There were several shining butterfly discs on the right side of her forehead.
characters.appearance: She wore a light purple, cotton dress. Her eyes shined like the stars and there was faint, plum-colored lipstick applied to her elegant lips. There were several shining butterfly discs on the right side of her forehead.
characters.history:
She tricked Wang Lin into entering the Immortal Graveyard and attempted to trap him inside. Immediately, Wang Lin turned the tables on her and threw her into the void.

She was captured by Qian Feng and used as his cultivation furnace. Later, she managed to absorb Qian Feng's cultivation at his death and escaped Suzaku.

She somehow ending up on Planet Five Elements. Soon after, she was chased out by the Heavenly Water Palace and reached the Blood Planet of Blood Ancestor while on the run. Subsequently, she was taken in as his concubine.

Afterwards, she went to investigate a dying planet under the Blood Ancestor's dominion. This planet was being occupied by Wang Lin's original body. She was scared off by him.

Later, Blood Ancestor harmed Wang Lin's avatar to the extent of sending it into a coma. Enraged, Wang Lin's original body attacked Blood Planet to get revenge. Zi Xin died when she tried to step in the passage inside the Blood Pavilion before Blood Planet destruction by having her body decaying and origin soul collapsing.

cultivation.title: Arcane Void
cultivation.introText: One spell Arcane Void cultivators can use is World of Law, Everything Freeze.
cultivation.trivia:
According to the White Tiger General, the inhabitants of the Cave World should have been bound by The Ancient Celestial Emperor's nine laws. One such law forbade the Cultivation of Ethereal Essences, meaning Cave World Cultivators could not reach this level when the laws were in place.

The non-Joss Flame method of reaching and mastering this step makes it essentially similar to the Dao Realm Paragons of Er Gen's later novel I Shall Seal the Heavens, in that it takes a full nine Essences to complete that realm.

cultivation.title: Ascendant
cultivation.introText: Ascension, or the Ascendant Stage, is the peak of the First Step. It finalizes the process of a mortal refining their soul and body to become an immortal.

cultivation.title: Ascendant Empyrean
cultivation.introText: Every single Ascendant Empyrean is personally appointed by the Celestial Ancestor and has their name added to the Ascendant Empyrean List. This list only appears when someone successfully passes the 10th palace. Everyone on the list receives the Celestial Ancestor’s protection.

cultivation.title: Celestial Body
cultivation.introText: Gained automatically when you attain Soul Transformation stage. It increases your talent and make you able to use and manipulate celestial spiritual energy more easily.

cultivation.title: Celestial Emperor (Cultivation Rank)
cultivation.introText: A Celestial Emperor is the Celestial Domain's equivalent to the Third Step and thus constitutes almost, if not all, of the Sealed Realm's Third Step Cultivators.
cultivation.trivia: The Ancient Celestial Emperor bears this title as does the Lord of the Sealed Realm, however as the both predate the Celestial Domain, and indeed the latter even created it, they are not Celestial Emperors within the context of the Celestial Domain's Cultivation branch.

cultivation.title: Core Formation
cultivation.introText: There are multiple ways to form one's core seen in the story:
cultivation.history:
Green Cores are a type of fake core found in Rank 4 countries and created using Demonic Techniques. The major difference between them and normal cores is that while a proper Core Formation Cultivator can only have a single core, one can possess tens of thousands of False Cores. These Cores are extremely dangerous when used to self destruct.

The Corpse Sect, or at least their branch in the Country of Zhao, the Corpse Yin Sect, is notable for practicing this.
cultivation.trivia:
In the universe of "Renegade Immortal", the color of the golden core of the Daoist does not depend on the attributes of the spirit root, it is always golden in color.

Devil cultivators who possess the relevant techniques can replenish their strength and increase their cultivation level by absorbing the energy of the golden cores of slain cultivators.

cultivation.title: Cultivation
cultivation.introText: Cultivation is the practice of absorbing and refining the energies of heaven and earth, strengthening the body and soul, comprehending the laws of existence, and ultimately pursuing one's own Dao.
cultivation.appearance:
Joss Flames are generated by faith, worship, and the collective belief of living beings.

Certain Third Step cultivators follow cultivation methods heavily dependent upon Joss Flames.

A practitioner may establish a Joss Flame Realm populated by beings whose worship generates Joss Flame power.

Support Third Step cultivation.

Strengthen the cultivator's connection to their Joss Flame Realm.

Assist advancement through the Four Void Realms.

Be integrated increasingly deeply into the cultivator's own existence.

At Spirit Void, a Joss Flame cultivator may integrate their Joss Flame Realm to a much greater degree and use it directly in battle.

Joss Flames are a cultivation method rather than a separate cultivation Step.

Cultivators such as Wang Lin demonstrate that advancement without depending upon the conventional Joss Flame route is possible, although such a path can require extremely unusual Essence cultivation.
cultivation.personality:
A Domain is the cultivator's personal comprehension of a concept, phenomenon, or aspect of existence.

Domain becomes the defining characteristic of Soul Formation.

Before Soul Formation, a cultivator's strength is primarily determined by cultivation base, techniques, treasures, physical ability, and spiritual energy. Beginning at Soul Formation, comprehension itself becomes an increasingly important component of power.

Different Domains possess different starting points, qualities, and potential.

Even among cultivators of the same realm, a cultivator possessing a profound Domain can greatly surpass one whose Domain is ordinary.

Domains can continue to evolve as a cultivator's comprehension deepens.

Known examples include:

Law refers to the natural principles governing heaven and earth.

The Second Step revolves increasingly around the comprehension and control of these natural laws.

An Essence represents a qualitative transformation of profound comprehension.

Essence is central to the transition into the Third Step and remains one of the foundations of Third Step cultivation.

Essences may arise from:

Personal enlightenment

Special inheritances

Unique cultivation methods

Essences can also differ by nature and level of development.

Some cultivators possess only the Essence necessary for their cultivation path, while extraordinary cultivators such as Wang Lin cultivate multiple Essences.

A higher form of Essence as cultivated by Wang Lin.
