cultivation.trivia:
Illusory Yin and Corporeal Yang are transitional stages between the First and Second Steps rather than separate great Steps.

Powerful peak Ascendant cultivators may already interact with Origin Energy; Illusory Yin and Corporeal Yang complete the fundamental transition toward Origin Energy cultivation.

The Five Heaven's Blights are calamities associated with the transition toward the Third Step rather than an ordinary cultivation realm following Nirvana Shatterer.

Entry into the Third Step fundamentally revolves around Essence and the Void Gate.

Nirvana Void, Spirit Void, Arcane Void, and Void Tribulant are collectively the Four Void Realms.

At least one Ethereal Essence is normally required for advancement into Arcane Void.

Wang Lin's cultivation of nine Essences before his own Arcane Void breakthrough was part of his exceptional cultivation path and should not be generalized into a universal rule.

Arcane Tribulant is a transitional stage involving the Nine Arcane Tribulations, not a fifth Void Realm.

Grand Exalt should not be treated as a separate cultivation realm between Void Tribulant and Golden Exalt.

Exalt, Golden Exalt, Empyrean Exalt, and Ascendant Empyrean primarily function as strength or status classifications within the late Third Step.

Grand Empyrean represents the supreme class of ordinary Third Step existence on the Immortal Astral Continent.

A complete seven-star Ancient God body can contend with an early Nirvana Void cultivator, but star-to-realm comparisons remain approximate.

Twenty-seven Ancient lineage stars represent nine Ancient God, nine Ancient Demon, and nine Ancient Devil stars rather than twenty-seven stars of a single lineage.

Different racial cultivation paths ultimately converge toward the same transcendent Dao.

Wang Lin reaches Heaven Trampling, the Fourth Step.

Later Ergenverse continuity explicitly confirms that cultivation continues beyond the Fourth Step.

Fifth Step and higher information should be separated from the cultivation hierarchy directly established during the main narrative of Renegade Immortal.

cultivation.title: Empyrean Exalt
cultivation.introText:
This title refers to people at Peak of Void Tribulant. If one could break through into peak Void Tribulant, then they would become a False Empyrean Exalt, or just be called Empyrean Exalt.
However the main reason this "Peak Void Tribulant" is so special on its own is due to the fact that at this level an individual can fuse Dao directly into their bodies. This eliminates the concept of incantation and casting time for spells and even allows the practice of stacking spells. Ultimately, Empyrean Exalts are defined by this ability and the number of spells they can simultaneously stack, from 2 to 99, indicates their ability. Being able to stack 100+ spells is ultimately the criterion for an Ascendant Empyrean.

cultivation.title: Foundation Establishment
cultivation.introText: This is the true first step on the path of Cultivation, with the Qi Condensation stage being nothing more than the preliminary steps toward it.
cultivation.trivia:
Early on in the books, Situ Nan notes that it's possible to enter Foundation Establishment at the later stages of Qi Condensation without actually completing it. It is however not recommended to do this.

As shown by the Underworld Ascension Method, it is possible to Cultivate through the Foundation Establishment stage using pure Yin Qi instead of Spiritual Qi.

Wang Lin used the first and third methods to reach the Foundation Stage. The first time, he absorbed Teng Li's foundation; the second time, cultivating his avatar, he used numerous self-created foundation pills and, in just a few months, advanced from the limit of Qi concentration to the limit of Foundation Establishment stage.

cultivation.title: Golden Exalt
cultivation.introText: This is the Second of the four special Titles that exist within the Void Tribulant stage. This title refer to people at Peak Late Stage Of Void Tribulant, these people were infinitely close to peak Void Tribulant but weren’t able to cross the gap.

cultivation.title: Grand Empyrean
cultivation.introText: This Stage's existence and the method to reach it was discovered inside the Immemorial God Realm by the Ancient and Celestial Ancestors. It was then quickly adopted by the two clans as the next level beyond their own pre-existing Cultivation Peaks, the Void Tribulant and 27 Stars.
cultivation.appearance:
This Stage's existence and the method to reach it was discovered inside the Immemorial God Realm by the Ancient and Celestial Ancestors. It was then quickly adopted by the two clans as the next level beyond their own pre-existing Cultivation Peaks, the Void Tribulant and 27 Stars.

However, as Wang Lin's case illustrates, the next realm beyond Peak Void Tribulant is still in reality Half Heaven Trampling.

The two Ancestors created Trials based on the Trial that allowed one to become a Grand Empyrean, which were used to help their descendants reach this level.

When the two Ancestors were alive, the Celestial Clan had amassed eight Grand Empyreans while the Ancient Clan only had four, when they died, however, the two clans went to war and Ancient One Guo Dao personally killed three of the Celestial Grand Empyreans, thus bringing the total number of Grand Empyreans down to nine.

The first known method to breakthrough to Grand Empyrean is for one to enter the Immemorial God Realm and complete the trial that exists there. There is also a second method via inheritance, as is the case with both the Celestial Emperor Lian Daozhan and the Ancient Clan's Guo Dao. Finally it is also possible to reach this level by one's own merits, as is the stated case for the late Dong Ling and was achieved by completing the Empyrean Exalt Trials. Other Grand Empyreans are noted to have achieved the level through some unknown stroke of luck after entering the Immemorial God Realm, but only Wang Lin achieved anything resembling this form of power without ever having gone to that realm at all.

Because his cultivation is based on the direct division of realms, Wang Lin jumped straight to Half Heaven Trampling from Peak Void Tribulant, however he was able to manifest a Grand Empyrean Sun at Void Tribulants Late and Peak levels by combining his Essence True Bodies and he fully manifests it at Half Heaven Trampling by feeding the head of the Celestial Ancestor into it.  

Grand Empyreans can Reincarnate themselves in order to lengthen their lifespan indefinitely. Furthermore Grand Empyreans can turn spells corporeal through their powerful faith, which can go so far as to create something from nothing. To create something from nothing therefore is the root of all Grand Empyrean spells. Only the Grand Empyreans can use these Faith Spells. Rumor has it that faith spells can’t be inherited and that therefore every Faith Spell was created by the Grand Empyreans themselves.

Beyond the Grand Empyrean Realm itself is the Fourth Step's Heaven Trampling Realm. However, the gap to reach that point is a massive one. One way to achieve this is to first cross the Nine Heaven Trampling Bridges. Until one succeeds at this, or otherwise ascends, they are stuck in the Half Heaven Trampling Transitional Realm. At least one Grand Empyrean is known to be in the process of doing this. The Grand Empyrean's power increases with every bridge they cross, similar to a Nirvana Shatterer overcoming the Five Heaven's Blights or an Arcane Void enduring the Nine Arcane Tribulations. The difference however is that the nine bridges are physical objects existing in the world and were created to help bridge the massive gap between the 3rd and 4th steps, similar to the Empyrean Exalt Trial.
cultivation.personality: During the fusion with with his Slaughter Essence True Body, Wang Lin's cultivation was rising and already approaching Grand Empyrean. After an unknown amount of time and his cultivation rising further, it was mentioned that treading the bridges and being halfway into Heaven Trampling would be stepping past Peak Void Tribulant. Later, it was mentioned that Grand Empyrean is half a step below Half-Heaven Trampling. This could imply that in some ways, Grand Empyrean is still part of the Void Tribulant stage.
cultivation.history:
All of the Nine Suns are called as such because they have reached the Grand Empyrean level and thus generated the characteristic Sun. Gemini used to be rumored as the strongest Grand Empyrean, but has since weakened when she was split in two.

The true strongest Grand Empyrean was actually Grand Empyrean Gu Dao from the Ancient Clan, who single handedly took out 3 of the Celestial Clan's Grand Empyrean's and is said to be heavily responsible for the death of the later ascended Dong Lin. In truth, he has a Cultivation even greater than this stage and is half a step into Heaven Trampling.

Wang Lin later officially became a Grand Empyrean by completing his Grand Empyrean Sun, but did so after taking half a step into Heaven Trampling.

Lian Daozhen (Central Continent)

Lian Daofei (Central Continent)

Jiu Di (Central Continent)

Dao Yi (Southern Continent)

Wu Feng (Northern Continent)

Gemini (Eastern Continent)

Dong Lin (Deceased)

Three Unnamed Grand Empyrean's (Deceased)

Xuan Luo (Dao Clan )

Gu Dao (Ancient Clan )

Song Tian (Shi Clan)

Unnamed Grand Empyrean (Ji Clan)
cultivation.trivia:
The strongest of the Nine Suns was revealed to be already beyond Grand Empyrean and has achieved Half Heaven Trampling.

This Stage was originally discovered inside the Immemorial God Realm, accordingly, it is achievable by both Ancient Clansmen and Celestials who have reached the end of their race specific systems.

Because his cultivation is based on the direct division of realms, meaning each time he progresses it is an immediate jump to the next step(Early-Mid-Late-Peak-Early of Next Realm) Wang Lin jumped straight to Half heaven Trampling from Peak Void Tribulant. He then completed his incomplete Grand Empyrean Sun afterwards.

cultivation.title: Great Void Gate
cultivation.introText: The Great Void Gate is the doorway to the Third Step.
cultivation.appearance:
The gate appears before a Nirvana Shatterer or Heaven's Blight Cultivator who has successfully cultivated an Essence to completion.

In the event that all Five Heaven Blights haven't been endured, the gate will be firmly shut and the practitionar will have to forcibly break it open. The act of doing so however is beyond difficult and will certainly require more than just that one Essense worth of power. The sole example is Wang Lin, who broke open the gate without ever enduring a single Heaven's Blight. Situ Nan was also able to do something similar with help from Celestial Emperor Qing Lin.

When the gate is opened, Void Energy is bestowed upon the Cultivator, allowing them to enter the Nirvana Void level. However if the practitioner so chooses they can refuse to absorb that energy right away, this results in further gates appearing, each stronger than the last. Wang Lin for example refused to absorb the Void energy released to become a Third Step Cultivator through only one Essense, and he instead shattered five Void Gates, one for each Essense.

Should the practitioner persist in this then eventually the Ten Thousand Bone Great Void Gate will appear as it did for Wang Lin's sixth and final Slaughter Essense, this is a special kind of Void Gate that appears only before people of exceptional talent.

With every subsequent gate he broke Wang Lin skipped a stage in Nirvana Void, eventually allowing him to reach the middle level of Spirit Void.

cultivation.title: Half Heaven Trampling
cultivation.introText: At the peak of the Third Step, a cultivator can attempt to further progress onto Heaven Trampling. However the gap between the Third and Fourth Steps is considerably massive thus causing them to fall into this state.
cultivation.trivia:
Because Wang Lin's breakthroughs are directly based on the division of realms(i.e. he breaks through directly from Early to Mid to Late to Peak before Early of the next stage with each jump in power) He skipped over the Grand Empyrean Realm and was directly transported to the realm where Heaven Trampling Bridges were located immediately upon breaking through Void Tribulant. He then completed his Grand Empyrean Sun after crossing the third bridge.

According to Gu Dao, it's likely these bridges exist above all the continents beyond the Immortal Astral Continent as well. Furthermore, if one is ready to cross the bridges, it is shown that an individual can be transported directly to the realm where the nine bridges reside as in Wang Lin's case.

cultivation.title: Heaven Defying Cultivator
cultivation.introText: “The heavens’ dao won’t allow a third type of heaven-defying cultivation… Countless years ago, when the universe first formed, there was a race that was as old as the heavens’ dao. The members of that race had a lot of power. They used that power to form their dao, and they used that dao to fight the heavens. Some had amazing spells; with a turn of their hand, they could destroy dao and use the spells to fight against the heavens. There were also those that walked the path of slaughter; they lived in slaughter and used death to fight against the heavens!

cultivation.title: Heaven Trampling
cultivation.introText: The standard way of reaching this realm is to successfully cross the nine Heaven Trampling Bridges, with the ninth bridge leading to Heaven Trampling. However, the bridges are only an external aid and a cultivator can break into Heaven Trampling without all nine bridges if they can comprehend and cultivate what is needed to breakthrough themselves.
cultivation.trivia:
This is the last level shown by Wang Lin in the story of Renegade Immortal.

This level was first mentioned by Daoist Water, who believed that Wang Lin was the reincarnation of a cultivator who had reached the 4th Step, Heaven Trampling.

While the Grey-Robed Old Man states he and Wang Lin are the first and second 4th Step Cultivators to reach that step through Heaven Trampling, he also states that others have achieved the 4th step long before them, and many have achieved a 5th or even 6th step over time.

In I Shall Seal the Heavens, which is Er Gen's later novel set in the same universe, the Fourth Step is called Transcendence, in which Heaven Trampling, alongside its equivalents from PotT and ISSTH are interchangeably, its first realm.

In the Mountain and Seas Realm, the nine bridges used to reach this realm are known collectively as the Pāramitā Heaven Trampling Foundation.

In AWWP, Er Gen's 5th novel, information regarding Heaven Trampling is expanded. Wang Lin was able to expand the power of Heaven Trampling Bridge, thereby making Heaven Trampling's level equal to the entire 4th Step.

cultivation.title: Heaven's Blight
cultivation.introText: At the Second Step, a cultivator can transform Heaven and Earth Origin Energy into Life Force. Therefore, they can theoretically live forever. The Heavens won't allow this and will directly send punishment. There are 5 desolations/tribulations in this level. With each passing of desolation, the practitioner's power will increase, this is what came to be called the "Five Broken Fingers" and later the "Five Heavens Blights".

cultivation.title: Ji Realm
cultivation.introText: JI Realm is one of the three great realms besides Shi Realm and Dao Realm. Ji Realm is a realm that represents Extreme Force and Death.
cultivation.trivia:
The Ji Realm was partially imitated by a technique known as the Death Spell, which allows one to turn their spiritual sense into an attack.

There are 2 type of Ji Realm cultivators, the first is to have part of the Ji Realm power in their qi like the Core Formation realm Wang Lin who had the Ji Realm integrated with his qi, the second is the True Ji Realm, it acts at the spiritual level like the 2 other great realms.

cultivation.title: Nascent Soul
cultivation.introText: In this stage the Core inside a person's Dantian will shatter to reveal a Nascent Soul with purple Nascent Soul energy.
cultivation.trivia:
Early on in the Novel, it was stated that people at the Nascent Soul stage can live forever. This is evidently proven false in later books.

The Nascent Soul is a common realm in Xian type novels in general, usually the last one after Qi, Foundation, and Core to be consistent across the genre. Depending on the author, there's usually at least one stage above this and before ascending to a higher plain.
Er Gen himself frequently uses these four levels, with some variation, across all of his books.

Absorbing another cultivator's nascent soul can increase the chances of creating one's own.

If the cultivator's body dies, the nascent soul may have time to leave it and exist outside the body until it finds a new one, but in this form its cultivation possibilities are limited.

Many Nascent Soul level cultivators use the services of the Yin Corpse Sect to find themselves a new suitable body to replace the old one that was destroyed.

Nascent Soul cultivators and above are able to recreate their destroyed body using special techniques, in particular Ancient God techniques or avatar creation techniques, but this may require special rare resources.

cultivation.title: Nirvana Cleanser
cultivation.introText: After comprehension of one's law reaches a certain extent they will be able to breakthrough. In this realm, one will be able to control natural law. They are also able to open a space that functions like a bag of holding but is locked by the cultivator instead of able to be robbed like normal bags.
cultivation.trivia: Early on it was stated that Cultivators who fail to reach Nirvana Shatterer will eventually still face a calamity akin to the Five Heavens Blights in this stage, due to their functional immortality. Their punishment however will be "far harsher" and they most likely will not survive. This concept was then never mentioned again.

cultivation.title: Nirvana Scryer
cultivation.introText: Those who are particularly talented will gain the ability to do a Spatial Bending as early as this level, effectively giving them true teleportation and the ability to hide themselves in the void.

cultivation.title: Nirvana Shatterer
cultivation.introText: At this step, a Cultivator can use their insight into Law to grasp and Cultivate an Essence, this is a necessary step to Cultivate to the Third Step. With a completed Essence, one can summon the Great Void Gate, however if the practitioner has not reached Fifth Heavens Blight they'll need to use force to open it.
cultivation.appearance:
At this step, a Cultivator can use their insight into Law to grasp and Cultivate an Essence, this is a necessary step to Cultivate to the Third Step. With a completed Essence, one can summon the Great Void Gate, however if the practitioner has not reached Fifth Heavens Blight they'll need to use force to open it.

A Cultivator's Essence cultivation is itself directly related to their actual cultivation level, for example after devouring the Eternal Thunderbolt and completing his Thunder Essence, Wang Lin's Thunder Essence' Cultivation level was equal to a late stage Nirvana Shatterer while his other four Essences were each still only at mid stage. This is also why it's easier to practice one Essence and not waste years maturing more.

The five Heavens Blights are five brutal trials that allow the user to grow stronger if they survive. These five trials serve to unlock the Void Gate, allowing the user to reach the Third Step. At the 5th Blight, a Cultivator can use Third Step spells regardless of if they've achieved a compete Essence and reached the Third Step proper, but it will consume their life force. It is a common practice for a Heavens Blight Cultivator to seal their Cultivation at Peak Nirvana Shatterer to conserve and store up life force and vitality.

cultivation.title: Nirvana Void
cultivation.introText: To reach this level, one must cultivate at least one Essence to completion. There are two methods to doing this, both of which will have lasting consequences on the Third Step as a whole:
cultivation.trivia: The second method of cultivating Essence is essentially the same as to the Dao Realm that replaces the Third Step in Er Gen's later novel, I Shall Seal The Heavens, as it involves cultivating 9 Essences.

cultivation.title: Qi Condensation
cultivation.introText: This stage is divided into 15 layers, all but the first of which require a chant to break through to.
cultivation.trivia: Situ Nan notes that the Qi Condensation and Spiritual Movement Stages are actually different equivalent practices. The latter is used in 4th Ranked Countries and above, and seems to require no chants to practice, making it clearly superior.

cultivation.title: Soul Formation
cultivation.introText: Soul Formation is the fifth stage in Cultivation, characterized by the creation of an Origin Soul. The Soul Formation signify a great change for a Country, each cultivator who attains Soul Formation elevates the country and allows it to birth more talented Cultivators.

cultivation.title: Soul Transformation
cultivation.introText: The key to breaking through from the Soul Formation stage to the Soul Transformation stage is the amount of celestial jades. The more celestial jades there are, the more dense the celestial spiritual energy will be and therefore the chance of breaking through to the Soul Transformation will be higher.
cultivation.trivia: This stage can be thought of as something similar to a transitional level, as it was originally not a necessary step for Celestials and could be entirely skipped over when the Celestial Domain was intact.

cultivation.title: Spirit Void
cultivation.introText: Cultivators who achieve this realm will experience changes in their Origin Soul, which will then fuse with their innate soul as a living being. The Origin Soul will transform to a Spirit Soul as a result of this.

cultivation.title: Upper Celestial
cultivation.introText: At the peak of Soul Formation a Cultivator would experience a tribulation. Those who survive would be brought into the Celestial Domain or one of its four subsidiary realms, which originally served as passageways. They would be given a true Celestial Body and would then achieve this form.
cultivation.trivia: The Thunder Celestials of the Allheaven Star System were able to undergo a conversion process to enter this path at the expense of giving up on their Qi Cultivator path.

cultivation.title: Void Tribulant
cultivation.introText: Due to the degree of renown that is held for those who manage to attain this level, the practitioners are awarded the title of Grand Exalt for merely stepping into the Void Tribulant stage. Even Late Stage Void Tribulants are called as such, however, those who are infinitely close to the Peak of Void Tribulant but still fail to bridge that gap are known as Golden Exalts. Those rare few who do achieve the peak are called Empyrean Exalts. Finally, those who exceed this level, yet do not manage to enter the Grand Empyrean stage, are called Ascendant Empyrean. As for the Grand Empyrean stage itself, this power exists beyond the peak of Void Tribulant yet not yet in the Half Heaven Trampling realm above. Throughout the Immortal Astral Continent, Ascendant Empyreans are exceedingly rare with just 48 at present, and there are only about a thousand Empyrean Exalts. As for Grand Empyreans, with as few as four exceptions, the only way to achieve this level was by obtaining a great fortune from the Immemorial God Realm, and two of those four achieved the level through an inheritance.
cultivation.personality:
The gap in power at the Void Tribulant stage is huge, such that Early, Middle and Late Grand Exalts are vastly distinguishable from each other, they are in fact so far apart that they can almost be considered different Realms of Cultivation. Mid Stage Void Tribulants are allowed to rule over sizeable sects even by the Immortal Astral Continent's standards while Golden Exalts are powerful enough to rule over one of the Nine Sects and Thirteen Factions. Empyrean Exalts and Ascendant Empyreans tend to be scouted by the Grand Empyrean Nine Suns and often serve them directly, there are thus few of these beings actually active outside of the Central Continent.
Those who reach Peak Void Tribulant(Empyrean Exalt) gain the ability to fuse Dao directly into their bodies. This allows them to use spells with the flick of a sleeve, and indeed an Empyrean Exalts power is as much about how many spells they can release simultaneously in this manner as it is their actual Cultivation Level. Only an Ascendant Empyrean can combine more than 100 spells into a single move in this way, making that the hallmark of Ascendant Empyreans in general. Further beyond the power of an Ascendant Empyrean lay the Grand Empyrean Realm. At this stage a person generates a sun around his or her being and can use Faith Spells, which are spells with the capability to alter reality itself.
cultivation.trivia:
This level has never appeared inside Wang Lin's Cave World, with exception to Old Ghost Zhan and the Seven Colored Daoist, who were splintered souls of a cultivator from the Immortal Astral Continent.

For Ancient Clan members, this stage seems to be equivalent to the 10th to 27th Star they can obtain by practicing the full powers of all three bloodlines and undergoing the final Trial's Three Calamities.
A good example is that someone who has managed to completely fuse the power of the 3 bloodlines is at the very least as powerful as a Golden Exalt).

It has also been shown that, through the same fortune as Celestials, Ancients can become Grand Empyreans.

techniques.title: 18 Plum Restriction
techniques.introText: 18 Plum Restriction is something derived from the Annihilation Restriction.

techniques.title: Celestial Slaughter Art
techniques.introText: By Killing anything with this technique you can convert it into Life Seals, the more Life Seals you have your defence will be more powerfull. its a life saving technique that was cultivated by all Seer and was given  to Wang Lin.
techniques.appearance:
The Celestial Slaughter Art is a powerful and unique celestial spell that revolves around the concept of slaughter to create life seals and harness vitality. It involves converting the energy from slaughter and killing into life force, forming protective life seals that provide strong defense. The more life seals one has, the stronger the defense becomes, to the extent that with enough life seals (such as one trillion), one could be safe even if a cultivation planet collapses

Wang Lin learned this spell from the grey-robed All-Seer, who taught it to him because of Wang Lin's cultivation of the life and death domain. The Celestial Slaughter Art is not a true celestial spell but an imitation of a celestial spell of unknown rank. To master it, Wang Lin had to promise that once he used the Celestial Slaughter Art, he must not leave any enemies alive

The art requires experience through actual slaughter to be comprehended. Wang Lin entered a scarlet world filled with endless slaughter and blood pools to cultivate and understand the Celestial Slaughter Art deeply. In this place, continuous killing and absorbing killing intent allowed him to comprehend the heart of slaughter, which is the cycle where death creates life seals, embodying the transformation between life and death, or reincarnation

The Celestial Slaughter Art harvests life force during slaughter, turning it into grey gas that can form life seals around the user. It has offensive capabilities and can be stored and used many times. However, cultivating it is extremely challenging because the slaughter energy can overwhelm the user's body if overused, potentially turning the user into a strand of slaughter energy if they reach too high a comprehension level without proper control

Wang Lin reached the small completion stage of the Celestial Slaughter Art after years of practice, being able to control several strands of slaughter energy. The art's essence is linked to the balance of life and death and reincarnation, creating a cycle where death leads to the creation of life seals. This understanding gave Wang Lin significant enlightenment and power, allowing him to wield the art with considerable killing intent

The Grey-robed All-Seer possessed a profound mastery of the Celestial Slaughter Art, able to condense up to 10 million strands of slaughter energy, and Wang Lin narrowly avoided becoming absorbed into the All-Seer's slaughter energy by giving up his cultivation at one million strands. Wang Lin also realized that the All-Seer taught him the art specifically because of his life and death domain cultivation

techniques.title: Divine Path
techniques.introText: This technique allow the cultivator to create an Avatar. The Avatar will help him breakthrough to Nascent Soul Stage. The only Drawback of the War God Shrine's Divine Path is the Avatar doesn't have cultivation and can only live 30 years. Wang Lin break the livespan drawback when he try to fuse the Avatar back to the Main Body, the Ji Realm conflict with the Avatar and remove the drawback.

techniques.title: Finger of Death
techniques.introText: Finger of Death is one of the three low-grade Celestial Spells taught by Situ Nan to Wang Lin during their journey to the Trading Planet. The technique was created from tens of thousands of years of Situ Nan’s cultivation insights, making its power extraordinary and difficult to match. Throughout his entire life, Situ Nan passed down this spell only to Wang Lin.
techniques.appearance: Finger of Death is one of the three low-grade Celestial Spells taught by Situ Nan to Wang Lin during their journey to the Trading Planet. The technique was created from tens of thousands of years of Situ Nan’s cultivation insights, making its power extraordinary and difficult to match. Throughout his entire life, Situ Nan passed down this spell only to Wang Lin.

techniques.title: Fishing the Moon in the Well
techniques.introText: Fishing the Moon in the Well is a spell which manifests a well beneath the target and water, which reflects them.

techniques.title: God Slaying Seal
techniques.introText: God Slaying Seal is one of the spells of the ancient gods, and it is something only the royal bloodline has.

techniques.title: Heaven Extinction Spell
techniques.introText: The origin souls of all the cultivators one has killed are devoured, and their flesh and blood absorbed to become nutrients for the user to recover.

techniques.title: Immortal Ancient Body
techniques.introText: The Ancient Immortal Finger/Body condensed the power of the three ancient clans into one finger/body. While it possessed a terrifying offensive power, it also had a terrifying recovery ability.
techniques.trivia: With Wang Lin’s cultivation level, he couldn’t make this entire body immortal at first; he could only make one finger become immortal! Only later on, after he formed his Seventh Essence that allowed him to become a late stage Spirit Void Cultivator and that he became a 24 stars Ancient Dao did he have the power to make his body "immortal".

techniques.title: Life and Death Restriction
techniques.introText: The Life and Death Restriction is one of the four great restrictions.

techniques.title: Nine Cycle Celestial Refining Tactic
techniques.introText: Transforms Celestial Energy into Metal Celestial Energy

techniques.title: Teleportation Restriction
techniques.introText: One seals themselves with this restriction so that in that one instant, they can use teleportation multiple times to produce a mysterious force. Then once the seal is released, all of the force explodes forth and creates a teleportation several times more powerful.

techniques.title: Time Restriction
techniques.introText: The Time Restriction is one of the four great restrictions.

artifacts.title: Ancient Lamp
artifacts.introText: An ancient lamp that contains the spirit of the Ancient Demon possessing Blood God.

artifacts.title: Celestial Ascension Fruit
artifacts.introText: The Celestial Ascension Fruit isn’t a rare fruit. Although it isn’t common, it is even possible to get it on planet Suzaku.

artifacts.title: Celestial Brush
artifacts.introText: The Celestial Brush is a supreme celestial treasure imbued with vast celestial spiritual energy and heavenly dao. Appearing as a golden ink brush, it releases radiant golden light when activated, carrying an overwhelming sense of majesty that commands respect even from celestials.
artifacts.appearance:
The Celestial Brush is a supreme celestial treasure imbued with vast celestial spiritual energy and heavenly dao. Appearing as a golden ink brush, it releases radiant golden light when activated, carrying an overwhelming sense of majesty that commands respect even from celestials.

Its true power lies in its ability to draw celestial symbols and spells, with each stroke requiring the wielder to split a portion of their origin soul.These strokes act as anchors for celestial intent, and when seven strokes are completed, they fuse into a complete celestial spell symbol capable of exerting immense pressure and altering the surrounding environment. The appearance of an eighth stroke represents a qualitative transformation, marking a higher level of mastery and spell completion.

Wang Lin obtained the Celestial Brush after defeating an old cultivator who had acquired it in the Celestial Realm and used it to enlighten lower-realm cultivators. Upon taking possession of the brush, Wang Lin quickly comprehended its structure and celestial energy flow, surpassing its former owner in mastery within a short time. His use of the brush demonstrates not only his strength, but also his exceptional intelligence and adaptability in controlling high-level celestial treasures.

As a core celestial artifact, the Celestial Brush is both powerful and dangerous. Improper use risks severe damage to the origin soul, while true mastery allows the wielder to inscribe spells that embody heavenly dao itself

artifacts.title: Celestial Sealing Stamp
artifacts.introText: Even a low level cultivator would feel his mind tremble and pain would fill his body as if he was being stabbed by countless swords. Even a cultivator with advanced cultivation would feel like their origin soul was being sealed when they saw it.

artifacts.title: Cultivation Planet Crystal
artifacts.introText: It is object given by cultivation alliance to plant it in the planets.little by little it absorbs little piece of soul from all the organisms that was in that planet where crystal was planted.Only Suzakus can control it and with it they can kill whoever they want unless that person is ascendant or above.Second Suzaku Situ Nan sealed it cause he thinked it was evil object to use it like that.

artifacts.title: Demonic Battle Drum
artifacts.introText: A mysterious item presented during the second/final round of the Demon General Competition. Whoever was able to strike the drum the most would win the competition.

artifacts.title: Distant Heaven Pill
artifacts.introText: The Distant Heaven Pill (远天丹) is a rare and potent alchemical elixir in Xian Ni, renowned for its ability to accelerate and stabilize crucial cultivation breakthroughs. Crafted only by the most skilled pill masters, it combines legendary herbs and celestial energies to refine a cultivator’s Essence, smoothing the transition from Foundation Establishment to Core Formation. When consumed, the pill sharpens Qi condensation and fortifies the body and spirit against the brutal backlash of heavenly tribulations, making it an invaluable aid for those standing on the edge of profound transformation. Wang Lin relies on the Distant Heaven Pill during his early Core Formation breakthrough, where even an incomplete version provides a vital boost, allowing him to shatter longstanding bottlenecks. Its power extends beyond mere cultivation speed—this pill represents the pinnacle of alchemical craftsmanship, symbolizing the fusion of Dao mastery and spiritual refinement.

artifacts.title: Fire Spirit Corpse
artifacts.introText: Rank 12 in the Corpse Sect’s corpse ranking. If one can successfully possess this corpse, then no fire spell in the world would be able to harm him. In addition, he would be able to control the fire of the world.

artifacts.title: God Slaying War Chariot
artifacts.introText: When Wang Lin used the God Slaying War Chariot, it would release a spirit beast for battle. The spirit beast would sometimes attack Wang Lin because it loathed Wang Lin. When Wang Lin became an Ascendant, Wang Lin was able to place seals on the spirit beast and it eventually evolved into the Thunder Celestial Beast.

artifacts.title: Heaven Defying Bead
artifacts.introText: The Heaven Defying Bead is a Treasure Wang Lin finds at the beginning of Renegade Immortal.

artifacts.title: Heaven Tiger Flag
artifacts.introText: Give the power to command 3,000 Allheaven Star System cultivators and form his own force.

artifacts.title: Li Guang's Bow
artifacts.introText: Li Guang's Bow is the strongest weapon in the Cave World and one of the strongest even in the Immortal Astral Continent.
artifacts.appearance:
The bow is quite large and has nine seals engraved upon it. The bow is made of bone, with engravings of a moon and stars. The bow string was made of an unknown material that gave off an ancient aura.

The arrow that is used along with it is long and dark with nine feathers on its tail.
artifacts.history:
Sovereign's disciple, Feng Yi, used Li Guang's Bow against Wang Lin near the end of the First Battle of the Third Sealed-Outer Realm War. Wang Lin managed to block the three blows with the help of Tai Aluo, however, he was severely injured. Then, Sovereign appeared and threw the bow near the torn hole on the Realm-Sealing Formation to lure Inner Realm cultivators to attempt to steal it. The Ancient Demon inside Esteemed Great Void immediately rushed out to steal it but fell into Sovereign's trap and had a large amount of his demonic aura stolen, instead.

Suddenly, Old Ghost Zhan appeared and took the bow. He then threw it towards Wang Lin which allowed him to take the bow but it further exacerbated his injuries as the bow would only acknowledge Celestials as its users. This forced Wang Lin to urgently call out the Nether Beast and escape inside its belly. There, he met Lian Daofei who passed on his Immortal Celestial Body to him which allowed him to finally control the bow.

Wang Lin later entered the 19th layer of the Tattoo Clan's Ancestral Grave on Planet Suzaku where he found the arrow used in conjunction with Li Guang's Bow.

Wang Lin used the bow for the first time when he was ambushed by Sovereign's Fishing the Moon in the Well. It allowed him to kill the avatars of Ice Boy, Second Concubine and Heaven Master Void God while it caused severe injuries to Sovereign.

Afterwards, Wang Lin drew the arrow on Li Guang's Bow inside the Ancient Celestial Realm to coerce the Four Generals into making a deal with him.

Finally, he used the bow once again when he killed Sovereign during the final battle in the Allheaven Star System. As Sovereign had the Sealing Extermination Clan's Three-Life Spell, he survived but it left him with just one life as he died once before.

After returning to the Outer Realm, Sovereign continuously sent strong cultivators such as five Nirvana Void cultivators along with 100,000 weaker cultivators to force Wang Lin to use up Li Guang's Bow twice as he had divined that Wang Lin could only use it twice before it extinguished his Celestial Bloodline. Sovereign even begged Seven-Colored Daoist to free Dao Master Miao Yin, Devil Master Nine Heavens and Esteemed Great Desolation from Ye Mo's Tomb so that they could draw out the two shots but they were routed by Dao Master Blue Dream.

Wang Lin returned the bow to the Imperial Li Family when he visited the Celestial Clan's Imperial City in the Immortal Astral Continent.

artifacts.title: Nirvana Void Pill
artifacts.introText: The person who takes this pill will have 10% chance of turning law into source origin and reaching what us cultivators call the third step! The person who takes this pill have have 50% chance of passing a Heaven’s Blight! The person who takes this pill will have an 80% chance to enter the Shi Realm!

artifacts.title: Soul Flag
artifacts.introText: Soul Flags are items used to trap and refine souls in the world of Renegade Immortal.

artifacts.title: Three Thread Nematoad Grass
artifacts.introText: Three Thread Nematoad Grass is an herb that causes those who consume it to temporarily fall under the control of someone else. It's a necessary step for refining puppets.

artifacts.title: Wither Dao Pair
artifacts.introText: A Beast crane with four pikes that release a monstrous killing and evil intent. If the cultivator is exposed to his attack, his body will be petrified in stone.

artifacts.title: Yin Blade
artifacts.introText: Created by Ji Si to impress the Green Devil after its resurrection.

clans.title: Blue Dragon Sect
clans.introText: It is affiliated to the Great Soul Sect, one of the Nine Sects and Thirteen Factions, that runs the Heavenly Bull Continent alongside the Gui Yi Sect.
clans.history:
Kang Ren, a third-generation disciple of the sect, saw Wang Lin entering the Immortal Astral Continent through the void and decided to take him back to the sect to refine him as a puppet. During the refining, however, Wang Lin woke up and began devouring the sect's earthen fire vein which attracted the attention of the sect's elders. They rushed in to capture Wang Lin only to end up almost dead. Wang Lin escaped the sect as he was unsure of his chances of standing up to the Blue Dragon Sect's supposed early-stage Void Tribulant Old Ancestor, Du Qing. Du Qing and the Sect Master arrived a few minutes after Wang Lin escaped. Enraged at his decimated sect, Du Qing soul-searched one of the sect disciples and saw what happened. He even sentenced Elder Sun Mengde to be sealed for 100 years due to his slip of words. He then ordered the sect to use their entire resources to look for Wang Lin. He then set out to capture Wang Lin and finally returned with Wang Lin, many months later. However, he returned with Wang Lin as the sect's honored guest and even had the sect's disciples and elders look for the earthen fire veins in the surrounding areas.

Wang Lin was gifted the best cultivation cave in the sect as his lodging. There, he stayed for almost a year until he managed to re-master Spatial Bending and then left for the Great Soul Sect where the Heavenly Bull Continent's main earthen fire vein was located.
clans.trivia:
Blue Dragon Sect's land is comparable to less than half of the Brilliant Void. From the perspective of a cave world cultivator, it is a behemoth. However, on the Immortal Astral Continent, it is just average.

The Blue Dragon Sect disciples are all good at making puppets to help them in battle. Disciples often need to refine their life puppets first before they could go outside. As for the puppets, they have different rankings and powers as well. Besides using special wood or mechanics, beast or cultivator corpses could be refined into puppets as well. The Blue Dragon Sect’s puppet spell had its own specialty: it would convert one’s body into a puppet in order to achieve immortality.

The Blue Dragon Sect's Old Ancestor Du Qing is a person made of wood. Normally, he looks like a normal person, but once he uses spells, one can see his wooden body.

clans.title: Brilliant Void Realm
clans.introText: In the past, they teamed up with the Cultivation Alliance to defeat the Four Divine Sect. After many conspiracies, they were able to bring the Four Divine Sect to their weakest point.
clans.history:
Mu Bingmei is current Saintess of the Brilliant Void Realm. Liu Mei was one of her nine avatars. She took Zhou Ru as her disciple most probably due to the latter's connection with Wang Lin.

Mu Bingmei's junior disciple sister entered the East Demon Spirit Sea alongside Middle-Aged Woman and Master Void, an elder of the Cultivation Alliance and Master Zhongxuan's younger brother.

It was destroyed by Tuo Sen after he escaped from the Land of the Ancient God. Its Saintess, Mu Bingmei, was seriously injured and forced to flee while its Ancestor, Lu Yundao, was sealed into one of Tuo Sen's Ancient God stars.

clans.title: Celestial Dragon Sect
clans.introText: After Little Red escaped from the Fallen Land, he ran quite far before stopping and establishing his own sect. All the sect members were those weaker than Little Red and were coerced into joining the sect.
clans.history:
After Little Red escaped from the Fallen Land, he ran quite far before stopping and establishing his own sect. All the sect members were those weaker than Little Red and were coerced into joining the sect.

Every few days, Little Red would set up his own congregation and have them march through the Outer Realm while carrying him and shouting chants of his praise. Little Red mapped out the route the congregation took very cautiously and made sure to not attract the attention of any cultivator stronger than itself.

Unfortunately, one day he met Wang Lin and was forced to become his slave.

clans.title: Cloud Sky Sect
clans.introText: The Cloud Sky Sect was located in a 3rd rank cultivation country, named Chu. It was a very mysterious sect which was well known for its alchemy and rarely recruiting disciples.
clans.history:
The Cloud Sky Sect was located in a 3rd rank cultivation country, named Chu. It was a very mysterious sect which was well known for its alchemy and rarely recruiting disciples.

After Wang Lin returns to Chu he decides to become part of the Cloud Sky Sect to learn about Alchemy and reach Nascent Soul stage. There he finds his one true love Li Muwan. After the people of the sect try to turn on him and Li Muwan, he tramples on them and takes their soul blood. This made him the new sect leader. Li Muwan controlled the sect in his absence.

When he returns and notices that Li Muwan's lifespan is nearly running out he decides to try and save her. During this trial he recruits two people from the Cloud Sky Sect which follow him to reach the Soul Formation stage.

After the Suzaku Arc the Cloud Sky Sect used its entire foundation and the help of fellow cultivators to create a statue of Wang Lin for all he has done for the planet Suzaku. The Cloud Sky Sect pretty much gains control over the country of Chu and gets elevated as well to a 4th rank cultivation country due to one of the followers finally reaching Soul Formation.

The Cloud Sky Sect has become so powerful now that even 5th rank cultivation countries need to be respectful to them. This is mainly due to Wang Lin's statue and the accomplishments he has achieved.

After Wang Lin rises as the new Lord of the Sealed Realm, Suzaku is remodelled by the powerful cultivators of the realm who wish to honour him. Only nine sects survive this period with the rest being assimilated or wiped out. The Cloud Sky Sect is one of these nine sects.

clans.title: Corpse Yin Sect
clans.introText: They collect resentment and like to target the Giant Demon Clan for possession because of their strong bodies. They are highly valued in the Cultivation Alliance because they can produce replacement bodies for cultivator’s who had their original bodies destroyed during battle.
clans.history:
The Eight Kings entered the Land of the Ancient God inside the Sea of Devils after hearing about it from Wang Lin. There, five of them died to Tuo Sen while the remaining three were saved by Master South Cloud.

After Wang Lin returned from the Outer Realm, he executed the traitor Daoist Water. During that time, Daoist Water attempted to destroy the Golden Bell he received from the Ancient Celestial Realm to destroy the Cloud Sea Star System and escape to the Outer Realm. Master South Cloud, Master Hong Shan, Zhou De, Cloud Edge and Esteemed Great Void attempted to stop him but could not. Just when they began despairing, Wang Lin's Nether Beast appeared and swallowed the golden storm energy from the destroyed Golden Bell.

clans.title: Cultivation Alliance
clans.introText: Cultivation Alliance is the administrative body of the Brilliant Void Star System. Its position in Brilliant Void is similar to the Thunder Celestial Temple's position in the Allheaven Star System.
clans.appearance: It is a giant cultivation planet with countless smaller planets surrounding it. A monstrous blood light is constantly emitted from below the planet. There is spatial rift below the cultivation planet and the blood light is coming from that rift.
clans.history:
After Lu Yun saved Wang Lin and killed the Celestials that came to kill Qing Lin, news of the Alliance's miserable defeat spread across the entire Star System.

Most of the sects and clans located in Brilliant Void declared independence, including Corpse Sect, which took the entire southern region of the star system as their territory. Also, Four Divine Sect took the eastern region of the star system as their territory.

Moreover, most of the Alliance's Rank 7 Cultivation planets, and all four of the Alliance's Rank 8 Cultivation planets that included Country of Rising Cloud, Country of Reed Flute, Temple of Heaven, and Evil Earth Sect declared their independence.

Finally, after two years, the Alliance's HQ opened and declared that all the "independent sects" that resist Allheaven for 60 years will be spared of any punishment and they will be allowed to enter the Elder Council. Also, the Alliance sent out a kill order for Wang Lin.

clans.title: Da Lou Sword Sect
clans.introText: This planet came from an illusionary planet that is always burning in the Brilliant Void Hell. That illusionary planet was very large, thousands of times larger than planet Tian Yun! It was refined as a sword by Master Void Spirit of the Brilliant Void Cultivation Sect. Due to an incident, the illusionary planet collapsed, and planet Da Lou is a fragment from the collapsed planet.

clans.title: Demon Sect
clans.introText: Like the God Sect, it was founded by the Lord of the Sealed Realm to combat the spatial crack that led to the Outer Realm. After the Lord of the Sealed Realm disappeared, the Demon Sect broke off from the God Sect and gained sole sovereignty over itself but it continued to fulfill its mission of combatting the fierce beasts that entered through the spatial crack.
clans.history: Every few thousand years, the Demon Sect calls forth young cultivators from the Rank 9 Region and lower to exterminate the accumulated fierce beasts. The best among these cultivators are taught the arts of the Demon Sect. Wang Lin entered the spatial crack to find Li Qian Mei who had agreed to a suicide mission in exchange for the sect helping deliver her life-blood to him. After exiting the spatial crack Wang Lin attracted the Infinite Retribution near the Demon Sect. He used it attack the Sealed Realm Formation and then used the Sealed Realm Jade to allow the Lord of the Sealed Realm to takeover the Sealed Realm Formation. Mysterious Brilliant, the Head Elder of Demon Sect, saw the Lord of the Sealed Realm and decided that Wang Lin was his inheritor.

clans.title: Devil Dao Sect
clans.introText: The Green Devil Continent's Three Great Sects, Devil Dao Sect, Poison Devil Sect, and Wu Ji Sect (author literally added a "Devil Restriction Sect" afterwards so idk which of these 4 are the 3 great sects XD), initiated war against the Heavenly Bull Continent. They planned to revert the half Celestial Pill that created the Pill Sea back into a pill and use it to break the barrier dividing the two continents. To this end, they sent Void Cloud, one of the Eastern Continent's Four Geniuses, there to refine the sea back into the pill and break the barrier as it would also allow his reputation to skyrocket and allow him to enter the Celestial Imperial Capital in the Central Continent to obtain the qualification to enter the ancestral temple.

clans.title: Dong Lin Sect
clans.introText: They are not to be confused with Planet Dong Lin, although they are connected as Su Dao was originally from this Sect.
clans.personality:
Wang Lin entered the Dong Lin Sect along with Liu Jinbiao whom he coincidentally ran into soon after he arrived on the Great Sage Continent.

He saw that the sect was booming with vitality and a heavenly presence. However, instinctively he felt that something was unnatural. While there, he arrived at Su Dao's cultivation cave where he had an epiphany which resulted in dao enlightenment for him and he managed to further boost his understanding of his ethereal essences (with some help from Liu Jinbiao's dao of deception).

With a greater comprehension of his ethereal essences, Wang Lin was finally able to understand the unnatural element present inside the Dong Lin Sect. He realized that the Dong Lin Sect had long been destroyed and that its current form was the result of an illusion casted by the sect's sole surviving and strongest member, an Ascendant Empyrean Old Ancestor.

Every person that walked the sect was in fact just a skeleton; every stream of sweet, clear water was in fact a puddle filled with blood and grime; and the celestial energy in the air was in fact deathly aura.

After meeting the sect's Ascendant Empyrean Old Ancestor, he learnt that the sect was destroyed while the old ancestor was out training. He even learnt from the old ancestor that none of the five Celestial Grand Empyreans were able to divinate the identity of the person who destroyed the sect. Even the Celestial Clan's Imperial Teacher was harmed in the process of divination and subsequently lost all memories regarding his divination indicating that a being higher than the Grand Empyreans was involved in the Dong Lin Sect's destruction.
clans.history:
Wang Lin entered the Dong Lin Sect along with Liu Jinbiao whom he coincidentally ran into soon after he arrived on the Great Sage Continent.

He saw that the sect was booming with vitality and a heavenly presence. However, instinctively he felt that something was unnatural. While there, he arrived at Su Dao's cultivation cave where he had an epiphany which resulted in dao enlightenment for him and he managed to further boost his understanding of his ethereal essences (with some help from Liu Jinbiao's dao of deception).

With a greater comprehension of his ethereal essences, Wang Lin was finally able to understand the unnatural element present inside the Dong Lin Sect. He realized that the Dong Lin Sect had long been destroyed and that its current form was the result of an illusion casted by the sect's sole surviving and strongest member, an Ascendant Empyrean Old Ancestor.

Every person that walked the sect was in fact just a skeleton; every stream of sweet, clear water was in fact a puddle filled with blood and grime; and the celestial energy in the air was in fact deathly aura.

After meeting the sect's Ascendant Empyrean Old Ancestor, he learnt that the sect was destroyed while the old ancestor was out training. He even learnt from the old ancestor that none of the five Celestial Grand Empyreans were able to divinate the identity of the person who destroyed the sect. Even the Celestial Clan's Imperial Teacher was harmed in the process of divination and subsequently lost all memories regarding his divination indicating that a being higher than the Grand Empyreans was involved in the Dong Lin Sect's destruction.

clans.title: Earth Sect
clans.introText: Unlike most large sects, the Earth Sect only has around 30,000 disciples, as focus on quality rather than quantity.
clans.appearance:
Unlike most large sects, the Earth Sect only has around 30,000 disciples, as focus on quality rather than quantity.

Disciples are ranked from 1 to 9, depending on ability, there are as few as 100 Rank 9 disciples and about 20,000 Rank 1 disciples. As a box standard, the 5th Rank disciples appear to be around the Second Step's Nirvana Cleanser level.
clans.history: Wang Lin visited the Earth Sect to get the map of the Meng Earth Continent. While there, he was pleasantly surprised to sense the aura of Zhou Yi and Qing Shuang. He even informed the Earth Sect's Golden Exalt Ancestor to look after the two of them.

clans.title: Four Divine Sect
clans.introText: In the past, the Four Divine Sect was even more powerful and mysterious than the current Cultivation Alliance. Even the Brilliant Void Cultivation Sect dreaded the Four Divine Sect. As a result, they teamed up with the Cultivation Alliance to defeat them. After many conspiracies, they were able to bring the Four Divine Sect to their weakest point.
clans.history:
Huang Long, an avatar of Lu Yun, gave Wang Lin the Vermillion Bird Mark when the latter returned during the war against Allheaven Star System.

Later, Wang Lin absorbed Ming Hai's Burn the Heavens flame inside the Bottle Realm of Rain Celestial Emperor Qing Lin and awakened his Vermillion Bird inheritance.

clans.title: God Sect
clans.introText: A long time ago, there was only one sect in the rank 9 region of the Cloud Sea. It was the God Sect.
clans.history:
A long time ago, there was only one sect in the rank 9 region of the Cloud Sea. It was the God Sect.

After the God Sect had ruled the Cloud Sea for countless years, the first outbreak of fierce beasts occurred. Among them, there were three fierce beasts with human form that were said to have come from another star system.

Without the God Sect, this outbreak of fierce beasts would have spread across the entire Cloud Sea. In the end, it was stopped by the God Sect, so it didn’t spread. That war was said to have brought heavy casualties. After suppressing the fierce beasts, the God Sect sent out a group of people to be stationed in the depths of the rank 9 region. There is crack in space there that links to a mysterious star system. Some extremely powerful beasts came from there. In order to stop the fierce beasts from spreading, battles broke out there for tens of thousands of years. Even now, the fight continues.

A part of the God Sect gave up their freedom and remained deep within the rank 9 region, acting as the first line of defense. However, as time passed, these God Sect disciples became independent and started calling themselves the Demon Sect. They stopped taking orders from the God Sect, but they still defended that position from waves of fierce beast attacks.

The God Sect dreaded the Demon Sect and the invading fierce beasts so they first helped promote the Ghost Sect, who are good at using soul capture spells, into a rank 9 sect. Then they raised the Heaven Breaking Sect into rank 9 as well. All of this was to prepare for the second outbreak that could happen at any time.

clans.title: Great Soul Sect
clans.introText: Although there are rampant rumors that the Gui Yi Sect can overpower the Great Soul Sect, they are false as just Esteemed Green Bull, who is a Golden Exalt with an Essence True Body, alone is enough to fight off all of the Gui Yi Sect's ancestors even after they use their famed battle-armors.
clans.appearance:
The Great Soul Sect is located within a mountain range that seems to pierce the clouds. The mountain gives off a red light and looks like a burning mountain. Clear ripples echo throughout the mountain's surroundings. The ripples contain soul force with countless hidden figures letting out silent roars inside.

It is located near the Esteemed Green Bull's Green Heavenly Peak. It is one of the most heavily guarded locations of the sect where the sect's dao spells are kept. It has nine floors that each contain powerful spells; the sixth to ninth floor contains the sect's nine dao spells. Powerful dao spells such as Soul Fantasy Origin and True Soul Illusion have their complete versions kept on the eight and ninth floor, respectively.

Wang Lin reached the eight floor the first time he entered the pavilion. Although it was not an unprecedented feat, very few across the Great Soul Sect's long history managed to do it.

Before setting out for the Ancient Nation to fulfill his deal with Xuan Luo, Wang Lin returned to the Great Soul Sect to resolve the karma between him and the Great Soul Sect's Ancestor, who had used him to help free the Mourning-Death Clan from the Imperial Family's rule. Returning to the Soul Scripture Pavilion he ascended to the Tenth Floor where he discovered no divine spells, but the ancestor's corpse. To atone for scheming against him, Wang Lin saw that he had ripped out his own heart and brain as an apology, eventually dying whilst bowing before a statue of Wang Lin and offering them to him in penance. Moved, Wang Lin forgives him and the Mourning-Death Clan for incorporating him into their schemes.
clans.history:
The sect was built upon the mountain range that contains the main fire vein of the Heavenly Bull Continent. This allows the sect's disciples to effectively practice fire cultivation.

One of the sect's core disciple, Fan Shanmeng, married Su Dao. The sect endorsed this marriage due to Su Dao outstanding talent and took his little sect under its wings.

The sect also values Du Qing due to his rare Ethereal Essence, the Weight Essence. They took his Blue Dragon Sect under their wings and even gave him the position of an Outer Elder of the Great Soul Sect.
clans.trivia: Great Soul Sect's Old Ancestor Esteemed Green Bull has an Essence True Body which is considered to be one of the rarest and most valuable supplement for one's cultivation.

clans.title: Gui Yi Sect
clans.introText: They were the "outsiders" that had entered the Seven Dao Sect's Cave.
clans.history:
Wang Lin met Na Duo in the War God Shrine's Divine Path Cave. Except at the time, Na Duo was a corpse. So, Wang Lin took his storage bag and left. Sometime later, Na Duo woke up and chased after Wang Lin. Wang Lin willingly gave up the storage bag as Na Duo was much stronger than him at the time. Intrigued by Wang Lin's Ji Realm, Na Duo showed him his own Five-Colored Ji Realm and told him to come to Planet Five Elements if he ever had the time.

Throughout his years of cultivation, Wang Lin continuously came across places that had interacted with mysterious cultivators such as the Scatter Thunder Clan and the Moon Devourer Clan. Finally, he put it together that another faction aside from the Seven Dao Sect had entered the Cave World from the Immortal Astral Continent.

Just before he left to destroy the Outer Realm's Ancient Celestial Realm, he entered the Wind Celestial Realm with his avatar. There, he reunited with Lil Mosqi who led him to the spatial rift deep inside the Wind Celestial Realm. There, Wang Lin felt a familiar aura. Further ahead, he saw a door. He attempted to reach the door but was pushed back by some mysterious force so he threw Ye Me’s Blood Sword towards the door. It pierced through the door and allowed Wang Lin to completely feel the familiar aura which he realized to be the aura of the Immortal Astral Continent. He immediately realized that his speculation regarding the mysterious cultivators was correct and that they were indeed part of another sect from the Immortal Astral Continent. Wang Lin destroyed the spatial rift surrounding the door so that no one may be able to leave through it.

After destroying the Outer Realm's Ancient Celestial Realm and obtaining the Heavenly Dao, Wang Lin arrived at Planet Five Elements as he wished to gauge the full battle might of the outsiders to include them in his plans for hegemony. As soon as he entered the planet, he was pushed into the Five Element Formation. However, contrary to the thoughts of the Gui Yi Sect, it did not harm Wang Lin and instead helped him as it allowed him to gain a sliver of essence of the five elements especially water since he watched the Gui Yi Sect's Water General use a spell to condense water essence which allowed him to comprehend long enough to give birth to a water essence seed. All in all, this formation set the foundation for Wang Lin obtaining the five elements' essences.

Then, he was pushed into the Nine Cycle Heart Wheel Formation which almost caused Wang Lin's death before he figured out its secret. After escaping the formation, he employed it upon Planet Five Elements which resulted in deaths and severe injuries to all cultivators except the Ninth Ancestor who was saved by the fifth, sixth and seventh ancestors. However, even the four together could not stop Wang Lin from forcing out the rest of the ancestors from their tower. Suddenly, Yun Yifeng appeared to battle Wang Lin but the latter was too elusive and escaped his pursuit to land a punch upon the tower. However, he was stopped by the Dual-Elements Ancestor appearing from the third floor. Nevertheless, Wang Lin once again evaded him and finally landed a punch on the tower which awoke Ancestor Ma from the second floor. Unfazed by his aura, Wang Lin threw Ye Me’s Blood Sword towards the first floor and opened it ajar. Inside, he saw a set of deep black armor that most likely belonged to Ancestor Ma.

Despite being injured and inside enemy territory, Wang Lin did not panic. He summoned the Nether Beast which instantly terrified Ancestor Ma and everyone else present. He retrieved Ye Me’s Blood Sword and left the planet calmly. Right after Wang Lin left, Xuan Luo appeared and killed the Dual-Elements Ancestor for daring to insult the Ancient Clan.

Every Gui Yi Sect member there realized that they would not be able to gain anything now that Xuan Luo was protecting Wang Lin. Thus, they decided to ally with Wang Lin so as to gain some favor with Xuan Luo and Wang Lin who was almost certain to be a future overlord.

After Wang Lin opened the core of the Cave, every Celestial in the cave entered it. Inside one of the 300 Destroyed Worlds, Wang Lin defeated and subjugated the White Tiger General. He also captured the Gui Yi Sect's Fifth Ancestor. When Wang Lin entered the Fourth Flower among the Five Flowers Eight Doors, he was challenged to a duel by Yun Yifeng with the conditions of subjugation of the loser by the winner. Wang Lin won and gained Yun Yifeng's as a helper. Later, Ancestor Ma and the other ancestors of Gui Yi Sect helped to hold back Old Ghost Zhan, Vermillion Bird and Black Tortoise General, and the remnants of the Seven Dao sect while Wang Lin obtained Ye Mo's complete inheritance.

After Xuan Luo connected the cave to the Immortal Astral Continent, Wang Lin allowed the Gui Yi Sect members to return.

clans.title: Heaven Breaking Sect
clans.introText: 18,000 years ago in the Cloud Sea, the Heaven Breaking Sect was a rank 8 sect ready to move into the mighty rank 9 region. Two months before the move, they accidentally found a spatial crack which led to the Seven-Colored Realm. The Heaven Breaking Sect gathered large amounts of cultivators together to enter the crack, including elders that were at Heaven’s Blight. They broke their way through despite countless casualties.
clans.history: After hearing the news of the resurgence of the beast bone fragment and Sima Mo's inheritance jade, the current Ancestor of Heaven Breaking Sect sent Li Qian Mei to look for the person who found the beast bone fragment and the jade and bring them back to inherit the position of Head Disciple of the sect.

clans.title: Heavenly Fate Sect
clans.introText: The Heavenly Fate Sect has seven divisions that are differentiated by color: Purple, Cyan, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, and Red.

clans.title: Heavenly Jade Sect
clans.introText: While flying, Wang Lin’s eyes suddenly became serious as he looked into the distance. In the distance was a mountain that went into the clouds. It looked like a celestial mountain.

clans.title: Heng Yue Sect
clans.introText: Heng Yue Sect is the first sect Wang Lin joins at the start of the novel. In the end, the land of the Zheng Yue Sect was taken over by Xuan Dao Sect. Some disciples chose to join Xuan Dao Sect, while some chose to not to join and left.

clans.title: Immortal’s Path Sect
clans.introText: Located in the mountain that looked like a very long dragon

clans.title: Lou He Sect
clans.introText: Later, Huo Fen itself was invaded, which led to the collapse of the sect and the scattering of its surviving disciples. This is how Li Muwan came to Cloud Sky Sect.

clans.title: Origin Sect
clans.introText: The Origin Sect was a rank 5 sect in the Cloud Sea Star System and was the first sect Wang Lin came to when he escaped Tuo Sen on Planet Suzaku.The Origin Sect's Ancestor was on on his dying breath and told Lu Yanfei his  direct disciples that they need to find someone in the north with white hair.
clans.history:
When Wang Lin arrived in the north region of the Cloud Sea Star System. He saved some mortals and began living in their village as a doctor and a mortal. One day, the Origin Sect sent out people to recruit and scout out cultivator. An Origin Sect disciple named Zhao Yu came to the village Wang Lin was living in. The arrogant Zhao Yu made all the mortal villagers stand outside in the rain. When one of the villagers pleaded with Zhao Yu to let the children back inside because they could not stand the freezing rain, Zhao Yu was about to reprimand that cultivator when Wang Lin stepped in. With Wang Lin's powerful cultivation, Zhao Yu's eyes immediately became dull and Wang Lin had Zhao Yu lead him back to the Origin Sect.

At the Origin Sect, Wang Lin took the name of  Ceng Niu. No one in the sect could see through his cultivation and they all thought he was just a mere mortal. When Rudy and Song Wude came to the Origin Sect to take it over, Wang Lin kills them both and everyone witnesses it. Lu Yanfei and Xu Yun comes to Wang Lin's small house and confronts him. Being the wise and smart person, Lu Yangfei accurately guesses Wang Lin's situation and then gives him an identity as one of the Origin Sect's ancestors.

After Wang Lin executed Daoist Water, he made Mu Bingmei the Sect Master of God Sect and merged the Origin Sect with it.

clans.title: Purple Dao Sect
clans.introText: Over 3,000 years ago, Purple Dao Sect was a minor sect in the Rank 5 Region but today its one of the strongest sects there. This was all done due to the efforts of  Lu Yuncong.
clans.history:
Two elders and over a hundred disciples of Purple Dao Sect invaded the Alliance Star System while it was warring with the Allheaven Star System. They managed to lure over two dozen of Wang Lin's mosquito beasts into a trap but they were killed by a fuming Wang Lin, soon after.

Rudy, the young master of Purple Dao Sect, invaded the Origin Sect soon after its Ancestor passed away. He did so in an attempt to kidnap Lu Yanfei and use her as his cultivation furnace. However, he, along with his attendant, Song Wude, were killed by Wang Lin.

clans.title: Scarlet Soul Sect
clans.introText: The Scarlet Soul Sect is a new and very powerful sect that emerged in the Cave World during Wang Lin's absence a thousand years following the war between the Inner and Outer Realms.
clans.history:
After Master Scarlet Soul was released by Wang Lin from Ye Mo's seal during Wang Lin's battle with the Sovereign on the false Suzaku, Master Scarlet Soul hid himself for the duration of the war to regain his lost cultivation.

After Wang Lin left for the Immortal Astral Continent Master Scarlet Soul recruited a descendant of the Wang Clan, rumoured to be Wang Lin's own descendant, as a disciple and founded this sect.

He then launched an assault on the New Celestial Realm, hoping to use the blood essence of the Cave World's strongest Cultivators to break through to Golden Exalt. His disciple was later killed by Thirteen, who had recently arrived with the Half Heaven Trampling Wang Lin, Liu Jinbiao, Xu Liguo and the Golden Exalt Sea Dragon.

clans.title: School of Heaven
clans.introText: School of Heaven is a sect that only has mortals and doesn’t affect cultivators.

clans.title: Seven Dao Sect
clans.introText: It is affiliated to the Great Soul Sect, one of the Nine Sects and Thirteen Factions, who run the Heavenly Bull Continent alongside the Gui Yi Sect. They were the owners of the Cave World.
clans.history: Wang Lin encountered the recovering disciples of the Seven Dao Sect in the Ancient Celestial Realm after he overcame his final Divine Tribulation. He then fought against the White Tiger General and defeated him. The Azure Dragon General and Black Tortoise General attempted to sneak-attack him but Wang Lin pulled out Li Guang's Bow which forced the Vermilion Bird General to step in and negotiate. They made a deal that Wang Lin would seal the Outer Realm's Ancient Celestial Realm three years later while the Four Generals and the remaining 50 sect disciples would help him destroy the concubines and the Outer Realm's remaining forces.

clans.title: Slaughter Realm
clans.introText: The Slaughter Realm created their own world as their base. Countless years ago, the founder of the Slaughter Realm took over a crack left over from the collapsed Rain Celestial Realm. He also gathered lot of heavenly metal to create the 99 Heaven Raising Swords. These 99 Heaven Raising Swords became buildings unique to the Slaughter Realm.
clans.history:
The Slaughter Realm created their own world as their base. Countless years ago, the founder of the Slaughter Realm took over a crack left over from the collapsed Rain Celestial Realm. He also gathered lot of heavenly metal to create the 99 Heaven Raising Swords. These 99 Heaven Raising Swords became buildings unique to the Slaughter Realm.

In the Cultivation Alliance, the Slaughter Realm’s name is illustrious, and over the tens of thousands of years, it has completed countless exploits for the Cultivation Alliance. Whether it was the first battle against the Four Divine Sect or the later exchanges with the Corpse Sect, all of those conflicts had the shadow of the Slaughter Realm.

clans.title: Soul Refining Sect
clans.introText: “This was the first group of rank 5 cultivation countries. My Soul Refining Sect was one of them!”
clans.history:
Soul Refining Sect is a sect in the Rank 5 country of Pilu. The leader of the sect Dun Tian, a Peak Stage Soul Transformation cultivator. He took Wang Lin as his disciple and passed down Soul Refining Sect’s inheritance to him including the One-Billion-Soul Flag. They had three time opportunity to become Rank 6, but failed because of the suppression of the Rank 6 country of Suzaku. They come from Planet Four Saints and became a Rank 5 country after arriving at Planet Suzaku, they had 3 Ascendant cultivators at that time.

After receiving the One-Billion-Soul Soul Flag, Wang Lin had to promise Dun Tian to protect the Soul Refining Sect. If the sect were to be destroyed on Suzaku, Dun Tian hoped Wang Lin would revive the sect somewhere else. Dun Tian’s lifetime ultimate goal is for the sect to be a rank 6 sect or even higher. As long as the One-Billion Soul Flag still exists, there is a hope for the sect to always be revived.

When Wang Lin gets sent to the East Demon Spirit Sea, he founded a new tribe called Soul Refining Tribe and taught them the cultivation techniques of the Soul Refining Sect. By doing this, he becomes the new ancestor of the tribe. Wang Lin altered the soul refining spell a little bit, so that he had full control over all soul fragments. He did this partly to prevent the new sect from using their spells against him, but also so he can collect all soul fragments from them to revive the One-Billion-Soul Soul Flag.
clans.trivia: A long time ago, a disciple of the Soul Refining Sect betrayed the sect and escaped. Using Soul Poison Technique, he went unopposed in a Rank 4 cultivation country and made his own sect called the Demonic Pill Sect. This person used some mysterious method to refine the poisonous soul into a pill and then inject death aura into it to turn it into a green core. He called this the Green Core Method and this allowed him to reach the Soul Formation stage. He was considered a genius of his time. A green core and a golden core are very different. You can only have one golden core, but you can have many green cores. He used this method developed from the soul poison technique to reach the Soul Formation stage. He had tens of thousands of green cores at that point. When he attacked, he would send out thousands of green cores to explode. His power was something even Soul Transformation cultivators wouldn’t want to mess with carelessly.

clans.title: Tian Dao Sect
clans.introText: One of the Demonic Sect of Zhao, their demonic cultivation is around the Demonic Flame.
clans.history:
One of the Demonic Sect of Zhao, their demonic cultivation is around the Demonic Flame.

After 400 years, they were able to stay in the first-rank sect of Zhao, unlike Wu Feng Valley, Jie Mie Sect or the orthodox, apart from Xuan Dao Sect, who fell to second-rank.

clans.title: Treasured Jade Sect
clans.introText: Every 30 years, the Treasured Jade Sect holds an auction where comprehensive list of treasures, pills, pill recipes, and spirit beasts are up for sale.

clans.title: Vermillion Bird Divine Sect
clans.introText: During the war against the Cultivation Alliance and the Brilliant Void Cultivation Sect, the Azure Dragon Divine Sect's Emperor disappeared; the Black Tortoise Divine Sect's Emperor turned traitor; and the White Tiger Divine Sect's Emperor died in battle. Only the Vermillion Bird Divine Sect's Emperor survived.
clans.history:
Vermillion Bird Divine Sect came out of seclusion when Wang Lin achieved first awakening of his Vermillion Bird mark. Lu Yun sent six elders and most of the second step cultivators to the East Demon Spirit Sea to escort Wang Lin back to the sect, safely.

When Wang Lin achieved second awakening of his Vermillion Bird mark, Lu Yun personally went in his origin soul form to escort Wang Lin back to the sect, safely. Along the way, he even brought along the elders of the three other divine sects and the Holy Weapons of the three other divine sects.

After Wang Lin was safely back at the Holy Vermillion Bird Planet, Lu Yun had him absorb fire origin energy from the Vermillion Bird Holy Weapon along with his own origin energy for three years. This allowed him to achieve the first of the Nine Mysterious Transformations which is something each Vermillion Bird Divine Emperor is required to achieve to be crowned.

clans.title: War God Shrine Sect
clans.introText: War God Shrine is a sect in the Rank 3 country of Hou Fen. It is famous because their ancestor found the Divine Path Technique that create an Avatar to help cultivators breakthrough to Nascent Soul Stage. The sect has six Nascent Soul Stage cultivators.
